title: Account Development Representative - France
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the Role

As an Account Development Representative (ADR) at Samsara, you will be trained — both on the job and through formal programs led by a world-class Sales team — to take on your next role as a closing Account Executive.

On a daily basis, you will build and work a portfolio of target accounts for our EMEA business in France: researching each account for commercial signal, prioritising which contacts to approach and in what order, and running a connected, multi-touch outbound motion that generates qualified pipeline rather than one-off meetings.

This is a remote position open to candidates based in France and the United Kingdom. This position requires working hours in CET. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: your efforts will result in real-world impact — helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: if you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. Successful ADRs can see promotion to a closing role in two years or less.
  • You're excited by AI: you'll use cutting-edge AI tools every day and sell some of the most advanced AI in the physical operations space.
  • You think several moves ahead: you'd rather build a real relationship across an account than force a single contact to a decision they're not ready to make.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: one day you'll be researching a transport operator, the next a food distribution centre. Our best reps dig into the businesses they support to make a sharper case for why Samsara matters to them specifically.
  • You treat rejection as a learning experience: in this role you will get hung up on and told no. You need the resilience to prepare, call again, and adjust.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance Sales culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go further than you have before.

In this role, you will:

  • Research target accounts before outreach — pulling commercial signal out of public information (financials, news, hiring activity, compliance or safety pressure) to build a specific, defensible point of view on where Samsara adds value.
  • Build and prioritise an account-level contact plan, identifying who to approach first across a range of stakeholders (e.g. MD, Operations/Transport Manager, Compliance/H&S, Finance) and being able to justify that choice.
  • Run a connected, multi-touch outbound motion across phone, email and LinkedIn — using early conversations to gather information and multi-thread the account, not just to book a meeting at any cost.
  • Write personalised, researched outreach (including cold emails) that carries a specific point of view into every call, rather than working from a generic script.
  • Read what a contact gives you on the call and adapt in real time — including recognising when the right move is to gather information and position a follow-up with someone else, rather than push for a meeting the contact can't actually commit to.
  • Keep meticulous account and contact records in Salesforce.
  • Become a product expert and represent the Samsara brand at trade shows and events.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 1–3 years professional experience, ideally in customer-facing roles
  • 6–12 months experience in a sales or equivalent target driven role
  • Highly motivated and committed, with a strong desire to work in target-driven sales
  • Proven track record of consistently meeting or exceeding targets in previous roles
  • Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written
  • Curious, and able to ask insightful questions
  • A champion of a Growth Mindset
  • Highly proficient in English and fluent in French
  • AI literacy and ability to showcase examples of leveraging AI in your work

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Comfort turning unstructured information (an annual report, a website, a news article) into a clear commercial argument
  • Experience multi-threading or navigating multiple stakeholders within a single sale
  • A genuine willingness to prepare — to research and write — before a call, rather than relying on improvising well under pressure
  • Experience in closing-sales roles or similar target driven environment
  • A proven track record of achievement beyond work (e.g. academics, sports, charity)
  • Willingness to collaborate and influence in a "win as a team" environment
  • Excitement about solving new problems in innovative ways
  • Motivation to help build a fast-growing business in the IoT and SaaS space.

ADR pathways

Through Samsara's ADR program, there are always opportunities to move to the next level and take on more responsibility. With emphasis on continued professional development, training doesn't stop after onboarding — we provide opportunities to expand ADRs' understanding of the market and competitors, develop hard skills, and work with mentors to progress through three levels:

  • ADR I — focus on inbound leads: a high volume of conversations, sharing the ins and outs of our products, and fostering relationships with interested prospects. Learning opportunities include call sessions with senior Sales team members, tool training (Salesforce, Salesloft, Lusha), product knowledge, and objection handling.
  • ADR II — work on top-of-funnel movement, creating high-quality sales engagements, and supporting Account Executives. Enrolled in specialised training including professional writing, persona-based messaging, cold calling 2.0, and AE collaboration.
  • ADR III — work hand-in-hand with field Account Executives and Enterprise Regional Sales Managers. Partner on large accounts, implement territory plans, join weekly strategy meetings, and schedule/attend customer demos, alongside a mentorship program ahead of an AE interview.

Please submit an English CV with your application.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

title: Account Director (Network Testing & Planning)
descriptionHtml:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Account Director (Network Testing & Planning) based in the United Kingdom.

We are seeking an experienced Account Director to drive revenue growth and expand strategic customer relationships across the UK, Ireland, and selected major European accounts. In this senior commercial role, you will lead sales strategy and business development for a portfolio of mobile network testing, planning, and optimisation solutions. You will be responsible for growing existing accounts, securing new customers, and building a sustainable pipeline across the telecommunications ecosystem. Working closely with technical, marketing, product, and sales teams, you will develop compelling value propositions and deliver solutions that address complex customer challenges. You will engage with mobile network operators, service providers, infrastructure companies, and other key industry stakeholders. This is an exciting opportunity to influence the evolution of next-generation networks, including 5G, IoT, and emerging connectivity technologies, within a collaborative and globally distributed environment.


Accountabilities:
  • Take full ownership of territory revenue targets, sales pipeline development, and forecasting across the UK, Ireland, and assigned strategic European accounts.
  • Develop and execute comprehensive territory and account plans aligned with business growth objectives and commercial priorities.
  • Expand existing strategic customer relationships through account penetration, upselling, cross-selling, and the development of new business opportunities.
  • Identify, prospect, and acquire new customers across the mobile network testing, planning, optimisation, and broader telecommunications ecosystem.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with senior commercial, technical, and operational stakeholders within target accounts.
  • Understand customer business objectives, technical challenges, and operational requirements, translating them into compelling commercial opportunities and tailored value propositions.
  • Develop robust business cases demonstrating measurable customer benefits, supporting larger-scale engagements and long-term partnerships.
  • Manage the complete sales lifecycle, from prospecting, qualification, and discovery through solution development, proposal preparation, negotiation, and contract closure.
  • Identify competitive displacement opportunities and position alternative network testing and planning solutions to increase market share.
  • Explore new market segments and addressable opportunities, including private networks, neutral hosts, infrastructure providers, engineering service companies, and adjacent telecommunications markets.
  • Develop and leverage strategic partnerships and channel relationships to strengthen market coverage and create additional routes to market.
  • Collaborate with Solution Engineering teams on technical qualification, product demonstrations, customer evaluations, and proof-of-concept (PoC) initiatives.
  • Work closely with Inside Sales and Demand Generation teams to identify target accounts, generate qualified leads, build pipeline, and accelerate sales opportunities.
  • Maintain accurate CRM records, ensuring clear visibility of opportunity status, pipeline coverage, customer engagement, next steps, and revenue forecasts.
  • Apply disciplined sales methodologies and opportunity qualification processes to ensure predictable growth and consistent commercial performance.
  • Strengthen customer and partner relationships to generate repeat business, increase engagement value, and establish sustainable revenue streams.

    • Requirements:

  • Demonstrated success in B2B technology sales, with a proven track record of managing and achieving revenue targets and sales quotas.
  • Significant experience selling to telecommunications operators, network equipment vendors, or organisations operating within the broader mobile network ecosystem.
  • Strong understanding of mobile network technologies and the processes involved in planning, deploying, testing, optimising, and operating mobile networks.
  • Proven ability to develop existing strategic accounts while successfully identifying and acquiring new customers.
  • Experience managing complex, consultative sales cycles involving multiple commercial, technical, and operational stakeholders.
  • Excellent account planning, business development, opportunity qualification, negotiation, and closing capabilities.
  • Strong commercial acumen and the ability to build compelling business cases, demonstrating measurable customer value beyond product features or pricing.
  • Experience working closely with technical presales and solution engineering teams while maintaining ownership of commercial strategy and sales outcomes.
  • Strong pipeline management, revenue forecasting, CRM discipline, and sales performance reporting skills.
  • Ability to work autonomously across a geographically distributed territory while collaborating effectively within an international organisation.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to influence senior decision-makers and build trusted customer relationships.
  • Previous experience in network testing, drive testing, network planning, RF optimisation, network performance, or related telecommunications software and solutions would be a significant advantage.
  • Experience gained within telecom software providers, network equipment manufacturers, test and measurement companies, engineering consultancies, service organisations, or technology suppliers serving mobile network operators is particularly relevant.
  • Knowledge of the competitive landscape for network testing, planning, and optimisation solutions would be highly desirable.
  • A proactive, results-oriented, and entrepreneurial mindset, with strong relationship-building skills and the ability to identify and pursue new commercial opportunities.

    • Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation package and benefits.
  • Fully remote working arrangement within the UK.
  • Flexible working hours and adaptable working locations.
  • Inclusive and collaborative international working environment that values diverse perspectives.
  • Opportunities to contribute to innovative technologies shaping next-generation telecommunications networks.
  • Career development opportunities and structured professional growth plans.
  • Access to a global network of experienced professionals across multiple countries and technical disciplines.
  • Commitment to sustainability through environmental, social, and governance (ESG) initiatives.
  • A workplace culture built around transparency, innovation, integrity, collaboration, and employee well-being.

title: Account Executive, Affiliate Marketing
descriptionHtml:
Position: Account Specialist, Affiliate Marketing  

The Account Specialist position is a remote, work-from-home role, as are all positions at Acceleration Partners (a structure central to our culture and vision to change the work/life paradigm). Some travel may be required for client meetings, internal meetings, conferences, and other events. Please note: This role requires fluency in both German and English.

The Role:  

As an Account Specialist, you will be responsible for the day-to-day operations of multiple affiliate programs. The ideal candidate will have 1-2 years of work experience. Affiliate marketing experience is not required. You will manage affiliate communications, reporting, and general account maintenance, including recruitment, newsletters, fraud checks, and data analysis. You’ll work closely with your manager and peers to maximize program effectiveness and create opportunities for growth. Duties are performed across one or more assigned client accounts, which will vary over time.

Top 5 Responsibilities:  

  • Account & Client Communication  
    Build and maintain client and affiliate communications, including creative newsletters and updates about promotions, program developments, and general client information. Develop relationships with clients and partners to understand their goals and objectives, providing clear and proactive communication across channels.  
  • Reporting & Data Management  
    Utilize Excel (pivot tables, v-lookups, etc.) to produce detailed reports, track performance, and analyze data for insights and trends. Summarize findings and provide actionable recommendations to optimize program performance. Proactively track key metrics and report on campaign performance.  
  • Strategy Execution & Task Ownership  
    Own and manage client tasks with minimal supervision, ensuring deadlines are met and tasks are completed accurately. Prioritize tasks effectively, flagging any potential delays and keeping the team informed. Consistently leverage tools and client tracking platforms to support program goals.  
  • Program & Portfolio Management  
    Manage multiple affiliate campaigns, maintaining a balanced focus across each, and organizing tasks by priority. Identify areas for process improvement, and provide proactive support to peers and clients. Manage risks, track fraud, and ensure compliance with program terms and conditions.  
  • Team Collaboration & Growth  
    Collaborate with peers and management to contribute ideas for process improvements and training. Serve as a resource for peers and help drive continuous improvement across the team, sharing best practices and insights.  

What Success Looks Like:  

By 6 Months:  

  • You will be proficient in the day-to-day operations of multiple affiliate programs, including managing reporting, affiliate applications, recruitment, and creative asset deployment.  
  • You will regularly present new campaign ideas to managers and demonstrate a clear understanding of program performance, ensuring regular fraud checks and compliance.  
  • You will have developed strong relationships with clients and affiliates and will be able to execute tasks with minimal guidance.  

By 1 Year:  

  • You will troubleshoot and resolve account and affiliate issues independently, providing valuable insights and actionable recommendations to clients and internal teams.  
  • You will be an integral part of each program, developing new ideas and improving processes to create efficiencies.  
  • You will take on new account responsibilities with support from your manager and serve as a thought leader within the team, contributing to relationship-building and firm development.  

Qualities of the Ideal Candidate  

  • Strong sense of curiosity  
  • Critical thinker  
  • Confident and comfortable being uncomfortable  
  • Flexible, resilient, coachable  
  • Relationship and service oriented  
  • Proactive and outcome oriented  
  • Strong work ethic and personal standards  

Qualifications & Skills:  

  • Fluency in German
  • 1-2 years of experience- background in online marketing, e-commerce, or affiliate marketing beneficial.  
  • Familiarity with affiliate networks and SaaS platforms (e.g., ShareASale, Commission Junction, Impact) is a plus.  
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience.  
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel (v-lookups, pivot tables, formatting, etc.).  
  • Knowledge of HTML is a plus.  
  • Ability to travel when necessary for conferences and team meetings.  

WHY ACCELERATION PARTNERS?  

Acceleration Partners is the world’s largest and first-to-market Partnership Marketing Agency creating and nurturing partnerships that drive exceptional measurable outcomes for their clients. Managing clients in 40+ countries, their global team of 300+ focuses on data-driven strategies that help connect brands to the right consumers through performance partnerships, traditional affiliate, influencer, performance PR, content and B2B partnership marketing.   

AP Perks & Benefits - What we offer  

  • 100% remote work for everyone  
  • Unlimited Paid Time Off  
  • Summer & Holiday Wellness Breaks in July and December  
  • Volunteer and Birthday Time Off  
  • Focus Fridays (no internal meetings)  
  • Paid Parental Leave Benefits  
  • Wellness, Technology & Education Allowance  
  • Paid sabbatical leaves, donation matching, and more!!  
  • Target salary range: £27–37K depending on location and experience  

Benefits may vary based on employment status or country location.  

Acceleration Partners is committed to a diverse workforce and we are an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate applicants regardless of an individual's age, race, color, gender, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, disability, or veteran status.

title: Account Executive, Enterprise
descriptionHtml:
About Flexport: 

At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year. 

The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

Build and grow with us! Join Flexport Germany as an Account Executive and supercharge your career!

The opportunity:

The Enterprise Account Executive (ENT) is responsible for driving complex, high-value enterprise deals and establishing long-term strategic partnerships with large customers. This role owns advanced, multi-stakeholder sales cycles that often span regions, business units, and decision layers. The ENT AE operates with a high degree of autonomy, shaping deal strategy, influencing executive stakeholders, and orchestrating cross-functional teams to deliver differentiated, value-driven solutions.

Your responsibilities as an Account Executive, ENT include, but are not limited to the following:

Pipeline & Opportunity Ownership

  • Own and close high-value, complex enterprise opportunities, consistently meeting or exceeding individual quotas.
  • Build a strategic pipeline through self-prospecting, account planning, and SDR partnership.
  • Proactively identify whitespace, expansion potential, and multi-entity opportunities within target accounts.
  • Maintain forecasting, opportunity hygiene, and deal governance in Salesforce (SFDC).

Strategic Discovery & Solution Architecture

  • Lead executive-level discovery to understand enterprise supply chain strategy, risk posture, and long-term business objectives.
  • Navigate complex buying groups across procurement, ops, finance, IT, and senior leadership.
  • Design integrated, multi-product Flexport solutions aligned to customer priorities and business outcomes.
  • Position Flexport as a strategic partner through compelling value narratives, business cases, and solution roadmaps.

Deal Strategy, Negotiation & Closing

  • Own end-to-end deal strategy for complex opportunities, including stakeholder mapping, decision criteria, and close plans.
  • Lead advanced commercial negotiation, pricing, contracts, and non-standard deal structures.
  • Orchestrate internal stakeholders (Ops, Finance, Legal, Product) to progress deals efficiently

Onboarding, Expansion & Relationship Leadership

  • Own the onboarding motion, ensuring enterprise customers are set up for scalable success.
  • Establish and maintain trusted relationships with senior and executive customer stakeholders.
  • Identify expansion opportunities together with Account Management to drive sustained growth.
  • Serve as a point of escalation and strategic advisor during the customer lifecycle.

Enterprise Leadership & Market Impact

  • Act as a senior commercial voice in enterprise pursuits, sharing market insight and customer feedback internally.
  • Contribute to enterprise sales best practices, deal reviews, and peer coaching.
  • Represent Flexport with credibility and confidence in high-stakes customer interactions.

You should have:

  • 5+ years of experience managing complex, enterprise-level sales cycles with consistent quota attainment.
  • Proven ability to close large, multi-stakeholder deals with long sales cycles and high deal complexity.
  • Strong executive presence with the ability to influence senior decision-makers.
  • Advanced discovery, negotiation, and value-based selling skills.
  • High degree of autonomy, strategic thinking, and commercial judgment.
  • Strong logistics, freight forwarding, or supply chain industry experience preferred.
  • Intermediate in English; additional languages are a plus depending on region.

We kindly ask our candidates to apply with a CV in English! 

What's in there for you: 

  • An opportunity to contribute to one of the fastest-growing companies, where you’ll have the chance to create a global impact while being a part of a  thriving multinational environment 
  • Lunch food delivery 4 days a week incl. vegetarian options, a salad bar and special menu options, plus breakfast options, snacks, soft drinks and barista coffee.
  • Health insurance:  employee contribution part is covered by Flexport
  • 25 paid vacation days 
  • Equity program: every team member becomes a shareholder, aligning our success with yours. As a private company in a multi-trillion dollar industry, you have a direct stake in our collective growth and success.
  • Employee Assistance Program through Aetna Resources for Living: Flexport provides an employer-sponsored program at no cost to you and your household members
  • Parental leave benefit: Flexport is here to support you and your families in one of the most important times in life – the birth of a child! Our parental leave program allows both mothers and partners to take time off from work for pregnancy, childbirth, and to bond with your new child. 
  • Monthly reimbursement of mobile phone expenses.
  • Car allowance: Flexport offers its sales team a monthly car allowance, allowing you to rent or lease a vehicle for both personal and professional use. This approach provides you flexibility and personalization, letting you choose a car that suits your needs.

  • Opportunités au sein du groupe à terme (France, Allemagne, Italie, Pays-Bas, UK)

Les qualités attendues en tant que Commercial.e B2B

Avant de poursuivre votre lecture, si vous n'avez pas le profil exact décrit ci-dessous, mais que vous pensez que cette description de poste correspond à vos compétences et à vos besoins, nous vous encourageons tout de même à postuler.

Vous pourrez être le prochain membre de notre équipe si vous :

  • 2+ ans d'expérience en vente B2B SaaS ou health tech (un plus)

  • Prospection outbound confirmée et appétence pour la chasse

  • À l'aise avec des interlocuteurs variés (médecins généralistes, spécialistes, chirurgiens, direction d'établissement)

title: Accountmanager Bouw - Waterdichting
descriptionHtml:
Nederland

Een commerciële buitendienstfunctie waarin jij zelf een markt opbouwt, met de slagkracht van een internationale producent achter je. Bij IKO krijg je de vrijheid om jouw eigen commerciële koers te bepalen, hoogwaardige technische oplossingen te verkopen en zichtbaar bij te dragen aan groei. Een zelfstandige baan voor een ondernemende accountmanager die kansen ziet én benut!

Maak het verschil als Accountmanager Bouw en Techniek in Nederland

Dankzij jouw commerciële daadkracht groeit IKO's positie in de Nederlandse markt voor vloeibare waterdichting. Je ontwikkelt zelfstandig nieuwe klantrelaties en brengt hoogwaardige oplossingen onder de aandacht bij onder andere aannemers, voorschrijvers, woningcorporaties en vastgoedbeheerders. Denk aan waterdichtingstoepassingen voor balkons, galerijen, parkeerdaken en -dekken, dakdetails en brugdekken. Je onderzoekt de markt, signaleert bouw- en renovatieprojecten en weet op het juiste moment de juiste gesprekspartners te bereiken. Daarbij verkoop je op technische meerwaarde en bouw je aan langdurige samenwerkingen. Je start met een kleine bestaande klantenportefeuille en richt je aanvankelijk op new business om jouw portefeuille verder uit te breiden. Je bent regelmatig onderweg naar klanten en projecten, werkt verder regelmatig vanuit huis en bent uiteraard welkom op het kantoor in Klundert. Je schakelt met jouw Nederlandse en Belgische salescollega's en technische specialisten.

Kortom, jij pakt de regie bij het:

  • zelfstandig ontwikkelen van de Nederlandse markt voor vloeibare waterdichting;

  • actief benaderen van nieuwe klanten, waaronder aannemers, voorschrijvers en andere potentiële opdrachtgevers;

  • signaleren en opvolgen van commerciële kansen binnen bouw-, renovatie- en infrastructurele projecten;

  • adviseren over hoogwaardige technische oplossingen en opbouwen van duurzame klantrelaties;

  • ontwikkelen van een sterke salespipeline en zorgvuldig vastleggen van commerciële activiteiten in Salesforce (CRM).

Als gedreven Accountmanager Bouw en Techniek kun jij rekenen op:

Een zelfstandige commerciële functie bij een internationaal familiebedrijf waar ondernemerschap en eigen initiatief worden gewaardeerd. IKO biedt je de ruimte om jouw markt te ontwikkelen, ondersteund door ervaren collega's en technische specialisten. Tijdens jouw inwerkperiode leer je bovendien van het Belgische salesteam.

Op basis van een fulltime dienstverband krijg je daarbovenop:

  • een salaris tot € 5.500,- bruto per maand, afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring;

  • een bonusregeling tot 10% van jouw jaarsalaris;

  • 25 vakantiedagen + 12 ATV dagen;

  • een auto, laptop en telefoon van de zaak;

  • een pensioenregeling volgens Hibin;

  • veel vrijheid om jouw eigen agenda en commerciële activiteiten te organiseren;

  • de mogelijkheid om regelmatig vanuit huis te werken;

  • toegang tot kennis en expertise binnen een internationale organisatie.

Voor deze vacature neem jij mee:

Jij krijgt energie van het openen van deuren en het ontwikkelen van nieuwe commerciële kansen. Je neemt initiatief, werkt gestructureerd en houdt koers tijdens langdurige verkooptrajecten. Met jouw nieuwsgierigheid en technische interesse achterhaal je de werkelijke klantbehoefte. Je schakelt gemakkelijk tussen verschillende gesprekspartners, van uitvoerende aannemers tot technisch adviseurs, en weet hen met inhoudelijke argumenten te overtuigen.

Vink jij deze checklist ook af?

  • mbo+/hbo werk- en denkniveau;

  • minimaal 3 tot 5 jaar commerciële buitendienstervaring, bij voorkeur als accountmanager of technisch-commercieel adviseur;

  • aantoonbare ervaring met directe verkoop aan aannemers en actieve acquisitie;

  • technische affiniteit, bij voorkeur met bouwproducten, waterdichting, coatings of infrastructurele toepassingen;

  • ervaring met CRM-systemen, bij voorkeur Salesforce, en goede kennis van Excel.

Jouw werkgebied

Jouw werkgebied beslaat heel Nederland, met een focusgebied in de driehoek Rotterdam, Utrecht en Amsterdam. Je werkt veel vanuit huis en bezoekt zelfstandig klanten, prospects en projecten. Je deelt jouw agenda grotendeels zelf in en stemt afspraken af op de commerciële kansen in jouw regio. Regelmatig heb je contact met collega's op de Nederlandse vestiging in Klundert. Voor trainingen en salesmeetings bezoek je incidenteel het Europese hoofdkantoor in Antwerpen.

Werken bij IKO

IKO is een internationaal familiebedrijf en producent van hoogwaardige dakbedekkings-, isolatie- en waterdichtingsoplossingen. Ze zijn marktleider en staan voor kwaliteit. Met circa 4.000 medewerkers wereldwijd levert de organisatie technische producten voor uiteenlopende bouw- en infrastructuurprojecten.

Binnen de productgroep IKO flexia ligt de focus op vloeibare waterdichting voor specialistische toepassingen, binnen dit segment zijn wij op zoek naar een nieuwe collega.

De organisatie is actief in meer dan 40 landen en heeft haar Europese hoofdkantoor in Antwerpen. IKO werd in 1951 opgericht in Canada en is nog altijd een echt familiebedrijf. De cultuur is nuchter, lean en hands-on: een ‘doe’-mentaliteit met veel vrijheid, eigen verantwoordelijkheid en korte lijnen.

You will sit between AI engineering and security. You will design the guardrails, attack the systems yourself, and build the governance controls that let the business deploy agents with confidence.

Requirements

  • 5+ years in security engineering (AppSec, cloud security, IAM or offensive security), with at least 1 year securing LLM or agent-based systems
  • Hands-on knowledge of LLM attack techniques: prompt injection, jailbreaks, data exfiltration via tools, RAG poisoning
  • Experience designing identity and access controls: OAuth 2.0 / OIDC, token exchange, workload identity, secrets management
  • Working knowledge of agent frameworks and protocols such as LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK, CrewAI or Model Context Protocol (MCP)
  • Strong coding skills in Python, plus one of Go, TypeScript or Rust
  • Cloud security on AWS, Azure or GCP, including logging, detection and policy-as-code (e.g. OPA / Cedar)
  • Ability to explain AI risk clearly to engineers, risk teams and executives

Mit wem du arbeitest

Henning hat bei Tchibo als Head of AI Engineering & Platform die AI-Transformation vorangetrieben. Mit GPT-1 hat er schon unlustige Witze-Bots gebaut, als noch niemand Sprachmodelle kannte. Als studierter Statistiker hat er sogar manchmal Ahnung, wovon er redet.

title: AI Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Apollo, a Skyward Group company, is an innovation-inspired insurance platform operating at Lloyd’s of London, delivering data-driven and creative solutions across a broad range of risks.

Our name reflects our origins. Inspired by one of our founding investors, Neil Armstrong, the first person to walk on the moon, the business was built with the same pioneering mindset. Alongside Jim Hays, Neil set out to create a different kind of Lloyd’s platform, focused, agile and built around people.

Since launch in 2009, we have grown into a diversified insurance group offering products across Property, Casualty, Marine, Energy and Transportation, Specialty and Reinsurance, alongside Smart Follow and digital and embedded risk programmes. Our experience and unique ecosystem give Platform Partners the best chance of success, from navigating the Lloyd’s new entrant process through to the delivery of their long-term strategy.

With a team of more than 300 professionals, we continue to grow with purpose, combining underwriting excellence, innovation and collaboration to enable a more resilient and sustainable world.

Your Role

We are growing how we use AI across underwriting, operations and colleague-facing products and are looking for an AI Engineer to join our Digital Solutions team.

This is a hands-on software engineering role where you will build AI-enabled applications and services that solve real business problems. You will take defined features from an initial idea through design, development and testing into production, then remain accountable for how they perform and improve in live use.

You will have room to make day-to-day technical decisions and independently own your work, while collaborating with Product, Engineering, Data and other technical specialists where needed.

What you'll do

  • Build and integrate AI-enabled applications, services and features using approved models, APIs and enterprise data.
  • Work with Product colleagues to understand the problem first, then determine where AI can genuinely deliver a useful outcome.
  • Apply techniques such as retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), assistants and agents, prompt and context engineering, workflow orchestration and safe tool or function calling where appropriate.
  • Write clean, maintainable and testable code supported by automated testing and AI evaluation.
  • Evaluate AI behaviour including effectiveness, groundedness, reliability, safety, performance and cost.
  • Build appropriate guardrails, access controls and human oversight into the solutions you develop.
  • Take your work through deployment into production, monitoring performance, diagnosing issues and improving reliability based on live operational evidence.
  • Manage changes to prompts, retrieval configurations, models and application components safely.
  • Contribute to code reviews, technical discussions and reusable AI engineering practices across the team.

What we are looking for

  • Strong software engineering skills using Python, C# or a comparable language, including maintainable code, automated testing, APIs and CI/CD.
  • Evidence of taking an application, service or significant feature from idea through development and deployment into production, with responsibility for supporting and improving it afterwards.
  • Hands-on experience building applications using large language models and APIs, with practical depth in areas such as RAG, prompt and context engineering, orchestration or tool calling.
  • An understanding of retrieval, embeddings and vector search, alongside a systematic approach to evaluating how AI applications behave.
  • Experience troubleshooting applications or services in production and an understanding of reliability, data access, privacy and security considerations.
  • The ability to independently own a defined feature or component and make sound technical decisions within established engineering standards.
  • A pragmatic, product-minded approach. You will be interested in solving the underlying business problem rather than using AI for its own sake.
  • Experience with Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, vector databases, AI observability or similar technologies would be beneficial, but you do not need experience across every area.
  • Experience applying AI within financial services, insurance or another regulated environment would also be beneficial.

What you’ll get in return

We offer a competitive and thoughtfully designed reward package that reflects the value of our people. This includes a fair and attractive salary, discretionary bonus, and a comprehensive benefits package - including 31 days’ annual leave, a non-contributory pension and private medical insurance.

Our commitment to inclusion

At Apollo, people are at the heart of everything we do. We are a diverse, growing team of empowered experts who bring collaboration, innovation and data-driven thinking to every relationship and every risk.

We believe diversity and inclusion go far beyond targets. They are essential to understanding the global communities we serve and to making better decisions. That’s why we are committed to developing diverse talent at every level and creating an environment where different perspectives are genuinely valued, supported and celebrated.

We also run a programme of events, training and initiatives designed to recognise both the challenges and opportunities that come with building an inclusive workplace.

Hybrid & flexible working

Flexible and hybrid working are fully embraced at Apollo. We do not believe in presenteeism. Instead, we trust our people to work in ways that allow them to perform at their best, balancing professional responsibilities with personal commitments.

Supporting your application

Apollo is committed to creating an inclusive recruitment experience where every candidate feels supported and able to perform at their best.

To help us do this, we invite you to complete a confidential ClearTalents profile. It takes just a few minutes and allows you to share any adjustments that may support you during the recruitment process.

Your information remains private, and the recruitment team is only notified if an adjustment is requested. Please register to create your profile here: ClearTalents

title: AI Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Alassio recherche son (sa) prochain(e) AI Engineer !

  

Missions

 

🏗️ Alassio en quelques mots

En France, la paie et le social comptent parmi les fonctions les plus réglementées qui soient. Entre inflation réglementaire et évolutions légales et conventionnelles incessantes, la conformité est devenue un véritable fardeau pour les cabinets de paie et les services RH :

  • ce fardeau les empêche de se consacrer à ce qui compte vraiment, le conseil et l'accompagnement des salariés, qui en subissent donc eux aussi le poids

  • c'est aussi l'un des métiers où l'attrition est la plus forte en France, notamment parce que 60 % du temps des gestionnaires de paie est encore consacré à de la saisie ou à de la relecture manuelle

Pourtant, des solutions technologiques majeures existent : l'IA permet en particulier d'automatiser une très grande partie des tâches les plus pénibles et de valoriser les données sociales. Mais le secteur reste largement à l'écart de cette révolution, et le problème n'est pas seulement réglementaire : le marché était verrouillé par des éditeurs historiques vieillissants, difficiles à quitter faute d'alternative crédible et de moyens pour migrer efficacement. Là aussi, l'IA fait voler ces barrières en éclats et ouvre la voie à une vague d'innovation attendue depuis des décennies.

C'est pour y répondre qu'Alassio construit la plateforme de paie et de gestion RH moderne qui manquait à ce marché, au service des cabinets et de leurs clients TPE/PME. Notre ambition est de développer en un temps record :

  • une plateforme collaborative et ouverte, qui s'intègre nativement aux outils des cabinets et de leurs clients, respecte leurs habitudes de travail et fluidifie les échanges entre gestionnaires de paie et entreprises

  • l'automatisation de la tenue administrative : collecte des données, paramétrage des évolutions légales et des règles propres à chaque entreprise, génération automatique des rapports et formulaires, traçabilité juridique dynamique et en temps réel, etc.

  • la valorisation des données de paie et sociales, pour offrir un conseil social à 360° et enfin répondre efficacement à l'ensemble des attentes des salariés, qui se sont de surcroît largement amplifiées depuis le Covid : gestion contractuelle, pilotage de la masse salariale, avantages salariés, fidélisation des talents, mutuelle…

L'objectif : devenir le « People OS » sur lequel les cabinets et leurs clients TPE/PME s'appuient pour gérer l'intégralité de leurs problématiques paie et RH.

 

🚀 Tes responsabilités

Ta mission : faire de l'IA le levier qui démultiplie le travail de chacun chez Alassio. L'objectif est assumé : multiplier par 10 la productivité de chaque membre de l'équipe.

  • Tu formes la Growth squad avec notre Founding Strategy & Operations : ce binôme transverse optimise l'existant, automatise les workflows de toutes les équipes et fait passer nos initiatives IA et nos outils internes à l'échelle : hébergement et mise en production dans des environnements partagés, sécurité, observabilité, optimisation et amélioration continue

  • Tu deviens le (la) référent(e) IA d'Alassio : on se veut profondément AI-native et on expérimente énormément. Tu centralises et coordonnes ces initiatives pour que ce "lab interne" soit efficace, et tu expérimentes aussi en continu avec toutes les techno IA (budget et outillage conséquents)

  • Tu construis la nouvelle colonne vertébrale IT d'Alassio, en identifiant les systèmes IA qui comptent à l'échelle de toute l'entreprise

  • Tu prépares l'avenir du produit : à terme, les usages testés et éprouvés en interne sous ton impulsion ont vocation à rejoindre notre plateforme. Ils nourriront le « People OS » qui démocratise les cas d'usage les plus pertinents de l'IA dans notre secteur

 

🧭 Tes premiers chantiers

Ton point de départ : Bedrock, notre OS interne. Un peu à la manière de Palantir Foundry, il agrège & orchestre tout le contexte de l'entreprise pour en tirer des actions concrètes : suivi ultra-personnalisé et automatisé de nos utilisateurs, analyse produit, documentation, rédaction de tickets et PR associées…

Bedrock est déjà au cœur du quotidien de toutes les équipes. Mais il s'est construit par couches successives, au fil des cas d'usage ajoutés. Ton premier objectif est d'en dresser l'inventaire complet, process et outils IA compris. Tu définis ensuite la roadmap qui le fera changer de dimension :

  • Workflows : optimiser l'existant

  • Infrastructure : sécurité, confidentialité, hébergement et environnements partagés, pour un OS multi-joueur, plug-and-play et scalable

  • Observabilité : suivre les agents et leur performance, et améliorer chaque logique en continu

  • Autonomie : construire des workflows agentiques déclenchés par webhook ou planifiés, qui nettoient le contexte et mènent des missions 24/7

Très vite, tu as vocation à devenir le (la) responsable qui orchestre l'IA chez Alassio, et le (la) référent(e) de notre OS Bedrock.

  

Profil recherché

 

🌱 Expérience

  • 1 à 2 ans d'expérience dans un rôle d'AI Engineer / FDE / AI Deployment Strategist dans une top structure tech (BCGX, Palantir, Dust)

  • Plusieurs missions concrètes de déploiement et d'optimisation de technologies IA : mise en place de zéro d'un workflow au sein d'une organisation, sujets de gouvernance et de déploiement en entreprise, etc.

  • Une utilisation intensive des outils IA et une bonne maîtrise de Python : Claude Code / Codex ; Cursor Agents, Linear/PostHog, déploiement et hébergement (cloud, AI routers, etc.)

 

💎 Qualités

  • Un goût pour l'optimisation et l'organisation : tu aimes que les choses soient claires, que l'information soit facile à mobiliser, propre et maintenable, et tu prends plaisir à produire vite des éléments actionnables

  • Un biais très fort pour l'action : tu repères les problèmes avant qu'on te les signale, et tu ne t'arrêtes jamais au diagnostic

  • Penser à l'échelle : tu conçois dès le départ des solutions capables d'encaisser des montées en charge ×10 ou ×100, tout en restant pragmatique sur ce qui compte à court et moyen terme

  

Processus de sélection

  1. Premier entretien avec Tancrède (CEO) : 45 min

  2. Étude de cas technique avec Hector (COO) et Ivan Robert (Founding SWE) : 1h30

  3. Rencontre informelle de l'équipe dans nos bureaux, puis échange de 45 min avec les fondateurs Ayoub (CAIO), Paul (CTO), Tancrède (CEO) & Hector (COO)

  4. Deux à trois prises de référence

  

Ce que nous offrons

 

👊 Une mission unique

Tu rejoins une aventure entrepreneuriale en plein passage à l'échelle, sur un marché verrouillé depuis des années. On est convaincus que l'IA ne transformera pas seulement le produit et secteur qu'on construit, mais aussi la façon avec laquelle toutes les entreprises devront se réinventer. On en fait déjà l'expérience au quotidien avec Bedrock, notre OS interne qui est aujourd'hui au cœur de l'activité de toutes nos équipes tech et non-tech.

Ton rôle est de faire passer ce laboratoire à l'échelle pour que chaque équipe d'Alassio aille plus vite, avec l'ambition assumée de bâtir une référence en matière d'organisation AI-native.

 

🎁 Rémunération et avantages

  • 💰 Package de 70 à 90K€ + BSPCE

title: AI Machine Learning Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Hoe lang duurt dit ziekteverzuim? Hoeveel stroom levert het windpark morgen? Welke klant staat open voor een volgend product? Organisaties willen het antwoord weten voordat het zover is. Als AI Machine Learning Engineer zorg jij dat die voorspelling er komt: betrouwbaar, herhaalbaar en verankerd in het werk van echte gebruikers.

De uitdaging

Generatieve AI trekt de aandacht, maar predictive AI levert vaak de harde waarde. De twee lossen verschillende problemen op en versterken elkaar. Jij weet welke aanpak bij welk vraagstuk past, en waar de grenzen liggen.

Als AI Machine Learning Engineer kom je in dienst bij LINKIT en ga je aan het werk bij toonaangevende opdrachtgevers, zoals overheden, ASML, InsingerGilissen en KLM. Daar tref je vaak data waar nog veel meer uit te halen valt. Jij maakt er producten op basis van AI van die werken.

Je werk bestaat onder meer uit:

  • Statistische analyses en dataverkenning om haalbaarheid en aanpak snel helder te krijgen.

  • Data pipelines bouwen en de juiste featureset samenstellen voor modeltraining.

  • Modellen ontwikkelen, van gradient boosting tot deep learning.

  • Modelregistratie, experiment tracking en modelvisualisaties op orde houden.

  • Modellen ontsluiten via FastAPI, zodat ze aanroepbaar zijn binnen het bestaande applicatielandschap.

Met coding agents vind je sneller de juiste libraries en creeër je inzicht zodat de haalbaarheid en juiste aanpak snel boven water komen. Je adviseert gebruikers en stakeholders over wat AI wel en niet kan. Je werkt pragmatisch en zet door tot de mensen voor wie je modellen bedoeld zijn ze dagelijks gebruiken.

Je plek

Je sluit aan bij de AI& Data Squad: Explorers die al jaren AI toepassen en elkaar scherp houden. AI is voor LINKIT een strategisch speerpunt waar we de komende jaren flink in investeren. Onze ambitie is dé partij voor integere AI-oplossingen in Nederland te worden. Daarvoor bouwen we aan nieuwe proposities, van verantwoorde AI op Europese infrastructuur tot voorspelmodellen op Databricks. Jij denkt daar actief over mee.

Om de twee weken kom je op vrijdag met alle Explorers samen op ons hoofdkantoor in De Meern voor de clubdag: een dag voor kennisdelen, leren en verbinden.

Lees hier meer over de AI squad.


Wat we vragen

  • Minimaal 4 jaar werkervaring als ontwikkelaar, waarvan minimaal 2 jaar met AI en machine learning.

  • Een stevige basis in data science of software engineering.

  • Ervaring met modellen en frameworks zoals LightGBM, XGBoost en Keras.

  • Ervaring met platformen als Azure ML, Databricks, AWS SageMaker of GCP Vertex AI.

  • Ervaring met pandas, polars of Spark, en met exploratie in Jupyter en Seaborn.

  • Ervaring met tracking en orkestratie via MLflow, Prefect of Airflow.

  • Je kunt onderbouwen welk model of welke tool in welke situatie het beste werkt, en je maakt je nieuwe tools snel eigen.

  • Je volgt generatieve AI op de voet, van prompt via context naar harness engineering, en weet hoe je oplossingen met LLM’s evalueert, monitort en verbetert.

Voldoe je niet aan elk punt, maar wel nieuwsgierig? Dan komen we alsnog graag met je in contact.

Wat je krijgt

  • Salaris tussen €4.000 - €7.900 per maand (o.b.v. 40 uur, afhankelijk van kennis & ervaring) + 8% vakantiegeld. Dit is een brede range omdat wij zowel op zoek zijn naar medior als senior Engineers.

  • Jaarlijkse winstdeling en pensioenregeling.

  • Hybride werken: op ons hoofdkantoor in De Meern, bij de klant of vanuit huis.

  • 25 vakantiedagen en de mogelijkheid om tijdelijk vanuit het buitenland te werken.

  • Elektrische leaseauto of mobiliteitsvergoeding.

  • Netto thuiswerkvergoeding, een goed ingerichte thuiswerkplek en een laptop en telefoon, die je ook privé kunt gebruiken.

  • Om de twee weken op vrijdag komen alle collega’s terug naar ons hoofdkantoor in De Meern, dan investeren wij tot 10% van jouw werktijd in kennisdeling, leren en verbinden (dit noemen wij de clubdag).

  • Extra’s zoals onbeperkt opleidingsbudget, dagelijkse verse lunch, jaarlijks wintersport en wellbeing-activiteiten, zoals een wijnproeverij en yoga.

Sollicitatieprocedure

We willen je leren kennen en jij ons. Daarom houden we het persoonlijk en concreet.

  1. Kennismaking: Een eerste gesprek over wie je bent, wat je drijft en of er een match is.

  1. Een assignment die je thuis maakt waarin jij jouw kennis en ervaring op een leuke manier kan toepassen en we iets concreets te bespreken hebben

  1. Verdiepende gesprekken: Twee gesprekken over je gemaakte assignment, ervaring, werkwijze en hoe jij past binnen de squad en bij onze klanten.

  1. Aanbieding: Als het klikt, volgt een concreet aanbod.

Vragen vooraf? Neem gerust contact op met Raoel via

Over ons

LINKIT is opgericht in 1998 en gegroeid van IT-bemiddelaar naar kennisgedreven IT-organisatie, met ruim 250 Explorers uit meer dan 25 nationaliteiten. We werken voor grote organisaties in overheid, finance en logistiek als partner die meedenkt van vraagstuk tot oplossing. Als AI Machine Learning Engineer ga je aan het werk bij toonaangevende opdrachtgevers, met een contract bij LINKIT. Je bepaalt je eigen richting, met een ongelimiteerd opleidingsbudget en de ruimte om te groeien op een manier die bij jou past.

Rethink it with LINKIT.

  • Produktnah arbeiten: Du sprichst mit Lehrkräften, erkennst echte Bedarfe und triffst mit Product und Design Entscheidungen, statt auf Tickets zu warten.
  • Engineering-Bar heben: Testing, Monitoring und saubere Architektur geben dir Geschwindigkeit. Du erkennst Risiken früh und steuerst technische Schulden bewusst.

Qualifikation

  • Product-Engineering-Erfahrung: Mindestens drei Jahre Erfahrung mit digitalen Produkten und echten Nutzer.
  • AI-Engineering-Know-how: Du hast LLM-Features oder agentische Systeme gebaut und in Production betrieben. Du verstehst Modellfehler, RAG, Evals und Vektor-Datenbanken. ML Research ist nicht erforderlich.
  • Technisches Fundament: Du bist sicher in API-Design, Datenmodellen und der Entwicklung über Backend und Frontend hinweg.
  • Ownership und Urteilskraft: Du kommst mit offenen Problemen klar, findest einfache Lösungen für komplexe Fragen und baust Systeme, die im Schulalltag funktionieren.
  • AI-native Arbeitsweise: Du nutzt Coding Agents und moderne AI-Tools selbstverständlich, um deinen Output zu vervielfachen.
  • Sprachen: Fließend Deutsch und sehr gutes Englisch.

Unser Tech Stack

  • Full-stack TypeScript: Next.js, Drizzle, Postgres
  • Web: Next.js, Tailwind, Zod
  • Mobile: React Native, Expo, EAS, React Query
  • AI: Vercel AI SDK, promptfoo, LiteLLM, Arize Phoenix, pgVector
  • Infra: DigitalOcean, Scaleway, Open Telekom Cloud, Azure

Benefits

  • Sichtbaren Impact: Du arbeitest am wichtigsten Zukunftsthema unserer Gesellschaft, der Bildung.
  • 70.000 bis 100.000 € Bruttojahresgehalt, abhängig von deiner Erfahrung, plus Equity (VSOP).
  • 100 % Remote-Arbeit. Wenn du lieber ins Büro kommst, steht dir unser modernes Office in Bielefeld offen.
  • Großen Gestaltungsspielraum und Ownership sowie direkte Zusammenarbeit mit den Foundern und einem starken Product- und Engineering-Team.
  • Ein hohes Budget, solange der Nutzen stimmt.
  • Zeit und Unterstützung für deine Entwicklung, mit Fortbildungsbudget, Coaching und klaren Entwicklungsperspektiven.
  • 30 Urlaubstage und 50 € monatlichen steuerfreien Sachbezug.
  • Regelmäßige Team-Events und Offsites.
  • Starkes Backing durch erfahrene Investoren und Mentoren.

Unser Bewerbungsprozess

Wenn die Kalender passen, können wir den gesamten Prozess innerhalb von fünf Tagen abschließen.

  1. Kennenlernen, Tag 1: Im ersten Gespräch schauen wir, ob es für beide Seiten passt. Wenn ja, vereinbaren wir direkt deinen Probetag.
  2. Probetag mit Case Study, Tag 4: Du arbeitest mit uns an einer echten Aufgabe und stellst anschließend dein Ergebnis vor.
  3. Gespräch mit unserem CEO, Tag 4: Das Gespräch findet am Abend deines Probetags statt.
  4. Teamgespräch, Tag 5: Du lernst die Engineers kennen, mit denen du arbeiten wirst.
  5. Entscheidung, Tag 5: Nach dem Teamgespräch geben wir dir unsere finale Rückmeldung.

Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen. Erzähl uns, welche Probleme du gelöst, welche Entscheidungen du getroffen und welche Systeme du in Produktion gebracht hast.

title: AI Research Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About us

We are building a global leader in physical AI, anchored in Europe’s strongest robotics heritage. Founded by entrepreneurs with backgrounds in scaling digital products and advanced robotics, the team is bolstered by senior leadership from top-tier AI research labs and industrial tech companies.

Driven by a mission to create versatile and trustworthy embodied AI for physical labor, we fuse deep engineering mastery in AI and mechatronics with a rapid-execution culture. We are addressing the labor shortage by closing the gap to production-grade deployment. This means building the trusted alternative: robots that are safe, secure, and engineered to automotive standards of scale and durability.

We are well-capitalized and now assembling our team.

Our Locations: Vesoma has two main locations: Munich, Germany and Limassol, Cyprus. This pan-European setup represents our core ambition of building a European technology leader, gives us a great talent base and a strong corporate structure.

Your mission

The role
As an AI Research Engineer, you enter as a key member of the early AI team. You will work directly with our AI leadership to define the research direction for how our humanoid robots learn. You research self-learning systems for robot foundation models, turn ideas into working prototypes and push the state of the art - measured not by how good a result looks in a paper, but by how well it holds up against strong baselines and, ultimately, on real hardware. You build on our large-scale training, RL post-training and simulation infrastructure, and your research needs shape where it goes next. This is a full-time, permanent position.

Your profile

Key responsibilities

  • Research on Self-Learning Systems: Develop methods that let our robot foundation models learn from large-scale video and robot data and keep improving from experience - across pre-training, imitation learning and RL post-training - for humanoid locomotion and manipulation

  • Prototyping: Turn research ideas and new papers into working prototypes quickly, in simulation and on physical robots.

  • Pushing the State of the Art: Track the frontier of robot learning and foundation models, identify what matters for real-world deployment, and develop methods that move beyond it

  • Experimentation: Design and run experiments at scale on our GPU fleet - from simulation to hardware - with clean setups that produce results the team can trust.

  • Evaluation: Benchmark rigorously against strong baselines using our simulation benchmarks and real-world tests, run ablations and make results reproducible, so decisions rest on evidence rather than impressions.

  • Sim-to-Real Collaboration: Work with the simulation, hardware and controls teams so that what is learned in simulation transfers to the robot.

Who we are looking for
We seek people who embrace the empirical nature of AI research and are ready to move beyond demos to real-world deployment.

  • Experience: 3+ years of research experience in machine learning or robotics, ideally with a track record in robot learning or large-scale models. [A PhD in a related field is a plus.] [Publications at top venues such as CoRL, RSS, ICRA, NeurIPS or ICML are a plus.]

  • Core Skills: Deep knowledge of learning-based methods for robotics and strong engineering skills to implement them. In detail:

    • Learning Methods: Hands-on research experience with robot foundation models or policy learning - e.g. VLAs, diffusion/flow-matching policies, imitation learning or RL post-training.

    • Engineering: Strong Python and PyTorch and/or JAX; able to write research code that others can build on.

    • Simulation: Experience with physics simulators for robot learning (MuJoCo/MjLab, Isaac Lab/Isaac Sim or comparable).

    • Experimental Rigor: Experience designing experiments, choosing meaningful baselines and evaluating results honestly.

  • A plus: Deploying learned policies on real robots; training large models on multi-node GPU clusters; multimodal or video models.

  • Mindset: You balance the agility of a startup with the professional rigor required for a global industrial player. You are a curious builder who thrives in a collaborative, fast-paced research environment - and you care whether a method works on the robot, not just on the benchmark.

Why us?

  • The Team: Work alongside leadership with a proven track record of building unicorn-scale companies and defining global robotics standards.

  • Smart Strategy: We operate as disciplined fast followers. Capital is timed to the deployment inflection point, avoiding early-mover dead ends to scale fast on proven foundations.

  • Resources: We are substantially internally funded and attract top-tier investors to avoid any capital constraints for our mission.

  • Historic Opportunity: Join at the dawn of a new industry comparable to the rise of the automobile. Help shape the European champion in this trillion-dollar market.

We are an equal opportunity employer.

title: AI Scientist - Agentic Engineering - AI4Engineering - (Internship, Masters or PhD)
descriptionHtml:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

Mistral is looking for an intern to support AI4Engineering Science in expanding what Mistral's agentic tools can do across the engineering lifecycle, spanning CAE (CAD, CFD, FEA, etc.) and EDA/Semi.

Within the team, your core work is helping build the pre- and post-training data for Mistral's LLMs to reason about and execute real engineering tasks. Alongside this, you'll help shape the agent architectures and harnesses that let these models operate reliably inside multi-step engineering workflows, not just answer isolated questions.

You'll work closely with domain experts across CAE and EDA to ground this work in how engineers actually work, and with the broader research team to translate that domain grounding into training signal and evaluation benchmarks that measure genuine task competence.

This internship is aimed at candidates in the late stages of a Master's degree or a PhD.

What You Will Do

  • Help design pretraining, SFT, and RL data for engineering tasks across CAD, CAE, and semiconductor/EDA

  • Help define verifiers and evaluation criteria that capture what "correct" and "high-quality" actually mean for each engineering task, beyond surface-level plausibility

  • Contribute to agent architectures and harnesses: how models plan, call tools, recover from errors, and chain steps together across long-horizon engineering workflows

  • Build evaluation benchmarks and diagnostic tooling to identify where models fail on engineering tasks, and trace those failures back to gaps in data, reward design, or agent scaffolding

  • Collaborate with domain experts across CAE and EDA (and the science and solutions teams more broadly) to identify which engineering workflows are highest-value to target next

What We're Looking For

  • Currently completing the final year of a Master's degree or in the late stages of a PhD in AI, machine learning, or an engineering discipline

  • Fluent English with excellent communication skills, able to explain technical ML and engineering concepts to both engineering and non-technical audiences

  • Solid, hands-on machine learning expertise, particularly LLM development (e.g. through research projects, coursework, or open-source work)

  • Some experience running, debugging, or validating real engineering workflows in at least one of CAD, CAE, semiconductor simulation, or EDA

  • You write clean, readable Python code and are comfortable in Linux/HPC environments

  • Self-directed: you don't need detailed roadmaps to make progress

  • Low-ego, collaborative, and eager to learn at the intersection of engineering and ML

It would be great if you

  • Have experience building or fine-tuning agentic systems (tool use, multi-step planning, agent orchestration frameworks)

  • Have experience with reward modeling, RLHF/RLAIF/RLVR, or preference-based training

  • Have academic or project experience with CAE or EDA tools (e.g. OpenFOAM, SU2, FreeCAD,OpenCourant, SolidWorks, CATIA, Fluent, Abaqus, LS-DYNA, STAR-CCM+, Cadence/Synopsys/Siemens EDA tools)

  • Have contributed to an open-source or industry codebase

  • Have publications or preprints in engineering and ML venues (NeurIPS, ICLR, JFM, AIAA, etc.)

What We Offer

You will join a dynamic, collaborative research team working at the frontier of agentic AI for engineering, with direct mentorship from senior AI Scientists, access to frontier models and large-scale compute, and the opportunity to contribute to published research and real products.

descriptionHtml:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. 

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

Dans un souci de clarté et d’accessibilité, nous avons choisi de ne pas utiliser l’écriture inclusive dans nos communications. WPP Media est fermement engagé en faveur de la diversité : nous valorisons l'inclusion et l'égalité, en considérant tous les candidats sans distinction d'identité de genre, d'origine ethnique ou de religion. Tous nos postes sont également ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap.

A propos de WPP Media :

WPP est le partenaire de confiance des plus grandes marques mondiales pour assurer leur croissance. Nous réunissons une intelligence média de pointe, une créativité de classe mondiale, une production de nouvelle génération, des solutions pour transformer le marketing à l’ère de l’IA et un conseil stratégique d’expert au sein d’une seule compagnie. 
Propulsés par des talents exceptionnels et WPP Open, notre plateforme de marketing agentique, nous déployons l’IA à grande échelle pour aider nos clients à naviguer dans un monde en pleines mutations et à optimiser leurs investissements marketing. 
Pour plus d’informations, visitez www.wpp.com.

WPP Media est le collectif média global de WPP. Dans un monde où les médias sont omniprésents nous regroupons la meilleure plateforme, les meilleurs talents et les meilleurs partenaires pour développer les solutions les plus innovantes, offrant une croissance inégalée à nos clients. Pour plus d'informations, visitez wppmedia.com.

Chez WPP Media, nous croyons en la puissance de notre culture et de nos collaborateurs. C'est grâce à cette synergie que nous parvenons à créer des expériences véritablement exceptionnelles, tant pour nos clients que pour nos équipes internes. Pour réussir dans ce poste, il est fondamental d'incarner les valeurs essentielles qui unissent WPP et WPP Media :

  • Être Extraordinaire en favorisant un leadership collectif qui inspire une créativité véritablement transformationnelle.
  • Créer un environnement Ouvert en trouvant l'équilibre parfait entre l'épanouissement de nos collaborateurs et la satisfaction de nos clients, le tout fondé sur une confiance mutuelle.
  • Diriger avec Optimisme en stimulant activement la croissance et le développement pour mobiliser l'ensemble de notre organisation.

Le contexte :

Au sein de StudioM, l’agence de brand content de WPP Media, vous rejoindrez la Business Unit dédiée à une marque leader de la grande consommation (FMCG) et contribuerez à ses stratégies d’influence en France.

Aux côtés de l’équipe Influence, en lien avec les équipes clients, média, créatives et les agences partenaires, vous participerez à des campagnes pour des marques iconiques, entre création de contenu, entertainment et pop culture : musique, gaming, sport, food ou lifestyle.


Vos missions :

  • Contribuer aux stratégies d’influence : participer à la construction des recommandations stratégiques et créatives, proposer des idées d’activation et assurer une veille sur les tendances, la culture Gen Z, les usages des plateformes sociales, les créateurs émergents et les activations concurrentes.

  • Participer au casting des créateurs de contenu : identifier des profils, de la nano-influence aux célébrités, et analyser leurs performances, leurs audiences, leur univers éditorial et leur affinité avec les marques.

  • Accompagner le suivi opérationnel des campagnes : participer à la rédaction des briefs, au suivi des agences partenaires, à la préparation des scripts et contenus soumis à validation, aux rétroplannings ainsi qu’au suivi budgétaire, administratif et contractuel.

  • Participer aux activations et aux productions de contenus : accompagner l’équipe lors des tournages, événements, expériences immersives et activations terrain avec les créateurs de contenu.
  • Contribuer à la mesure des performances et à l’innovation : suivre les KPI organiques et paid, notamment via CreatorIQ, participer aux bilans de campagne et aux pistes d’optimisation, et explorer l’apport des outils d’intelligence artificielle dans nos réflexions et méthodes de travail.

Compétences requises :

  • Formation Bac +4/+5 en communication, marketing ou publicité, à la recherche d’une alternance.
  • Un vif intérêt pour l’influence, l’entertainment et la pop culture, et une bonne connaissance des créateurs de contenu et des plateformes sociales (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Twitch, Snapchat).
  • Curiosité, créativité, réactivité, rigueur et sens de l’organisation pour suivre plusieurs sujets en parallèle.
  • Aisance rédactionnelle et relationnelle, esprit d’analyse et de synthèse, bonne maîtrise de PowerPoint et d’Excel, et bon niveau d’anglais (B2 souhaité).

Un plus : la connaissance d’outils de marketing d’influence (comme CreatorIQ) et de social listening.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre :

  • Contribuer à des campagnes d’influence d’envergure nationale pour des marques iconiques à dimension internationale.
  • Évoluer au sein d’une Business Unit dédiée, dans une équipe pluridisciplinaire.
  • Travailler aux côtés de créateurs de contenu, d’agences partenaires et d’experts média et créatifs.
  • Acquérir une vision complète du marketing d’influence, de la stratégie à la mesure de la performance.

La vie chez WPP Media et ses avantages

Notre engagement à façonner l'avenir des médias se manifeste par un soutien actif au développement professionnel de nos talents, les aidant à atteindre leur plein potentiel. Cette démarche s'accompagne d'une vision responsable dans nos stratégies d'investissement médiatique, reflétant ainsi notre double priorité : valoriser nos collaborateurs tout en adoptant des pratiques durables dans notre secteur. Les collaborateurs de WPP Media ont un accès privilégié aux réseaux internationaux de WPP Media et WPP, leur permettant de développer leurs passions, d'étendre leur réseau professionnel et de rester à la pointe des innovations en marketing et publicité.

Nous disposons de ressources vastes et variées au service de nos collaborateurs, notre entreprise cultive activement l'inclusion des talents de tous horizons. Les réussites et expertises des équipes sont régulièrement mises en lumière lors d'événements fédérateurs qui ponctuent également les moments clés de l'année, renforçant ainsi notre culture d'entreprise collaborative et diversifiée.

Ce que nous offrons :

  • Une expérience professionnelle unique au sein d'une compagnie média renommée, où vous pourrez acquérir des compétences précieuses et développer votre réseau professionnel.
  • L'opportunité de travailler avec des clients de premier plan et de contribuer à la création de campagnes publicitaires de grande envergure.
  • Un accompagnement personnalisé pour tous les Padawans (stagiaires/alternants chez WPP Media) de votre intégration à votre départ … ou pas !
  • Des déjeuners, cafés, afterworks ainsi que différents évènements qui rythmeront votre année chez nous.
  • Un campus à Levallois-Perret qui rassemble toutes les agences WPP (WPP Media et ses sœurs) au terminus de la ligne 3 !

Process de recrutement

  • Entretien avec l’équipe recrutement : Un premier pré-entretien téléphonique de 5mn, puis un entretien de 30mn en visio-conférence par un membre de notre équipe recrutement. Cela nous permettra de mieux connaître vos compétences et votre expérience, et vous donnera l'occasion de poser des questions sur le poste et l'entreprise.
  • Entretien opérationnel : Pour évaluer l'adéquation de vos compétences et de votre profil par rapport aux exigences du poste.
  • Étude de cas : Une étude de cas vous sera proposée afin d’évaluer vos compétences techniques liées au poste. Une restitution vous sera proposée.

Nous nous engageons à rendre ce process aussi rapide et efficace que possible, et à maintenir une communication ouverte et transparente tout au long du process.

WPP Media garantit l'égalité des chances et considère tous les candidats sans discrimination ni considération de caractéristiques particulières. Nous nous engageons à cultiver un environnement de respect où chacun se sent à sa place et bénéficie des mêmes opportunités d'évolution professionnelle.

title: Applied AI & Backend Engineer (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Über odacova

odacova ist ein wachsendes B2B-Software-Startup mit Sitz in Dortmund. Wir entwickeln eine modulare Plattform, mit der Unternehmen individuelle Ernährungslösungen für ihre Mitarbeiter*innen umsetzen können – datenbasiert und praxisnah.

Zur Skalierung unserer markterprobten Lösung haben wir eine Finanzierungsrunde abgeschlossen und bauen nun unser Kernteam weiter aus. Das ist ideal für Entwickler*innen, die früh Verantwortung übernehmen, sich fachlich weiterentwickeln und unser Produkt aktiv mitgestalten möchten.

Wir arbeiten gemeinsam in unserem Büro in Dortmund. Gleichzeitig ermöglichen wir flexible Arbeitszeiten und ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell mit Home-Office-Tagen und mobilem Arbeiten. Dabei legen wir großen Wert auf Verantwortungsbewusstsein, verlässliche Ergebnisse und einen regelmäßigen persönlichen Austausch im Team.

Aufgaben

Deine Rolle

Als Applied AI & Backend Engineer (m/w/d) entwickelst du unsere Plattform in zwei eng verbundenen Bereichen weiter: Backend Engineering und APIs sowie Data Engineering und Applied AI.

Zum Einstieg liegt dein Schwerpunkt auf der Weiterentwicklung unseres Python-Backends, unserer APIs und der zugehörigen Datenverarbeitung. Mittelfristig baust du unsere daten- und KI-gestützten Produktfunktionen schrittweise aus. Konkrete Anwendungsfälle entwickelst und bewertest du gemeinsam mit unserem Produkt-Team.

Langfristig streben wir eine etwa gleichmäßige Verteilung zwischen Backend Engineering und APIs sowie Data Engineering und Applied AI an. Die tatsächliche Gewichtung entwickelt sich mit den Produktvorhaben.

Deine Aufgaben

Backend Engineering und APIs

  • Entwicklung und Weiterentwicklung Python-basierter Backend-Services

  • Konzeption und Umsetzung von REST-APIs, Datenmodellen und Anwendungslogik

  • Anbindung externer Services und Schnittstellen

Data Engineering und Applied AI

  • Weiterentwicklung datengetriebener Business-Intelligence-Tools sowie Entwicklung KI-gestützter Analyse- und Reportingfunktionen

  • Produktive Integration vorhandener Modelle und LLM-APIs

  • Perspektivisch Entwicklung eigener ML-Modelle auf Basis unserer domänenspezifischen Datengrundlage

Qualität und Betrieb

  • Aufbau und Pflege automatisierter Tests sowie technischer Dokumentation

  • Unterstützung bei Deployments, Monitoring und CI/CD

  • Analyse von Logs und Fehlerbehebung im laufenden Betrieb (Kein Bereitschafts- oder 24/7-Dienst)

Qualifikation

Das bringst du mit

Erforderlich

  • Abgeschlossenes Hochschulstudium in Informatik, Data Science, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder einem vergleichbaren MINT-Fach

  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Python oder einer vergleichbaren Backend-Sprache (z. B. Java, Kotlin, C# oder Go) sowie die Bereitschaft, produktiv mit Python zu arbeiten

  • Praktische Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von Backend-Anwendungen mit REST-APIs und Datenmodellen sowie sicherer Umgang mit Linux/Ubuntu und Git

  • Solides Grundlagenwissen zu Machine Learning, generativer KI und Large Language Models

  • Erste praktische KI-Anwendungen, zum Beispiel aus Studium, Abschlussarbeit, eigenen Projekten oder dem beruflichen Kontext
