title: Assistant Controller
descriptionHtml:
About MUBI

MUBI is a global streaming service, production company and film distributor dedicated to elevating great cinema. To make this possible, we create, curate, acquire and champion visionary films, bringing them to audiences all over the world. We have a team of brilliant, dedicated and passionate people to help bring our mission to life. From London to New York, Istanbul to Paris, and Berlin to Mexico - we work together to realize MUBI’s vision.

That’s where you come in! Join our global team and help us make great cinema accessible to everyone, everywhere.

About the Role

MUBI is looking for an Assistant Controller to lead our group accounting and financial reporting function from London. Reporting to the Global Controller, you will own the US GAAP close and consolidation, lead group financial reporting and the day-to-day delivery of our Big Four group audit, and oversee statutory accounting across our international entities.

You will directly manage our senior statutory accounting leads. This is a hands-on leadership role: you will stay close enough to the detail to resolve issues and set a high bar for accuracy, while also developing the team, strengthening controls and improving how we close, report and operate.

Your initial mandate is focused on group and statutory accounting. Cash and treasury operations and payroll will initially remain outside your remit. Once the core accounting mandate is firmly established, we expect the role to broaden over time to include greater oversight of cash and treasury. We are therefore looking for someone who already brings meaningful experience in these areas.

You will work closely with the Global Controller on complex accounting matters, systems and automation, controls and the continued development of the function. MUBI's accounting environment spans subscription streaming, film distribution and production across multiple entities, countries and currencies. We are looking for someone who learned the fundamentals in Big Four audit and has since applied them in-house, with the judgement and experience to operate effectively across this complexity as the business continues to grow.

We work hybrid-remote where we require 3 office days in London. Our core days are Tuesday, Wednesday & Thursday, with the flexibility to use our offices on the remaining two days if you wish.

Where you’ll have impact:

  • Own the close and consolidation. Lead the month-, quarter- and year-end close and consolidation process across all entities, including review of journal entries, accruals, reconciliations, eliminations and other key close outputs.

  • Lead financial reporting. Prepare and review consolidated US GAAP financial statements, management reporting packs and supporting schedules, ensuring group reporting is accurate, timely and well supported.

  • Own key accounting areas. Oversee accounting for content assets, subscription and distribution revenue, deferred revenue, partner and app-store settlements, intercompany balances and foreign currency. Work with FP&A, content and other teams where accounting depends on operational data or business context.

  • Oversee global statutory accounting. Directly manage our senior statutory accounting leads and coordinate statutory reporting across the group, working with local teams and external advisers to ensure statutory accounts and filings are complete, accurate and delivered on time.

  • Lead the audit. Manage the day-to-day delivery of the Big Four group audit and coordinate statutory audits across our entities. Build an effective relationship with our auditors and advisers and ensure requests and deliverables are well supported and resolved promptly.

  • Strengthen controls and processes. Document and improve accounting processes and SOPs, strengthen key close and reporting controls, and help develop the control environment toward public-company and SOX standards.

  • Partner on technical accounting. Work with the Global Controller and external advisers on new or complex accounting matters, helping translate technical conclusions into clear accounting policies and treatment.

  • Improve systems and automation. Lead improvements to our accounting systems, close and reporting workflows. Use automation and AI where they can materially improve accuracy, speed and efficiency.

What you’ll bring:

  • Active US CPA licence. You hold an active US CPA licence and bring strong practical knowledge of US GAAP.

  • Big Four and in-house experience. You have at least eight years of accounting experience, including meaningful Big Four audit experience and at least two years in an in-house accounting role, ideally within a complex, multi-entity international business.

  • Close and consolidation expertise. You have owned or played a senior role in month-, quarter- and year-end close and group consolidation, including the preparation or review of financial statements, with a strong understanding of the GL and end-to-end financial reporting process.

  • Strong people leadership. You have at least three years of experience managing and developing accounting professionals and are comfortable leading experienced team members across different countries and areas of responsibility.

  • Audit and controls experience. You have acted as a senior company-side contact for external auditors and have experience documenting, operating and improving internal financial controls.

  • International statutory experience. You have overseen statutory accounting and reporting across multiple jurisdictions and know how to work effectively with local finance teams, advisers and auditors without needing to be the technical expert in every market.

  • Meaningful cash and treasury experience. You have practical experience with the core disciplines of cash and treasury in a multi-entity business, including cash reporting or forecasting, banking operations, payment controls and bank reconciliations.

  • Strong systems and process capability. You have experience with NetSuite, Ramp and other finance and accounting systems, plus advanced Excel skills.

  • Clear judgement and communication. You have strong attention to detail, can move comfortably between accounting detail and the wider business context, communicate clearly with senior stakeholders, and manage competing priorities under tight deadlines.

  • You have the right to work in the UK and are able to work in person from our London office.

We want to make cinema accessible to everyone. We believe people from different backgrounds bring different ideas that foster innovation and engagement, allowing us to attract great people to develop the best experience for our users.

title: Assurance Lead
descriptionHtml:
I quit medicine because I kept watching patients die needlessly, for avoidable reasons. In almost every case, the medical knowledge and clinicians were there. It was the system that failed: the way information moved, decisions got routed, and fragmented teams and data turned solvable problems into tragedy.

I started Anima to change that.

Our mission is human wellbeing, and we believe personalised medicine will transform it. Our founding insight is that getting there requires a system that learns continuously from care and its outcomes, optimising for human wellbeing. Building that learning engine is the opportunity at the heart of Anima.

We're now in 1,000+ clinics across 5 product lines, serving more than 25% of the UK population. We are cash flow positive, growing fast, and have a tight crew of ~45 people who care deeply for each other and the mission. Everyone has real ownership and a voice in decisions.

Multiple trillion-dollar companies will be built in healthcare over the next two decades. We intend to be one of them.

If you want to work on problems where the stakes are high, you belong at Anima. Your work here will save lives.

-- Shun

Assurance Lead

Healthcare organisations need confidence that the technology they use is clinically safe, protects patient data and can withstand serious scrutiny. At Anima, assurance is not a box-ticking function: it shapes how we build, earn customer trust and bring our technology to more clinicians and patients.

We’re looking for an intellectually sharp, pragmatic assurance leader to build and own this function.

What you’ll do

Shape product decisions. Work closely with Product and Engineering to understand how Anima operates, identify risks early and translate clinical, regulatory and data-protection requirements into practical decisions.

Build the assurance function. Own the systems, documentation and processes behind customer and product assurance—including DPIAs, clinical-safety documentation and customer assurance materials. Turn fragmented work into a dependable, scalable function.

Lead external assurance. Build trust with ICBs, clinical directors and other healthcare leaders. Explain complex issues clearly, handle challenging questions credibly and support important commercial conversations.

Who we’re looking for

  • Demonstrates exceptional critical thinking and systems-level judgement.

  • Can understand complex products and work credibly with Product and Engineering.

  • Has built or substantially improved a function, system or operating process.

  • Can distinguish material risk from process for its own sake.

  • Communicates with authority in difficult customer and stakeholder conversations.

  • Thrives in ownership, ambiguity and a fast-moving technology company.

Experience in high-performing medtech or healthtech organisations—particularly those working with the NHS—would be especially valuable. Experience in clinical safety, data protection, DPIAs or healthcare assurance is useful, but we care more about your ability to think, learn and build than whether you have owned every framework.

This is a hands-on individual-contributor role with significant ownership. Success means assurance is embedded in how Anima builds, customers trust our answers and teams can move quickly without compromising safety or patient trust.

What we offer

We are exceptionally selective about who we hire at Anima. As a consequence, we are very generous with our team about the benefits we offer. Anima should be where you do your life’s very best work.

Competitive compensation and meaningful equity. 25 days leave plus 8 UK public holidays with flexible additional time off. Private health insurance covering medical, dental, vision and mental health. 12 weeks maternity leave at full pay (rising to 24 weeks after 2 years), 4 weeks paternity at full pay. 4% employer pension contributions with full salary sacrifice and 100% NI savings passed to you. $1,000 annual learning budget. Gym subscription matching up to £50 per month. High-spec MacBook plus home office budget. Two full-team off-sites per year (we've previously gone to Mykonos, Dominican Republic, Mexico, Florida). Hybrid from Farringdon, at least 2 days a week in person.

What we offer

Anima should be where you do your life’s best work. We support that with:

  • Time off: 25 days’ annual leave plus 8 UK public holidays, with flexible additional time off.

  • Health cover: private medical, dental, vision and mental health insurance.

  • Parental leave: 12 weeks’ maternity leave at full pay, rising to 24 weeks after two years; 4 weeks’ paternity leave at full pay.

  • Pension: 4% employer contributions, with salary sacrifice and 100% of the employer National Insurance savings passed on to you.

  • Learning: £1,000 annual budget for your development.

  • Fitness: gym subscription matching up to £50 per month.

  • Equipment: a high-spec MacBook and a home office budget.

  • Time together: two full-team off-sites each year, previous destinations include Mykonos and Mexico.

  • Farringdon office: a beautiful new London HQ, with most of the team together at least twice a week.

Everyone is welcome at Anima. We strongly believe in building a diverse and inclusive team. If you’re excited by our mission and believe you could do this work well, we’d love to hear from you, even if your experience doesn’t match every point above. inca ist ein AI-first TPA für die Schadenbearbeitung und arbeitet mit den größten Versicherern Deutschlands. Wir verkaufen keine Software, die Sachbearbeiter:innen unterstützt. About the role

Das ist kein klassisches Praktikum mit fester Stellenbeschreibung. Du zeigst uns, was du gebaut hast, und wir bauen das Praktikum rund um dich und deine Stärken. Wenn du mit KI baust, weil du nicht anders kannst, ob mit Claude, Cursor, Codex oder etwas anderem, wollen wir das sehen.

Show us what you've built

Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und Links zu Projekten, die du mit KI gebaut hast. Zwei Arten von Projekten finden wir besonders spannend:

  • Something that helps inca. In der Schadenbearbeitung gibt es genug harte Probleme: unstrukturierte Dokumente (Rechnungen, Fotos, Kostenvoranschläge, handschriftliche Formulare), Deckungsprüfung gegen komplexe Versicherungsbedingungen, Plausibilitäts- und Betrugssignale, Kundenkommunikation. Bau etwas, das eines davon angeht, oder etwas, an das wir noch nicht gedacht haben.

  • A passion project. Etwas, das du gebaut hast, weil es dich nicht losgelassen hat, und das zeigt, wie du denkst.

Ein GitHub-Repo, eine Demo oder ein kurzer Write-up reichen völlig, gern mit ein paar Zeilen dazu, worum es geht. Noch nichts zum Verlinken? Kein Problem, bewirb dich trotzdem und erzähl uns, was du bei inca bauen würdest.

What you will do

  • Own a real project. Idealerweise das, das du uns gezeigt hast. Du bringst es vom Prototyp zu etwas, das unser Claims-Team oder unsere Versicherungskunden wirklich nutzen.

  • Ship, measure, iterate. Du shippst, misst an echten Schäden und entscheidest auf Basis von echtem Feedback.

  • Work with the founders. Du arbeitest direkt mit den Gründern und, je nachdem wo dein Projekt liegt, mit Product, Engineering oder Operations.

You might be a fit if

  • Du baust mit KI, statt nur darüber zu reden, und hast schon Dinge geshippt, die funktionieren, auch wenn sie noch roh sind.

  • Du denkst in Wirkung, nicht in Technologie, und kannst ein unübersichtliches Problem in eine klare Lösung zerlegen.

title: CDI - Manager Context & Analytics Engineer - Paris
descriptionHtml:
Mission

Un agent ne vaut que ce que valent les données et les connaissances sur lesquelles il répond. Pipelines, modèles de données, définitions de métriques, droits d’accès : vous créez et gouvernez ce socle, et les applications et les agents de nos clients s’appuient dessus. Quand un analyste ou un agent demande un chiffre, la réponse est celle de l’équipe finance, accompagnée de sa définition et de sa source.

Ce poste est fait pour vous si vous voulez que les métiers et les agents puissent se fier aux données, et les utilisent.

Artefact accompagne les plus grandes entreprises du monde dans le déploiement de l’IA : 3 000 AI makers dans plus de 30 pays, plus de 1 000 clients. En France, le département Engineering réunit environ 300 personnes sous la responsabilité du CTO ; vous y rejoignez le chapter AI Applied Engineer, archétype Context & Analytics Engineer.

Activités et responsabilités

Avec les équipes métier et les analystes, il s’agit de définir ce que signifie chaque métrique et de vérifier que les données y correspondent. Sur ce socle, les Product Engineers et les AI Engineers construisent applications et agents.

Les Platform Engineers exploitent l’infrastructure sur laquelle tournent vos pipelines. Les échanges avec les data owners et les équipes de gouvernance du client, la relecture de code entre pairs et l’accompagnement des nouvelles recrues complètent le quotidien.

Vos responsabilités :

  • Construire des pipelines d’ingestion et des modèles de données, avec dbt par exemple.
  • Mettre en place des contrôles de qualité des données et maintenir le lineage.
  • Construire la couche sémantique et les définitions de métriques, pour que les personnes et les agents utilisent les mêmes chiffres, y compris en text-to-SQL.
  • Définir les règles de gouvernance et les droits d’accès.
  • Construire des pipelines de connaissances pour le RAG : indexation, chunking, métadonnées, permissions.
  • Préparer le contexte exploitable par les agents : métadonnées, définitions, lineage et permissions.

Profil recherché

Les indispensables :

  1. Vous écrivez du SQL avec aisance et modélisez les données pour l’analyse.
  2. Des pipelines de données planifiés, testés et surveillés figurent à votre actif.
  3. Aux côtés des équipes métier, vous définissez les métriques et vérifiez que les données veulent bien dire ce que tout le monde croit y lire.
  4. La qualité des données, la documentation et les droits d’accès comptent pour vous.
  5. Les coding agents font déjà partie de votre quotidien, et vous vérifiez ce qu’ils produisent.

Un plus, pas un prérequis :

  • Python pour le traitement de données.
  • Une plateforme de données cloud, comme BigQuery, Snowflake ou Databricks.
  • Une couche sémantique ou un metrics store.
  • La préparation de documents pour le RAG : chunking, indexation, métadonnées.
  • Des outils de data catalogue ou de lineage.

Pas besoin de cocher toutes les cases pour postuler : si vous avez l’essentiel des indispensables et l’envie d’apprendre le reste, parlons-en.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

Dans un métier où deux tableaux de bord affichent parfois deux chiffres différents, ce poste consiste à rétablir la confiance : un chiffre juste, une définition partagée, une source identifiable. Ce travail, discret quand il réussit, conditionne tout ce que les autres archétypes construisent au-dessus.

Nous sommes des AI makers : l’IA se construit avec nos clients, pas seulement pour eux. Leurs enjeux deviennent les nôtres, et nos choix techniques s’expliquent dans le langage du métier. Les positions que nous prenons sont claires ; elles évoluent face aux faits, jamais sous la pression.

Notre domaine change tous les mois, et ce rythme nous convient : les nouvelles technologies et les nouveaux secteurs s’apprennent vite, et les habitudes qui ne servent plus s’abandonnent sans regret. Devant un problème difficile, le réflexe est de le découper en étapes vérifiables, avec un haut niveau d’exigence sur le code comme sur les livrables.

Quand il manque quelque chose, pour un client ou pour le chapter, nous le construisons. La progression passe par des retours constructifs, par le partage des connaissances, par la demande d’aide sans attendre et par la reconnaissance du travail des autres. Il y a beaucoup à apprendre, et beaucoup à construire.

Un counsellor accompagne vos premiers mois. L’onboarding technique ouvre le parcours, suivi d’un premier projet client ; si aucun n’est prêt, les starter kits internes prennent le relais.

Le reste s’apprend sur les projets, avec les AI Engineers et l’appui de la communauté Context & Analytics Engineer, notamment le context engineering, c’est-à-dire le travail qui rend les données exploitables par les agents d’IA. À partir de 2027, l’archétype Context & Analytics Engineer disposera de sa propre grille de compétences et de son propre parcours de formation, en plus du socle commun à tous les AI Applied Engineers (évaluation de l’IA, responsabilité en production).

Plus tard, un rôle transverse devient possible (Project Tech Lead, Pre-sales Engineer, Engineering Manager), tout comme les chapters AI Architect et AI Product Manager.

Processus de recrutement

Le processus demande environ quatre heures, réparties en six étapes dont une seule sur site.

  1. Entretien RH (45 min, à distance) : parcours, motivations et points pratiques, comme le calendrier et les prétentions salariales.
  2. Appel avec le CTO (15 à 30 min, à distance).
  3. Screening technique (30 min, à distance, avec un membre du chapter AI Applied Engineer) : retour détaillé sur vos projets passés, puis questions techniques et de design de solution.
  4. Code review et live coding (60 min, sur site, avec un membre du chapter) : relecture d’un dépôt de code existant et correction de ses défauts, puis construction d’une nouvelle fonctionnalité avec un coding agent et présentation du résultat.
  5. Cas technique (45 min, à distance, avec un membre du chapter) : cadrage d’un problème métier, proposition d’une solution technique, description de la méthode d’évaluation, puis discussion de vos choix.
  6. Entretien final (30 min, à distance, avec une personne de l’encadrement du département, Engineering Manager ou Director) : reprise des points restés ouverts, choix de l’archétype et du niveau les mieux adaptés à votre profil, et réponses à toutes vos questions.

Selon les étapes, tous les outils d’IA sont autorisés, ou aucun. Lors du live coding, c’est la manière de travailler avec l’assistance de l’IA qui est observée.

Rémunération : 66 000€ à 75 000€ brut annuel (fixe) + jusqu’à 10 000€ de variable selon expérience et séniorité

Chez Artefact, nous sommes convaincus que la diversité des parcours, des expériences et des perspectives fait la richesse de nos équipes. Nous nous engageons à offrir un environnement inclusif et des opportunités équitables, où chacune et chacun peut évoluer et exprimer pleinement son potentiel. Nos recrutements reposent sur les compétences, le potentiel et l’adéquation avec le rôle.

Qui sommes-nous ?

Syneo, filiale du Groupe Associatif Réunir, est le cabinet d’ingénierie mobilité au service de PME du transport routier de voyageurs. Il les accompagne dans la réponse aux appels d’offres : de la phase amont jusqu’à la mise en place du réseau une fois le marché remporté.

En nous rejoignant, vous intégrez une équipe experte et engagée, au service d’entreprises et leurs divers projets pour contribuer concrètement à leur croissance.

Le poste

Vous rejoignez notre équipe en tant que Chargé.e Marketing & Communication – Transport de voyageurs. Rattaché.e à la référente Marketing et Communication, vous l'accompagnez sur les réponses aux appels d'offres de nos adhérents et le déploiement des réseaux remportés. Vous construisez des stratégies de communication pour des réseaux de transport urbain et transformez des contenus techniques en supports clairs et convaincants.

Vos missions

Réponse à appel d’offres

  • Participer à l'élaboration et au chiffrage de la stratégie marketing et communication de réseaux de transport urbain de petite et moyenne taille

  • Contribuer à l'élaboration des briefs destinés aux agences de communication

  • Participer à la rédaction des argumentaires marketing et communication des mémoires techniques

  • Concevoir les supports graphiques qui valorisent l'offre : affiches, mock-up, autres visuels

  • Préparer les supports de présentation pour les phases de négociation

Déploiement des réseaux

  • Accompagner la mise en place des nouveaux réseaux une fois le contrat remporté, en appui de la Référente Marketing & Communication

Veille

  • Suivre les tendances en communication, design et IA, et proposer de nouveaux usages

Savoir-faire

  • Formation Bac+5 en communication, marketing ou équivalent

  • Au moins 1 an d'expérience professionnelle obligatoire, alternance comprise

  • Maîtrise de la suite Microsoft (Word, PowerPoint, Excel) et de Canva

  • Appétence pour la création graphique ; la maîtrise de la suite Adobe est un plus

  • Curiosité pour l'IA et ses usages en communication

  • Aisance rédactionnelle et capacité de synthèse, pour produire des supports clairs

  • Intérêt pour la mobilité, le transport de voyageurs et l'accompagnement des PME

Savoir-être

  • Rigueur et sens des délais, pour mener plusieurs projets en parallèle

  • Sens du relationnel, pour échanger avec nos adhérents et les fournisseurs

  • Esprit d'équipe et capacité à travailler en transversalité

  • Créativité et force de proposition

  • Mobilité, pour les déplacements chez les adhérents et sur les événements

Ce que nous vous proposons

  • Rémunération : 32-40k€

  • Tickets restaurant

  • 1 à 2 jours de télétravail

  • Accès à la plateforme "Réunir Avantages"

title: Chief Financial Officer at Private Equity Insights
descriptionHtml:
Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment, where you gain a tremendous amount of responsibility? Do you want to be part of an exceptional entrepreneurial team with young, motivated and extremely driven people? And are you curious or passionate about finance? If so, you might be our Chief Financial Officer.

About us

Private Equity Insights is part of United Media (https://www.united-media.com/) which focuses on building large-scale industry media and conference products in sectors such as insurance, HR, private equity, retail, etc.

What we offer you

As our Chief Financial Officer you get the unique opportunity to be a key player in building one of our portfolio companies. By providing you with the ownership of our finances, we want to constantly push you out of your comfort zone. You’ll be working out of our HQ in London and to ensure a never ending growth curve, we provide you with:

  • An opportunity for getting operational experience in a start-up or scale-up where both your work and the results are highly tangible and matters to the business.
    • A chance to work closely together with one of our CEO’s on our finances and budgets as well as report to investors on a monthly basis and participate in board meetings.
    • Unlimited growth potential in our company - we strongly believe in and have a track record of promoting internally.

Your responsibilities

Your responsibilities will vary; however, some of them will be to:

  • Prepare annual budgets for effective financial planning.
  • Provide weekly updates on cash flow.
  • Conduct monthly P&L and cash updates for comprehensive financial insights.
  • Evaluate and implement cost optimisation programs.
  • Review intercompany and external loans to ensure optimal financial health.
  • Offer support to sales and operations teams.
  • Lead the Working Capital responsibilities.
  • Manage the Human Resources Financial Planning responsibilities.
  • Offer support to sales and operations teams.

What we expect from you

You possess an unparalleled work ethic with a high sense of urgency. You have a relentless drive and desire to be the very best at what you do. You take ownership of everything you do, are proactive and follow through on commitments. Moreover, you’re humble and you share our passion for building and executing new businesses. Furthermore, we expect that you have:

  • Accounting background. Ideally, more than two years of experience from a Big Four firm.
  • Experience as CFO, Head of Finance or Finance Director from a small or medium-sized business.
  • UK working permit.
  • Media and Conferences industry background preferred but not mandatory.

title: Chief Growth Officer

title: Chief of Staff
descriptionHtml:
About Act

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives. The net effect is to eliminate misinformation, achieve low coordination costs, enable high quality tasks and collaboration at scale with minimal or little prompting.

 

About the Role

You will be responsible for building and running the operational infrastructure behind ActAI.

This includes setting up new offices and entities, implementing payroll and local operations, managing vendors, supporting recruiting operations, and ensuring the company can execute efficiently as it scales.

You will be responsible for operational execution across markets.

 

What You Will Be Doing

  • Lead business operations across multiple countries.

  • Manage and develop a team of Business Operations Partners.

  • Oversee office setup, entity incorporation, and market launches.

  • Oversee payroll implementation and local operational requirements.

  • Manage external vendors and service providers.

  • Support recruiting operations, recruiter onboarding, and hiring activities.

  • Plan and execute company events, offsites, and operational logistics.

  • Track key initiatives and ensure actions are completed on time.

  • Improve processes where needed to increase speed and reliability.

What You Will Need

  • Experience in business operations, strategic operations, founder's office, or similar roles.

  • Experience managing projects involving multiple stakeholders.

  • Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and follow through on commitments.

  • Comfortable working across recruiting, finance, legal, and administrative functions.

  • Able to identify problems, make decisions, and drive execution independently.

  • High ownership and willingness to take responsibility for outcomes.

How We Work

The best products in the world are built by small, highly capable teams.

We operate with high talent density, high ownership and high standards. We value people who can think independently, move quickly and solve problems without waiting for instructions.

This is a hands-on environment. Everyone is expected to contribute directly to the company's success.

Interview Process

If there appears to be a fit, we will schedule up to 3 interviews.

Applications are reviewed by members of our leadership and hiring teams. Interviews may be conducted virtually or onsite.

We value speed, transparency and decisiveness throughout the process.

title: Client Support Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Location: Bristol, UK(hybrid, three days a week in the office)

Level: Engineer C2

Team: Client Support

Salary: 43,700 - £65,600 + discretionary bonus

Contract: Permanent

Reporting To: Client Support Lead

 

Please note: This role requires an existing right to work in the UK. We can’t offer visa sponsorship, but we review sponsorship role by role, so keep an eye on our careers site for future opportunities.

 

About Kaluza

 

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

 

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

 

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

 

What you’ll do

 

You’ll combine deep technical support with hands-on engineering, building the tooling, data models and infrastructure that make support faster and leaner over time, rather than something that grows with headcount. Your balance across these areas may shift with business needs.

  • Lead impact assessments and root cause analysis on platform issues. You’ll trace journeys through our systems using metrics, logs and data, evaluate behaviour against specs, tests and documentation, identify affected accounts and drive fixes through the Kaluza incident process.

  • Own escalations for the toughest problems, working with senior product and engineering colleagues to diagnose failures and land lasting fixes and structural improvements instead of workarounds.

  • Be the go-to expert for early-life support on the Retail Energy platform, working with change and release managers so every release is adopted smoothly.

  • Build and maintain SQL reporting models (e.g. DBT/Dataform on Databricks or BigQuery) that power automated fixes for recurring issues. You’ll keep them accurate as upstream data and business rules change, and use data, APIs and dashboards to spot trends that improve operations and inform product decisions.

  • Automate manual workflows in Python or TypeScript against internal APIs and services, with full audit trails (requests, responses, timestamps, success/failure) so every fix is traceable. You’ll also spot where automation and AI can remove manual work and take those ideas from concept to production.

  • Deploy and run the infrastructure behind this work, including serverless (Lambda, Step Functions), Kubernetes scheduled jobs and CRON batch processes. Everything you own in production will be defined in Terraform, with monitoring and alerting in line with our policies.

  • Shape what great client support looks like at Kaluza. You’ll champion ITIL best practice, turn solutions into runbooks with service desk analysts to shift work left, share learnings with the wider engineering community and contribute to our engineering standards.

This role includes some out-of-hours work and a place on a 24/7 on-call rotation.

What you’ll bring

Essential criteria:

  • Experience leading technical investigations and root cause analysis on production systems, using logs, metrics and data to trace issues across multiple services.

  • Strong hands-on skills in at least one of TypeScript, Python or SQL data modelling (DBT, Dataform or similar, building and maintaining models rather than just querying them), with working familiarity across the others.

  • Experience integrating with REST APIs and using observability platforms and data query tools such as Databricks.

Ideally, you’ll have:

  • Experience with Terraform and AWS, including serverless (Lambda) and container or scheduling patterns (Kubernetes, CRON). If you haven’t used these yet, we’ll support you to learn them quickly.

  • Knowledge of energy industry processes and supporting technologies, and awareness of modern architectures such as microservices.

  • Experience using AI tooling to automate support or engineering workflows.

  • Experience in the energy industry or a SaaS business, with an understanding of how clients use a platform to reach their goals.

  • Strong stakeholder management skills

Tech stack: TypeScript, Python, SQL, DBT/Dataform, Databricks, BigQuery, AWS (Lambda, Step Functions), Kubernetes, Terraform

 

Our Values

Five values guide how we work at Kaluza:

 

  • Play to win: Collective pride in decarbonising energy at scale.

  • Solve the real problem: Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes.

  • Build trust every day: Consistency, transparency and doing what we say.

  • Own the outcome: Full accountability, wins and setbacks, without ego.

  • Go further together: Collaboration, respect and different perspectives.

 

Our Perks

 

  • Time off and family: 26 days’ holiday, plus 26 weeks’ full pay for new parents with no qualifying service period

  • Health and security: Private medical insurance with virtual GP, life assurance, pension scheme, free mortgage advice and eye tests

  • Pay and flexibility: Discretionary bonus, a Flex Fund of 5% [of salary] to spend on the benefits you want most, retail discounts through Perks at Work

  • Growth and setup: Personal learning budget, home office budget

  • Climate: Furthr, our climate action app

Come as you are

 

We want to meet people from all walks of life. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be, and we recognise talent on merit and potential. If you’re excited about the role but don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you.

 

Find out more on our careers page and LinkedIn. Our Applicant Data Protection Policy is here.

title: Compliance Analyst Intern (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
At Upvest, we are on a mission to make investing as easy as spending money. Upvest empowers businesses to offer a wide range of investment products and the best experience in the field of capital market investment and retirement planning. Upvest’s Investment API is easy to integrate so that fintechs and financial institutions can save resources and fully focus on their core business.

We are proud to partner with Europe’s leading Fintechs and financial institutions such as DKB, Revolut, N26 and Raisin. Founded in 2017 by Martin Kassing, Upvest now brings together over 270 talented professionals from more than 70 nationalities. Upvest is backed by €280M in total funding from world class investors, including BlackRock, Tencent, Sapphire Ventures, and Bessemer Venture Partners, Earlybird, Notion Capital, and Motive. Our latest €105M funding round in March 2026 led by Sapphire and Tencent serves as a massive catalyst for our growth, allowing us to offer premier investment experience.


About the role:

  • Join Upvest Securities Ltd, our FCA authorised UK entity, as a Compliance Analyst Intern for an initial six month term (extendable), reporting into the Head of UK Compliance.

  • You’ll help us maintain our compliance monitoring and outsourcing oversight and keep pace with Upvest’s growth, so that controls are checked systematically rather than reactively;

  • Experience hands on exposure to the rules that matter most for our UK investment platform, understand regulatory requirements including CASS, Consumer Duty and the outsourcing requirements.

  • Deep dive into financial crime and anti money laundering related topics to understand the real time impact of 2LOD oversight in an established financial institution

  • Maintain monitoring and second line approval and work closely with our regulatory team to focus on strategic priorities and direct engagement with the FCA and our auditors.

  • Enable our Growth and Product colleagues to onboard new clients and partners, so your work makes it easier for others to move quickly and safely.

  • Start with a structured two week induction and a 90 day ramp plan, with the Head of Compliance as your named buddy and everything you produce reviewed by an experienced colleague.

  • A midpoint check in will review your progress and the option to extend your term or move into a permanent junior role, so this is a real stepping stone into a compliance career.


What you’ll do:

  • Execute scheduled checks under our compliance monitoring programme, log and report the results, and flag any issues early so they can be resolved fast.

  • Support due diligence and periodic reviews and keep the outsourcing register and risk assessments up to date.

  • Keep actions and comments up to date for the Core UK Compliance initiatives in our UK readiness plan, and chase progress where it stalls.

What you bring:

  • Currently studying, or recently graduated, in law, finance, economics, business or a related field, and available for a six month term (part time as a working student or full time as an intern).

  • Clear written and spoken English, with the ability to turn complex regulatory topics into simple, concise summaries.

It’s great if you have:

How we Upvest in you:

Our Values:

title: Comptable général sénior H/F
descriptionHtml:
Tu as envie de travailler dans un environnement bienveillant qui avance vite ? 5ème fournisseur français en 10 ans, Octopus Energy est un fournisseur d’énergies renouvelables qui agit comme un véritable fer de lance pour la révolution électro tech.

Comment on fait ? On ne peut pas révolutionner le monde en travaillant comme tout le monde On essaye de ne pas trop se prendre la tête, ici on évolue dans un environnement sans trop de process ni trop de règles. Le plus important, ce n’est pas seulement de suivre le mouvement, mais de le créer.

On ne veut pas créer des clones d’entreprise. On te veut toi, avec tes talents, tes perspectives et tes compétences uniques.




Pourquoi ce poste ?

Octopus Energy France connaît une forte croissance sur ses segments B2C, B2B et B2G, et sa fonction Finance se structure en parallèle : migration récente d’Odoo vers NetSuite, automatisation de la chaîne fournisseurs, interfaçage avec les plateformes de facturation, harmonisation avec les standards du groupe au Royaume-Uni. Nous cherchons un·e comptable général senior capable de prendre en main un périmètre critique (marge brute et fiscalité énergie), de le fiabiliser et de le faire évoluer. Plus qu’un·e exécutant·e, tu seras celui ou celle qui identifie les problèmes, en comprend la cause et met en place des solutions durables.
Tes missions
Gross margin et comptabilité énergie
  • Piloter la comptabilisation mensuelle des flux de marge brute (achats d’énergie, acheminement, ventes facturées et non facturées) et en produire une analyse critique : variations, écarts, leviers
  • Fiabiliser le cut-off et les estimations de fin de mois (factures à établir, énergie livrée non facturée, provisions), en lien avec les équipes opérationnelles et facturation
  • Justifier et documenter les comptes de ton périmètre, et traiter les anomalies jusqu’à leur résolution définitive
    • Fiscalité énergie et TVA
  • Établir, contrôler et déposer les déclarations de TVA (CA3) ainsi que les accises sur l’électricité et le gaz naturel et la CTA
  • Établir les déclarations d’échanges de biens (EMEBI) sur les flux intra-UE
  • Être l’interlocuteur·trice de référence sur les questions fiscales du périmètre : analyser les cas nouveaux (offres commerciales, programmes de fidélité, nouveaux produits), formaliser une position et la challenger avec nos conseils externes
  • Contribuer à la mise en conformité avec la réforme de la facturation électronique et du e-reporting
    • Supervision et contrôle
  • Superviser et contrôler les opérations de la comptabilité fournisseurs, et contribuer à l’amélioration de la chaîne d’automatisation (NetSuite, Rossum)
  • Être l’interlocuteur·trice des commissaires aux comptes et des auditeurs sur ton périmètre : préparation des justificatifs, réponses aux demandes, suivi des recommandations
    • Structuration et amélioration continue
  • Identifier les points de friction dans les clôtures et les process, proposer des solutions et les mettre en œuvre
  • Raccourcir et fiabiliser les clôtures mensuelles post-migration NetSuite
  • Rédiger et maintenir la documentation des process et des contrôles
  • Être moteur·trice dans le déploiement de l’IA et de l’automatisation au sein de la Finance

    • Ce que l'on attend de toi
    De ton arrivée à 3 mois :
  • Prendre en main NetSuite, Rossum et comprendre les flux entre l’ERP et les systèmes de facturation et de back-office
  • Comprendre les mécanismes du marché de l’énergie et la construction de la gross margin
  • Réaliser tes premières clôtures et déclarations en binôme, et livrer un premier diagnostic des fragilités de ton périmètre
    • De 4 à 6 mois :
  • Être pleinement autonome sur les clôtures, l’analyse de marge et l’ensemble des déclarations fiscales
  • Être l’interlocuteur·trice de référence sur la fiscalité énergie, en interne comme vis-à-vis des CAC et conseils
  • Avoir porté au moins une amélioration concrète et mesurable (process, contrôle, automatisation)
    • Au-delà de 6 mois :
  • Être force de proposition sur la feuille de route Finance et accompagner la montée en compétences de l’équipe sur ton périmètre

    • Ce poste est fait pour toi si
  • Tu es diplômé·e d’un DSCG, DCG, d’un master CCA ou équivalent, avec 4 à 7 ans d’expérience en comptabilité et fiscalité, idéalement avec un passage en cabinet d’audit ou d’expertise suivi d’une expérience en entreprise
  • Tu as une solide maîtrise de la TVA et, idéalement, des accises énergétiques ; une expérience dans l’énergie, les utilities ou un secteur à fort volume de facturation est un vrai plus
  • Tu es habitué·e aux clôtures mensuelles exigeantes et aux échanges avec les commissaires aux comptes
  • Tu es très à l’aise avec la donnée : Excel avancé (TCD, XLOOKUP, Power Query), analyse de gros volumes ; une appétence pour l’automatisation et les outils d’IA est appréciée
  • Tu as une bonne connaissance des ERP (NetSuite apprécié) et l'expérience d’un projet de migration ou de refonte de process souhaitée
  • Tu maitrises le Français et l'Anglais professionnel (niveau B2-C1): tu échangeras régulièrement avec les équipes du groupe au Royaume-Uni
    • Ce qui fera la différence :
  • Tu es un·e vrai problem solver : face à un écart inexpliqué, tu ne te contentes pas de le corriger, tu remontes à la cause et tu fais en sorte qu’il ne se reproduise pas
  • Tu es à l’aise dans un environnement en construction, où tout n’est pas encore documenté, et tu aimes structurer
  • Tu es autonome, rigoureux·se et capable de prioriser dans un contexte qui bouge vite
  • Tu sais vulgariser des sujets techniques et travailler avec des interlocuteurs non financiers (opérations, facturation, IT)

    • Pourquoi tu vas adorer travailer chez nous ?

    Tu as vu le salaire ou la fourchette prévu·e pour ce poste mais tu aimerais en discuter ? Demande-le nous ! Lors de notre premier contact, c’est un point que nous abordons toujours, car même si nous prenons soin de définir des grilles les plus justes possibles, il nous semble également important de faire correspondre ton expérience au bon salaire. Nous aurons l’occasion de t’en dire plus sur la manière dont nous avons défini le salaire et sur les autres avantages dont tu pourras bénéficier si tu nous rejoins ! Sache enfin que nous pouvons avoir un certain degré de flexibilité, car nous ne voudrions jamais que le salaire soit une raison pour laquelle quelqu’un·e ne postule pas chez Octopus - ce qui est le plus important pour nous est de trouver le bon Octofit !

    Certifiée depuis 2024 et 4e en 2025, Octopus Energy France est classée 1ère sur plus de 200 entreprises au classement Great Place to Work 2026 ! Cela reflète bien notre engagement pour un environnement de travail épanouissant !

    Nous sommes une organisation où les gens apprennent, décident et construisent plus rapidement. Où ils travaillent de manière autonome, avec des gens extraordinaires, sur des projets qui innovent. Intéressement au capital, flex-office, excellente mutuelle, forfait mobilité douce, prise en charge d’une partie de ton titre de transport au-delà du minimum légal, et même des jours de congés spéciaux pour t’investir dans un projet associatif qui te tient à coeur… Nous voulons que ton investissement soit récompensé par des avantages auxquels tu tiens vraiment !

    Chez Octopus, nous cherchons des personnes foncièrement bienveillantes et empathiques. L’égalité des chances nous tient à cœur et nous veillons à offrir un environnement de travail inclusif et équitable. Nous t’invitons à postuler, quels que soient ton âge, genre, vie conjugale, couleur, handicap, grossesse ou parentalité, origine, convictions religieuses ou orientation sexuelle.

title: Confirmed / Senior Machine Learning Engineer (Jobexit)
descriptionHtml:
Notre mission ⚖️

Chez Doctrine, nous construisons le leader de l’IA juridique en Europe.

Notre conviction ? Le droit ne doit pas être ralenti par des tâches répétitives. Il doit être augmenté par une IA spécialisée, conçue pour comprendre, analyser et produire du raisonnement juridique avec un haut niveau d’exigence.

Notre ambition ? Permettre aux professionnels du droit de gagner en fiabilité, en efficacité et en sérénité, grâce à une plateforme unique, exhaustive et sécurisée.

Aujourd’hui, 27 000 professionnels du droit, répartis dans cinq pays (France, Italie, Allemagne, Espagne, Luxembourg), nous font confiance.

Notre développement est guidé par une approche claire : une vision globale, ancrée dans une compréhension fine des spécificités locales.

Derrière cette ambition, une équipe d’environ 250 personnes, réunies autour d’un même objectif : accompagner les juristes et avocats à toutes les étapes de leur travail, de l’analyse à la rédaction.

Et nous n’en sommes qu’au début.


Le contexte

Doctrine développe des workflows dédiés aux professionnels du droit pour accélérer et améliorer la gestion de leurs dossiers. Parmi eux, la squad Jobexit accompagne les avocats et juristes en droit social dans la simulation de ruptures du contrat de travail, notamment en calculant les indemnités de départ, les indemnités en cas de contentieux, le calendrier de sortie et les allocations chômage. Le scope de la squad s'est considérablement enrichi au-delà du simulateur, en allant vers la gestion de cabinet d’avocat à travers plusieurs langues. Tu peux trouver des détails sur l’ensemble de la stack sur Github ! A savoir : il n’est pas nécessaire d’avoir une expérience professionnelle dans le domaine du droit, cependant l’envie de s’investir et de monter en compétence dans la compréhension des documents juridique est importante :)
Les missions 🛠
  • Apporter de la compréhension et de l’automatisation autour des activités administratives et commerciales des avocats.
  • Générer automatiquement des documents administratifs propres aux dossiers de l’avocat.
  • Tirer parti de la jurimétrie et des simulations existantes pour apporter du contexte et des suggestions personnalisées autour d’une simulation de rupture de contrat de travail.
  • Étudier le développement d’un chatbot spécialisé sur la plateforme Jobexit.
  • Collaborer avec différents types de profils (ingénieurs, product managers, product designers, juristes) pour identifier de nouveaux axes de développement produit.
  • Participer à la diffusion interne et à la consolidation de nos bonnes pratiques dans le chapter ML ; contribuer à l’élaboration de notre stratégie Engineering.
  • Faire monter en compétence les autres ingénieurs de l’équipe.

    • Le profil idéal 👀
  • Une expérience significative en termes de construction de produits reposants sur des modèles de machine learning, de classification, de résumé, de génération de contenu, etc.
  • Une bonne connaissance du machine learning et en particuliers des modèles de deep learning.
  • Une capacité à délivrer rapidement des prototypes dans un environnement product-centric.
  • Un fort intérêt pour les sujets d’intelligence artificielle.
  • L’envie d’identifier, d'analyser, et d'intégrer en production les dernières avancées scientifiques dans le domaine.
  • Une bonne maîtrise du développement Python, avec un focus sur la construction d’algorithmes.
  • La maîtrise de la langue française et anglaise.

    • Les à côtés du poste 👁
  • Comme tous les ingénieurs de Doctrine, tu participeras à un de nos chapters transverses, en l’espèce du chapter Data Science.
  • Au sein de ce chapter, tu contribueras à des projets internes pour améliorer nos process et notre vision long-terme. Le chapter se réunit toutes les semaines pour :
  • 🤝 Partager des connaissances : suivit de l’état de l’art, revue de papiers scientifiques, amélioration continue, bonnes pratiques, etc.
  • 🎯 Proposer des évolutions : nouveaux outils à expérimenter, nouveaux process à mettre en œuvre.
  • Tu participeras également au 👩‍💻 recrutement : tous les contributeurs individuels rencontrent des candidats à l’occasion de tests techniques ou d’entretiens.

    • Ce qui t'attend si tu rejoins Doctrine 🤝

    • Contribuer à un projet ambitieux, avec un impact réel et positif sur la société : rendre le droit plus accessible et plus ouvert.
    • Un onboarding très complet permettant une intégration et une montée en compétence rapides.
    • Une aventure dans laquelle la formation et le partage des connaissances font partis du quotidien.
    • Rejoindre une entreprise avec une vie d’équipe riche et dynamique : conférences, team-buildings, déjeuner, offsite, afterwork, etc.

    Nos valeurs 🤝

    Chez Doctrine, nos 4 valeurs nous accompagnent au quotidien et dans notre ambition de faire bouger les choses.

    • Challenge the status quo : nous défendons les idées audacieuses qui contribuent à l’évolution de tout un secteur.
    • Liberty and responsibility : nous encourageons l’autonomie, l’impact de chacun·e et l’ownership.

    Nos avantages pour faire la différence ☀️

    Notre processus de recrutement 🚀

title: Consultant/Senior Consultant, Data & AI Strategy & Governance
descriptionHtml:
About Baringa 

Baringa is a global consulting firm that partners with leaders to drive change and create value. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.

The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence – all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.

Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly – all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors.

Certified as a Great Place to Work around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the Financial Times in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by Forbes for four consecutive years as one of the World’s Best Management Consulting Firms.

Our Data, AI, Solutions and Engineering practice are looking for experienced Consultants and Senior Consultants to join the team. 

Our Data, AI, Solutions & Engineering team really likes helping our clients solve their complex problems with data, by implementing controls and governance of data, creating actionable insights, embedding machine learning solutions or building data platforms. We bring the right team and skills on the table and can offer deep expertise across Data Strategy, Data Science & Engineering, Data Visualisation, Data Management, Data Architecture and Software Development. 

What you will be doing

You will be using your experience to help our clients solve their most important data challenges. Data and AI strategy and governance call on very similar skills, and you will bring both: understanding what the business is trying to achieve, shaping a clear data vision and business case, and putting in place the right data foundations.  

You will also support the growth of our team, helping them to build the skills they need to solve our clients’ challenges. Depending on your level, you will have the opportunity to help shape the direction of the practice, grow the business and lead our people. 

Most of our engagements span both strategy and governance. Typical engagements look like: 

  • Defining the data strategy for clients, including a UK energy company, to identify the team, capability, technology and governance required to meet growing data needs, and a European energy trader, to set out a vision and establish a well-governed data platform that better supports trading analytics 
  • Supporting a non-profit government-owned organisation in defining their data strategy and implementing a new data management and governance capability 
  • Defining AI strategies and use-case roadmaps that link AI ambition to business value, assessing data and AI readiness, and prioritising investment in the data foundations needed to scale AI safely 
  • Developing tailored strategies for the delivery of data governance and data culture, and designing practical Data Governance frameworks and operating models aligned to business needs and strategic priorities 
  • Designing and embedding AI governance frameworks and operating models, covering accountability, model and use-case approval, risk classification, monitoring and lifecycle management, aligned to emerging regulation and standards 
  • Assessing our clients' data management maturity to identify areas for improvement and set out a prioritised roadmap, then delivering targeted uplift of Data Governance capabilities that drive business benefit, including improved governance and management of metadata, data lineage, data quality, master data, reference data and data architecture, using agile delivery approaches to iteratively deliver value whilst building capability 
  • Driving the remediation of data quality and other root cause issues related to data, working with technology teams and data engineers to automate data governance activities and integrate them into data pipelines and cloud platforms as code 

 
Your skills and experience  

We are hiring highly motivated and talented individuals with around 3 to 8 years’ experience who want to help clients realise the value of their data. You will be comfortable moving between setting the direction for an organisation’s data and building the operating model, controls and capability needed to deliver it. At the heart of the role are the skills that sit across both AI strategy and governance: 

  • Collecting and understanding business requirements to draw out the data needs of the business, and turning these into clear priorities 
  • Assessing data management maturity and identifying the gaps between where an organisation is today and where it needs to be 
  • Defining the capabilities, processes, roles, skills and governance needed for the client, including data ownership and stewardship, drawing on previous experience embedding operational data governance in complex and diverse environments 
  • Setting out the required roadmap of initiatives for an organisation to transform to become more data-driven, balancing quick wins with longer-term change 
  • Constructing the business case for the cost and benefits of investing in data strategy and governance 
  • Understanding of the principles, practices and frameworks in data governance and experience delivering data quality management 
  • Understanding of AI governance frameworks and operating models, covering accountability, model and use-case approval, risk classification, monitoring and lifecycle management 
  • Understanding of knowledge graphs and semantic technologies and how they underpin trusted, explainable AI, including grounding generative AI in enterprise knowledge 
  • Understanding of how data quality, privacy and regulatory requirements shape both what an organisation can do with its data and how it needs to be managed, including knowledge of data protection standards and regulation, the risks and controls in data privacy, and experience with tools supporting data privacy and data management  
  • Driving data culture and change, bringing both business and technology stakeholders along with you 
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to develop clear requirements and specifications and communicate complex technical information to both technical and non-technical colleagues, alongside excellent people skills – creating, developing and maintaining relationships

title: Content Marketing Lead
descriptionHtml:
Our Mission
Human time and effort is the rarest thing in the universe. The fact that so many people hate what they do for work is a disaster on so many levels. How many people live quiet lives of misery? How many generational talents do we miss due to circumstance?

Dex’s mission is to close the gap between Talent & Opportunity, we believe that work, and being productive, is part of the human condition, that regardless of AI, human passion, ingenuity and a desire to do things means that work will always exist.

We are building Dex to create a future where technology helps every individual to understand their strengths, interests and unique abilities, and to connect with opportunities where they can thrive, because more people doing things they love leads to a better, happier and more productive world.

We are starting by connecting the world's most ambitious software engineers with the companies that deserve them.

About the Role

As Content Lead at Dex, you'll write and publish everything that carries our name.

You'll own Dex's channels: the website, social, email, our events programme and blog. You'll take a content strategy that already exists and turn it into a steady, high-quality output.

This is a job for someone who writes fast and well, and who thinks past the draft. The copy is half of it. The other half is knowing where a piece needs to land, what it needs to look like to get found, and what it should do to the reader once it does.

You'll work closely with Marketing, Growth, Design and Product.

You'll have real autonomy and very little bureaucracy.

What You'll Do

  • Own the channels. The publishing calendar across site, social, email and the blog is yours. You decide what runs, when, and in what order.

  • Write across every format. LinkedIn and X posts, campaign and event emails, landing pages, product and lifecycle copy, event pages and follow-ups, articles and explainers. A 90-word page and a 1,500-word argument in the same afternoon, both sounding like us.

  • Think in distribution, not just drafts. Every piece gets planned around where it will be read: why a piece lands on Hacker News and dies on LinkedIn, which newsletters and communities our audience already trusts.

  • Write for search and AI answers. We have a GEO and SEO spec built with our search partner: answer-first structure, extractable formatting, clean internal linking, author entity pages. You'll write to it and help us improve it.

  • Carry the events programme. Copy and collateral for our event series, before, during and after, and the follow-up sequences that turn attendance into something.

  • Work the numbers. Track performance and report back on the metrics that matter across our owned blog and organic social media channels.

  • Use AI properly. Research, outlining, structuring, first passes, repurposing, quality checks. We'll give you all the Claude tokens you can use. We will not ship anything that sounds like AI wrote it, and we'll ask you how you draw that line.

  • Guard the voice. You'll be the most frequent user of our tone of voice and audience research, and the person most responsible for whether it holds up in public.

What we're looking for

  • 4+ years writing in-house or at an agency, ideally for a technical or developer audience, ideally in a start-up where you had to build the process as well as the output

  • Genuine range across formats and lengths, evidenced by a portfolio of published work

  • A real view on distribution: where our audience discovers, consumes and shares things, and what a piece needs to look like to survive that journey

  • Working knowledge of SEO and how AI search surfaces content, enough to write to a spec and challenge it

  • Fluent with AI tools across research, outlining and iteration, with judgement about where the machine stops and you start

  • Commercial literacy. You can connect a piece of content to an outcome and look beyond vanity metrics

  • Editorial judgement under your own steam. You can take a rough steer and come back with something better than the brief

  • A proactive communicator who works well without supervision and asks for what they need

Nice to Have

  • Any technical background, formal or self-taught

  • You've run a newsletter, blog or publication of your own

  • Experience marketing to engineers, developers or another audience that punishes fluff

  • Experience with content for events and communities

  • Basic design or motion skills, enough to get a social asset out without waiting

What this role isn't

Not a strategy job. The strategy exists and you're here to execute it, though you'll influence it constantly and we expect you to argue with it.

Not a pure writing job. Publishing, sequencing, formatting, distribution and measurement are all yours.

What We Offer

  • Above market salary — we're building a world class team and believe pay should match that ambition

  • Significant equity — we want this to be the last job you 'have' to take

  • Full private healthcare & dental — because life happens and we want to support you

  • Fertility benefits & enhanced parental support

  • Gym membership & wellness benefits

  • Claude tokens — lots and lots of Claude tokens

  • Regular socials, offsites and an annual trip

  • MacBook Pro + team kit

  • "Whatever you need" approach to tools and support


Interview process

We move quickly and with conviction. Broadly you can expect:

  1. We love it when candidates have experimented with our agent, Dex. Even if you aren't an Engineer, you can get a sense of what we're building, and we love to hear your feedback.

  2. A 30m video call with our Internal Talent Lead; we'll share more about the team, role and business before asking questions about your experience and fit.

  3. Hiring Manager call: we'll share more specific context on short and medium-term objectives and ask deeper questions relative to the role requirements.

  4. Most roles involve a practical task to better understand how you work. Usually completed offline and reviewed by the team.

  5. Onsite interview loop where you'll visit the office, meet a cohort of the team, one interview centred on the task you produced, another on Dex culture and values, with a final interview with our Founder, Paddy.

Dafür suchen wir erfahrene Persönlichkeiten, die Verantwortung übernehmen, Teams führen, Kunden begeistern und unser weiteres Wachstum aktiv mitgestalten.

DEINE ROLLE

Als Creative AI Lead (m|w|d) übernimmst Du eine zentrale kreative Rolle in unserem wachsenden AI-Bereich.

Du verantwortest die kreative Entwicklung anspruchsvoller AI-Projekte für führende internationale Marken und begleitest sie von der ersten Idee bis zum finalen Ergebnis. Dein Fokus liegt auf der Entwicklung außergewöhnlicher visueller Konzepte, Bildwelten und kreativer AI-Lösungen, die Markenidentität, gestalterischen Anspruch und neue technologische Möglichkeiten miteinander verbinden.

Du bist kreative Instanz, fachlicher Lead, Sparringspartner unserer Kunden und Impulsgeber für die kreative Weiterentwicklung unserer AI-Projekte.

DEINE AUFGABEN

  • Kreative Konzeption: Entwicklung und fachliche Führung innovativer GenAI-Konzepte für Marken, Kampagnen und unterschiedliche Content-Formate.

  • AI Art Direction: Definition und Weiterentwicklung von Look & Feel, Bildsprache, visuellen Systemen und kreativen Qualitätsstandards für AI-gestützte Produktionen.

UNSER ANGEBOT

title: Creative Strategist
descriptionHtml:

title: CRM Executive
descriptionHtml:
THE CARWOW GROUP

Carwow Group is driven by a passion for getting people into cars. But not just any car, the right car. That’s why we are building the go-to destination for car-changing. Designed to reach drivers everywhere with our trail-blazing portfolio of personality rich automotive brands; Carwow, Auto Express, evo, Driving Electric and Car Buyer.

What started as a simple reviews site, is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe - over 10m customers have used Carwow to help them buy and sell cars since its inception. Last year we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service.

In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia, doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with over 1.1 billion annual views, sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million.

WHY JOIN US?

We are winners of the prestigious Culture 100 award that recognises the most loved and happiest tech companies to work for! We recently raised $52m in funding led by global venture capital firm Bessemer Venture Partners (an early backer of LinkedIn and Shopify) to accelerate our growth plans!

As pioneers, we’re always driving for new territory and positive change, so our work as a group is never done. Where others see difficulty, it’s our responsibility to see possibility – building new experiences, launching new titles and listening to drivers.

Being a part of Carwow Group means championing drivers and the automotive industry, acting as a disrupter and never being afraid to fail (but learning fast when we do!).

Our team of 500 employees across the UK, Germany, Spain and Portugal are revolutionising car-changing and we are fast expanding our mission across every single brand and country we operate in, so jump in!

THE ROLE

As a CRM Marketing Executive within the Customer and Marketing team at Carwow, you will play a key role in communicating to our users about changing their car.

Email and Push are pivotal channels for communicating with our users and you will be responsible for managing campaigns from brief through to delivery.

Working alongside the CRM Marketing Manager/Senior Manager, you will work closely with the commercial and marketing teams.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Traffic email campaigns through Carwow, making sure that campaigns are briefed on time, correct assets have been provided, and sign off is given ahead of campaign deployment

  • Managing the email campaign calendar, populating new briefs and updating statuses

  • Building email templates using a drag and drop editor in Iterable

  • Creating dynamic content and A/B tests to maximise personalisation and performance.

  • Building customer segments in Iterable, including managing exclusions

  • QA of email campaigns to ensure 100% accuracy of spelling and grammar, URLs and targeting

  • Reporting on key performance metrics back to the business

  • Assisting with CRM programs and subscription initiatives for the Carwow Studios brands (Auto Express / Evo Magazine)

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

  • Some hands-on experience building email campaigns in a marketing platform (e.g. Iterable, Braze, Klaviyo, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Mailchimp) - you don't need to be an expert, but you've actually built and sent campaigns before

  • A fast learner - comfortable picking up new tools and processes quickly with minimal hand-holding

  • Sharp attention to detail

  • Strong written English - you'll be reviewing copy and content

  • Comfortable working with data at a basic level (segments, exclusions, reporting)

BONUS POINTS

  • Experience with Iterable specifically

  • Exposure to A/B testing or personalisation in a CRM/email context

  • Experience with Mobile Push as a marketing channel

  • Experience with AI tools like Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini

  • Experience in the publishing / subscriptions industries


INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Introductory call with our Talent team

  • Online interview with the Hiring Manager

  • Values Interview

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU

  • Hybrid working (2 days working from home)

  • Competitive salary

  • Matched pension contributions

  • Share options - when we thrive, so do you!

  • Bupa Private medical and dental insurance, for peace of mind, plus eyecare vouchers

  • Life Assurance

  • Monthly coaching sessions with Spill - our mental wellbeing partner

  • Enhanced holiday package, plus Bank Holidays

  • 28 days annual leave

  • 1 day for your wedding

  • 1 day off when you move house - because moving is hard enough without work!

  • For your third year anniversary, get 30 days of annual leave per year

  • For your tenth year anniversary, get 35 days of annual leave per year

  • Option to buy 3 extra days of holiday per year

  • The option to work from abroad up to 4 weeks

  • Inclusive parental, partner and shared parental leave, fertility treatment and pregnancy loss policies

  • Bubble childcare support and discounted nanny fees for little ones

  • Up to £500/€550 home office allowance for that massage chair you’ve been talking about

  • Generous learning and development budget to help you master your craft

  • Regular social events: tech lunches, coffee with the exec sessions, lunch 8 learns, book clubs, social events/anything else you pester us for

  • Refer a friend, get paid. Repeat for infinite money

title: Customer Care Associate
descriptionHtml:
Join Choco, where we build and own solutions that reshape a broken food system.

The global food supply chain is inefficient by design. Waste is high, margins are thin, and most distributor order processes are done over the phone, tracked across broad spreadsheets, and based on intuition rather than strong data.


At Choco, we’re changing that. We build software used daily by food distributors and their customers to run their business. It automates orders, reduces errors, and helps operations run faster and more reliably. Because it’s embedded in daily operations, our SaaS platform has immediate, real-world impact, on efficiency, margins, and how businesses run day to day.

As Customer Care Associate, you will own customer issue resolution end to end and ensure distributors receive fast, reliable support in their day to day operations. You are accountable for ensuring customer order flow stays running and resolving customer issues as they arise.

What you’ll do

  • Own customer issues from first contact through resolution across French and Spanish-speaking markets

  • Build and deliver fast, reliable support workflows used by distributors in day-to-day operations

  • Work through messy, time-sensitive issues (order errors, blocked accounts, product problems) to keep operations running smoothly

  • Make decisions that directly impact customer satisfaction, retention, and order flow continuity

  • Improve support quality by identifying patterns in recurring issues and driving root-cause fixes

  • Take responsibility for clear escalation and coordination with internal teams when needed

  • Coaching and training of external agents supporting Choco customers

  • Collaborate with external support agents and internal teams to maintain high-quality service standards

What you bring

  • 1+ years of experience in customer support or operations in fast-paced, tech-enabled environments, with a track record of owning outcomes

  • Comfort operating across multiple tools and stakeholders in ambiguity and high-pressure situations

  • Strong judgment in prioritization and real-time problem solving

  • Accountability when things go wrong and the drive to resolve issues fully

  • Native level of French speaking & writing is required

  • Fluency in Spanish and English (C1+ written and spoken)

Working hours

This is a customer-facing operational role with fixed coverage requirements. You will work Monday to Friday from 9:00 to 18:00, including a daily upaid lunch break. You must be consistently available during these hours to support customers across both Choco and Goot.

What you get

  • Work on digitalizing core operating systems for food distributors, automating orders, sales and payments in a system that still largely runs on calls and spreadsheets.

  • Work with an AI product with proven product–market fit, already embedded in distributor workflows and directly affecting order accuracy, speed, and margins.

  • Join a global team across 6 countries and 40+ nationalities, building a company that has raised $300M+ and reached unicorn status (~$1.2B valuation) with the ambition to define this category end-to-end.

  • In return, you get real ownership, equity, and the support to do your best work, including competitive compensation, health and wellbeing support, and long-term benefits like a sabbatical (all localized by office).

  • Collaborate with people who want to own outcomes in a messy, real-world system and make it work at scale.

If you want to work on real problems, take ownership, and raise the bar, we should talk.

Choco is an equal opportunity employer. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply. We are committed to ensuring that our technology is available and accessible to everyone. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, religion, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital status, family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Customer Care Officer - IT
descriptionHtml:
About Alma

At Alma, we believe that commerce should be balanced and sustainable.

Our mission is to put finance back where it belongs: at the service of merchants and consumers.

We build Buy Now Pay Later solutions that help merchants increase sales while enabling consumers to manage their budget responsibly.

Today:

  • 25,000+ active merchants
  • 10 million consumers served
  • 4.8/5 on Trustpilot

Our team has grown from 2 to more than 400 people and we continue to expand across Europe.

About the role

As a Customer Care Officer, you will play a key role in ensuring a smooth and reliable experience for both merchants and consumers using Alma in Italy.

This position is part of our international expansion, and you will contribute directly to supporting our growth in the Italian market. You will handle customer and merchant requests, resolve complex issues, and help improve our operational processes to deliver a high-quality experience.

This role is based in Lille, with 2 days of remote work per week.

Occasional weekend shifts may be required (approximately twice per quarter).

Your main responsibilities will include:

💬 Customer & merchant support

  • Handle complex requests from merchants and consumers via email and phone
  • Guide users in the use of Alma’s payment solutions
  • Provide clear and helpful responses while ensuring a high level of customer satisfaction

⚙️ Operations & process management

  • Manage debt collection actions and follow up on payment delays
  • Ensure smooth onboarding of new merchants and help them implement the Alma solution
  • Monitor cases and ensure issues are resolved efficiently

📈 Continuous improvement

  • Identify recurring issues and share insights to improve processes and tools
  • Contribute to quality reviews and operational improvements
  • Support the onboarding and training of new team members as the team grows

About you

You would be a great fit if you:

  • Have strong written and verbal communication skills in Italian, French and English
  • Are customer-oriented, empathetic and solution-driven
  • Are organized and rigorous in your work
  • Are autonomous and resourceful when solving problems
  • Are comfortable working in a fast-growing environment

A first experience in customer support, operations or similar roles is a plus.

Why join Alma

  • Offices in Paris (10th arrondissement) and Lille – Euratechnologies
  • Health insurance fully covered for you and your family
  • Meal vouchers (Swile)
  • Sustainable mobility package
  • Choice of laptop (Mac or Windows)
  • Regular team events and internal talks

Recruitment process

The process includes:

  1. Introductory interview with Talent Acquisition
  2. Online test
  3. Interview with the Team Lead or Operations Manager
  4. Team fit discussion with members of the Operation teams
