title: Customer Success Account Manager, Mid-Market
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

You help customers adopt the platform, realise measurable value, and renew and expand with confidence. You pick up where Implementation leaves off, learn each customer's fleet and challenges, and advise on tailoring Samsara to them. You manage 100+ named accounts, using AI tooling to extend your reach and focus your time where it counts. Your understanding of the value customers get earns you the right to lead the ROI conversation, negotiate terms and close renewals that work for both sides, minimising financial attrition. You work with Sales, Support, Deal Desk, Operations and Product.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact, helping to keep the lights on, get food into stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
  • You thrive the most when solving problems: Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.
  • You are a natural relationship builder: Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. This team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper-growth environment.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together, and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there.

In this role, you will:

  • Deeply understand the Samsara platform's capabilities and explain them to businesses of all types, from field services and utilities to long-haul transportation and school buses.
  • Manage a portfolio of 100+ named accounts, using AI tooling to accelerate your engagement, prioritize proactively, and drive efficiency and outcomes across your book of business.
  • Lead the ROI and value conversation into the renewal, negotiate favorable terms, and close renewals that are a win for both the customer and Samsara while minimizing financial attrition.
  • Demonstrate a willingness to understand and explain technical issues to a non-technical audience and to engage the right cross-functional partners to drive resolution.
  • Conduct workshops with customers to understand their current operations and recommend workflow changes to maximize the value of their Samsara products.
  • Work cross-functionally with Sales, Support, Deal Desk, Operations and Product to strategically solve problems and optimize customer experience and business outcomes.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • Business fluency in French (spoken and written).
  • 2+ years in a customer-facing, quota-carrying role (renewals, customer success, account management or sales), ideally in SaaS, technology or logistics.
  • A record of consistent quota over-achievement.
  • Strong problem-solving, communication and presentation skills, and the ability to build trust with executives, users and internal teams.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce, Gainsight, Gong or similar GTM tools.
  • Comfort in a fast-changing, high-growth environment.
  • A bachelor's degree from a 4-year institution, or equivalent practical experience.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • A strong bias towards action, big-picture thinking and high standards.
  • An AI-first approach: you use AI tooling to drive efficiency and outcomes.
  • Technical depth across a suite of products, with a bonus for hardware-software integration.
  • Industry Knowledge: Experience with routing, navigation, commercial trucking fleets, and logistics.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

descriptionHtml:

Verifone offre un environnement de travail diversifié, dynamique et rythmé, dans lequel les collaborateurs sont orientés résultats et disposent d'opportunités pour se dépasser. Nous sommes fiers de travailler avec les principaux commerçants, enseignes, banques et partenaires tiers afin de concevoir et de déployer des solutions de paiement innovantes à travers le monde. Nous visons l'excellence dans nos produits et nos services, et nous sommes obsédés par la satisfaction de nos clients. Partout dans le monde, les collaborateurs de Verifone font avancer l'industrie du paiement grâce à leur expérience, leur sens de l'innovation et leur esprit ambitieux. Qu'il s'agisse de développer la prochaine plateforme de systèmes de paiement sécurisés ou de chercher de nouvelles façons d'amener le paiement électronique vers de nouveaux marchés, l'équipe de Verifone se consacre à la réussite de ses clients, de ses partenaires et de ses investisseurs. C'est cette passion pour l'innovation qui anime chacun de nos collaborateurs dans sa réussite personnelle et professionnelle. 

Verifone est fière de sa culture du travail en présentiel, car nous sommes convaincus que la proximité physique de nos collègues apporte d'immenses bénéfices pour le développement des carrières et les résultats de l'entreprise. Nous autorisons actuellement un mode de travail hybride, mais nous réexaminons régulièrement notre politique de présence. 

À propos du poste 

Nous recherchons un(e) Coordinateur(trice) Customer Success & Opérations très organisé(e), proactif(ve) et orienté(e) service, à recruter dans un premier temps dans le cadre d'un contrat de 6 mois.

Aucune journée ne se ressemble. De la coordination des initiatives clients et du suivi des jalons de projet jusqu'au soutien en matière de reporting, de facturation et d'amélioration opérationnelle, vous serez exposé(e) à un large éventail d'activités et développerez une solide compréhension du fonctionnement d'une organisation dynamique, tournée vers le client. 

Ce poste vous offre la possibilité de bâtir des relations durables avec les clients, de prendre en charge des processus importants et d'avoir un impact visible sur la satisfaction client et la performance de l'entreprise. Il est idéal pour une personne qui aime l'organisation, la résolution de problèmes et le travail avec des interlocuteurs variés, tout en développant des compétences précieuses en customer success, en opérations et en coordination de projet. 

Principales Responsabilités 

Support opérationnel quotidien et demandes clients 

  • Assurer le suivi opérationnel des projets clients : calendrier, jalons, livrables, points d'avancement 
  • Être l'interlocuteur(trice) quotidien(ne) des clients attribués : demandes, escalades, suivi des engagements 
  • Coordonner les équipes internes et externes (Opérations, support, technique, finance, partenaires) 
  • Suivre les commandes, les contrats et la facturation associée, et signaler les écarts 
  • Produire des rapports et des tableaux de bord (avancement, KPI, SLA)

Support à la facturation

  • Extraire et tenir à jour les données de facturation à partir des systèmes internes. 
  • Mettre à jour et rapprocher les enregistrements de facturation et les tableaux de suivi. 
  • Participer à la résolution des écarts de facturation, sous la supervision de l'équipe. 
  • Apporter un soutien administratif aux activités de facturation client. 

Assistance aux réunions et administrative 

  • Contribuer à la préparation des supports, de la documentation et des présentations destinés aux réunions clients. 
  • Coordonner la planification des réunions et veiller à ce que les informations utiles soient transmises aux participants. 
  • Préparer et diffuser les comptes rendus de réunion lorsque nécessaire. 
  • Tenir à jour les tableaux de suivi des actions afin de garantir le suivi dans les délais des engagements pris. 
  • Soutenir la planification et la coordination des ateliers clients et des revues opérationnelles. 

Compétences et expérience requises

  • Très bonne organisation et grand souci du détail, capacité à gérer plusieurs priorités et flux de travail simultanément tout en assurant la responsabilité des activités de suivi courantes.

Notre engagement

title: Cybersecurity Intern
descriptionHtml:
SwissBorg is building the future of crypto wealth management, making investing more accessible, transparent and intuitive for everyone. At the core of our platform is the Meta-Exchange (MEX). This smart routing engine connects multiple exchanges and liquidity sources to deliver optimal execution in a single, seamless app.

We're Swiss-engineered, regulated, and trusted by nearly one million users managing over $1B in crypto assets. But beyond the numbers, what drives us is the people behind every wallet and a commitment to continuously improving how they experience and interact with crypto.



Join us!

At SwissBorg, safeguarding user funds is our top priority. As our cloud infrastructure evolves, we’re looking for an innovator to help us stay ahead of emerging AI-era threats. You’ll take the lead on exploring how AI can actively strengthen our security posture tackling everything from real-time anomaly detection in custodian money flows to automated cloud hardening.   • Document and present your results

  • Kennis van databasebeheer, datavisualisatie en datagovernance.

  • Bij voorkeur ervaring met Python, SQL of vergelijkbare tools.

  • Sterke communicatieve en probleemoplossende vaardigheden.

  • Een proactieve, zelfstandige en teamgerichte werkwijze met interesse in duurzaamheid.

  • In deze functie werk je tenminste 60% van je werkweek vanuit ons kantoor in Amsterdam.

  • Je kunt je zowel mondeling als schriftelijk goed uitdrukken in het Nederlands en Engels.

Maak kennis met ONE-Dyas

ONE-Dyas B.V. is het grootste particuliere exploratie- en productiebedrijf in Nederland. Als onder-nemers in de Nederlandse offshore gas- en oliesector streeft het bedrijf ernaar een belangrijke bijdrage te leveren aan de energietransitie, waarbij het vooroploopt op het gebied van duurzaam-heid en technologische innovatie. Het winnen van gas en olie dicht bij huis draagt bij aan de natio-nale economie, de voorzieningszekerheid en de klimaatdoelstellingen door gebruik te maken van lokale diensten, producten en knowhow, de afhankelijkheid van geïmporteerde brandstoffen te verminderen, de uitstoot te verlagen en te voldoen aan de hoogste milieunormen in de sector.

Met wortels die teruggaan tot 1893 in de mijnbouw, kent ONE-Dyas een lange geschiedenis van succesvolle baanbrekende energieoplossingen. Tegenwoordig bestrijken de activiteiten de volledi-ge levenscyclus van offshore-activa in Nederland, Duitsland en het Verenigd Koninkrijk, waaronder het vlaggenschipproject N05-A in het Nederlandse en Duitse deel van de Noordzee, dat het eerste in zijn soort zal zijn waarin aardgas, windenergie en groene waterstof worden geïntegreerd. ONE-Dyas onderzoekt tevens actief mogelijkheden op het gebied van koolstofafvang en -opslag, en groene waterstof als toekomstige energieoplossingen.

ONE-Dyas, met het hoofdkantoor aan de Zuidas in Amsterdam en circa 150 medewerkers, kenmerkt zich door een sterke ondernemingscultuur, korte lijnen tussen alle disciplines en een hechte band met haar aandeelhouders, wat leidt tot een doelgerichte en effectieve werkomgeving. ONE-Dyas geniet in Nederland, het Verenigd Koninkrijk en Duitsland een uitstekende reputatie vanwege zijn ervaring en expertise in de gehele toeleveringsketen van de olie- en gasindustrie. ONE-Dyas staat erom bekend zaken veilig, betrouwbaar en efficiënt te realiseren.

descriptionHtml:
Limebit ist ein Berliner Beratungsunternehmen für Data Science und Machine Learning im Gesundheitswesen. Unser Team aus Data Scientists, ML Engineers, Mathematiker:innen und Softwareentwickler:innen wächst weiter. Wir suchen eine Person mit erster Praxiserfahrung, die mit uns an anspruchsvollen Kundenprojekten arbeitet und sich bei uns fachlich weiterentwickeln will.

Aufgaben

Qualifikation

Das bringst du mit:

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium in Data Science, Informatik, Mathematik, Statistik, Physik, Bioinformatik oder einem vergleichbaren Fach, alternativ vergleichbare Praxiserfahrung

Ein zusätzliches Plus gibt's für:

Benefits

Benefits

Wir sind klein genug, dass du dich in jeder Situation auf Feedback und Unterstützung des ganzen Teams verlassen kannst. Florian und Philipp werden dich einarbeiten, dir ein bisschen was über die Geschichte von Limebit erzählen, dir dein neues MacBook überreichen und dich ganz persönlich willkommen heißen. descriptionHtml:
Nous recherchons un-e Data Steward Corporate Operations People basé-e à Lille ou Paris

DECATHLON accélère la transformation et la digitalisation de ses processus RH, en partie grâce à une forte maîtrise de ses données People et de leurs usages. Pour accompagner cette transformation, nous déployons une plateforme RH mondiale intégrant un CORE RH (Workday) et plusieurs modules de talent management (Performance, Comp&Ben, Career management...).

Au cœur de la réussite de Decathlon se trouve notre engagement envers nos 100 000 collaborateurs. L’équipe People Data joue un rôle essentiel dans ce développement. En rejoignant notre équipe pluridisciplinaire (plus de 30 experts : Data Product Managers, Data Analysts, BI engineers, Analytics Engineers, Data Engineers et d’experts en Gouvernance de données), vous travaillerez sur l'ensemble des processus RH et serez le garant de la gestion et de la protection de nos données.

Vos responsabilités principales

En tant que Data Steward, vous jouerez un rôle essentiel dans la gestion et la protection des données au sein de l'entreprise. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes métiers, les équipes IT et les autres parties prenantes pour garantir que les données de votre domaine soient documentées, fiables, accessibles et conformes aux normes internes et réglementaires :

  • Documentation & discoverability : vous participez à la structuration des concepts business et garantissez une documentation cohérente et centralisée dans le Data Catalog (Collibra). Vous assurez le lineage entre les concepts métiers et les connaissances techniques
  • Accessibilité de la donnée : vous traduisez les besoins métiers en exigences techniques d'exposition, et accompagnez les Data Users dans la localisation et l'utilisation des données en favorisant l'usage du Data Catalog. Vous vous assurez que les ingestions de données dans le Datalake respectent les standards (storage zone, schémas, nomenclatures…)
  • Sécurité & conformité : vous veillez à ce que la donnée reste strictement conforme aux exigences de sécurité et aux règles légales (ex: CNIL, RGPD, PIPL). Vous vérifiez l'alignement avec le registre de traitement du DPO
  • Animation & collaboration : vous collaborez activement avec les Data Owners, Data Quality Manager, Data Manager, Product Owners/Data Producers et équipes techniques (Data Engineers, BI Engineers). Vous contribuez également à la communauté globale des Data Stewards pour améliorer la maturité et faire évoluer les standards.

Votre écosystème & les spécificités RH

  • Outils & processus : vous évoluerez dans un écosystème marqué par des solutions telles que Workday, des outils d'acquisition de talents (ex: GreenHouse), et des systèmes de paie locaux et globaux.
  • Objets de données : vous documenterez des entités propres aux ressources humaines (Job profile, Worker, Payroll, Cost Center, etc.).
  • Enjeu clé de conformité : une attention extrême sera portée à la confidentialité des données personnelles et sensibles des collaborateurs.

Ce dont vous aurez besoin pour réussir

  • Expérience : solide background en Data Stewardship, idéalement sur des projets RH, dans un environnement complexe et multi-pays
  • Savoir-faire technique : maîtrise de l'usage d'un Data Catalog (idéalement Collibra), compréhension des écosystèmes Data (API, Datalake, Data Warehouse), requêtes SQL simples, et méthodologies Agiles (Jira). Connaissance des environnements Cloud (Databricks, Tableau)
  • Savoir-être : rigueur, excellent esprit d'analyse et de synthèse, sens du service. Capacité à convaincre, à vulgariser et à fédérer des interlocuteurs variés. Anglais courant indispensable (niveau B2/C1) pour collaborer avec le réseau mondial.
  • Niveau d'autonomie : capacité à travailler en autonomie sur des périmètres complexes, à influencer les bonnes pratiques et à animer des initiatives transverses à fort impact.

Ce que nous t’offrons

  • Mode de travail hybride (3 jours sur site / 2 jours de télétravail)
  • Matériel fourni en accord avec tes missions et nos engagements sociétaux
  • Une équipe apprenante : intégration dans la team People Data composée de plus de 30 experts et une communauté globale de Data Quality Managers.
  • Développement des compétences et accompagnement (diversité des projets, certifications techniques dès la première année, formations internes et externes, etc.)
  • Package de rémunération (participation des employés aux actions de l'entreprise, bonus mensuels/trimestriels)

NOTRE ENGAGEMENT EN FAVEUR DE L'INCLUSION ET DE L'ACCESSIBILITE

Chez Decathlon, nous reconnaissons l'immense valeur qu'apporte la diversité à nos équipes et nous nous efforçons continuellement de favoriser et de cultiver un lieu de travail inclusif et équitable : c'est pourquoi l'Inclusion est l'un de nos Fondamentaux Humains. Nous encourageons les personnes de tous horizons et de toutes capacités à postuler, car nous sommes convaincu·es que la diversité des pensées, des cultures, des identités et des expériences vécues nous rend plus fort·es.

Decathlon s'engage également à offrir un processus de sélection inclusif et accessible à tous les candidat·es. DECATHLON DIGITAL 

Imaginez si la technologie nous permettait de repousser les frontières et d'offrir des expériences sportives inédites. C'est précisément notre ambition chez Decathlon Digital ! Nous sommes une équipe de plus de 5 000 experts en ingénierie logicielle, gestion de produits, données, cloud et cybersécurité, répartis à Paris, Lille et Amsterdam. Ensemble, nous créons la plus vaste plateforme sportive numérique, en exploitant les innovations technologiques pour optimiser la chaîne de valeur, concevoir des expériences connectées et donner une seconde vie à nos produits.

Changeons la donne pour de bon. Notre passion du sport nous guide et nous voulons qu’elle perdure. We’re building the next generation of plug-and-play robots, powered by a novel approach to make robots autonomous. Our robots are designed to revolutionize material handling, from stacking boxes to sorting parcels and unloading goods.

We’re looking for a hands-on Deployment Engineer who loves debugging, stress-testing and is ready to install robots that move the world’s parcels. In this role, you’ll be the face of Flink at customer sites and industry events, making sure every system is rigorously tested, commissioned and continuously improved.

Who you are

  • Eager to join a VC-backed startup in its early phase and take ownership of field projects.

  • Passionate about robotics: from mechanics and electronics to computer vision and control.

  • Proactive problem-solver wanting to learn new things

  • Clear communicator, fluent in English, German, French, and other languages is a strong plus.

  • Excited about frequent travel to production sites (up to 60 %).

  • Enjoys collaborating with multidisciplinary teams and customers on the shop floor.

What you bring

  • Mechanical engineering background with experience designing, prototyping, and building mechanical assemblies

  • Ability to diagnose and resolve hardware and software issues, with an understanding of mechatronics, sensors, networking and basic control principles

  • Demonstrated track record in commissioning complex electromechanical or robotic systems in the field

  • Excited about travel and deploying robots in production environments

  • Prior robot deployments, proficiency in German or other languages, driver's license and familiarity with Linux are a plus

What you'll do

  • Assemble, configure and test our robots in the lab and at customer sites to iterate and improve the system

  • Plan, coordinate and execute on-site installations, acting as the technical lead and ensuring a smooth handover to the customer

  • Design, prototype, and produce mechanical and electrical elements for new product run deployments

  • Train operators and provide hands-on support during ramp-up, collecting insights that feed straight back into our product roadmap

  • Diagnose and resolve complex hardware/software issues, both remotely and on-site

Why join

  • A great team dedicated to building a product with almost unlimited potential

  • Work on challenging problems at the cutting edge of robotics

  • Competitive salary, equity, and top-tier gear

  • Work in a central office in Zurich and around the world, wherever our partners are

Apply now if you’re ready to push boundaries and help shape the future of robotics!

title: Deployment Strategist - SAP & ERP Specialist
descriptionHtml:
TL;DR

You know how to walk into an enterprise, spot the pain points in its ERP processes, and see what good could look like. At Conduct you turn that into a game changing moment: you show leadership, with confidence, how Conduct will transform the way they run SAP. You own optimising the delivery of transformation projects with Conduct, from the first use case to adoption across the business. You build the trust that turns a pilot into a long-term partnership, and the product insights you bring back directly shape what we build next.

Why Conduct

The world's largest companies should move at the speed of their ideas, not the speed of the systems they run on. Today they don't, and you've seen why firsthand.

Every new product line, pricing change or process redesign runs into SAP estates layered with decades of custom code, user exits and enhancements no single person fully understands. Requirements take months to ship. S/4HANA migrations cost $100M+ and years of pain, and the 2027 ECC deadline is forcing every large enterprise to face it.

We're building the AI operating system that absorbs this complexity and gives enterprises back their speed. Major enterprises already trust us with their most critical systems. We've closed game-changing SI partnerships, just raised a $60M Series A, and demand is outpacing what we can service.

We're a small, talent-dense team doing our life's work out of London and NYC. Extreme ownership, high velocity, low-ego collaboration. What you build here shapes the company and how the world's largest companies operate. We sponsor visas and are convinced diverse teams build better products, so we especially encourage underrepresented groups in tech to reach out.

What you'll own

You will make sure Conduct lands and sticks inside our most strategic SAP customers. You join accounts early, shape how Conduct fits into their transformation programmes, and fully take over post-sale. You'll have a direct line from what you see in the field to what ships in the product.

  • Be the SAP brain in the room. Translate between CIOs, process owners, Basis teams and our engineers. Scope use cases across finance, supply chain, procurement and sales that land real value fast.

  • Design the transformation. Get under the skin of complex, heavily customised ECC and S/4HANA landscapes. Conceptualise where Conduct can have the biggest impact, then lead the deployment that gets the customer there.

  • Turn pilots into partnerships. Onboard hundreds of end users, prove ROI, spot expansion signals and hold the early commercial conversations that grow an account.

  • Shape the product. You'll have a direct line into product and engineering. Your view of how SAP actually runs in the real world will shape our roadmap.

  • Build the engine. Our GTM team is small and lean. You'll build the onboarding flows, tooling and reusable playbooks that let customer capacity compound without headcount growing linearly.

  • Work with our SI partners. You speak their language. Help partners deploy Conduct inside their own programmes.

No two days look the same. You'll fly out to customers when it counts and spend the rest of the time building alongside the team.

Who we hire

We're looking for people obsessed with delivering for customers. You'll fit right in if former colleagues would, without hesitating, call you one of the sharpest people they've worked with.

In practice that tends to look like:

  • 3+ years in SAP or ERP consulting, at a Big Four firm, a global SI or a specialist SAP partner. You've been on live implementations, rollouts or S/4HANA transformations, not just advisory.

  • Real depth in at least one area of SAP. Functional (FI/CO, SD, MM, PP, EWM), technical (ABAP, integration, BTP) or solution architecture. You understand how processes and custom code fit together across the landscape.

  • Client-facing confidence. You've run workshops, owned a workstream and earned the trust of senior stakeholders who were sceptical at first.

  • Commercial instinct. You notice the next problem worth solving, and you understand that a great deployment is how accounts grow.

  • Builder energy. You want to do the hands-on customer work and build the process behind it. Ambiguity excites you more than it worries you.

  • Curiosity about AI. You don't need to be an engineer. You do need to want to learn how it works and where it breaks.

  • Low ego, high self-awareness. You're comfortable saying "I don't know" in a complex technical room, then going and figuring it out.

Don't tick every box? Apply anyway. We care more about trajectory and sharpness than a perfect match.

title: Dexterous Hands Lead (Founding Team Lead)
descriptionHtml:
About us

We are building a global leader in physical AI, anchored in Europe’s strongest robotics heritage. Founded by entrepreneurs with backgrounds in scaling digital products and advanced robotics, the team is bolstered by senior leadership from top-tier AI research labs and industrial tech companies.

Driven by a mission to create versatile and trustworthy embodied AI for physical labor, we fuse deep engineering mastery in AI and mechatronics with a rapid-execution culture. We are addressing the labor shortage by closing the gap to production-grade deployment. This means building the trusted alternative: robots that are safe, secure, and engineered to automotive standards of scale and durability.

We are well-capitalized and now assembling our team.

Our Locations: Vesoma has two main locations: Munich, Germany and Limassol, Cyprus. This pan-European setup represents our core ambition of building a European technology leader, gives us a great talent base and a strong corporate structure.

Your mission

You will build Vesoma’s hands development group from the ground up. Starting as its first member, you will define how our humanoids manipulate the world: what we buy, what we build, and how hand hardware and learning-based control come together on our platform.
In the near term you will get capable third-party hands running reliably on our robots so that development and deployment are never blocked. In parallel you will set the technical direction for our own dexterous hands, build the team that develops them, and take the first in-house generations from concept to robust, deployable hardware.

Key responsibilities

  • Own the hands engineering roadmap. Make and defend the build-versus-buy decisions, define the architecture for in-house hands, and plan the path from first prototypes to a product that holds up in real deployments.

  • Build and lead the team. Hire the first engineers across mechanical design, actuation, sensing and embedded electronics, and set up the processes, tooling and test infrastructure the group needs to move fast without cutting corners.

  • Drive the design of our own hands, including kinematics, actuation and transmission concepts, tactile and proprioceptive sensing, and the electrical and communication interfaces to our control and software stacks. Design for robustness, serviceability and manufacturability from the start.

  • Bridge the gap with external hardware. Evaluate the global ecosystem of robotic hands, select and manage suppliers, and lead the mechanical and electrical integration of third-party end-effectors until our own hardware takes over.

  • Establish validation as a core discipline. Develop test rigs, benchmarks and endurance protocols that measure precision, force, duty cycle, durability and real-world task performance, and use the results to drive design decisions.

  • Work closely with our AI team so that hand hardware fits our learning-based approach, with attention to sensing quality, backdrivability, contact robustness and transfer from simulation to reality.

  • Bring safety into the design early, in line with the standards work our company helps shape.

Your profile

You have built dexterous or comparably complex mechatronic systems yourself and want the chance to do it again, this time with ownership of the whole effort. You combine deep hands-on engineering with the judgment to set direction and the drive to build a team around it.

Experience

  • 8+ years in robotics hardware, mechatronics or system integration, with significant hands-on work on robotic hands, grippers or other high-DoF manipulation systems.

  • A track record of taking hardware from concept through multiple prototype iterations to a working, tested system.

  • Experience leading engineers or technical workstreams, ideally including hiring and building a team.

Core skills

  • Strong understanding of actuation and transmission choices for compact, high-DoF systems (direct drive, tendon-driven, gear and linkage designs) and their tradeoffs in force, speed, backdrivability, efficiency and wear.

  • Experience with tactile and force sensing and how sensor data feeds into control and learning.

  • Mechanical design for small, dense, robust assemblies, including CAD, tolerancing, material choice and design for manufacturing and assembly.

  • Electrical and embedded fundamentals: motor drivers, sensor interfaces, communication buses, firmware integration.

  • Fundamental software skills, solid grasp of real-time control requirements.

  • Comfort with kinematics, linear algebra, coordinate systems and 3D transformations.

  • Willingness to get your hands dirty: rapid prototyping, wiring, soldering and assembly.

Mindset

  • You think like a builder and an owner. You make clear technical decisions under uncertainty, explain them well, and change course when the data says so.

  • You care about reliability above showcase demos. Hands that work consistently in the field matter more to you than hands that look impressive once.

  • You enjoy building something from zero: the hardware, the team and the way they work together.

Why us?

  • The Team: Work alongside leadership with a proven track record of building unicorn-scale companies and defining global robotics standards.

  • Smart Strategy: We operate as disciplined fast followers. Capital is timed to the deployment inflection point, avoiding early-mover dead ends to scale fast on proven foundations.

  • Resources: We are substantially internally funded and attract top-tier investors to avoid any capital constraints for our mission.

  • Historic Opportunity: Join at the dawn of a new industry comparable to the rise of the automobile. Help shape the European champion in this trillion-dollar market.

We are an equal opportunity employer.

title: Director Minerva Frontline (All Genders)
descriptionHtml:
At Stark, we forge the future of European and national security through cutting-edge, AI-driven technology and unmatched engineering precision. As a premier defence technology company, our mission is clear: to equip NATO Allies and their partners  with next-generation autonomous defence platforms and advanced AI-driven software built to perform in the world’s most demanding environments.

We believe that true security stems from relentless innovation. By combining elite engineering talent with agile technology and an AI-native operational culture, Stark turns complex defence challenges into field-tested, multi-domain solutions.

WHY JOIN US

  • The software and systems you work on directly protect personnel and defend European and national sovereignty.
  • You will work alongside industry-leading minds on autonomous systems, advanced propulsion, and secure cyber platforms.
  • We foster a fast-paced, collaborative environment where bold ideas are supported by serious R&D backing.

About the Team

Minerva is STARK’s overarching Mission Operating System — the central cognitive backbone connecting all our unmanned platforms across air, land, and sea, while seamlessly integrating third-party systems and interfacing directly with national Battle Management Systems (BMS). Within this ecosystem, the Minerva Frontline organization owns the entire human-machine interface and operator experience on the ground. Our program brings together three specialized product pillars — Minerva Frontend Applications, Ground Control Stations (GCS), and Mission Simulation — distributed across Berlin and Munich. We operate with high autonomy, a mission-first mindset, and close collaboration between software engineers, hardware specialists, and operational experts to build reliable, intuitive systems that work when stakes are at their highest.

Your Mission

As Director Minerva Frontline, you are the holistic Program Owner and external face of STARK’s customer-facing software and mission control suite. Reporting directly to the VP of Software, you will lead the departments across Command & Control (C2) Applications, Ground Control Stations, and Simulation, unifying their efforts into one cohesive, battle-tested product experience. You will set the visionary product roadmap internally while representing our capabilities externally to military stakeholders, procurement agencies, and partners across NATO nations.

WHAT YOU WILL DO AT STARK

  • Own the end-to-end Minerva Frontline program, taking full accountability for its strategic roadmap, program budget, commercial targets, and cross-functional delivery across all three product lines.
  • Lead, mentor, and empower three direct reports and scale the broader multi-disciplinary organization across Berlin and Munich in these teams.
  • Define and communicate a compelling product vision internally, aligning engineering and UX teams around operator needs so that software, ground station hardware, and simulation environments feel like one seamless system.
  • Serve as the primary external representative for Minerva Frontline, pitching and demonstrating our C2, GCS, and simulation capabilities to military end-users, defence ministries, and procurement bodies (e.g., BAAINBw).
  • Drive seamless system interoperability, ensuring Minerva Frontline connects effortlessly with STARK’s physical unmanned platforms, third-party assets, and sovereign Battle Management Systems .
  • Translate complex battlefield and customer requirements into structured, actionable engineering priorities, balancing rapid prototyping with mission-critical reliability and safety.
  • Establish and scale a lean Program Management Office (PMO) over time to professionalize program tracking, release planning, and cross-entity alignment.
  • Collaborate closely with Commercial, Marketing, and Physical Platform Leads to shape go-to-market materials, pricing models, and integrated system demonstrations at test ranges and customer sites.

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE MISSION

  • Proven senior leadership and program ownership experience managing complex, multi-team software or cyber-physical product organizations, including responsibility for roadmaps, budgets, and delivery.
  • Strong technical background in building mission-critical software suites, ideally combining software engineering leadership with hardware-in-the-loop, robotics, C2 systems, or ground control interfaces.
  • Credibility and domain expertise in the defence or aerospace sector, with the ability to speak at eye level with military decision-makers, operators, and technical engineers alike.
  • Exceptional internal and external communication skills — you know how to inspire engineering teams with a crisp vision and persuasively represent complex technical products to B2G (Business-to-Government) customers.
  • High organizational rigor and an owner’s mindset, capable of turning startup ambiguity into clear structure and driving execution under high tempo.
  • Willingness to travel regularly between our hubs in Berlin and Munich as well as to customer sites, military bases, and test ranges across Europe.
  • Fluency in English (written and spoken) is mandatory.

Nice-To-Have

  • Prior military service (e.g., former officer or reservist in the Bundeswehr or a NATO allied force), particularly within IT, Cyber, C2, or Air Defence domains.
  • Fluency in German, enabling seamless direct engagement with German defence stakeholders and procurement authorities.
  • An established network within the European defence ecosystem, military procurement agencies, or the NATO technology community.
  • Experience with tactical Battle Management Systems (BMS), military simulation environments, or unmanned systems (UxV) operations.

If you're interested in building the future of European Defence with us, and you see yourself reflected on the description above, please send us your CV in English. We're looking forward to meeting you!

title: Director, Text-to-Speech Synthesis Research
descriptionHtml:
Company Overview

Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.

Company Operating Rhythm

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.

Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5.

The Opportunity

We're looking for a Director of Research to own our Text-to-Speech program end to end — the research strategy, the technical bets, and the models that ship. This is a hands-on leadership role: you set direction and stay in the details, shaping architectures, experiments, training strategy, and evaluation. You'll also build the team and operating model that let exceptional researchers move fast without lowering the bar.

The mandate is broad: advance the state of the art in speech generation, and turn those advances into models in production.

What You'll Do

  • Own the TTS research and model roadmap — decide which technical directions can materially move speech-generation quality, including the expensive and non-obvious ones, and recognize when an approach should change or die.

  • Drive advances across neural audio modeling, prosody and expressiveness, controllability, multilingual speech, voice identity and consistency, data and training strategy, post-training, and inference performance — and make sure they land as measurable production gains.

  • Stay deeply technical: review research, challenge assumptions, design experiments, diagnose model failures, and take on the highest-leverage problems yourself.

  • Build evaluation and benchmarking that explains why models improve, not just whether they did — automated metrics alongside human perceptual assessment.

  • Lead a mix of individual contributors and tech lead managers. Hire and develop both, hold an exceptionally high technical bar, grow senior researchers into technical leaders, and set direction across sub-teams while pushing decisions down to the people closest to the work.

  • Partner with engineering and product leadership on ship-readiness, and represent Deepgram's TTS research internally and externally.

You'll Love This Role If You

  • Want to own a frontier-model program end to end rather than optimize one slice of someone else's agenda.

  • Care about the breakthrough and the ship in equal measure.

  • Still love training runs, failed evals, and architecture arguments, even as most of your impact now comes through the people you lead.

  • Get energy from deciding which bets are worth making when the answer isn't obvious and the experiments are expensive.

You Must Have

  • Deep expertise in modern TTS, speech generation, or audio generative modeling, with a track record of personally training and improving large-scale neural models.

  • Command of the modern speech-generation stack and the open problems behind naturalness, expressiveness, controllability, robustness, voice consistency, and inference cost.

  • A history of setting research direction under genuine uncertainty: prioritizing experiments, allocating compute and researcher time, and killing approaches that aren't working.

  • Experience leading researchers and research engineers through other technical leaders — developing tech lead managers or equivalent, setting direction across sub-teams — while staying technically influential yourself.

  • AI as your default mode of work, not an occasional tool. You've rebuilt how you and your team operate around it, and you have a specific, earned view of what it still can't do in speech research.

  • The ability to make complex technical tradeoffs legible to product, engineering, and executive audiences.

It'd Be Great If You Had

  • TTS or generative-audio models deployed at meaningful production scale.

  • Built or substantially scaled a high-performing AI research organization.

  • Sophisticated evaluation systems for generative speech; expressive or multilingual generation, voice cloning and adaptation, or controllable generation.

  • Recognized external contributions — publications, open source, patents, invited talks — in speech synthesis, neural audio codecs, speech language models, or multimodal models.

  • Experience in fast-moving startup or research environments that routinely take models from idea to production.

title: Engineering Manager - Compute and Data Platform (AI Platform)
descriptionHtml:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our Engineering Teams

Behind Wayve’s embodied AI is the compute and data infrastructure that enables our ML engineers and researchers to train and run increasingly capable models. Our Compute Foundations team builds and operates the large-scale cloud infrastructure that makes this possible, spanning GPU compute, storage, workload scheduling and the platforms that support training and inference.

You’ll lead this London-based team through its next phase of growth, helping build and maintain a reliable, high-performance, multi-cloud and multi-region platform. The challenges go beyond provisioning resources: they include scheduling workloads across different GPU architectures, keeping valuable compute available, and moving data efficiently while managing costs.

You’ll lead a team working with state-of-the-art tooling to tackle infrastructure challenges found only at the world’s leading AI companies, building the platform that enables Wayve to develop its AI Driver.

 

🧠 Your day-to-day

People leadership will be your first priority. You’ll coach and develop engineers, set clear expectations, manage performance. You’ll build technical leadership within the team, giving engineers the support and ownership they need to grow. You will guide the growth of the team through hiring and onboarding.

Alongside this, you will own project prioritisation and roadmap planning, aligning priorities and delivery plans with stakeholders across Wayve. Your goal is to maximise the impact of the team in alignment with the department and company objectives. You will provide visibility into the state of systems you own through clear KPIs and dashboards.

Leading a highly technical team, you’ll bring the technical judgement to guide complex infrastructure decisions and turn competing needs into a clear roadmap. Working with technical leads, partner teams and cloud providers, you’ll balance reliability, performance, capacity and cost, and help the team deliver sustainably.

 

🧩 What you’ll be working on

  • Leading and developing the team: Coach engineers through regular feedback and one-to-ones, manage performance, support career development and build a healthy, performant and accountable team.

  • Hiring and building technical leadership: Lead hiring and onboarding as the team expands, and develop technical leads who can take ownership of key areas of the platform.

  • Driving the roadmap and delivery: Translate training and inference needs into priorities, align commitments with available resources, and surface risks and dependencies early.

  • Scaling cloud compute: Guide the evolution and operation of a multi-cloud, multi-region training and inference platform, including the adoption of new compute architectures (Nvidia Hopper, Blackwell; Qualcomm).

  • Improving scheduling and availability: Oversee Kubernetes-based infrastructure and queuing and scheduling systems, enabling workloads to use the right resources across heterogeneous GPU environments.

  • Planning capacity and cost: Partner with stakeholders and cloud providers on compute and storage forecasts, accounting for resource lead times, performance requirements and cost trade-offs.

  • Ensuring efficient storage across clouds: Guide distributed storage and caching approaches that improve data access and reduce unnecessary duplication and cross-cloud transfer costs.

 

🙌 You should apply if

  • You have a strong track record of managing and developing an infrastructure, platform or distributed systems engineering team, including hiring, coaching, performance management and career development.

  • You have delivered through others, owning team priorities and balancing delivery with operational reliability and longer-term platform improvements.

  • You have substantial experience in Kubernetes and workload queuing and scheduling systems, such as Kueue or equivalent technologies.

  • You can reason about availability, capacity, performance and cost across complex cloud infrastructure, including the interaction between compute, storage and data movement.

  • You understand large-scale GPU compute infrastructure for machine learning training or inference and the operational challenges of scaling beyond small GPU deployments.

  • You can earn engineers’ trust through sound technical judgement without needing to be the team’s primary individual contributor. You have successfully delivered as an individual contributor in the past.

  • You communicate clearly with technical teams, stakeholders and external providers, and can turn ambiguous requirements into practical priorities.

  • You are able to work from our London office and lead a team based there.

The following experience would be useful but is not required:

  • Operating multi-cloud or multi-region platforms for large-scale AI workloads.

  • Introducing new GPU architectures or managing heterogeneous GPU fleets.

  • Distributed storage, caching and data-locality strategies for data-intensive workloads.

  • Capacity forecasting, cloud cost modelling and close collaboration with cloud infrastructure providers.

 

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

 

More about Wayve:

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.

 

How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working:

Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.

 

🔍 The Interview Process:

Our process is clear and respectful of your time:

  • Initial call / recruiter screen (30 mins)

  • Competency Interviews: system design and hiring manager interview

  • Deep-dive technical interviews: technical leadership, code review and people management

  • Final interview: leadership, mission & values alignment

We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability.

 

What’s in it for you (Location dependant):

💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually
📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long term success of Wayve
✈️ Relocation support and visa sponsorship where applicable
✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands on in vehicle workshops and labs
📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth
🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more

A quick, honest note before you apply.

Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.

If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you.

At Wayve we're committed to creating a diverse, fair and respectful culture that is inclusive of everyone based on their unique skills and perspectives, and regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis as protected by applicable law.

For more information visit Careers at Wayve. To learn more about what drives us, visit Values at Wayve

DISCLAIMER: We will not ask about marriage or pregnancy, care responsibilities or disabilities in any of our job adverts or interviews. However, we do look to capture information about care responsibilities, and disabilities among other diversity information as part of an optional DEI Monitoring form to help us identify areas of improvement in our hiring process and ensure that the process is inclusive and non-discriminatory.

Technical Leadership

title: Engineering Manager
descriptionHtml:
We’re on a mission to become the go-to destination for students across Europe to find a trusted home away from home. We make every step of the rental journey simple and seamless, so students can focus on what really matters: studying, exploring, and growing.

With HousingAnywhere, Kamernet, and Studapart under our roof, we’re Europe’s largest student rental platform. You’ll find us in Rotterdam, Paris, and Cergy, always guided by our four core values: Ownership, We are enablers, We are changemakers, and We are connectors.

As an Engineering Manager at HousingAnywhere, you will play a critical role in leading the evolution of our platform with your vision. You will join the Product Engineering team, leading one of our product teams that owns a key part of the renter journey, from finding and applying to booking, moving in and staying. You will collaborate closely with other product teams and departments, from Sales to Marketing to Customer Support, serving both internal and external customers.

We expect you to lead and enable your team to deliver effectively, setting the right technical direction while leveraging the talent present in your team. While we expect you to be technical, your focus will be on strategy and leadership rather than heavy hands-on coding. AI is changing how we build software, and we are going all in. You will lead a team that uses AI in its daily work, from writing and reviewing code to planning, testing and decision-making. We expect you to be a hands-on practitioner who uses these tools yourself and pushes your team to get the most out of them.

Our Tech Stack

At the Backend we mostly use Go, Postgres, and Redis. At the Frontend we use React, Typescript, and NodeJs. Our infrastructure runs on GCP, and we are heavy users of Kubernetes. Our Architecture is a distributed architecture made of several "Modular Monoliths". We practise DevOps, Continuous Delivery, Domain Driven Design, and Contract Driven Development.

Your role

In your daily role, your impact will be defined by key pillars: Delivery, Direction, Talent, and Culture.

  • Delivery: Lead your team to scope and plan projects, identifying bottlenecks and improving processes. You will ensure engineering standards are held high and remove impediments to provide a smooth developer experience. 
  • Direction: Create alignment and a sense of urgency through well-crafted strategies and goals. You will direct your team to relate their work to organizational goals and provide a clear sense of purpose.
  • Talent: Nurture talent with regular feedback and performance reviews, supporting career growth. You will identify skill gaps and execute hiring strategies to acquire top talent.
  • Culture: Lead by example to foster ownership, empowerment, and autonomy. You will promote a growth mindset, value diverse perspectives, and address problems to maintain a healthy team culture.
  • Craft: Equip your team to solve problems with pragmatic, sustainable solutions. You will foster engineering excellence, support knowledge-sharing, and keep the team up to date with the latest technical trends.
  • AI-first engineering: Make AI a core part of how your team works, not an experiment on the side. You will drive adoption of AI-assisted development and review, define what good practice looks like, and measure the effect on delivery speed and quality. You will keep the team’s standards high while the way of working changes.

Your profile

  • Strong recent experience in managing high-performing, diverse, and inclusive teams.
  • Strong knowledge in Distributed Systems and Domain Driven Design.
  • Ability to set technical direction without getting bogged down in heavy hands-on work.
  • Real, recent experience using AI tools in your own day-to-day work and getting your team to do the same. For us AI is central to how we deliver, so if you see it as a nice-to-have, this role is not the right fit.

descriptionHtml:
About Zable

Zable (formerly Lendable) is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money.

  • Founded in 2014, profitable since 2017, unicorn since 2021

  • The number one issuer of new credit cards and loans in the UK

  • Backed by Balderton Capital and Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan

  • Loved by customers & our team with top reviews on Glassdoor and Trustpilot

Zable was founded on the belief that smarter technology is the solution to lower cost, more transparent consumer finance. Our proprietary foundation models analyse thousands of data points in seconds, drawing a more complete picture of individual financial behaviour. This means we can make better risk decisions, widening access and lowering prices.

The Zable credit card harnesses this technology to deliver better borrowing for three million people. Through our superapp, Zable connects this card to a single platform which makes it effortless to manage credit, get a loan, refinance existing borrowing, switch utilities, get a mobile plan and save more.

Zable is now the number one issuer of new credit cards and personal loans in the UK, but we’ve barely got started. Next, we’re taking our approach to some of the biggest markets in the world - the US and Mexico - where hundreds of millions of people are underserved by outdated bank processes.

Join us if you want to

About the role

Engineering Managers at Zable are a unique group of amazing humans that combine strategic insight, hands-on technical leadership, and strong people management to shape and evolve our engineering teams. They operate at the convergence of business goals, technical execution, and team coaching, ensuring that every project and process aligns seamlessly with our mission and values. They build a resilient foundation for sustained success by focusing on team growth and technical innovation.

We’re looking for an experienced Engineering Manager to lead one of the teams delivering our Zable App, used by over 1 million customers on iOS and Android. You’ll own and refine the delivery process, balancing feature development with technical investments and maintaining high team development standards. From enhancing delivery quality to developing a robust, valuable platform, your work will ensure we deliver impactful solutions that meet the needs of our customers and stakeholders alike.

The backend of our Zable app is Kotlin, AWS & GraphQL and the frontend is React Native with TypeScript, and NextJS. Across the rest of Zable we also use PHP 8, Symfony, MySQL, PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ, Docker, Kubernetes, React, ArgoCD, Behat, PHPUnit, Jest, and Maestro.

  • Facilitate cross-team collaboration to align on shared objectives and integrated roadmaps, ensuring seamless workflows and supporting key OKRs across dependent teams.

  • Embed continuous feedback within the team culture, fostering an environment of continuous improvement and aligning the team’s performance with organisational goals.

What we're looking for

  • A degree in Computer Science or relevant experience in software engineering and technical management.

  • 5+ years of experience in engineering leadership, with a strong track record in driving delivery processes, team development, technical strategy, and cross-team collaboration.

  • Strong understanding of the mobile app development process and experience managing cross functional backend and frontend teams in an environment with dependencies on other business areas.

  • Demonstrated ability to balance feature delivery with technical improvements, ensuring a sustainable and high-quality pace for the team.

  • Strong business acumen and a proactive approach to gaining deep business context, enabling alignment of technical decisions with broader business goals.

Enterprise Team Leader, Account Management (UKI Market)

We are looking for an experienced and motivated person to step into a Team Leader role within our Account Management team, focusing on the UKI market.

 

As a Team Leader, you will manage a team of Enterprise Account Managers, guiding them in enhancing client satisfaction within the UKI region. You will be accountable for your team’s KPIs, targets, and the establishment of best practices. We value a candidate with a strong strategic mindset and a passion for developing their team.

 

Are you an experienced manager with a proven track record in Account Management and a desire to further your leadership career? If so, we encourage you to apply!

 

What You’ll Do

  • Lead and manage a team of Enterprise Account Managers, focusing on customer retention and growth within the UKI market.

  • Have a strong emphasis on People Management and Performance Development.

  • Be responsible for setting and achieving team KPIs.

  • Guide the team in strategic negotiations with key clients.

  • Enhance materials and deliverables tailored to Perk’s UKI customers.

  • Drive automation of Business-as-Usual (BAU) tasks.

  • Define team roles and responsibilities.

  • Oversee the onboarding of new clients in coordination with the implementation and sales teams.

  • Manage the onboarding and training of new Account Managers.

What We’re Looking For

  • Proven experience in a managerial role.

  • Previous experience in Account Management at Enterprise Level. Commercial experience is a plus.

  • Ability to thrive in a dynamic and fast-paced environment.

  • Excellent organizational and structuring abilities.

  • Strong problem-solving skills.

  • Strong commercial acumen.

  • Ability to analyze data and provide concise summaries.

  • Numerical literacy and ability to perform forecasts, with strong Excel proficiency.

  • Fluency in English, written and spoken.

Important Information

  • This role is based in Birmingham or London and will require a 3 day week attendance

  • This is a permanent position.

 

What We Offer

  • Receive competitive compensation and equity ownership in Perk

  • Rest and recharge with 25 days of annual leave plus bank holidays

  • Take control of your physical health with private medical cover and voluntary dental insurance from Bupa, and discounted gym memberships with GymFlex

  • Plan for your future with our qualifying earnings company pension plan with Aviva

  • Know that your loved ones are protected financially through your Life Insurance if the worst were to happen

  • Rest assured that you’re covered by income protection in case you experience a long-term sickness or absence

  • Leverage tax-efficient cycle and electric car schemes with Cycle2Work & Octopus

  • Join our unforgettable Perk events, including our spectacular annual summer party

  • Always feel supported with Spring Health, our market-leading wellbeing partner, providing fast, comprehensive access to 12x therapy and 12x coaching sessions for you and your loved ones

  • Focus on your family with 12-16 weeks’ paid parental leave

  • Contribute to your community with 16 paid hours per year to spend volunteering for your dearest charitable causes

  • Broaden your horizons with up to 20 "Work from Anywhere" days per year

  • Stay savvy with access to a wide variety of discounts and rewards

  • Follow your passions and take a four-week, fully paid sabbatical once you reach 5 years

  • Let us help you move to one of our hubs with relocation support

The Process

  • Talent Acquisition Interview - 30mins Virtual

  • Interview with the Hiring Manager - 30mins Virtual

  • Assessment interview with two Mangers in the hiring team - 1hr onsite

  • Values interview - 30mins virtual

 

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

descriptionHtml:
📍Manchester | 💰 up to £60k OTE

Street Group is one of the fastest-growing PropTech companies in the UK. We want to transform the experience of buying, selling, renting and letting property, elevating UK estate agencies through world-class technology.

Joining our Enterprise sales team means playing a key role in driving new business growth across our products, Spectre and Street.co.uk. With the support of our industry-leading, multi-award-winning technology, you’ll have the opportunity to identify and engage high-value prospects, build relationships with key decision-makers, and contribute to the expansion of our enterprise client base.

As we continue to scale, we’re looking for an Enterprise SDR to spearhead outbound prospecting and strategic account engagement. Working closely with our VP of Sales and Strategic Account Executives, you’ll be responsible for targeting enterprise-level accounts, executing ABM/ABS strategies, and multi-threading across complex organisations. This role requires a consultative approach, strong research skills, and the ability to craft compelling outreach that drives meaningful conversations and sets the foundation for high-value deals.

Here’s what you can expect to be working on:

  • Execute ABM/ABS strategies, identifying and targeting high-value accounts.

  • Conduct outbound prospecting via cold calls, emails, and LinkedIn outreach to engage key decision-makers.

  • Leverage sales tech stack (HubSpot, Outreach, Salesloft, LinkedIn Sales Navigator) to streamline prospecting and engagement.

  • Manage your time effectively, balancing prospecting, follow-ups, and booked meetings.

  • Craft compelling, personalised outreach that resonates with enterprise prospects and drives engagement.

  • Handle objections confidently, guiding conversations towards value and setting high-quality meetings.

  • Develop strong relationships with multiple stakeholders within target accounts.

  • Research large multi-branch estate agents and competitors to tailor outreach and position our solutions effectively.

  • Become a product expert, articulating the value of our PropTech solutions to prospective clients.

  • Stay organised within the CRM, ensuring accurate data entry, pipeline tracking, and lead management.

  • Continuously improve by seeking feedback, refining strategies, and staying ahead of industry trends.

A bit about you…

  • Experience executing ABM/ABS strategies to effectively target key accounts.

  • Strong outbound prospecting skills, including cold calling, email outreach, and personalised engagement.

  • Proficiency in sales technology and sequencing tools, such as HubSpot, Outreach, Salesloft, Reachdesk and other CRM tools, ensuring efficiency and data accuracy.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage and persuade prospects.

  • Confidence in objection handling, guiding conversations toward value-driven solutions.

  • The ability to craft compelling, tailored outreach that resonates with potential clients.

  • Resilience and adaptability, maintaining momentum in the face of challenges.

  • A consultative sales approach, leveraging research and active listening to uncover client needs.

  • A natural ability to build rapport and nurture relationships with key decision-makers.

  • Coachability and curiosity, always seeking to refine your approach and stay ahead of industry trends.

Research has shown that women tend to rule themselves out of applying for jobs unless they meet 100% of the requirements. If you fall into that category and are about to rule yourself out based on the above criteria; please consider applying anyway. We'd love to see your application!

Who are Street Group?

We’re an award-winning PropTech business based in Manchester, founded in 2015 by brother and sister duo, Tom & Heather Staff. Most of us have personal experience of how painful moving can be, and Tom and Heather saw an opportunity to change this: utilising technology, as well as our incredibly talented team, to improve the industry for everyone.

Our products, Street.co.uk and Spectre form a powerful duo, working harmoniously together to transform an agent’s job. From securing more leads and winning new instructions to streamlining business operations and growing market share, our products are supercharging 1,000s of agencies across the UK.

Back in 2015, our co-Founder, Tom Staff, spent his evenings building Spectre v1.0. He’d seen first-hand an opportunity to automate the very manual process of winning new business for estate agents. Spectre is now our multi award-winning, instruction generation tool, generating an average return on investment for them of over 3000%!
