title: EW Network & Embedded Software Engineer (All Genders)
descriptionHtml:
At Stark, we forge the future of European and national security through cutting-edge, AI-driven technology and unmatched engineering precision. As a premier defence technology company, our mission is clear: to equip NATO Allies and their partners  with next-generation autonomous defence platforms and advanced AI-driven software built to perform in the world’s most demanding environments.

We believe that true security stems from relentless innovation. By combining elite engineering talent with agile technology and an AI-native operational culture, Stark turns complex defence challenges into field-tested, multi-domain solutions.

WHY JOIN US

  • The software and systems you work on directly protect personnel and defend European and national sovereignty.
  • You will work alongside industry-leading minds on autonomous systems, advanced propulsion, and secure cyber platforms.
  • We foster a fast-paced, collaborative environment where bold ideas are supported by serious R&D backing.

YOUR MISSION

You will take our directional mesh datalink from the lab bench onto real platforms and make it a fieldable, manageable, and verifiable network. You own everything between the radio and the rest of the system: the embedded software stack, network management, data transport, and the logging that proves the link works. No RF background is required. We are looking for a strong embedded and networking engineer who has put software on physical systems.

ABOUT THE TEAM

STARK's Electronic Warfare team is a systems-focussed engineering group delivering software-defined, mass-scalable RF solutions for autonomous systems. Combining deep domain expertise in hardware board design, thermal/ structural packaging, real-time C++ signal processing, and resilient directional mesh networking, we rapidly build field advanced EW capabilities designed to survive and operate in contested spectrum environments. 

WHAT YOU WILL DO AT STARK

  • Integrate the datalink onto platform compute: embedded Linux bring-up, drivers, deployment images, OTA updates, and secure boot.
  • Build network management: node identity, configuration and key distribution, health monitoring, and remote diagnostics of fielded nodes.
  • Own automated logging as a deliverable in its own right: time-aligned at both ends of the link and detailed enough to serve as evidence for programme milestones.
  • Implement telemetry and video transport (UDP/TCP, RTP) and the interfaces to ground control stations and our C2 software.

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE MISSION

  • Embedded Linux experience beyond the application level: bring-up, drivers, and product deployment.
  • Networking at packet level, including how UDP and TCP behave under loss.
  • You have integrated software onto a physical system (vehicle, robot, or aircraft) and you treat the log as a design object, not an afterthought.
  • C/C++, Python, and Yocto or a comparable build system.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience with the PX4, ArduPilot, or MAVLink ecosystem, ideally from a UAS manufacturer.
  • Video transport over constrained or lossy links.

If you're interested in building the future of European Defence with us, and you see yourself reflected on the description above, please send us your CV in English. We're looking forward to meeting you!

SECURITY CLEARANCE

Due to the nature of our work in the defence sector, candidates must be eligible to obtain and maintain the appropriate security clearance required for this position. Details will be provided during the recruitment process.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

We are an equal-opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Nous avons récemment été reconnus « Meilleur réseau de recharge » au Royaume-Uni, en France, en Suisse et aux Pays-Bas. C'est l’opportunité de créer un impact durable !

Le rôle

Tu intégreras l’équipe chargée de l’expansion en France, tout en collaborant avec des expertes et experts en architecture, construction, branding et data.

Grâce à ton réseau dans l'immobilier, tu renforceras notre maillage territorial en créant de nouvelles opportunités avec des propriétaires fonciers, des promoteurs et développeurs immobiliers. Tu mèneras des négociations stratégiques, en incarnant les valeurs de Fastned, et veilleras à ce que chaque projet se développe de manière fluide.

Pas de problème ! Dans le cadre de ton intégration, tu participeras à une série d’onboardings passionnants où tu apprendras tout ce qu’il faut savoir sur le monde de l’e-mobilité et de la recharge.

Nos avantages

On valorise l’équilibre vie pro / vie perso, on t’offre une vraie flexibilité de travail et nous mettons en place des initiatives family-friendly.

Derrière cette ambition, une équipe d’environ 250 personnes, réunies autour d’un même objectif : accompagner les juristes et avocats à toutes les étapes de leur travail, de l’analyse à la rédaction.

Et nous n’en sommes qu’au début.

  • Au sein du Chapter Data Engineering, participer à l'élaboration de nos pratiques de modélisation et de traitement des données.

title: Facilities Coordinator
descriptionHtml:

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

descriptionHtml:

The role

  • Run day-to-day finance: bookkeeping, month-end close, payables and receivables, and payroll coordination across our UK and German entities.

What we offer

Wir scheuen uns nicht vor komplexen Daten und schaffen Intelligenz, die die Ökonomie des Einkaufs verändert, weit über einfache agentische Workflows hinaus.

Wir sind von Top-VCs (10x und Plug and Play) und Business Angels finanziert, und unsere Gründer bringen Erfahrung aus der Strategieberatung und aus schnell wachsenden Startups mit.

Wir sind drei Freunde, die sich seit Jahren kennen. Wir haben Spaß, bewegen uns schnell und uns geht es um echte Ergebnisse.

Aufgaben

Du bist Allrounder:in: technisch versiert, stark im Kundenkontakt und voller Energie, auch wenn du fünfmal am Tag das Thema wechselst. In der einen Stunde sitzt du einem CPO gegenüber und sorgst dafür, dass unsere AI überzeugt. In der nächsten steckst du im Produkt, findest heraus, warum ein Agent nicht geliefert hat, und gestaltest die Lösung mit.

Du willst aus einer "interessanten AI-Demo" einen unterschriebenen Enterprise-Vertrag mit nachgewiesenem Mehrwert machen, und du lässt nicht zu, dass gute Ideen zwischen Kunden und Techies verloren gehen. Das ist eine Founders-Associate-Rolle im wahrsten Sinne: Du arbeitest Seite an Seite mit den Gründern, verantwortest Kunden und Produkt, erlebst aus erster Reihe, wie ein Enterprise-AI-Unternehmen aufgebaut wird, und übernimmst vom ersten Tag an echte Verantwortung für Produkt und Kundenbeziehungen. Du lernst direkt von Gründern, die schon Unternehmen aufgebaut und skaliert haben.

Die Stelle ist nur als Praktikum in Vollzeit möglich, mit Start im April 2027 und einer Dauer von idealerweise 6 Monaten.

Du arbeitest an der Schnittstelle von Produkt, Vertrieb und Kunde, direkt mit den Gründern. Konkret:

  • Baue Demos, bei denen CPOs aufhorchen. Du entwickelst präzise, maßgeschneiderte Demos, die die Fähigkeiten unserer Agents in ein klares "Das brauchen wir" übersetzen, aufgebaut auf den echten Daten und echten Problemen des Interessenten statt auf einem generischen Durchklicken.

  • Bring Proof of Values zum Erfolg. Du begleitest den POV vom Kickoff bis zum Ergebnis: Du definierst vorab, was "Erfolg" bedeutet, hältst den Kunden engagiert, findest heraus, was nicht funktioniert, und lieferst einen Business Case, den der Kunde intern vertreten kann.

  • Verantworte Product Discovery von Anfang bis Ende. Du bereitest Kundeninterviews vor, um herauszufinden, was Einkaufsteams wirklich brauchen, analysierst den Wettbewerb, damit wir genau wissen, wo wir gewinnen, und übersetzt beides in klare Feature-Anforderungen für das Tech-Team.

  • Finde heraus, wo unsere Kunden hängen bleiben. Mit modernen Product-Management-Methoden erkennst du, wo Kunden aktuell auf Engpässe stoßen, und schreibst Briefings, damit unsere Engineers sie beheben.

Qualifikation

Wir glauben nicht an perfekte Kandidat:innen oder starre Checklisten. Uns geht es um Antrieb, Neugier und die Fähigkeit, Dinge zu bauen. Die folgenden Punkte sind eine Orientierung, keine Hürde.

Must-haves

  • Motivation. Du bist hochmotiviert, fühlst dich in Unsicherheit wohl und passt dich schnell an. Die Studienrichtung spielt keine Rolle.

  • Eingeschrieben. Du bist aktuell in einem Bachelor- oder Masterstudium eingeschrieben (Urlaubssemester oder Gap Year willkommen).

  • Customer first. Du stellst den Kunden instinktiv an erste Stelle und baust echte, tragfähige Beziehungen zu Menschen auf.

  • Technisches Verständnis. Du musst unsere Plattform nicht selbst bauen, aber du verstehst die Grenzen von LLMs wie Context Windows, RAG und Tool Calling. Du weißt, dass Prompt Engineering nur der Anfang ist, und gräbst dich gern in Logs, um zu verstehen, warum ein Workflow fehlgeschlagen ist.

  • Storyteller. Du kannst etwas Komplexes so erklären, dass ein Raum voller skeptischer Einkäufer:innen daran glaubt.

  • AI-native. Du nutzt AI ganz selbstverständlich, um deine eigene Arbeit zu beschleunigen, experimentierst ständig und teilst, was wirklich funktioniert.

  • Sprachen. Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (C2) und gute Englischkenntnisse (min. C1).

Nice-to-have

  • Erste Erfahrung in Beratung, Strategie, Produkt oder Engineering ist ein Plus.

Benefits

Als Praktikant:in bei qado hast du echten Impact und echte Verantwortung. Wir legen bei Praktikant:innen denselben Maßstab an wie bei Festangestellten. Deshalb holen wir nur Leute an Bord, denen wir zutrauen, Projekte eigenständig zu führen, und mit denen wir langfristig zusammenarbeiten wollen.

  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit den Gründern. Du bist Sparringspartner:in der Gründer, nicht mehrere Ebenen darunter. Du siehst und beeinflusst, wie das Unternehmen geführt wird.

  • Schnell echte Verantwortung. Deine Demos, Features und POVs gehen ab der ersten Woche live und landen bei echten Enterprise-Kunden.

  • Steile Lernkurve. Ein ehrlicher Einblick aus erster Reihe, was es braucht, um eines der ambitioniertesten AI-Unternehmen im Einkauf aufzubauen, über Produkt, Vertrieb und Tech hinweg.

  • Werde wirklich AI-native. In einem AI-Unternehmen nutzt und gestaltest du täglich Frontier-Tools und weißt danach genau, wie Unternehmen sie tatsächlich einführen.

  • Tools: High-End-Hardware und deine bevorzugten Produktivitätstools (Copilot, Cursor usw.). Wir zahlen, was dich produktiv macht.

  • Flexibilität: Standort München mit Hybrid-Modell.

  • Mentoring: Direkte, praktische Zusammenarbeit mit erfahrenen Gründern, die in deine Entwicklung investieren.

  • Faire Bezahlung und echte Perspektive: Eine solide Praktikumsvergütung und für die richtige Person eine klare Aussicht auf Übernahme in Vollzeit und frühe Führungsverantwortung.

Wir sind ein AI-native Startup aus München und bauen ein Geschäft in einem riesigen, bisher übersehenen Markt auf. In unserem kleinen, schnell wachsenden Team bist du von Anfang an mittendrin. Du arbeitest Tag für Tag direkt mit den Gründern, übernimmst echte Verantwortung statt Zuarbeit und bekommst Einblick in alle Bereiche, von Vertrieb und Strategie bis zur Produktentwicklung.

title: Founders Associate Praktikum - Schwerpunkt Operations (m/w/d) ab Mitte November
descriptionHtml:

Windparks, Umspannwerke, Industrieareale: Große Anlagen werden bis heute vor allem durch Revierfahrten geschützt. Menschen fahren Objekte ab und kontrollieren sie. Doch der demografische Wandel trifft die Branche hart. Sicherheitsunternehmen finden keinen Nachwuchs mehr und müssen Aufträge ablehnen, während die Zahl der Anlagen, die geschützt werden müssen, weiter wächst.

Novosafe will das ändern: Statt Objekte abzufahren, schützen wir sie digital. Smarte Technologie, Künstliche Intelligenz und Software übernehmen die Kontrolle, ergänzt durch herausragenden Service für unsere Kunden. So bauen wir den nächsten Marktführer im Bereich Sicherheit.

Geführt wird Novosafe von erfahrenen Gründern (Accenture, McKinsey, Palantir), unterstützt von Firstlane Ventures, den Köpfen hinter Viafintech (ehemals Barzahlen). Wir stecken mitten in der Go-To-Market-Phase: Jeden Tag passieren echte Fortschritte, und du bist von Anfang an dabei.

Was du bei uns bewegst

… Probleme dich anspornen. Du bleibst dran, bis du eine Lösung gefunden hast.

… du Verantwortung übernimmst. Du erkennst, was getan werden muss, und wartest nicht darauf, dass jemand es dir sagt.

… du schnell lernst und gerne ausprobierst. Du testest, lernst aus dem Ergebnis und entwickelst deinen Ansatz weiter.

… du selbst gründen möchtest. Du willst lernen, wie man ein Unternehmen aufbaut - nicht aus der Theorie, sondern indem du es selbst erlebst und mitgestaltest.

… du etwas bewegen willst. Am Ende des Tages möchtest du sehen, was du vorangebracht hast.

Das bringst du mit

  • Du studierst Wirtschaftswissenschaften, VWL, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder ein vergleichbares oder völlig anderes Fach und suchst nach einem (Pflicht-)praktikum

  • Organisation, Struktur und Kommunikation sind deine Superpower. Du kannst mit Menschen - ob am Telefon, per Mail oder im echten Leben

  • Du hast Lust auf viel Eigenverantwortung und eine steile Lernkurve

  • Du arbeitest zuverlässig, selbstständig und mit hohem Anspruch an Ergebnisse

  • Du hast keine Scheu, dir auch einmal einen Helm aufzusetzen, um dir auf der Kunden-Baustelle einen Eindruck zu verschaffen

  • Du denkst unternehmerisch und hast Lust auf ein schnelles Umfeld und Ownership statt Routine

  • Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und Englisch

Was du von uns bekommst

  • Kein Kaffeekochen, sondern echte Verantwortung ab Tag 1 - natürlich bezahlt

  • Direkter Draht zu den Gründern: Du lernst hands-on, wie man ein Unternehmen aufbaut und arbeitest mit modernsten Tools

  • Die bestmögliche Vorbereitung, wenn du selbst zukünftig gründen möchtest

  • Bei uns treffen kreative Köpfe auf gegenseitigen Respekt - Hierarchien? Brauchen wir nicht. Gute Ideen? Immer her damit.

Bewirb dich

Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf, mögliches Startdatum und deine gewünschte Praktikumsdauer - statt einem Anschreiben beantworte uns bitte in drei bis vier Sätzen die Frage: Welches Problem hast du zuletzt gelöst, obwohl es zäh war, und wie?

Du erfüllst nicht alle Punkte? Bewirb dich trotzdem. Persönlichkeit, Motivation und Lernbereitschaft sind uns wichtiger als ein perfekter Lebenslauf.

Wir setzen uns für ein diverses, inklusives Team ein, unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Alter, Behinderung oder sexueller Identität.

title: Full Stack Software Engineer - AI Finance Agent
descriptionHtml:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

 

The Role

We are looking for full stack engineers to build fast across BJAK's AI Finance Agent.

This role is for product-minded engineers who can move across frontend, backend, internal tools and customer journeys to turn ideas into working products quickly.

 

What You'll Own

  • Build customer-facing and internal product features end to end.

  • Develop web flows, backend APIs, admin tools, dashboards and operational systems.

  • Support products across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel and financial services.

  • Work with product, design, mobile and operations teams to launch fast.

  • Integrate APIs, handle data flows and improve production reliability.

  • Use analytics, feedback and production issues to improve features after launch.

  • Help build tools that reduce manual work and improve speed across the business.

 

What We're Looking For

  • 3+ years of full stack software engineering experience.

  • Strong frontend and backend fundamentals.

  • Experience with modern web frameworks, APIs, databases and production systems.

  • Able to build useful products quickly without needing perfect specs.

  • Good product sense, UX awareness and attention to detail.

  • Comfortable debugging across the stack.

  • Experience in fintech, insurtech, marketplace, consumer apps or high-volume platforms is a strong advantage.

 

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Can turn rough requirements into working product.

  • Thinks about user flow, backend logic and business process together.

  • Moves fast while keeping systems maintainable.

  • Takes ownership from build to launch to post-launch fixes.

  • Clear about what they personally built and what was team-owned.

 

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who only want to work on one narrow layer.

  • People who need complete specs before starting.

  • Developers who ship UI without understanding backend or operations impact.

  • Candidates who avoid production support.

  • People who make vague claims without showing real shipped work.

 

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Germany. We are hiring for this market specifically, so applicants should already be based in Germany.

 

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Technical interview

3. CEO / final round

 

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

  • ontwerpen en verbeteren van API's en integraties;

  • werken met databases en data-intensieve functionaliteit;

  • schrijven van onderhoudbare, testbare en kwalitatief goede code;

  • bijdragen aan CI/CD, automated testing en DevOps;

  • oplossen van technische vraagstukken die frontend, backend en data met elkaar verbinden;

  • meedenken over architectuur en technische keuzes;

  • stap voor stap moderniseren van bestaande onderdelen van OrtaX.

Je werkt aan een volwassen product waarin continu de afweging wordt gemaakt tussen vandaag waarde leveren en bouwen aan de architectuur van morgen.

2. De technische uitdaging

OrtaX heeft een bestaand softwarelandschap én een duidelijke moderniseringsopgave. Binnen het ontwikkelproces worden onder andere Visual Studio, Azure DevOps, pipelines, testing, SonarQube en Oracle gebruikt. Dat betekent dat je niet alleen bezig bent met: “Hoe bouw ik deze feature?” maar ook met vragen als: “Hoe zorgen we ervoor dat wat we vandaag bouwen ook past bij waar we technisch naartoe willen?” Voor een developer die graag verder kijkt dan alleen zijn of haar eigen user story is hier dus veel te doen.

Bij OrtaX gebruiken we AI als een belangrijk hulpmiddel bij het ontwikkelproces. Daarbij geloven wij ook dat de developer verantwoordelijk is dat we goede code en een duidelijke architectuur opleveren. Ook op lange termijn willen we beschikken over een goed onderhoudbaar product. Daarbij is AI inmiddels een essentieel hulpmiddel, maar niet zonder input van de developer.

3. Wie zoeken we?

We zoeken vooral een developer die nieuwsgierig is en zich prettig voelt aan meerdere kanten van de applicatie. Je:

  • hebt een hbo- of wo-opleiding in bijvoorbeeld Software Engineering, Informatica, Computer Science of een vergelijkbare richting;

  • hebt ervaring met C# en .NET;

  • hebt ervaring met, of interesse in, moderne frontendontwikkeling;

  • hebt bij voorkeur gewerkt met één van de grote frontend frameworks;

  • begrijpt principes rondom API's, databases en softwarearchitectuur;

  • schrijft graag code die niet alleen werkt, maar ook begrijpelijk en onderhoudbaar is;

  • bent gewend om samen te werken in een Agile/Scrum-omgeving;

  • denkt analytisch en vindt het leuk om complexe problemen terug te brengen tot een pragmatische oplossing;

  • durft bestaande oplossingen ter discussie te stellen, maar begrijpt ook dat software stap voor stap moet kunnen veranderen;

  • communiceert makkelijk met developers, analisten en andere collega's.

Je hoeft niet op ieder onderdeel expert te zijn. We vinden het belangrijker dat je technisch sterk bent, graag leert en bereid bent je zowel aan de frontend- als backendkant verder te ontwikkelen.

4. Waarom OrtaX?

OrtaX ondersteunt gemeenten en samenwerkingsverbanden bij het WOZ-proces en richt zich op consistente, uitlegbare waarderingen en slimme automatisering. Daarbij wordt geïnvesteerd in technologieën zoals data-analyse, AI, automatisering en integratie.

Je werkt daardoor aan software waarvan de toepassing heel concreet is. Tegelijkertijd kom je in een omgeving waarin technisch nog veel te ontwikkelen en te moderniseren valt.

Je krijgt dus de combinatie van een volwassen product én de technische veranderopgave die normaal gesproken vooral bij een nieuw product hoort.

5. Wat bieden we jou?

Het salaris ligt tussen € 4700,- en € 5500,- per maand (daarnaast ontvang je een variabele beloning, vaste 13e maand en 8% vakantiegeld), afhankelijk van je rol, competentieprofiel en ervaring.  Verder bieden we je uitstekende voorwaarden, waaronder: 

  • deelname aan een goede pensioenregeling 

  • 27 vakantiedagen (gebaseerd op een fulltime contract) 

  • mogelijkheid om extra vakantiedagen te kopen 

  • Hybride werken vanuit huis en het kantoor in Amsterdam (uiteraard ben je welkom om elke dag op kantoor te werken) 

  • reiskostenvergoeding voor je dagelijkse woon-werkverkeer en evt. zakelijke reizen 

  • mogelijkheden om jezelf te ontwikkelen met een trainingsprogramma en wekelijkse onderzoeks- en kennisbijeenkomsten 

  • je start met een jaarcontract, daarna is er uitzicht op een vast contract, omdat we streven naar een langdurige samenwerking 

  • een prettige werkomgeving met enthousiaste en leuke collega's! 

6. Over OrtaX

OrtaX ondersteunt gemeenten en samenwerkingsverbanden bij het efficiënt, betrouwbaar en transparant uitvoeren van het WOZ-proces. De ambitie is om taxateurs te ondersteunen met slimme automatisering en tegelijk te investeren in nieuwe technologie, procesautomatisering en integratie.

Daarbij werken we niet alleen aan wat OrtaX vandaag nodig heeft, maar ook aan hoe het product er technisch morgen uit moet zien.

Wil jij daar als Fullstack Developer aan meebouwen? Dan maken we graag kennis met je.

title: FullStack Engineer - Prospect Data Solutions
descriptionHtml:

About Us

Constructor is the next-generation platform for search and discovery in ecommerce, built on a unique GPT-based architecture made specifically for commerce. Constructor's AI-first solutions make it easier for shoppers to discover products they want to buy and for ecommerce teams to deliver highly personalized experiences, from search, to recommendations, to AI Shopping Agents and everything in between. Optimizing specifically for ecommerce metrics like revenue, conversion rate and profit, Constructor generates consistent $10M+ lifts for some of the biggest brands in ecommerce, such as Sephora, Petco, Under Armour, home24, Birkenstock and The Very Group. You’ll work closely with internal Engineering, Product and Sales stakeholders to seamlessly integrate prospective customer data with our services, supporting them to create an optimized and accurate product discovery demo.

title: Fullstack Software Engineer (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
YOUR JOB

AI can write code now. It can't decide what's worth building, and it can't tell whether its own output is right. That part is yours. As a Fullstack Software Engineer in our customer-facing feature team, you'll take on real problems, often co-leading an initiative with a fellow engineer. You'll carry them from the first discovery conversation to production and beyond, working with Product, Design and engineers who would rather own an outcome than close a ticket. What you build lands with many companies working to keep their data, and the people behind it, safe.

WE PROTECT THE PEOPLE BEHIND THE DATA

We are a fast-growing security and compliance tech company with a clear purpose: we protect the people behind the data. With over 200 team members worldwide and with offices in Munich, Berlin, London, Stockholm, and Vienna, we help more than 4,000 global customers get certified fast and build a strong and scalable risk posture. With AI-powered automation, self-serve capabilities, and additional tailored expert advice, we offer our customers a seamless security and compliance experience to stay ahead of the rapidly evolving security landscape and challenges like the surge in cyber-attacks.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

  • Own what you build, end to end. Shape capabilities in discovery with your Product Owner and Designer, build them across frontend and backend, ship them to production, and make sure they work properly in customers' hands.

  • Help decide what gets built, not just how. Challenge assumptions, suggest alternatives, and help define requirements before anyone writes code.

  • Engineer with AI, responsibly. Use agentic workflows and AI tooling every day while you stay accountable for architecture, security and quality. You'll also help shape how our team builds with AI.

  • Build the new and improve the existing. Your time splits roughly evenly between new product capabilities and modernising an established codebase. Every area you touch should be better when you leave it.

  • Work beyond your team's walls. Spot dependencies with our other teams early, raise risks before they block delivery, and keep stakeholders informed.

  • Deliver as a team. Join four talented engineers who share ownership. You'll work in four-month terms with two-week sprints, keep rituals lean, and adjust scope when reality changes.

WHAT YOU'LL GET IN RETURN

  • The freedom, trust, and tools to do what you love and make an impact in a purpose-driven company, committed to doing genuine good in the digital world

  • Enjoy a high degree of flexibility with tailored working hours, choice of work location, and benefits that support your lifestyle, health, and family needs

  • Join a secure, future-focused role in a dynamic scale-up positioned to make a major impact in the rapidly expanding Security & Compliance market

  • Grow along expert or leadership paths with support from employee accelerator programs, bi-annual feedback cycles, and a personal training budget

  • Work in an environment that values autonomy, rapid decision-making, a flat hierarchy, and collaborative, eye-level communication to keep things moving forward.

THE QUALITIES YOU'LL NEED FOR A SUCCESSFUL CAREER AT DATAGUARD

  • You think in problems, solutions and how to implement them properly to deliver value to customers, not tickets that should to be done.

  • You're a builder across the stack. You've shipped features on both frontend and backend. Your backend are Java, Node.js using typescript or a similar typed languages, a knowledge in ruby is a plus. Your frontend is a modern SPA framework: Vue is ideal and React works too. You don't need deep expertise in both, but you can deliver on each without help.

  • You treat Product and Design as partners. You've worked closely with Product Managers and Designers. You've disagreed with one, and the result was a better idea.

  • Ambiguity doesn't stop you. You don't wait for a perfect ticket. You ask the right questions, make a call, write it down and move forward.

  • You use AI seriously, but not blindly. You've built real workflows with AI tools and you know how to verify what they produce through reviews, tests and asking "is this actually right?" You don't vibe-code your way to production.

  • You fix what's broken, deliberately. You won't ignore an issue just because it sits outside your ticket. You also know which ones to fix now, which to flag for later, and which rabbit holes to stay out of.

  • You explain things clearly. You can describe a technical decision in plain English to a customer, a colleague from Sales or Support, or a fellow engineer. You've worked in more than one company or product and you bring what you learned.

LAST BUT NOT LEAST. FROM THE BOTTOM OF OUR HEARTS:

No matter your origin, ethnicity, gender identity, religion or individual requirements; at DataGuard, all that counts is the person you are. As Guards and Guardettes, we are united not only by our dedication, but also by our shared belief in our purpose: Protect the people behind the data. Convince us with your personality and your skills – and together we will make great things happen. We are looking forward to meeting you!

Du hast Dein Abitur mit sehr guten Leistungen abgeschlossen oder befindest Dich zwischen Bachelor und Master.

Du bringst hohe intrinsische Motivation mit und Lust, ein Jahr lang wirklich etwas zu lernen statt es einfach zu überbrücken.

Keine Angst vor technischen Herausforderungen: Wenn ein Workflow automatisiert werden muss oder ein neues Tool evaluiert werden soll, legst Du los und lernst beim Tun.

Analytisches Denkvermögen, Hands-on-Mentalität und unternehmerisches Gespür.

Reife, Eigenverantwortung und Lust, schnell zu lernen, auch wenn vieles neu ist.

Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

Warum wir?

Unser Ziel: ein faires, datengetriebenes Wertgutachten für jede Immobilie in Deutschland. Bei Certa ersetzen wir das klassische Sachverständigenwesen durch eine KI-gestützte Bewertungsplattform, die schneller, präziser und transparenter ist als alles, was der Markt heute kennt.

Du planst ein Gap Year zwischen Schule und Studium oder zwischen Bachelor und Master und willst diese Zeit nicht mit Backpacking-Klischees, sondern mit echter Verantwortung füllen? Bei Certa bekommst Du eine Rolle, die Du in einem Jahr nirgendwo sonst bekommst.

Das Office der Geschäftsführung arbeitet direkt mit den beiden Gründern und Geschäftsführern (Alexander Rausch & Matthias Mertens) an den Top-Themen, die Certa als Unternehmen entscheidend voranbringen. Vom OKR-Framework über Marktexpansion und Operational Excellence bis zum Aufbau skalierbarer Backoffice-Strukturen. Trotz der Nähe zur Geschäftsführung leben wir eine entrepreneuriale, pragmatische Arbeitskultur: kurze Wege, schnelle Entscheidungen, hohe Umsetzungstiefe.

Ein Gap Year bei Certa ist kein Praktikum mit Abstrichen, sondern eine vollwertige Rolle mit eigenen Verantwortungsbereichen. Du bekommst Zeit, in mehrere Themen tief reinzukommen, eigene Projekte aufzubauen und mit der Zeit echte Ownership zu übernehmen.

Ein Jahr, das Dich prägt: Du lernst in 12 Monaten mehr über Wirtschaft, Technologie und Unternehmensführung als in den ersten zwei Studienjahren.

Direkte Linie zu den Gründern: Du arbeitest täglich mit den beiden Gründern und Geschäftsführern. Keine Layer, keine Politik, keine Slide-Schlachten.

Spielwiese für KI-Enthusiasten: Bei uns ist KI kein Buzzword, sondern Arbeitsalltag. Du bekommst Zugang zu allen relevanten Tools und Modellen.

Echte Verantwortung: Du arbeitest an Themen, die wirklich zählen, nicht an Beschäftigungstherapie.

Faire Vergütung: Anders als bei vielen Gap-Year-Programmen wirst Du bei uns als vollwertiges Teammitglied bezahlt.

Perspektive über das Gap Year hinaus: Werkstudentenstelle während des Studiums, langfristige Mentorship und ein klarer Einstiegspfad nach dem Abschluss.

title: Generalist, Fellowships
descriptionHtml:
You make sure each fellowship cohort runs smoothly, from acceptance to the last day, so that fellows and Research Managers can focus on research.

  • Salary: £68,250–£95,500 per year. We may be able to pay more for exceptional candidates.

  • Location: London, at our office at LISA

  • Hours: Full time

  • Visa: We can sponsor a Skilled Worker visa, but approval isn't guaranteed.

Why work at Pivotal

Pivotal finds people who can work on the biggest risks from advanced AI and gets them working on them. Since 2024, 135 fellows have taken part in our fellowships, and alumni now work at METR, Apollo Research, UK AISI and GovAI. We have grown from 2 staff in 2024 to 10 today, and we plan to reach at least 16 in 2027. Read more about us at pivotal-research.org, and about what it is like to work here.

What you might own

There are many areas worth owning at Pivotal that shape how good and productive a fellow’s time with us is. In 2027 we expect about 170 fellows across our fellowships, often with multiple cohorts on site at the same time. You help each of them have an excellent experience.

Which areas you own depends on your strengths and interests. It might be the systems behind each cohort, our events, how we collect and act on fellow feedback, and sometimes new areas will arise. You’ll likely work on several projects and areas at the same time, and these will change as Pivotal grows.

  • Fellow logistics. Onboarding, travel, letters for visas, desks and equipment, and stipend payments with our finance provider.

  • Events. Socials, speaker events, retreats and closing weeks, including the room and AV setup.

  • Fellow experience. Collect feedback during each cohort and fix problems quickly.

  • Records and tools. Keep fellow records and fellowship tools up to date, and automate work that repeats every cohort.

  • Other cohort needs. Take on whatever the cohort needs, with good judgement about what matters most.

Who does well in this role

  • You are organised and reliable: things you own get done, and people know their status.

  • You have run events or operations for a program, a team or an organisation.

  • You understand why a task matters, and you suggest better ways to do it.

  • You are friendly and calm with fellows, also under pressure.

  • You use AI tools to automate repetitive work.

  • You care about reducing catastrophic risks.

We don’t expect anyone to be strong in all of this. If the role excites you, please apply, even if you match only part of what we describe here.

How we hire

We review applications as they come in, so applying early helps. The process has these stages:

  • Written application. A short form and your CV. It takes about 30 minutes.

  • Automated video interview. About 10 minutes. You record short answers to a few questions, at a time that suits you.

  • Work task. About 2 hours, based on real work in this role. We pay you for this time. You may use AI tools, as you would in the job. Tell us which ones you used and how.

  • Personal interview. About 45 minutes. We discuss your work task and how you would approach the role. With your consent, we record it so that more of the team can review it.

  • Work trial and references. Up to three paid days working with us at our office in London. We also speak to two referees, after asking you.

If you need an adjustment at any stage, such as extra time, tell us and we will arrange it. If you have questions, email ----- £68,250 – £95,500

title: Global Trainee Program - Outperformer Software Business Track (HILTI)
descriptionHtml:
4PS is part of the Hilti Group, which gives our people access to international opportunities and development programs within the wider Hilti organization. This vacancy is part of Hilti’s Global Trainee Program. Interested in joining the program? Please submit your application directly via Hilti Careerpage

Construction technology is being reinvented. Be part of it.

Construction is one of the world's largest industries, and one of its least digitized. That is changing fast. At Hilti, we are not only developing software products - we are building and growing digital businesses around them. Hilti is at the centre of that shift, with a growing portfolio of software products that connect jobsites, offices, teams, and tools across the entire construction lifecycle. We are looking for ambitious, internationally mobile early-career talents with a global mindset who are excited about technology but see their future in business and leadership rather than in a purely technical software career.

The Software & Digital Business Track of Hilti's Outperformer Program is a two-year accelerated development program that prepares you for a commercial, international leadership career in our software and digital businesses. You will learn how technology becomes customer value, how software businesses grow, how products are brought to market, and how commercial decisions are made. This is not a rotation program where you shadow senior leaders. From day one, you carry real responsibility.

What You'll do

The Software Track is designed to build the next generation of software business leaders at Hilti – Business Owners, Business Directors, Segment Managers and ultimately Senior Management Team members. If you want a structured path to running a business, this program is built for that outcome.

The program places you inside one of two business units:

Construction Software: Home to Fieldwire (Field Software for project and workforce management), ON!Track (asset management), and 4PS (construction business management). You will work directly with customers, product teams, and business leadership across Europe and beyond.

Fastening & Protection Solutions: Where design & engineering software for structural connections (e.g. PROFIS Engineering Suite), MEP supports and passive fire protection systems are developed and brought to market across a global customer base of structural and mechanical engineers.


For the Construction Software business unit, the program is structured to provide a balanced foundation in customer and market exposure, software product understanding, and business experience, while giving you the opportunity to work with at least two software products during the program:

  • ​Year 1: Begin with a 12-month sales assignment, developing direct customer insight and understanding the business challenges addressed by our software solutions.
  • ​Year 2: Undertake three rotations of 3–6 months each across product and business teams, including exposure to an international project.

​For the Fastening & Protection Solution business unit, the program provides exposure to product management , software development, exposure to customers and start-ups and international project experience:

  • ​Year 1: Begin with a 12-month product management assignment, building product understanding and market insight.
  • ​Year 2: Undertake three rotations of 3–6 months each, involving international projects that broaden your business perspective and global exposure.

You will have a dedicated senior mentor from the start, direct exposure to executive leadership, and a peer cohort of Global Trainees across all Hilti business tracks globally.

What You’ll Bring

You are close to graduating or have recently completed a Master's degree - your degree is likely to be in construction management, civil engineering, or mechanical engineering with a focus on construction, Computer Science, or also Business study programs with an affinity for Software and construction. What matters more than your degree subject is the combination of traits below:

  • Global mobility - you are willing and able to relocate internationally, multiple times. A global thinker who is keen for diverse cultural experiences.
  • Digital and AI orientation - you think natively in digital workflows, comfortable with software tools, and know the power and potential of AI.
  • Language - you are fluent in English and/or German, Dutch, French, Spanish or Italian. 
  • Commercial instinct - you are drawn to how businesses grow, how customers make decisions, and how products create.
  • Low ego, high drive - you take the work seriously and yourself lightly. You seek feedback, move fast, and are energised by ambiguity rather than unsettled by it.
  • You are at the start of your career and have maximum three years of junior work experience.

What’s In It for You

​​Show us what you can do, and in return, we promise you the experience of a lifetime. We offer you a transformative journey filled with learning, growth, and invaluable experiences that will shape your perspective and personal and professional development. On top of that, you’ll also take part in some fascinating courses and events:

  • Introductory Global Summit: Experience 4 days at our global headquarters in Liechtenstein, featuring the presence of our Executive Board and Global Senior Leadership. The summit offers a comprehensive overview of our business, while fostering soft skill development and meaningful collaboration with fellow program participants.
  • Social Project Summit: 7 days dedicated to building a better future, with contribution to a hands-on, high-impact community project. This experience offers the chance to immerse yourself in a different culture while actively improving living conditions for those in need.
  • Leadership Summit: An enriching learning journey in partnership with a renowned business school, featuring online modules and collaborative projects with fellow program participants. The experience concludes with a 5-day on-campus summit to deepen insights and to foster business and leadership skills.

Why Hilti

Hilti is a global leader in construction innovation, with more than 34,000 team members across 120 countries. Guided by our purpose, Making Construction Better, we’re driven to keep learning, growing, and finding new ways to make a lasting impact. Here, you’ll be empowered to use your strengths, work with a global and inclusive team, and take on meaningful challenges. At Hilti, you’ll have the chance to make your ideas, achievements, and growth real through purpose, passion, and teamwork.

Learn more about our recruitment process: https://careers.hilti.group/en/candidate-interview-preparation/

Commitment to Inclusion

​​At Hilti, inclusion is a key focus in how we work, lead, and grow together. We are committed to embracing diversity of thought and creating an environment that is inclusive of everyone, everywhere. We continuously strive to ensure every voice is valued and every team member feels empowered to contribute. By building on this foundation, we strengthen our teams, our innovation, and our impact, making construction better together.

​Exciting software journey: You will dive into the fast-paced world of our construction software business, gaining exposure to innovative digital solutions that are transforming one of the world's largest industries.
​
​Global cross-team collaboration: You will work with colleagues worldwide and get guidance from a dedicated mentor as you grow in your career.

​We hire for a career, not for a position. If you are looking for long-term career prospects and opportunities to grow, this is the perfect start.​

​Are you ready to jumpstart your career? Our hiring process is designed to help you showcase your skills and experience. The process has multiple steps and requires a longer period of time:

  • It all starts with your application and a video interview.
  • Get connected with our HR team in an online interview.
  • Get ready to flex your problem-solving muscles with our online Business Case Round.
  • Impress our Business Line Managers with your presentation skills and insights during the next round.
  • And, if you make it to the end, you'll receive an invitation to our Assessment Center.

​Exciting, right? Let's get started!

4PS is part of the Hilti Group, which gives our people access to international opportunities and development programs within the wider Hilti organization. This vacancy is part of Hilti’s Global Trainee Program. Interested in joining the program? Please submit your application directly via Hilti Careerpage

​The Assessment Center will take place in Liechtenstein at Hilti Headquarter on December 1st and 2nd, 2026. Applications will be reviewed in the order they’re received, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible since there are limited spots for the Assessment Center!​

Learn more about our recruitment process:

Candidate Interview Preparation

​​For further questions, please feel free to contact Vanessa Furtner ----- and (My LinkedIn).
​
*For non-EU / EFTA citizens: Please state your eligibility status to work in EU or UK countries and note that if you do not own a valid work permit, Hilti cannot guarantee your final employment due to authority regulations.​

title: Grafikdesigner – Vollzeit (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Wir suchen engagierte Mitarbeiter:innen für unser Social-Media bzw. Designteam, die die komplette grafische Umsetzung unserer Recruiting- und Marketingprojekte übernehmen und damit maßgeblich zum Erfolg unserer Kunden beitragen. Wenn du strukturiert arbeitest, ein gutes Auge für Design hast und visuelle Inhalte erstellen kannst, die nicht nur gut aussehen, sondern auch performen, dann bist du bei uns genau richtig.

Wer wir sind:
DIGIHEADS gehört zu den etablierten Agenturen im Bereich Recruiting-, Employer-Branding- und Neukundenstrategien. Als Wachstumspartner für den deutschen Mittelstand entwickeln wir Social-Media-Kampagnen, Aufbau- und Optimierungsprozesse sowie automatisierte Systeme, die unseren Kunden helfen, planbar neue Mitarbeiter und Neukunden zu gewinnen.

Mit einem starken, prozessorientierten Team unterstützen wir Unternehmen deutschlandweit und suchen Kolleginnen & Kollegen, die in einem stabilen, strukturierten Umfeld Verantwortung übernehmen möchten. Wenn du bereit bist, Projekte präzise zu steuern, Kundenbeziehungen aktiv zu stärken und mit einer klaren Hands-on-Mentalität zum Wachstum von DIGIHEADS beizutragen, dann werde Teil unseres Teams.

Bisher haben wir über 210 Partner betreut und gehören damit deutschlandweit zu einer der führenden Agenturen in diesem Bereich. In der Zusammenarbeit konnten unsere Partner bereits über 930 Einstellungen verzeichnen. Zu unseren Partnern zählen namhafte Unternehmen und Organisationen wie alle Standorte der Bäckerei Grobe, alle akzenta-Standorte sowie Vanderlande, DSW21, verschiedene Standorte der Diakonie und des DRK sowie Meyer Recycling.

Deine Rolle – kreativ, performanceorientiert & verlässlich

Als Grafikdesigner (m/w/d) bist du verantwortlich für die komplette grafische Umsetzung unserer Kundenprojekte.

Du übernimmst die Verantwortung (nach gründlicher Einarbeitung) für:

  • Die Planung und Gestaltung von Creatives (Bilder, Grafiken, Animationen, kurze Videos, Carousel-Formate) für Meta-Werbeanzeigen (Facebook & Instagram)

  • Gestaltung von Karriereseiten & Landingpages über Perspective und Onepage

  • Gestaltung und Planung von Social-Media-Beiträgen für uns selbst oder unsere Kunden (Layouts, Grids, Feed-Gestaltung und Upload)

  • Gestaltung von internen Marketingmaterialien (Reports, Präsentationen, Collagen, Visuals, Grafiken)

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem Projektmanagement sowie Foto-/Videografen.

  • Sicherstellung einer konsistenten visuellen Markenqualität inkl. strukturierter Dokumentation und Ablage.

Kurz gesagt:
Du bist die zentrale Ansprechperson für alles Visuelle und verwandelst Strategien in performante Designs.

www.digi-heads.de/karriere

Die Einarbeitungsphase dauert in der Regel 1–3 Monate.

Das erwartet dich bei uns:

  • Kein Großraumbüro: du arbeitest mit maximal 2–3 Kolleg:innen pro Raum

  • Höhenverstellbare Schreibtische für ergonomisches Arbeiten

  • Möglichkeit, Prozesse effizient zu unterstützen

  • Moderne, hochwertige Arbeitsausstattung

  • Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag – sicherer Arbeitsplatz

  • Abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung oder Studium im Bereich Mediengestaltung, Grafikdesign oder vergleichbarer Fachrichtungen

  • Sicherer Umgang mit Canva und/oder der Adobe Creative Cloud (insb. Photoshop)

  • Erste Erfahrung im Grafikdesign oder in der Erstellung digitaler Inhalte

  • Interesse für konvertierendes Performance-Design

  • Grundverständnis für visuelle Kommunikation und Designprinzipien

  • Hohe Genauigkeit & Qualitätsanspruch an deine Arbeit

  • Starke Organisationsfähigkeit – du behältst den Überblick, auch bei mehreren parallelen Projekten

  • Fähigkeit, strukturierten Prozessen zu folgen und Deadlines einzuhalten

  • Sehr gute schriftliche Ausdrucksform in Deutsch

  • Zuverlässige, konzentrierte und selbstständige Arbeitsweise

title: Group Agency Director
descriptionHtml:
Overview

Captify, now part of Verve Group, is the leading Search Intelligence Platform for the open web and the largest independent holder of first-party search data outside of Google, connecting the real-time searches from over 2 billion devices globally. Its Search Intelligence technology powers omnichannel programmatic advertising and real-time insights for the world’s biggest brands, such as Disney, Unilever, eBay, Mercedes-Benz, Microsoft, Nestlé, GSK, Uber, Mars, P&G, Sony and Toyota—without reliance on third-party cookies. Captify brings brands more customers, publishers greater yield and consumers the most relevant digital experiences.

We are looking for an enthusiastic and passionate Sales Planner to work alongside the Sales team to create growth opportunities with new and existing clients. You will be responsible for identifying key marketing opportunities, delivering best in class audience insights and supporting the commercial teams with your client and vertical expertise. In this role you will play a crucial part in helping drive commercial success and growth for the business.

What we're looking for

As Group Agency Director, you will own Captify's relationship with Publicis Groupe and be accountable for growing revenue across the group. You will lead a team of agency-facing sellers, set the strategy for the patch, and make Captify a go-to partner for Publicis agencies and their clients.

This is a senior commercial role. It combines hands-on relationship building at leadership level with team management, forecasting and close work with our product, data and operations teams.

  • Reports to: VP of Sales 
  • Location: London, hybrid
  • Direct reports: 3/4

What you'll do 

Revenue growth

  • Own and deliver the annual revenue target for the Publicis Groupe patch, including new and repeat business.
  • Build a clear account plan across Publicis agencies and networks, identifying where Captify can grow share of spend.
  • Lead pitches, proposals and upfront or partnership negotiations at agency and holding-group level.
  • Keep an accurate pipeline and forecast, and report performance to the leadership team.

Relationship leadership

  • Be the senior point of contact for Publicis Groupe, building trusted relationships from trading and investment leads through to agency and client leadership.
  • Position Captify's search intelligence as a strategic asset for planning, activation and insight, not only a media line.
  • Spot opportunities to work directly with key Publicis clients alongside their agencies.
  • Stay close to the group's priorities, structure changes and trading arrangements.

Team management

  • Lead, coach and develop a team of agency-facing sellers.
  • Set clear targets, run regular pipeline and performance reviews, and support the team on key deals.

Working across Captify

  • Work with Client Success, Product, Insights and Trading to deliver campaigns that perform and grow.
  • Feed agency and client needs back into product and commercial strategy.
  • Share wins, case studies and best practice with the wider commercial team.

What you'll bring

  • Significant experience in agency-facing sales or partnerships in ad tech, data or digital media, with a strong track record of hitting and beating revenue targets.
  • Established senior relationships within Publicis Groupe (for example Publicis Media, Starcom, Zenith, Spark Foundry, Digitas or Epsilon) and a good understanding of how the group plans and trades.
  • Experience leading and developing a commercial team, ideally including people managers or senior sellers.
  • Confidence negotiating at holding-group level, including partnership and investment deals.
  • A solid grasp of programmatic, audience data, measurement and the privacy-led changes shaping digital advertising.
  • A consultative, insight-led selling style, and the ability to turn data into a clear commercial story.
  • Strong forecasting and pipeline discipline, plus comfort with CRM tools such as Salesforce.
  • Energy, resilience and a collaborative approach to working across teams.

What success looks like in 12 months

  • Revenue from Publicis Groupe is growing in line with or ahead of target.
  • Captify is active across more Publicis agencies and clients, with a clear plan for the next year.
  • A partnership or preferred-supplier agreement is in place or in active negotiation at group level.
  • The team is fully staffed, hitting its targets, and has clear development plans.
  • Pipeline and forecasting are accurate and trusted by leadership.

What We Offer

  • Stay healthy with our Bupa HealthCare Plan with easy access to medical care
  • Support your long-term financial security with our Aviva Corporate Pension Scheme, with Verve contributing 5% of your qualifying earnings
  • Pick what matters most to you in our Personalised Benefits Platform, with a budget of £50/month
  • Recharge with 25 paid vacation days + 3 Wellness days throughout the year, in addition to the public holidays
  • Boost your professional knowledge with our annual training budget & internal webinars
  • … and even more reasons to join us!

title: Growth Strategist – Rewarded, CTV & New Channels (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
JustPlay is looking for a Growth Strategist to drive the next phase of our User Acquisition growth across Rewarded, Connected TV (CTV) and emerging channels. Beyond campaign management, you’ll define the long-term strategy, identify new growth opportunities and turn them into measurable results.

You’ll decide where JustPlay should grow next, why, and how we’ll know it’s working. Then you’ll build it end to end: strategy, partners, budget, measurement and scale. Day-to-day execution is part of the job. Your real impact is defining what our growth looks like a year from now.

 

Job Responsibilities

  • Define and own the long-term growth strategy for Rewarded, CTV and new channels, setting priorities, identifying opportunities and driving measurable results.

  • Lead and scale the Rewarded channel, owning strategy, partnerships, payout models (playtime, multi-reward, CPE) and budgets, while keeping ROAS, retention and fraud in check.

  • Build and scale CTV as a performance channel, owning strategy, partners, audiences, creative direction and incrementality measurement (geo-lift and holdout testing).

  • Identify, test and scale new acquisition channels, evaluating opportunities and turning successful experiments into sustainable growth streams.

  • Own a structured testing roadmap across channels and platforms, with clear hypotheses, success criteria, sample sizes and decision rules for every test.

  • Own channel measurement and attribution, partnering with Data to develop dashboards, incrementality frameworks and performance reporting.

  • Manage strategic partner relationships, negotiating commercial terms and ensuring performance and accountability.

  • Work across functions with Product, Creative, Data and Engineering on UA × Product experiments, creative for TV and rewarded formats, and the tracking these channels need.

  • Act as a strategic partner to UA lead and the team, challenging assumptions, mentoring team members and shaping future growth opportunities.

Job Requirements

  • You have 5+ years of experience in mobile User Acquisition within gaming or mobile apps, including at least 2 years owning budgets and channel performance at scale.

  • You think beyond campaigns, with proven experience defining channel strategies, gaining leadership buy-in and owning results.

  • You have hands-on experience with rewarded and incentivized UA (playtime, offerwall, multi-reward or CPE), including payout models, partner management and fraud control.

  • You have hands-on experience with CTV or other upper-funnel channels, ideally for mobile apps, including incrementality measurement through geo-lift or holdout testing.

  • You have a track record of launching new channels from scratch, from assessing opportunities and testing to scaling or stopping based on results.

  • You have strong analytical skills in cohort and LTV/ROAS analysis, attribution (MMP, SKAN, probabilistic vs. deterministic) and experiment statistics. SQL is a strong plus.

  • You are proficient with Adjust, Firebase and Looker (or similar BI tools), as well as Jira, Miro and Figma.

  • You actively use AI tools such as Claude to improve analysis, experimentation and decision-making.

  • You’ve negotiated with partners and confidently managed commercial terms.

  • You bring an entrepreneurial mindset and strong ownership, turning ambiguous opportunities into measurable business impact.

  • Experience with rewarded gaming or fintech apps is a strong plus.

 

Job Benefits

  • Work-Life Balance and Flexibility: Flexible working hours and options for digital nomads, occasional office visitors, or regular office-goers

  • Mental Health Support: Free personal coaching through our partner OpenUp to support our team members to live fulfilled lives at home and at work

  • Training & Development: A competitive personal development budget of up to 2000€/year for training, conferences, workshops, etc. and free language tutoring in German and English with Preply

  • Germany-Based Benefits: 25 vacation days (based on a 5-day work week) and free Wellhub gold subscription

  • State-of-the-Art Equipment: Doesn’t matter if you are a MacBook or Windows user; we will provide you with the technical gear you need to succeed

  • Berlin Office Perks: Ergonomic setup, free daily lunch at our office, and a dog-friendly environment

  • Engaging and Diverse Work Environment: Join a diverse team, with over 30 nationalities working from over 25 different locations

Benefits may vary depending on location and contract type. Do not hesitate to ask us about more details on our benefits offer.

 

About us

Come join the team building the engine behind rewarded mobile gaming – making playtime truly rewarding. At JustPlay, we’re on a mission to power a fairer, more sustainable rewarded gaming ecosystem where users earn real value for their time through a self-sustaining modell.

Since launching in 2020, we’ve grown into one of the world’s leading rewarded gaming platforms, with 25M+ downloads and 500K+ daily active users. Headquartered in Berlin and backed by NCSoft, one of the world’s leading gaming companies, we continue to operate fully independently – combining the speed, ownership, and ambition of a startup with the long-term backing of a global gaming powerhouse.

With a team across 20+ countries, we’re shaping a major shift in mobile gaming – and it’s still early enough for you to make your mark. At JustPlay, you’ll build end-to-end, move fast, and ship work that reaches millions – in a company that’s profitable, built to last, and focused on outcomes over hype.

Everyone's welcome here

Coordinate across the business

Helpful experience

Competencies and Behavioural Traits

Strong narrative judgment, senior presence, clear prioritisation and calm leadership. A capable people manager who develops others, gives direct feedback and delegates with purpose. Takes personal ownership where the stakes or complexity require senior experience, while keeping regional and global colleagues aligned. title: Head of Compliance
descriptionHtml:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, accessible and safe.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who love building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who care about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it’s the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

Doit is building its investment business from Vilnius. As Head of Compliance and AML at Doit Lithuania, you will build and run our compliance and anti-money-laundering function from day one.

You will act as our Compliance Officer and AML Officer, and report directly to the management board. You will be independent of the business lines you monitor. You will run compliance and AML for a digital investment platform serving clients in Lithuania and across the European Economic Area.

What You’ll Own

  • Write and own the compliance and AML/CTF policies and procedures.

  • Build the business-wide AML risk assessment, customer risk scoring and risk appetite.

  • Design remote onboarding controls with our KYC partners, including enhanced due diligence for PEPs and high-risk clients.

  • Design and tune transaction monitoring scenarios for brokerage activity.

  • Run sanctions screening at onboarding, on an ongoing basis and on payments.

  • File suspicious activity reports with the FNTT and suspicious order reports under MAR.

  • Run the compliance monitoring programme and report to the board.

  • Approve marketing communications and oversee product governance, complaints and conflicts of interest.

  • Manage the regulatory relationship with the Bank of Lithuania on compliance and AML matters.

  • Prepare the firm for the EU AML Regulation, which applies from July 2027.

  • Build the compliance and AML team as the business grows.

What We’re Looking For

  • Significant experience in AML/CTF at a regulated EU financial institution. Ideally at an investment firm, neobroker, neobank or e-money institution.

  • Experience with digital onboarding and remote identity verification at scale.

  • Hands-on experience building risk assessments, monitoring scenarios and EDD processes.

  • Experience filing suspicious activity reports and handling regulatory inspections.

  • Knowledge of MiFID II conduct and investment-services compliance, or the ability to learn it fast.

  • Experience selecting and overseeing KYC, screening and monitoring tools.

  • Strong judgment and the confidence to challenge senior colleagues.

  • Clear, concise writing for policies, board reports and regulators.

  • A clean record and good reputation, suitable for regulatory approval as a key function holder.

  • Based in Lithuania, or open to relocating to Lithuania.

Nice to Have

  • Lithuanian language ability.

  • An existing working relationship with the Bank of Lithuania or the FNTT.

  • Knowledge of Lithuanian AML law and Bank of Lithuania instructions.

  • Experience with clients across several EEA countries.

  • CAMS (ACAMS) or ICA certification.

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only want to attend meetings.

  • Candidates who cannot follow up aggressively and professionally.

  • People who copy policies from templates without fitting them to the business.

  • People who say no without offering a compliant way forward.

  • People who produce long updates without clear decisions or next actions.

Location

This role is based in Vilnius, Lithuania. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our Vilnius office at least 3 days per week.

You must be a European citizen or already hold a valid right to work in Lithuania. We are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Role-specific interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process.

Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritised.

title: Head of Compliance & Risikomanagement (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:

Wir entwickeln das Wertpapiergeschäft der Genossenschaftlichen FinanzGruppe weiter und schaffen ein neues digitales Neo-Brokerage-Angebot. Es richtet sich gezielt an junge, digital-affine Zielgruppen, die wir für unsere Finanzgruppe gewinnen wollen. Unser Ziel ist es, mit einem zukunftsweisenden Mobile-First-Angebot, bestehend aus einer leistungsstarken Brokerage-App, einem unverwechselbaren Marktauftritt mit erstklassigem Service und nahtlosem Zugang zu persönlicher Beratung unserer Primärbanken eine starke Antwort auf den sich wandelnden Brokerage-Markt zu geben. Bei uns hast Du die einzigartige Chance, ein innovatives Angebot von Anfang an aktiv mitzugestalten – von der Markenentwicklung über die User Experience bis zum Produktdesign. Flache Hierarchien und agile Arbeitsweisen erlauben dir schnell Verantwortung zu übernehmen und echten Impact zu schaffen.

Gemeinsam mit deinem Bereich identifizierst, bewertest, steuerst und überwachst du sämtliche Risiken.   • Überwachung der Risikotragfähigkeit

  • Regelmäßige Berichterstattung an das Management

  • Verantwortung der engen Zusammenarbeit mit den Fachbereichen des GENO Broker und der DZ BANK AG, der Internen Revision, Wirtschaftsprüfern und dem Leitungsorgan

  • Etablierung und Weiterentwicklung einer angemessenen Risikokultur

  • Auslagerungs- und Drittparteien-Management (TPRM): Überwachung regulatorischer Anforderungen bei Dienstleistern und Kooperationspartnern

  • Du übernimmst Verantwortung für die interne Meldestelle/Whistleblowing nach HinschG

Das bringst du mit

  • Du hast mindestens 5–7 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Risikomanagement, in der Compliance-Abteilung einer Bank, in der Internen Revision oder bei einer bankennahen Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaft gesammelt.

  • Du hast einen wirtschaftswissenschaftlichen, rechtswissenschaftlichen oder wirtschaftsmathematischen Studienabschluss, idealerweise nach klassischer Bankausbildung.

  • Du verfügst über Zusatzqualifikationen/Zertifikate wie Certified Compliance Officer, Abschlüsse der genossenschaftlichen Akademien (z. B. GenoAkademie oder ADG) sowie im Bereich Geldwäsche/Anti-Financial-Crime (AFC) und über nachweisbare, tiefe Kenntnisse der Bankenregulierung (insb. KWG, WpHG, GwG, EBA-Leitlinien, BaFin-Rundschreiben zu MaComp).

Das erwartet dich bei uns

Deine Benefits

Neben einer vielseitigen und abwechslungsreichen Tätigkeit im Herzen von Frankfurt wirst Du Teil eines dynamischen und motivierten Teams, das die Umsetzung eines innovativen Geschäftsmodells mit Fokus auf das Wertpapiergeschäft verfolgt. title: Head of Legal
descriptionHtml:
About Agon

Agon is building Europe’s defence AI lab. We develop the sovereign infrastructure and AI foundation models to train, test and evolve autonomous defence systems, in Europe and for Europe. At the heart of it is a synthetic battlefield: a virtual testing ground where drones, vessels and other autonomous systems face adaptive adversaries at scale, and where their failure modes are exposed before they ever deploy. We work as a neutral partner to defence manufacturers and governments.

Founded in London in January 2026, we’ve raised $100M to date. Our $70M Series A, at a $450M valuation, was led by Northzone alongside Lakestar, Lux Capital and XYZ, with backing from former Sequoia Capital head Roelof Botha. It was also the first joint investment by the UK Government’s Sovereign AI Fund and the National Security Strategic Investment Fund.

Between them, our founders have helped build one of the defining defence-tech companies of the last decade, and started an aerospace company from scratch. Around them is a founding team hand-picked from Europe’s best engineers, each at the top of their field, and brought together to build this. We’re scaling fast across our offices in London and Berlin.

The role

We’re hiring our first Head of Legal: a hands-on commercial lawyer who will build Agon’s legal function and be a trusted partner to our leadership team. You’ll lead on the contracts and partnerships that shape our growth, cover corporate and employment matters with confidence, and represent Agon with partners and customers.

This role is based in London, with work across our UK and German entities.

What you’ll do

  • Lead commercial contracting: negotiate and draft defence contracts, sales agreements, teaming and partnership agreements, and joint ventures with industry partners and government customers.

  • Protect our IP: shape how we own, license and protect our technology and data in commercial deals.

  • Navigate defence regulation: own the legal view on export controls and related regimes, and manage specialist external counsel where needed.

  • Cover corporate and employment law: support governance, fundraising and transactions, and handle employment matters across the UK and Germany.

  • Be a partner to the business: work closely with our founders, commercial and product teams, and help them move quickly with sound judgement.

  • Build partnerships: represent Agon at industry events and with partners and customers, helping to open and shape strategic relationships.

  • Build the function: set up the processes, templates, training and external counsel relationships a scaling defence company needs.

What you’ll bring

  • Commercial depth: substantial hands-on experience negotiating complex commercial agreements, such as sales agreements, JVs and IP.

  • Defence context: familiarity with the defence or government sector, including export controls. You don’t need to be a specialist, but you should know the risks and when to bring in expert counsel.

  • Breadth: confidence handling corporate and employment law as well as commercial work.

  • Big law and beyond: training or experience at a leading law firm, followed by time in another setting, such as in-house, a scale-up, or military or government service.

  • An outward-facing style: you enjoy building relationships, attending events and talking to partners and customers.

  • Judgement and pace: you give clear, pragmatic advice and are comfortable doing the work yourself.

Nice to have

  • In-house experience at a defence, aerospace or deep-tech company

  • Experience with government contracting or procurement

  • Knowledge of German law or experience working with German entities

  • Experience supporting a venture-backed fundraising

What we offer

We pay at the top of the market we compete in, and everyone is an owner.

  • Pay: salary at the 90th percentile of the companies we compete with, benchmarked by role, level and location.

  • Equity: every permanent employee holds options. New hires receive options worth their base salary, vesting over four years with a one-year cliff.

  • Cash and equity choice: trade some salary for more options, or some options for more cash.

  • Pension: 5% employer and 5% employee contributions on full base salary.

  • Ownership from day one: you’ll build Agon’s legal function directly with our founders.

How we work

Our values shape how we work: All as One Company, Take Extreme Ownership, Low Ego, Be Bold, and Remember Who We Serve. We prefer clear written thinking to polished slides, and we hold a high bar.

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds. If you’re excited by this role but don’t meet every requirement, we’d still like to hear from you.

We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

The Role

Checkout.com holds licences in many countries, and the way we work with our supervisors matters more every year. We are creating a new Regulatory Affairs function to lead that work, and we are looking for the person to build it.

As Head of Regulatory Affairs, you will manage our supervisory relationships day to day and run the formal work that comes with them: information requests, thematic reviews, inspections and examinations. You will also shape how the new function works and where it grows, working closely with the Director of External Affairs.You will bring together the right people across Legal, Compliance, Risk, Finance, Product and Tech, and make sure everything we send is accurate, consistent and on time.

You will start hands-on, building the foundations yourself, leveraging advanced AI tools, then build a team of regulatory affairs specialists across our major markets over time.

What you'll do

Build the function

  • Shape our approach to supervisory engagement across our regulated entities.

  • Design how Regulatory Affairs works day to day, including how it works with Compliance, Legal, Risk and the business.

  • Help plan where the team grows, including which countries need local specialists and in what order.

  • Build a clear view of supervisory risk across the group and use it to set priorities.

  • Advise executives on what our supervisors expect and how upcoming supervisory activity will affect the business.

Manage our supervisory relationships

  • Run the regular cycle of supervisory meetings: preparation, briefing senior colleagues, attending and following up.

  • Keep a clear record of what we have told each regulator and what we have committed to.

  • Own the protocol for how we engage with supervisors, so colleagues know who speaks to whom and when.

  • Spot emerging issues early and raise them with senior leadership.

Run regulatory requests

  • Own regulator information requests and thematic reviews from receipt to submission: scope, owners, deadlines, evidence, version control and quality checks.

  • Act as a single front door for the business, so teams get one clear request instead of several.

  • Challenge draft responses for gaps and inconsistencies before they go out.

Lead inspections and examinations

  • Run inspections, examinations and skilled-person reviews as programmes, from the opening notice to the closing meeting.

  • Set the plan and the narrative, coordinate evidence, and prepare and rehearse subject-matter experts and senior leaders.

  • Run a lessons-learned review after each engagement and improve the process for next time.

Build the team and the infrastructure

  • Hire, develop and lead a team of regulatory affairs specialists across our major markets.

  • Build the playbooks, templates, trackers and governance the function will run on.

  • Build a library of past submissions so we can reuse good work.

  • Set up regular reporting to senior leadership and entity boards on open requests, inspections and commitments.

What we are looking for

  • A builder. You have set up a function, team or process from scratch, and you enjoy turning an open brief into something that works.

  • Significant experience as a regulatory affairs manager / lead at a regulated payments, e-money or fintech firm.

  • Hands-on experience running regulatory information requests and inspections end to end, ideally across more than one country.

  • Time in a supervisory team at a major financial regulator, such as the FCA, ACPR, MAS or CBUAE, is a strong advantage.

  • Strategic judgement. You can set a clear direction, explain it to executives and turn it into a plan.

  • Excellent project management. You can run several deadlines with many contributors at once and keep every one of them on track.

  • A track record of keeping calm under pressure.

  • Sound judgement on when to bring in Legal or Compliance.

  • Credibility with regulators and the trust of senior executives.

  • Impeccable written communication.

  • People management experience, or clear readiness to build and lead a team

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

For a closer look at daily life at Checkout.com, follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram
