title: Mobile Engineer - IOS
descriptionHtml:
OVERVIEW:

This role exists to build and maintain the iOS app that a large share of Gymshark customers shop through, at a standard that holds under peak load. You will turn refined product work into features that are shipped, tested and observable, and improves the quality of the code you touch.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING:

CRAFT  

  • Writes production Swift confidently. Most new work is SwiftUI; the app still contains UIKit that is being migrated, so both are relevant. 
  • Works effectively in a modular codebase. Understands why a type belongs in one module rather than another, and adds features without crossing module boundaries. 
  • Applies Clean Architecture and MVVM as standard, can explain the separation of concerns, and identifies where a pull request breaks it. 
  • Writes unit tests as part of the work rather than afterwards, and is comfortable building test doubles. Some of the team work test-first, and we want to increase that. 
  • Understands Swift concurrency sufficiently to avoid data races, and raises it when a problem exceeds their experience. 
  • Diagnoses production issues from crash reporting and analytics, and identifies the root cause independently. 
  • Treats performance, accessibility and app size as part of completing a piece of work. 
  • Understands the path their code takes after merge: CI, review, distribution and App Store submission, and the common failure points at each stage. 
  • Uses a branching strategy consistently and writes pull requests that are straightforward to review. 
  • Raises design specifications that conflict with the Human Interface Guidelines rather than implementing them unchanged. 
  • Considers security and dependency risk routinely, and can assess whether a third-party SDK should be added

DELIVERY

  • Contributes actively to Agile ceremonies, and raises when one is no longer useful. 
  • Helps Product Owners refine stories into buildable work, and raises when a story is not ready. 
  • Breaks work into increments that each deliver value, rather than a sequence that only delivers at the end. 
  • Demonstrates their own work to non-technical stakeholders and explains its value in plain language. 
  • Raises problems early, while they are still inexpensive to fix.

CULTURE 

  • Uses their 10% time and shares what comes out of it. 
  • Cross-skills beyond iOS sufficiently to work with adjacent teams. 
  • Shares what they learn through an appropriate channel. 
  • Documents solutions to a level the next person can use: diagrams, decisions and reasoning. 
  • Listens and understands other perspectives before forming an opinion, and asks questions that draw out wider input. 

LEADERSHIP 
 

  • Brings a formed view to a discussion rather than an open question, and revises it when presented with a better argument. 
  • Takes responsibility for their contribution to an outcome, including when it goes wrong. 
  • Treats input from design, product and QA as a constraint to understand rather than an obstacle. 
  • Weighs team goals against their own workload when the two conflict.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

Essential Criteria:

  • Several years writing Swift in a production app used by customers. 
  • SwiftUI work you have written is live in the App Store. 
  • Experience working in an established codebase alongside other engineers. 
  • You write unit tests for your own production code as a matter of routine. 
  • You have been responsible for resolving a production issue. 

 Desirable:
 

  • Worked on consumer or e-commerce apps at scale. 
  • Experience of a UIKit to SwiftUI migration. 
  • Experience of feature flagging and experimentation in production. 
  • Kotlin, or another second platform, sufficient to collaborate with the Android team. 

CLOSING DATE: 

Monday 12th October

LOCATION:

We’re an equal opportunities employer, and for us that means we always strive to be as inclusive as possible in all aspects of employment, right from your application. We’re committed to finding reasonable adjustments* for candidates with specific needs or have a disability during our recruitment process, and all applicants will be considered fairly and equally. A team that’s growing rapidly around the world. A collective of talented individuals working together to invent Gymshark’s future. title: Paralegal / Legal Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Dust

Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it.

With enterprise-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest-moving companies to rewire how work gets done.

With 70%+ weekly active users, people stick with Dust as much as they do with Slack and Notion. We don't get piloted and shelved. We land once, and spread. We're at an exciting stage of our journey, and growing fast.

We're serving great customers like Datadog, 1Password, Cursor, Clay, Vanta and Persona, and aim to x5 our growth by the end of 2026.

Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50.

Summary

We're looking for an early-career legal professional to help drive how Legal works at Dust. You'll shape and build legal processes and tools, and you'll get directly involved in a broad range of commercial legal matters, working under the supervision of Dust's lawyers. This role combines legal engineering and process improvement with hands-on experience in commercial contracting, including customer, vendor and partner matters. With a view to qualifying as a solicitor, the role may lead to consideration for an England & Wales training contract, subject to performance, business needs, eligibility and formal approval. A training contract is a potential pathway, not a guarantee.

What you'll do

Drive legal engineering and process improvement

  • Identify recurring legal bottlenecks and design better ways for the company to get legal support.

  • Translate legal rules and approved playbooks into practical workflows, templates, structured guidance and automations.

  • Build and improve legal workflows using Dust and other appropriate tools, including intake, contract review and approval processes.

  • Test workflows, gather feedback, document how they work and iterate to improve their quality and adoption.

  • Build appropriate controls into processes, including lawyer review points, escalation paths and safeguards for confidential information.

Get directly involved in commercial legal work

  • Draft, review and prepare redlines for a wide range of commercial agreements, including NDAs, SaaS agreements, MSAs, order forms, DPAs, vendor contracts and partnership agreements.

  • Support negotiation and deal execution with Sales, GTM and other teams, including participating in discussions when appropriate and under lawyer supervision.

  • Help identify legal, privacy, data protection, security and AI-related issues in commercial matters, and bring them to the right lawyer for review.

  • Conduct legal research, prepare issue summaries and help develop practical options for resolving contract questions.

  • Progressively take on more responsibility as your experience and judgment develop, while escalating non-standard or higher-risk issues to qualified counsel.

Build the legal team's capabilities

  • Help create and improve templates, playbooks, legal knowledge resources and tools that allow the wider company to handle routine work more consistently.

  • Use and improve systems that make matter status, contract obligations and key deadlines visible, rather than relying on manual follow-up.

  • Work with the General Counsel, Commercial Counsel and external counsel across a varied commercial workload.

Requirements

Every candidate and employee's success is measured against the same three dimensions: Aptitude, Attitude and Agency.

Aptitude

  • Legal training, such as a law degree, paralegal qualification or equivalent experience.

  • Some experience in a paralegal, legal assistant, commercial contracts or legal operations role is helpful. We're also open to strong early-career candidates.

  • Clear legal writing, research and issue-spotting skills, with an interest in commercial law.

  • Interest or experience in process design, automation, no-code or low-code tools, AI workflows or contract-management systems.

  • Business-standard English is required. Business-standard French is a strong advantage, but not essential.

  • Willingness to travel to the US or Paris from time to time when required.

Attitude

  • Curious and motivated to develop as a commercial legal professional.

  • Organised, careful and discreet when handling confidential information.

  • A clear communicator who is comfortable asking questions, surfacing uncertainty and taking feedback.

  • Collaborative and pragmatic, with a genuine interest in helping colleagues move work forward.

Agency

  • Proactively identifies opportunities to improve how legal work is done, then helps design and build the solution.

  • Takes ownership of process improvements from problem definition through implementation, testing and iteration.

  • Gets directly involved in commercial legal matters and follows them through within the level of responsibility agreed with supervising lawyers.

  • Uses judgment to move work forward while escalating decisions that require qualified legal review.

Location

We're prioritizing building our team with an in-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together.

We have an office-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect.

That said, we hire people with strong judgement and we extend that trust to how they manage their time. When working from home makes more sense for what you need to get done that day, we trust you to make that call.

Why Dust

The models are powerful enough. What's missing is the product layer where AI meets how companies actually work. That's what we're building: the infrastructure that lets any team turn scattered knowledge and tools into coordinated execution with agents they build, own, and run themselves.

We use Dust ourselves every day. We get to shape how humans and agents collaborate while solving our own problems with the product we ship. That loop is rare, and it's why we move fast.

If you're excited about defining a new category and want to join a determined team of optimists who focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously, we'd love to talk.

Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist.

Learn how we think and work.

  • Our product constitution, a story about our mission

  • Your Next Co-Worker Isn’t Human, Stanislas Polu, VivaTech 2026. A conversation about AI agents taking on larger parts of work and how teams collaborate with them.

  • Dust: Gabriel Hubert on Enterprise AI, Gabriel Hubert, Nasdaq, published May 7, 2026. On Dust’s approach to enterprise AI and building the company in Europe.

title: Platform Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Akuna: 

Akuna Capital is an innovative trading firm with a strong focus on collaboration, cutting-edge technology, data driven solutions, and automation. We specialize in providing liquidity as an options market maker – meaning we are committed to providing competitive quotes that we are willing to both buy and sell. To do this successfully, we design and implement our own low latency technologies, trading strategies, and mathematical models. 

Our Founding Partnersfirst conceptualized Akuna in their hometown of Sydney. They opened the firm’s first office in 2011 in the heart of the derivatives industry and the options capital of the world – Chicago. Today, Akuna is proud to operate from additional offices in Sydney, Shanghai, London, and Singapore. 

What you’ll do as a Platform Engineer at Akuna: 

This is an exciting role where you will be given the opportunity to take ownership of projects and make them your own. At Akuna, we are constantly looking for ways to improve our efficiency as we continue to grow. As a Platform Engineer, you will work closely with our Trading, Development, Infrastructure, and Operations teams. You will design and implement cloud solutions, automate infrastructure as code, improve cloud governance and security, and monitor our hybrid-cloud environments. In this role, you will: 

  • Ensure cloud services are leveraged to their full potential (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and best practices are being followed
  • Help manage our public cloud growth and continuously improve Akuna’s hybrid-cloud operating model
  • Evaluate proposed solution architectures and provide recommendations
  • Provision, configure, upgrade, and monitor technologies such as Kubernetes (EKS and on-premise), Spark, Kafka, and other large-scale distributed databases
  • Automate infrastructure management and development pipelines with tools like Terraform, Ansible, Jenkins and GitLab
  • Explore new technologies in the cloud-native/container ecosystem
  • Work with Infrastructure and Development teams to monitor systems, clusters and cloud deployments to detect errors and monitor performance
  • Adhere to the engineering mindset of creating and maintaining performant and reliable production systems

Qualities that make great candidates: 

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
  • 5+ years of experience in Platform Engineering, Cloud Engineering, SRE, DevOps, or related infrastructure roles
  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect certification preferred
  • Deep experience deploying, operating, and scaling Kubernetes in production, including on-premise clusters and Amazon EKS
  • Strong expertise designing and managing cloud infrastructure on AWS; experience with GCP is a plus
  • Advanced proficiency with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code (IaC), including reusable module development, state management, and platform automation
  • Experience building and operating highly available, scalable, and secure cloud-native platforms
  • Strong knowledge of observability, including monitoring, logging, alerting, and operational troubleshooting 
  • Proven experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines and modern software delivery practices
  • Strong Linux systems administration and troubleshooting skills in distributed production environments 
  • Proficiency in automation and scripting with Python, Bash, or similar languages
  • Experience with cloud-native data services, including Amazon RDS, Aurora, Redshift, and DynamoDB
  • Demonstrated ability to lead technical initiatives, influence architectural decisions, and mentor engineers
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with experience partnering across engineering, operations, and business teams
  • The ability to react quickly and accurately to rapidly changing market conditions, including the ability to quickly and accurately respond and/or solve math and coding problems are essential functions of the role

In addition to technical skillsets, Akuna values the unique perspectives people can bring to the table to collaboratively solve complex problems and drive Akuna forward. We want everyone to feel empowered to apply. We welcome your application and encourage you to take the first steps toward your future with us!

Please note that level/title will be determined upon the conclusion of the interview process. If you are a current student or recent graduate, please take a look at our Entry Level and Intern positions.

title: Portfolio Data Operations Analyst (EDI)
descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore.

The Role

Part of the broader Addepar Data Management organisation, the Portfolio Data Operations team is responsible for ensuring Addepar's clients have timely and high quality data. This will include overseeing the processing of transactions and positions so that it meets client timelines, ensuring data quality through verification checks, and helping clients with their data support questions. The Portfolio Data Operations team sits at the nexus of Addepar's activity and requires daily communications with data providers, clients, and other personnel within Data Operations and across the firm. 

Applicants must have, and maintain, the right to work in the United Kingdom from the first day of employment. Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this role.

What You’ll Do

  • Perform daily internal verification checks to ensure portfolio account data is accurate and available within SLAs.
  • Investigate and troubleshoot data pipeline issues and data feed processing exceptions, and triage with Engineering Support when needed.
  • Complete and maintain operational workflows while continuously identifying and implementing opportunities for optimization and automation.
  • Collaborate with Client Support, Solution Architects, and other members of Sales and Services to address client data inquiries and requests.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering to design, test, and implement new processes and tooling features that improve data quality as well as increase operational efficiency.
  • Participate in broad company initiatives to stand up new product offerings and services.

Who You Are 

  • 2+ years of work experience in the financial investment/advisory industry with deep knowledge of capital markets, trade processing and lifecycle, and middle/back-office operations systems.
  • Demonstrates excellent attention to details and a passion for problem solving!
  • Outstanding communication and interpersonal skills for engaging with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Proven track record of multitasking and prioritising effectively in a fast paced environment.
  • Very team-oriented, balanced, and forward thinking.
  • Technical skills preferred in any or all of the following: Microsoft Excel, SQL, Salesforce, Jira, Bloomberg, Thomson Reuters, or other common financial services systems and applications.

Our Values 

  • Act Like an Owner - Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes.
  • Build Together - Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value. 
  • Champion Our Clients - Exceed client expectations. Our clients’ success is our success. 
  • Drive Innovation - Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry. 
  • Embrace Learning - Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset. 

In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

PHISHING SCAM WARNING: Addepar is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving con artists posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote “interviews,” and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. title: Praticienne Spa – Massages & Kobido
descriptionHtml:
Et si prendre soin des autres avait une autre dimension ?

LE SONGE est une maison de bien-être intimiste où chaque soin est pensé sur mesure, selon les besoins, les envies et les émotions du moment.

Plus qu'un spa, nous avons imaginé un véritable cocon chaleureux et raffiné, où l'on prend le temps d'écouter et de proposer une expérience unique.

Pour accompagner le développement de notre maison, nous recherchons une praticienne expérimentée, passionnée et investie, qui partage notre vision du bien-être et souhaite s'impliquer dans une aventure à taille humaine.

Nous souhaitons accueillir une personne qui aime prendre soin des autres et qui a envie de s'investir durablement au sein d'une petite équipe soudée, dans un environnement où la qualité du travail et le bien-être des praticiennes sont aussi importants que l'expérience de nos clientes.

Vos missions

  • Réaliser des massages bien-être et/ou des soins du visage, notamment le Kobido, selon vos spécialités.

  • Accueillir et accompagner chaque cliente avec attention et bienveillance.

  • Adapter votre approche aux besoins et aux attentes de chaque personne.

  • Assurer la préparation des cabines, l'entretien des espaces et le bon déroulement des rendez-vous.

  • Participer à l'accueil, à la gestion des réservations, aux encaissements et au conseil client.

  • Contribuer à l'atmosphère et à l'expérience propres au Songe.

  • Participer à la vie quotidienne de la maison et au bon fonctionnement de l'équipe.

Le profil que nous recherchons

Au-delà de votre parcours, nous recherchons avant tout une personne investie, fiable et bienveillante, qui partage notre vision d'un bien-être authentique et profondément humain.

  • Vous êtes diplômée d'un CAP Esthétique minimum ou disposez d'une expérience en massage bien-être.

  • Vous avez suivi une ou plusieurs formations certifiantes en massage bien-être et/ou Kobido, et/ou justifiez d'une expérience significative dans ces pratiques.

  • Vous justifiez d'une expérience pratique en institut, spa ou établissement de bien-être.

  • Vous êtes autonome dans la réalisation de vos soins, rigoureuse, organisée et attentive aux détails.

  • Vous avez un excellent relationnel, le sens de l'écoute et une présentation soignée.

  • Vous aimez travailler en équipe et vous investir dans un projet à taille humaine.

  • Vous êtes sensible à l'univers du bien-être haut de gamme et aux soins personnalisés.

Les conditions

  • Contrat : CDI à temps partiel – 20 heures par semaine.

  • Disponibilité : le samedi indispensable, complété par des heures en semaine.

  • Planning : jours et horaires en semaine à définir ensemble selon vos disponibilités et les besoins de la maison.

  • Lieu : Paris 15e, métro Boucicaut.

  • Rémunération : selon profil et expérience.

  • Prise de poste : dès que possible.

Pourquoi rejoindre LE SONGE ?

Parce que nous sommes convaincues qu'une praticienne épanouie est aussi une praticienne qui prend mieux soin des autres. Nous avons à cœur de proposer un environnement de travail agréable, respectueux et équilibré.

Vous rejoindrez une maison à taille humaine qui privilégie le savoir-faire, l'écoute et la qualité plutôt que les soins standardisés. Un lieu où chaque détail compte et où l'on prend soin des personnes autant que de leur bien-être.

Rejoindre LE SONGE, c'est notamment bénéficier de :

  • Un temps de transition de 30 minutes entre les soins, pour préparer les cabines et accueillir chaque cliente dans les meilleures conditions.

  • Une attention particulière portée au rythme de travail, avec un nombre de soins par jour et par praticienne adapté, afin de préserver la qualité des prestations et le bien-être de l'équipe.

  • Un cadre de travail soigné, chaleureux et qualitatif.

  • Une salle de repos spacieuse et agréable, pour que chacune puisse profiter de véritables temps de pause.

  • Une perspective d'évolution : LE SONGE est une maison en plein développement, avec de beaux projets pour les années à venir. Nous souhaitons construire une équipe stable et durable. Le poste pourra évoluer progressivement en fonction du développement de l'activité, avec la possibilité d'augmenter le temps de travail, d'élargir vos missions et de prendre davantage de responsabilités à terme.

Vous vous reconnaissez dans cette approche ?

Envoyez-nous votre CV accompagné de quelques lignes pour nous présenter votre expérience, votre parcours, vos spécialités et vos disponibilités.

Nous serons ravies de découvrir votre parcours !

Au plaisir de vous rencontrer et, peut-être, de vous accueillir dans la dream team du Songe !

title: Principal Design Engineer - Mechanical Equipment (80-100%)
descriptionHtml:
Lead technically by doing.

Join our Design Engineering team as a highly experienced individual contributor. You will take on challenging mechanical design problems yourself, from concepts and CAD models to manufacturing drawings, prototypes and tested hardware, while helping the wider team make strong technical decisions.

As a Principal Design Engineer, you are a hands-on member of our Design Engineering team, designing Climeworks’ CO2 collectors, the heart of our direct air capture plant. Improving how they perform, are manufactured and scale is central to the future success of DAC.

  • Mechanical concept & product design: You personally turn new concepts into robust physical products: developing mechanical concepts, creating CAD models, designing components and complete collector assemblies, producing manufacturing drawings, and supporting hardware through fabrication, assembly and testing.

  • Engineering problem-solving & risk reduction: Your experience helps you find the right solutions faster, anticipate problems early and reduce risk before issues reach manufacturing or testing.

  • CO2 collector design: You take mechanical systems from requirements and concepts through to detailed, manufacturable designs. You develop solutions, perform engineering calculations and make the decisions needed to create robust industrial hardware.

  • First-principles engineering: You use experience and first-principles reasoning to identify risks early, evaluate alternatives quickly and converge on simple, robust solutions. You apply calculations, tolerance analysis, design reviews and testing to reduce uncertainty.

  • Own design from concept to commercialisation: You work directly in SolidWorks to create and modify parts, assemblies and system layouts. You manage complex interfaces, packaging constraints and design changes so the complete system works together. You produce and maintain high-quality 2D manufacturing drawings, including appropriate GD&T, tolerances, materials, finishes and manufacturing requirements.

  • Prototype fabrication, assembly & testing: You stay closely involved after the CAD work is complete. You support prototype fabrication, assembly and testing, investigate issues and incorporate the learning back into the design.

  • Technical leadership & design reviews: You act as a senior technical reference for the team, supporting the Design Engineering line manager with design reviews, engineering standards and approval of critical designs. You support the extended team with technical judgement on complex mechanical design decisions, help maintain strong engineering practices and share your experience through everyday collaboration, mentoring and constructive challenge.

  • Cross-functional engineering collaboration: You work with manufacturing, testing, process engineering, procurement, suppliers and other engineering disciplines to ensure mechanical designs work as part of the complete product. You integrate external design resources where needed.


What makes you stand out

Your experience makes your engineering more effective: you spot promising solutions early, expose weak points before they become expensive, and deliver designs that are clear, manufacturable and ready to perform in the real world.

  • Mechanical Design Experience: You bring 15+ years of hands-on mechanical design experience, ideally developing complex industrial equipment from concept through manufacture, assembly and testing.

  • Sheet Metal Design & Manufacturing: You have deep practical experience designing sheet-metal parts, structures and assemblies for manufacture at scale. You understand bending, welding and joining methods, forming, tolerances, material and thickness selection, and how design choices affect tooling, cost, assembly and quality.

  • CAD & Drawings: You are an expert SolidWorks user and remain hands-on with CAD. You personally create high-quality manufacturing drawings and are confident with GD&T and tolerance chains.

  • System Design & Engineering Judgement: You have experience designing from components and mechanisms through subsystems, interfaces and complex assemblies. You understand how decisions at one level affect the complete collector and can balance structures, airflow, movement, sealing, process interfaces, manufacturability, reliability and cost to arrive at robust solutions.

  • Manufacturing & DFMA: You have strong knowledge of machined parts, welded structures, materials and manufacturing processes, and apply DFMA to create robust, cost-effective designs.

  • Collaboration & Technical Leadership: You work effectively with engineers, technicians, manufacturers and suppliers. You share your experience, challenge constructively and help others make better technical decisions.

  • Education: You have a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or similar.

    This job is not for you, if…

    • you mainly want to manage people or projects.

    • you mainly do simulation, concept work or system-level engineering without your own CAD work.

    • you have no experience with sheet metal, welded structures or manufacturing at scale.

Our promise: At Climeworks, you are accepted for who you are, and we are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued. We encourage all qualified applicants to apply – regardless of background, identity, or experience. Studies show that women and individuals from minority backgrounds often only apply for jobs when they meet 100% of the listed criteria. If this sounds like you, don’t hold back. If you think you’d make a great fit for this role, we’d love to hear from you, even if you don’t check every single box. Let’s tackle one of humankind’s greatest challenges together.

What we offer:

  • Time Off: Enjoy 25 paid vacation days every year, plus public holidays.

  • Flexibility: Work how it suits you best. We offer a hybrid work setup and up to 4 weeks of remote work annually within any EU country.

  • Ownership: Fair base pay paired with an equity package – because your contributions matter.

  • Family Support: Inclusive parental leave.

  • Continuous Learning: Dedicated budget to invest in your professional growth.

  • Referral Rewards: Help us grow our team and earn bonuses for your successful referrals.

Salary: At Climeworks, salary ranges are assigned to a job based on the level of seniority and the location specific market median of similar jobs according to external benchmark surveys. Individual compensation depends on your skills, experience, and the value you bring to the team.

Formalities:

  • This position is based in Opfikon, Zurich, and we ask that you work onsite at least three days per week.

  • The percentage in the job title means flexibility – choose full-time or part-time based on what works for you.

  • We do not accept candidate profiles through recruitment agencies.

title: Principal Software Engineer - Vector Search - Elasticsearch
descriptionHtml:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What is the role

We're looking for a Principal Software Engineer to join the Elasticsearch - Search team. This globally-distributed team of expert engineers focuses on delivering a robust and feature-rich search experience, including contributing to improving the search experience in Lucene. This is a principal software engineering role that focuses on enhancing the vector similarity search functionality within Elasticsearch, covering the design and implementation of new vector search features, enhancements to existing vector search functionality, and resolving bugs.

Our company is distributed by intention. We hire the best engineers we can find wherever they are, whoever they are. We collaborate across continents every day over email, GitHub, Zoom, and Slack. At our best, we write fast, scalable and intuitive software. We believe that the best way to do that is to empower individual engineers, code review every change, decide big things by consensus, and strive for incremental improvements.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Lead initiatives within Elasticsearch to produce an industry-leading vector database offering, supplying unparalleled speed and relevance in search.
  • Contribute to Elasticsearch full time, building new search features and fixing intriguing bugs, all while making the code easier to understand. Sometimes you'll need to invent a new algorithm or data structure. Or find one and implement it. Sometimes you'll need to get close to the operating system and hardware.
  • Work with a globally distributed team of experienced engineers focused on the vector search capabilities of Elasticsearch.
  • Be an expert on how Elasticsearch implements vector similarity in support of search relevance and everyone will turn to you when they have a question about this area. You'll improve this area based on your questions and your instincts.
  • Work with community members from all over the world on issues and pull requests, sometimes triaging them and handing them off to other experts and sometimes handling them yourself.
  • Write idiomatic modern Java -- Elasticsearch is 99.8% Java!

What You Bring Along

  • You have implemented novel techniques in vector similarity on a search platform with a large user base or progressed the field of academic research in vector similarity information retrieval.
  • Professional experience with vector similarity and vector databases, and you used HNSW, IVF, or other relevant algorithms and libraries on search platforms at scale.
  • You have strong skills in core Java and are conversant in the standard library of data structures and concurrency constructs, as well as other features like lambdas.
  • You work with a high level of autonomy, and are able to take on projects and guide them from beginning to end. This covers both technical design and working with other engineers to develop needed components.
  • You're comfortable developing collaboratively. Giving and receiving feedback on code and approaches and APIs is hard! Bonus points if you've collaborated over the internet because that's harder. Double bonus points for asynchronous collaboration over the internet. That's even harder, but we do it anyway because it's the best way we know how to build software.
  • You've used several data storage technologies like Elasticsearch, Solr, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, or Cassandra and have some idea how they work and why they work that way.
  • You have excellent verbal and written communication skills. Like we said, collaborating on the internet is hard. We try to be respectful, empathetic, and trusting in all of our interactions. And we'd expect that from you too.

title: Procurement Specialist
descriptionHtml:
At Oxa, we're building the future of Industrial Mobile Autonomy (IMA) and are in the market for new talent.

Oxa’s customers are the operators of some of the world's largest industrial facilities. Our technology transforms existing industrial vehicles into intelligent autonomous fleets, unlocking new levels of productivity, safety, and performance.

 

‘The phone in your hand, the coffee on your desk, the shirt on your back - they all moved through a web of ports (air and sea), distribution yards and manufacturing hubs. This is the invisible circulatory system of global trade, and it relies entirely on a relentless, repetitive shuffle of goods. Towing.

This towing task happens in complex, commerce-critical industrial environments. Here, having self driving technology “do the driving” delivers immediate, measurable impact. IMA will revolutionise the movement of goods across the world's ports, airports, and yards.

You can be part of that as an Oxbot’

‘Paul Newman - Founder and CEO’

 

Our Products:

Our products are built on four core technology pillars which come together to build a complete system:

Oxa Ware – Our modular autonomy hardware systems for consistent and repeatable integration of autonomy with existing vehicles.

Oxa Driver – Our Physical AI, embodied in Oxa Ware, self-driving software that enables vehicles to perceive, reason, and drive autonomously in complex real-world environments.

Oxa Foundry – Our development toolchain that leverages generative AI to continuously train and assure Oxa Driver, synthesising situations and sensor data.

Oxa Hub – Our suite of cloud services for monitoring, managing and orchestrating fleets driven by Oxa Driver, including an API for integration with existing logistics systems.

 

Behind these technologies is our exceptional team, the Oxbots. We are home to some of the world's leading experts in autonomous systems, robotics, machine learning, artificial intelligence, cloud infrastructure, and distributed software engineering. Together, we're solving some of the hardest technical challenges in autonomy, turning the research and development we do into production and deploying it into environments. Making robots do useful work.

 

Your Team:

Oxa’s procurement team ensures the organisation acquires goods and services that meet quality, cost and timing requirements while complying with legal, ethical and financial standards.

 

Your Responsibilities:

  • Assisting with the purchasing of materials and services required by Oxa’s operations and scaling customer programs globally, with an initial focus on indirect procurement.

  • Placing orders using our systems, track and receive them and support invoice processing and payment reconciliation.

Requirements:

  • Recent, relevant experience within a procurement role.

  • Strong and proven negotiating skills.

  • An understanding of a scale-up environment and of a manufacturing/engineering/automotive/tech environment.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, including stakeholder-management skills and a demonstrated ability to interact effectively with suppliers, management, and peers.

  • A detail-oriented and organised approach that delivers consistently high-quality services to deadlines within a fast-paced environment.

  • Ability to prioritise workload.

  • Analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Ability to work effectively on own initiative within a team as well as to contribute constructively.

  • High proficiency in Excel and databases.

  • Strong numeracy skills.

  • A change-positive attitude.

Extra kudos if you have:

  • Sourcing experience.

  • Experience with Xero, MANU, ZIP.

Your Interview Experience:

Our interview process is designed to give you every chance to get the measure of us, and us of you. You will join three stages which will give you every opportunity to show your strengths and qualities, via scenario based questions and technical exercises.

title: Product Manager (m/w/d) – B2C-Plattform & AI
descriptionHtml:
München (Hybrid) · Vollzeit

Du willst ein Produkt bauen, das spürbaren Impact hat. Ein Produkt, das Menschen eine neue Perspektive gibt und sie auf ihrem beruflichen Weg unterstützt? Du denkst unternehmerisch, hast ein Gespür für großartige digitale Produkte und willst mit KI etwas Neues schaffen? Dann sollten wir uns kennenlernen.

Die Arbeitswelt verändert sich tiefgreifend. Für viele Menschen wächst damit die Unsicherheit: Wird mein Beruf morgen noch gebraucht? Welche Fähigkeiten werden wichtig? Und wie finde ich meinen Platz? Weiterbildung ist ein Schlüssel, damit Menschen diesen Wandel mitgestalten können und neue Perspektiven gewinnen.

Mit GenauMeinKurs wollen wir ihnen dabei als verlässlicher Partner zur Seite stehen. Wir wollen Orientierung geben, alle verfügbaren Informationen verständlich zusammenführen und Menschen helfen, den bestmöglichen nächsten Schritt ihrer beruflichen Entwicklung zu finden.

Über uns

Wir sind Edtelligent, ein Tech-Unternehmen aus München mit rund 20 Mitarbeitenden. Wir arbeiten remote first, sind gebootstrappt und profitabel. Unser Gründerteam hat bereits mehrere erfolgreiche Unternehmen aufgebaut und skaliert.

Wir haben bereits eine Software für den Weiterbildungsmarkt entwickelt, die von über 100 Bildungsanbietern genutzt wird, um ihre Kurse zu verwalten. Dadurch bringen wir eine umfangreiche Datenbasis und ein tiefes Verständnis des Weiterbildungsmarktes mit.

Jetzt wollen wir diese Expertise nutzen, um mit GenauMeinKurs eine Plattform für Weiterbildung zu bauen, die den Endnutzer im Fokus hat. Wir entwickeln einen digitalen Begleiter, der Menschen von der ersten Orientierung bis zur passenden Entscheidung unterstützt.

GenauMeinKurs ist ein zweiseitiger Marktplatz: Für Nutzer ist die Plattform kostenlos, Bildungsanbieter zahlen für qualifizierte Anfragen. Beides zusammenzubringen ist ein zentraler Teil deines Jobs. Du entwickelst ein Produkt, dem Menschen vertrauen, weil es ihnen bei ihrer Entscheidung hilft, und das gleichzeitig für Bildungsanbieter so wertvoll ist, dass ein tragfähiges Geschäft entsteht.

Aufgaben

GenauMeinKurs ist seit Herbst 2026 live. Auf der Plattform findest du bereits mehrere tausend Kurse, und jeden Monat nutzen sie mehrere tausend Menschen. Wir stehen noch am Anfang – und du kannst entscheidend mitprägen, wohin sich das Produkt entwickelt.

Gemeinsam mit 2 erfahrenen Entwicklern und unserem Co-Founder und CTPO Stefan entwickelst Du GenauMeinKurs zu einem vertrauenswürdigen Begleiter für den nächsten beruflichen Schritt. Du findest heraus, wo Menschen bei der Suche unsicher werden, welche Informationen ihnen fehlen und was ihnen hilft, eine gute Entscheidung zu treffen.

Konkret bedeutet das:

  • Du bist die Stimme der Nutzer im Unternehmen. Du sprichst mit ihnen, wertest Feedback und Nutzungsdaten aus und vertrittst ihre Interessen bei Produktentscheidungen.

  • Du weißt, was Bildungsanbieter von uns brauchen und wie GenauMeinKurs Geld verdient. Du triffst Produktentscheidungen, die für Nutzer und für das Geschäft funktionieren.

  • Du gibst der Produktentwicklung Fokus. Du erkennst was wirklich zählt, setzt klare Prioritäten und entwickelst unsere Produktvision und Roadmap weiter.

  • Du suchst die besten Lösungen – auch außerhalb unserer Branche. Du untersuchst, wie führende digitale Produkte Orientierung geben, Entscheidungen erleichtern und komplexe Suchen einfach machen. Relevante Erkenntnisse übersetzt du in eigene Ideen für GenauMeinKurs.

  • Du denkst AI first. Du nutzt KI selbstverständlich, um Nutzerprobleme zu analysieren, Ideen zu prüfen und produktiver zu arbeiten. Gleichzeitig entwickelst du mit uns, wie KI Suche, Matching und persönliche Begleitung grundlegend verbessern kann.

  • Du baust selbst mit. Mit KI entwickelst du funktionsfähige Prototypen und setzt erste Produktverbesserungen selbst in Code um. Du testest deine Lösungen und bereitest deine Codebeiträge so vor, dass unsere Entwickler sie reviewen, weiterentwickeln und in das Produkt übernehmen können.

Qualifikation

Du passt gut zu uns, wenn du:

  • bereits Erfahrung bei der Entwicklung eines digitalen Produktes hast;

  • Verantwortung in einem kleinen Team übernehmen möchtest und die Energie mitbringst, Dinge voranzutreiben;

  • einen hohen Anspruch an Produktqualität hast und dich mit unserer Mission identifizierst;

  • Nutzerprobleme verstehen willst, bevor du Lösungen entwirfst;

  • aus vielen Möglichkeiten das Wesentliche herausfilterst und einem Team Orientierung gibst;

  • KI bereits praktisch in deinem Arbeitsalltag nutzt und Lust hast, damit auch selbst Software zu entwickeln – von ersten Prototypen bis zu Codebeiträgen, die du gemeinsam mit unserem Entwicklungsteam zur Umsetzung bringst;

  • fließend Deutsch sprichst

Erfahrung im Weiterbildungsmarkt ist willkommen, aber keine Voraussetzung. Entscheidend ist, dass du Lust hast, ihn in der Tiefe zu verstehen.

Benefits

  • 🏡 Flexible Arbeitszeiten, 30 Tage Urlaub und die Wahl zwischen unserem Büro in München-Giesing und flexibel bis zu 3 Tagen Homeoffice pro Woche.

  • 🚀 Viel Gestaltungsspielraum und Verantwortung vom ersten Tag an – bei einem Produkt, das du sichtbar mitprägen kannst.

  • 💡 Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit unserem Gründerteam sowie mit Tech, Growth, Sales und Customer Success.

  • 🤖 KI als fester Bestandteil unserer Arbeit und Raum, neue Möglichkeiten im Produkt praktisch zu erproben.

  • 🧪 Die Freiheit, Ideen schnell zu testen, aus Nutzerfeedback und Daten zu lernen und erfolgreiche Ansätze weiterzuentwickeln.

  • 📈 Eine Rolle, mit der du wachsen kannst, während wir GenauMeinKurs weiter aufbauen.

  • 🛠️ Ein modernes Toolset mit Google Workspace, Slack, Claude, HubSpot und weiteren Tools.

  • ☕ Modernes Büro, mit kostenlosen Snacks, Siebträgermaschine und hochwertiger Ausstattung

  • 🧘 Subventionierte Wellpass Mitgliedschaft mit unlimitierten Zugang zu über 16.000 Sport- und Wellnesspartnern.

title: Program Manager - Field CTOs - EMEA
descriptionHtml:
We are an applied AI lab building end-to-end software agents.

We're the makers of Devin, the first AI software engineer.

Our team is extremely talent-dense. Among our founding team, we have world-class competitive programmers, former founders, and leaders from companies at the cutting edge of AI including Scale AI, Palantir, Cursor, Waymo, Tesla, Lunchclub, Modal, Google DeepMind, and Nuro.

Building Devin is just the first step—our hardest challenges still lie ahead. If you’re excited to solve some of the world’s biggest problems and build AI that can reason on real-world tasks, apply to join us.

Cognition is the company behind Devin, the AI software engineer. We’re hiring an Executive Engagement Program Manager to coordinate how our executives, Field CTOs and Managing Directors participate in our global executive programs.

You’ll start with a plan for each leader: their expertise, priority audiences and relationships, key forums and available time. You’ll turn those plans into a coordinated calendar across summits, customer advisory boards, executive sponsorship, briefings, dinners and major industry gatherings.

A strong working partnership with Sales is essential. You’ll need to understand account priorities, ask the right questions about requests and make sound recommendations about where executive involvement will be most valuable. You’ll balance those needs with our program goals and executive capacity, communicating tradeoffs clearly and pushing back constructively when needed.

This role sits within Executive Engagement and works closely with program owners, executive assistants, regional marketing, Events and Communications. You’ll bring structure and continuity to the portfolio so our leaders spend their time thoughtfully and each customer interaction builds on the last.

What you’ll do

  • Build executive engagement plans. Understand each leader’s priorities, expertise, existing relationships and capacity, then maintain a proactive plan for their participation.

  • Partner with Sales on priorities. Build trust with sales leaders and account teams. Understand which senior relationships matter, the customer’s priorities and why a particular executive or program would be valuable.

  • Manage and prioritize requests. Establish a clear intake process that captures the audience, purpose, relationship context, timing and expected value of each request. Assess requests against agreed priorities, executive fit and capacity.

  • Exercise judgment and communicate tradeoffs. Recommend what to accept, defer, redirect or decline. Offer alternatives where appropriate and route assignment decisions and escalations to the right owner.

  • Coordinate the global calendar. Align executive hosts, audiences, preparation deadlines and commitments across programs. Identify conflicts and gaps early.

  • Maintain continuity. Keep a shared record of participation, feedback and commitments. Ensure follow-up has a named owner and carries through between programs.

  • Keep the team aligned. Run planning meetings, surface decisions and report on participation, capacity and program feedback.

What you bring

  • Experience managing executive programs, executive briefings, customer advisory boards or similar programs in an enterprise environment.

  • A demonstrated ability to partner with sales, understand account priorities and translate requests into well-defined executive engagements.

  • Strong prioritization skills. You can distinguish an urgent request from a strategically important one, assess competing needs and explain your recommendations.

  • Confidence asking sales leaders and account teams for context, challenging assumptions and pushing back constructively.

  • Experience working with senior executives and their assistants, with sound judgment about how to use limited executive time.

  • Clear, concise writing and experience preparing executive briefing materials.

  • Strong organizational skills, discretion and attention to detail.

  • The ability to build practical processes and personally manage the details required to make them work.

Our Commitment

title: Programme Director
descriptionHtml:
About WPP Production

We are WPP Production - the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation. We combine world-class human craft with next generation technology to originate, design, and deliver multi-channel content systems at scale. Built for borderless collaboration and powered by deep craft expertise, we are the production engine designed for today's always on, AI driven marketing world.

About WPP

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.

A Hybrid working model

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

The role

HEX brings together creative talent, emerging technology and industry-leading partners to turn innovation into scalable solutions for our clients.

We’re looking for a Programme Director to lead the end-to-end delivery of a complex, high-profile programme at the intersection of creative production, AI and emerging technology.

You will translate strategic objectives into an integrated delivery plan, bring multiple workstreams together and ensure the programme delivers against its commitments. You’ll take ownership of programme governance, dependencies, risks and decisions, providing the clarity and control needed to navigate complexity and maintain momentum.

Working across senior leadership, technology partners, clients and multidisciplinary delivery teams, you’ll connect the bigger picture with the detail of execution, ensuring everyone is aligned on what needs to happen, when and why.

What you’ll do

Lead the programme

  • Own the integrated programme plan, translating objectives into clear workstreams, milestones, deliverables and success measures.
  • Establish effective governance, clear accountability and a consistent approach to programme reporting and decision-making.
  • Maintain oversight of the critical path, dependencies and delivery commitments, ensuring activity across workstreams comes together to achieve the overall programme objectives.
  • Provide a clear view of programme health, progress and emerging issues, giving leadership the information needed to make timely, informed decisions.

Drive delivery

  • Lead delivery across multiple workstreams, aligning teams on priorities, milestones and interdependencies.
  • Anticipate risks, resolve blockers and drive action on issues before they impact delivery.
  • Manage changes to scope, timelines and deliverables, assessing their implications and ensuring trade-offs are agreed and understood.
  • Challenge assumptions, address competing priorities and keep teams focused on the outcomes that matter most.
  • Hold workstream leads accountable for commitments, following through on actions and intervening where delivery is at risk.

Align clients and stakeholders

  • Build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders across WPP, technology partners and client organisations.
  • Create alignment across teams with different priorities, ensuring clear ownership, timely decisions and a shared understanding of programme objectives.
  • Lead programme reviews and executive reporting, communicating progress, risks, decisions and required actions with clarity.
  • Act as the central point of coordination for programme delivery, connecting stakeholders and ensuring commitments translate into action.

Deliver measurable outcomes

  • Maintain oversight of performance against programme objectives, milestones, budgets and agreed commercial commitments, working with the relevant commercial and finance leads.
  • Define and track success measures that demonstrate client adoption, business impact and value delivered.
  • Identify emerging delivery or commercial risks, making their implications visible and driving appropriate action.
  • Use performance data and programme insight to inform decisions, address underperformance and improve outcomes throughout the programme lifecycle.

What you’ll bring

  • Significant experience leading complex programmes involving multiple workstreams, interdependent deliverables and senior stakeholders.
  • A proven track record of translating strategic objectives into executable plans and delivering against challenging commitments.
  • Strong programme management expertise across integrated planning, governance, critical path management, risk, dependencies and change control.
  • The judgement to anticipate problems, navigate ambiguity and make effective decisions when priorities or delivery conditions change.
  • The confidence to challenge constructively, influence senior stakeholders and hold teams accountable across matrixed organisations.
  • Strong commercial awareness, including an understanding of budgets, forecasts and performance against agreed commitments.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to turn complex information into clear decisions, recommendations and executive-level reporting.
  • A proactive, collaborative approach, combining attention to detail with a clear focus on overall programme objectives.

Experience in creative production, digital transformation, AI-enabled programmes or technology partnerships would be advantageous.

title: Project Manager
descriptionHtml:
We are seeking an energetic, adaptable Project Manager to lead end-to-end client implementations and rollouts. Though the position is remote we are looking for candidates who will cover the Kent or Scotland regions for customer visits and deployments.

In a fast-growing scale-up, project management isn't just about updating spreadsheets—it's about driving delivery pace, mitigating real-world risks, aligning cross-functional teams, and making sure our technology delivers immediate, tangible value in live operational environments.

At Tended, we create first-of-a-kind safety systems that use some of the most advanced technologies on the market to transform rail worker safety. Our flagship geofencing solution has been named as one of TIME’s Best Inventions and has made it onto the Digital Leaders 100 list for Geospatial Initiative of the Year.

We’re a venture-backed scale-up with an incredible team and work alongside industry-leading organisations in the rail sector to innovate and bring rail workers home safe every day. Tended is growing quickly and we're now recruiting for Project Managers to support our technology deployments on client sites around the UK.

Tasks

Key Responsibilities

  • Project Planning & Governance: Build and maintain detailed project plans, critical path timelines, and resource schedules using project management software (e.g., MS Project, Jira).

  • Risk & Scope Management: Continuously track risks, manage dependencies, resolve delivery blockers, and maintain scope control across parallel client deployments.

  • On-the-Ground Rollouts: Take charge of live implementations. You're comfortable being on-site in operational settings (such as depots, hubs, or shift-based operations) to support deployments—including occasional weekend, bank holiday, or overnight shifts when rollouts go live.

  • Client Reporting & Value Insights: Measure deployment progress and operational outcomes. Write clear, structured reports that demonstrate project performance, ROI, and key insights to client stakeholders

Requirements

About You

  • Proven PM Experience: Track record managing complex technical projects, deployments, or system rollouts end-to-end.

  • Strong Leadership & Communication: Exceptional stakeholder management skills -able to speak the language of engineers, enterprise leads, and frontline operations.

Desirable Qualifications & Experience

  • Domain Expertise: Prior project experience in the rail, transport, logistics, or infrastructure sectors is a major advantage.

  • Academic Background: Degree or professional qualifications in Project Management (e.g., PRINCE2, PMP, APM), Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.

  • Commercial Acumen: Understanding of how project outcomes tie into client retention, expansion, and long-term account value.

title: Projektmanager E-Commerce (m/w/d)

Als Projektmanager stellst du sicher, dass Kampagnen schnell, sauber und effizient umgesetzt werden – ohne Reibungsverluste.

title: Propulsion Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Propulsion Engineer - Solid Rocket Motors

We are looking for a Propulsion Engineer to support the design, development, manufacture, testing, and qualification of the solid rocket motors used on our orbital launch vehicle. This is a hands-on role covering the full motor development cycle, from preliminary design through static-fire testing and flight qualification.

 

You will work as part of the project team delivering an orbital-class launch vehicle, contributing to the development of propulsion hardware, engineering analysis, test campaigns, and the tools required to support motor and vehicle-level design.

 

About us

We’re a Germany-based rocketry startup currently in stealth mode, scaling up rapidly to meet the demand for high-performance, reliable, and scalable solid propulsion technologies for space and defense applications.

 

We are already launching suborbital and ballistic rockets on a regular basis, generating significant revenue and applying our knowledge toward the development of an orbital rocket.

 

We are working hard to build something truly spectacular.

 

To thrive here you will need to be comfortable working at pace, with the autonomy to make decisions and execute on them quickly. If you’re excited by hard technical challenges and want a role where you will make a real difference each day to the future of the company, we may be the place for you.

 

Key responsibilities

  • Contribute to the design and development of solid rocket motors from preliminary design through detailed design, manufacturing readiness, static-fire testing, and flight qualification.

  • Perform engineering analysis covering relevant aspects of internal ballistics, grain geometry, motor performance, nozzle design, motor cases, and structural sizing.

  • Develop or extend Python-based analysis and simulation tools for ballistic simulation, performance prediction, structural sizing, and related design activities.

  • Translate vehicle-level performance requirements—including total impulse, burn time, thrust profile, and mass fraction—into motor-level design specifications.

  • Feed measured motor performance data back into vehicle-level design and sizing tools.

  • Support the definition and execution of verification and validation activities, including analysis, subscale and component testing, static-fire testing, and flight qualification.

  • Support the planning and execution of static-fire test campaigns, including instrumentation requirements, test preparation, and post-test data analysis.

  • Prepare technical documentation, design reviews, test plans, analysis reports, and clear records of design assumptions and results.

  • Work closely with structures, manufacturing, chemistry, systems, and vehicle engineering teams to manage interfaces and cross-disciplinary design impacts.

  • Contribute to the development of engineering methods, tools, and processes as the propulsion team and company scale.

 

What we are looking for

  • A Bachelor's or Master's degree in aerospace engineering, mechanical engineering, or a related discipline.

  • Experience or demonstrated academic/project experience in solid rocket motor design, propulsion, aerospace hardware, experimental engineering, or a closely related field.

  • An understanding of several propulsion disciplines, including internal ballistics, grain design, nozzle design, motor case design, or propulsion performance.

  • A strong foundation in thermodynamics and internal ballistics, including combustion, propellant energetics, and burn-rate behaviour.

  • Working knowledge of nozzle flow theory and thrust coefficient behaviour, including off-design and altitude effects.

  • Working knowledge of pressure-vessel and composite structural design principles.

  • Proficiency in Python or a similar programming language for developing and maintaining engineering analysis tools.

  • An understanding of verification and validation approaches for propulsion hardware.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work from first principles when established methods or tools do not exist.

  • The ability to work independently, take responsibility for assigned technical work, and contribute effectively within a small, fast-moving team.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document design assumptions, analysis, and results clearly for a cross-disciplinary team.

 

Desirable experience

  • Direct experience designing, manufacturing, assembling, or testing solid rocket motors.

  • Experience with composite filament-winding process design or qualification.

  • Experience supporting or executing static-fire test campaigns.

  • Experience analysing pressure, force, temperature, or other propulsion test instrumentation data.

  • Propellant formulation or strand-burner testing experience.

  • Experience with explosives licensing, range safety, or similar regulatory processes for propellant systems.

  • Experience at an early-stage aerospace company or in a similar environment.

  • Familiarity with vehicle-level launch-vehicle design, including staging, mass budgeting, performance sizing, or trajectory analysis.

Benefits and important information:

  • We offer top-decile compensation packages, bonuses and meaningful equity, to attract exceptional aerospace talent.

  • Every employee is awarded stock options in the company, you will directly benefit from your own hard work and success.

  • Comprehensive relocation support including flights, shipping and visas.

  • Lunch, dinner and drinks provided everyday

  • Free access to shared company housing

Please note, we are a fast paced, hyper-scaling startup. You will need to be comfortable working extended hours with high levels of autonomy, ownership, and flexibility, with contracts structured around a 48-hour working week.

We are committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, has equal access to opportunity, and can thrive. We welcome different perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences—and believe our differences make us stronger.

Please submit applications in English

title: QA Engineer (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
adjoe builds the technologies behind mobile apps growth and monetization. With our core product Playtime Arcade, we've become the global leader in rewarded advertising, an ad unit built on a simple premise: users earn real in-app rewards for engaging with new apps. Transforming 50M+ daily events into real-time actionable dashboard insights

We build the campaign management APIs, analytics engines, and high-throughput tools that allow advertisers and publishers to configure, monitor, and optimize their activity on our platform.

🌎 We welcome applications from talent worldwide and provide relocation support to Hamburg, Germany for those ready to join our team.

What’s in It for You?

At adjoe, you’re not here to just close JIRA tickets, you’re helping build the infrastructure behind one of the most impactful platforms in adtech. The systems you work on will reach hundreds of millions of users and power billions of decisions every day.

title: Quality Inspector
descriptionHtml:
Help Build Europe's Hypersonic Capability At Hypersonica, we’re redefining what’s possible in European defence technology. We exist to deliver speed, resilience, and technological independence at a pace that sets a new standard. We are a small, elite team working on problems that matter, and solving them fast. By joining Hypersonica, you’re not stepping into a predefined role. You’re joining a talent dense environment where every individual shapes the direction of the company. Our philosophy is to hire a small number of exceptional people with broad, deep technical capability, strong judgement, and the ability to operate autonomously. We hire for talent, not rigid boxes. This role represents a business need, but the way it evolves will be shaped by the individual. If you’ve achieved what others said was impossible, or you bring a unique combination of skills that doesn’t fit a traditional mould, we want to hear from you. The work you do here directly contributes to Europe’s technological independence.

Be the final safeguard between production and launch

What this really means is that we are looking for a quality inspector to be the last line of defense in ensuring that our raw materials, components, and assets meet the industry-established safety, regulatory and compliance standards, whilst being conscious of fast-moving business priorities.


What You'll Do:
The Quality Inspector is charged with verifying mission-critical components, sub-assemblies and systems meet strict regulatory standards such as AS9100.
  • You will perform final inspections against engineering drawings, CAD models and Inspections and Test Plans (ITPs) and compile First Article Inspection Reports whilst following AS9102 standards
  • You will manually verify tolerances using tools such as micrometres or via advanced testing equipment such as 3D optical scanners.
  • You will maintain an unbroken audit trail by verifying all supplier Certificates of Conformity, test reports and batch records
  • You will be responsible for maintaining calibration logs for inspection tooling as well as supporting internal/customer audits

    • Who You Are:
  • 3-6 years experience working within quality assurance at inspector level, with a Degree, apprenticeship or equivalent experience in supply chain, business, engineering, manufacturing or operations.
  • You possess proven hands-on experience across precision manufacturing, CNC machining, sheet metal fabrication, electronics assembly within a highly regulated industry
  • You possess a working knowledge of industry quality and security standards such as AS9100 for manufacturing, AS9110 for maintenance or AS9120 for distribution
  • You will have experience with and the ability to read complex engineering drawings, Bills of Materials (BOMs) and 3D CAD models. Experience working with manual verification tools such as micrometres, digital callipers and advanced measurements tools will be beneficial
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, ERP systems such as SAP is advantageous
  • High attention to detail with the ability to hold firm against safety-critical standards amid production pressure and time constraints with the ability to communicate clearly and often
  • Fluency in written and spoken English. Proficiency in additional languages may be beneficial.

    • What We Offer:

  • A mission-driven environment with the opportunity to work on one of Europe’s most consequential defence challenges, with direct impact on sovereign capability and security.

  • Daily collaboration with leading experts across engineering, operations, business development, and defence, with genuine opportunities to learn, contribute, and grow.

  • Exposure to the full lifecycle of complex defence programmes, from customer requirements and commercial strategy through to engineering delivery and flight testing.

  • High ownership and autonomy: no time tracking and no micromanagement, just clear objectives and accountability for outcomes.

  • A fast-paced environment where good ideas are implemented quickly and feedback from testing and flight drives real decisions.

  • A culture that values clarity, integrity, and excellence, and supports people who take initiative and push boundaries responsibly.

  • Competitive compensation and real share options aligned with responsibility and impact, not tenure or hierarchy.

    • At Hypersonica, every hire raises the bar. We are deliberately small, intensely capable, and deeply mission-driven. If this role feels like a strong fit, or if you believe you bring something exceptional that goes beyond the description, we encourage you to apply. Hypersonica is an equal-opportunity employer and assesses candidates solely on merit, capability, and potential. You can apply directly to this role or reach out to Nathan Sweeney, Head of Talent. We review every application and aim to respond to all candidates within two weeks, whether the answer is yes or no.

title: Quantum Dot Process & Characterisation Engineer- Post-Growth Processing (Master)
descriptionHtml:
Quandela stands as a global leader in quantum computing, driven by groundbreaking technology and a strategic vision for scaling quantum solutions. The company’s unique ability to offer both hardware and software solutions, along with its commitment to build energy efficient datacenters and scalability, positions it to play a key role in the next wave of innovation, and in many strategic and sovereign industrial sectors.

Join Us at the Forefront of Quantum Computing Innovation 🚀

Role overview

We are looking for a Process & Characterisation Engineer to prepare and validate GaAs/AlGaAs samples containing InAs quantum dots (QDs) through the first steps of our single-photon source fabrication flow.

The role combines hands-on cleanroom processing – chemical treatment, PECVD deposition and high-temperature annealing – with optical characterisation of the QDs before and after each step. The data you produce decides whether a sample is ready to move forward, and how the process recipes should be adjusted.

You will start by running an established, well-documented procedure with rigour and consistency. As you build expertise, the role is designed to grow: within your first year, you will contribute to optimising the process, automating the measurement setups and taking ownership of sample validation for these steps, working closely with both the Production and R&D teams.

Sample preparation & processing (from day one)

  • Run the established step-by-step procedure for preparing GaAs/AlGaAs samples with InAs quantum dots.
  • Carry out the cleanroom fabrication steps: chemical surface treatment, PECVD deposition and high-temperature annealing.
  • Follow recipes and operating procedures precisely, and flag any deviation, drift or anomaly as soon as it appears.
  • Contribute to a safe, disciplined and efficient cleanroom environment.

Optical characterisation & validation

  • Measure QD optical properties before and after processing, using photoluminescence and white-field imaging, including at cryogenic temperature.
  • Compare pre- and post-processing results against acceptance criteria to decide whether each sample can be released to the next fabrication steps.
  • Adjust process recipes based on measurement results, within defined process windows.

Data, reporting & traceability

  • Analyse measurement data using Python and report results clearly and regularly to the Production and R&D teams.
  • Maintain the sample database so that every sample’s processing history and measurements are fully traceable.
  • Keep process documentation and procedures up to date.

Growing your scope (within the first year)

  • Contribute to the automation and optimisation of the optical measurement setups and data-acquisition pipeline.
  • Propose, design and test improvements to the fabrication steps, using experimental data and the scientific literature.
  • Take ownership of sample validation for these steps, including defining checks and acceptance criteria.
  • Contribute to the development and qualification of new or additional process steps, together with the R&D team.

Requirements

Required qualifications & experience

  • Master’s degree (Bac+5) in Materials Science, Semiconductor Physics, Optics, Micro/Nanofabrication or a related field.
  • Solid foundations in semiconductor physics, particularly III-V materials.
  • Solid foundations in optics and in semiconductor fabrication processes.
  • Fluency in Python for data analysis.
  • Excellent attention to detail and a rigorous approach to experimental work.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to investigate technical problems using experimental data and scientific literature.
  • Clear documentation and communication skills.
  • Fluent English, both written and spoken.

Preferred qualifications

  • Hands-on cleanroom experience, ideally in III-V device fabrication: wet and dry etching, PECVD deposition, thermal processing.
  • Hands-on experience with optical characterisation, including building and aligning optical setups (photoluminescence, white-field imaging).
  • Experience with cryogenic measurements (e.g. 40 K Stirling cryostat).
  • Experience automating instruments or measurement setups with Python.

You enjoy hands-on work in the cleanroom and the lab every day, and you get satisfaction from a measurement done right and a sample that is fully traceable. You are comfortable applying an established procedure with rigour, and curious enough to ask why a result looks the way it does.

Over time, you want to do more than follow the recipe: you are ready to propose ideas, make decisions based on experimental results and modify the process accordingly. You are autonomous, proactive, and enjoy working at the interface between Production and R&D.

If you are passionate about semiconductor fabrication and quantum technologies, we would love to hear from you, even if you don’t tick every box.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary, flexible based on your experience
  • Profit-sharing & company savings plan
  • 100% health coverage (Alan)
  • 50% transport reimbursement or sustainable mobility bonus
  • Meal vouchers (Swile), Gymlib fitness support
  • Childcare assistance & referral bonuses (€1,000–€2,000)

What we offer:

  • A meaningful role with real ownership, from day one
  • A team eager to collaborate and grow with you
  • Daily exposure to the entire quantum stack — from high-level APIs to low-level firmware, and everything in between.

Process

      1. Talent Acquisition interview (30–45 minutes).
      2. Hiring Manager interview (45 minutes).
      3. Technical interview and team meeting.
      4. Two reference checks.
      5. Offer.

(This process is provided for guidance only and may evolve depending on the roles)

At Quandela, we believe that the strength of our team is the plurality of experiences, perspectives, and journeys. We are committed to building a respectful, inclusive, and welcoming work environment. All applications are welcome.
