title: Chief Information Security Officer
descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

Catalyst Capital is a profitable, bootstrapped holding company building a diversified financial services group: education, publishing, software, wealth and tax planning tools, investment products and proprietary trading technology. Funded entirely from its own operating cash. We have never taken outside capital.

The cash engine is Decentralized Masters, a DeFi education business that went from zero to 150+ people, 4,500+ paying members and roughly $48.6M of FY26 revenue at ~25% earnings before tax in four years. That engine funds everything else on this page.

Role summary

Catalyst Capital is hiring its first Chief Information Security Officer to own security across every brand in the group. You will set the strategy, build the program, and personally run the response when something goes wrong.

The job is two halves. Half is the core of a CISO's role: incident response, identity and access, vendor risk, phishing defense, policy and audit readiness, and the judgment calls only a person can own. The other half is making security AI-driven: mapping our full surface and building agentic systems that test, monitor and audit it with near-total coverage, so security keeps pace as more of the company runs on AI. This is a player-coach role: about half hands-on, leading a small team of engineers.

You report to Group leadership, brief the leadership team monthly, and are the person they trust to explain risk in plain language and make the call under pressure.

What you will own

Core security leadership (about half)

  • Security strategy and program. Own the security strategy, roadmap and budget across Decentralized Masters, Legacy, Inflection Club, Sentinelis and future brands. Report posture, top risks and trends to leadership every month, with a risk register leadership can act on.
  • Incident response. Own IR end to end: detection, triage, containment, eradication, recovery and the postmortem. Lead the room during a live incident and coordinate with legal counsel, forensics firms, insurers and regulators. Keep runbooks current and run tabletop exercises.
  • Cloud and identity security. Own identity and access across the group: SSO, MFA, least-privilege roles, admin redundancy and short-lived credentials. Set the AWS security baseline.
  • Third-party and vendor risk. Assess the security of every vendor and data provider we depend on, including their audits and attestations, and set the bar a vendor must clear before connecting to our systems or data.
  • Platform and customer account security. Set the standards for login protection and account-takeover defense on our platforms, and work with the engineering teams that own each platform to build them in.
  • Phishing and impersonation defense. Own email security, staff training and phishing simulations. Run brand protection: find and take down fake domains and accounts impersonating our brands and leaders.
  • Policy, compliance and trust. Write and enforce policies people actually follow. Prepare the company for SOC 2 or ISO 27001 with Legal & Compliance. Own the public security and trust story, including the trust page on our products.
  • Team leadership. Manage and develop our security engineers, decide what we build in-house versus outsource, and grow the team only where automation cannot do the job.
  • Member scam awareness. Supply the security content behind scam-awareness messaging to members, working with Community, Support and Marketing. Legal approves the wording.

AI-driven security (about half)

  • Full attack-surface map. Build and maintain a living inventory of everything we run: internal apps, cloud, code repos, and every SaaS tool and integration (CRM, telephony, community, payments, data providers). Know what connects to what, who has access, and what is logged.
  • Agentic security harness. Design and run AI-driven systems that approach 100% coverage: automated code and dependency review, continuous configuration and access audits, and vendor documentation review. Humans set direction and make the judgment calls; agents do the exhaustive work.
  • AI-driven detection and logging. Own the security stack (SIEM, Rapid7; endpoint protection; email security; identity and device management), make sure every critical system sends usable logs, and use AI to triage alerts and hunt across them.
  • Secure AI and vibe-coding standards. Set the rules for how teams build with AI: what can ship, what data AI tools may touch, and the review path before anything with customer data goes live.
  • AI agent security. As more of the company runs on agents and automations, secure them: scoped credentials and tool permissions, prompt-injection defense, data exposure, and monitoring and guardrails for agents in production. Review high-risk agents before launch, including our own security agents.

Scope

This role protects our company, our platforms, our data and our brands. For members' personal wallets and accounts outside our platforms, our role is education: helping members recognize and avoid scams.

Requirements

What you will bring

Must have

  • 10+ years in security, including 3+ years leading a security function as CISO, Head of Security or equivalent at a company of 100+ people.
  • Has led live-incident response, not just tabletop exercises, including briefing executives during the incident.
  • Has built or rebuilt a security program from an early stage: strategy, policy, tooling, training and incident response.
  • AI-native operator. Uses AI agents daily to do the work: writing detections, reviewing code and configs, reading vendor documentation, drafting policy. Can show us the harnesses, workflows or automations you have built, and knows where AI stops and human judgment has to take over.
  • Deep, current knowledge of AI-specific risks: prompt injection, over-scoped agent permissions, credential and data exposure through AI tools, and insecure AI-generated code.
  • Hands-on with cloud security (AWS preferred), identity and access management, SIEM, endpoint protection and email security.
  • Writes code: scripts, tooling and automation, not only vendor UIs.
  • Experience in crypto, fintech or another high-fraud industry, and deep knowledge of phishing, social engineering and impersonation attacks.
  • Can read the fine print: thorough with documentation, contracts and vendor security terms, and documents everything so nothing slips through.
  • Briefs executives in plain language, trains non-technical staff, and writes policy people follow.
  • Player-coach: comfortable spending about half your time hands-on while leading a small, fully remote team across many time zones.

Nice to have

  • Has prepared a company for SOC 2 or ISO 27001.
  • Has secured or evaluated AI agents and LLM-based tools in production.
  • Has run a third-party risk program covering financial data aggregators or similar providers.
  • Has run a brand protection or takedown program.
  • Experience with customer-facing security features such as account-takeover defense.
  • Experience with risk quantification (FAIR or similar) and presenting to a board.
  • Certifications such as CISSP, CISM, GCIH or OSCP.

Benefits

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation package
  • Independent Contractor opportunity
  • Fully remote, globally distributed team
  • Team offsites (Dubai, Costa Rica, etc.)
  • Collaborative, forward-thinking culture that values innovation and results

title: Data Ingenieur (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Data Ingenieur

Du bist technisch versiert, probierst gerne neue Ansätze aus und möchtest nicht bei jeder Entscheidung durch bestehende Strukturen ausgebremst werden? Als Data Ingenieur erwartet dich eine Umgebung, in der vieles neu aufgebaut wird und du deine technischen Vorstellungen aktiv einbringen kannst. Von der Architektur über Datenpipelines bis hin zu Data Quality und AI Schnittstellen kannst du moderne Lösungen entwickeln und dabei Verantwortung für deren Umsetzung übernehmen. Bewirb dich jetzt und nutze den technischen Spielraum, den diese Position bietet.

Deine Benefits als Data Ingenieur

Deine Aufgaben als Data Ingenieur

  • Data Layer: Übernimm Betrieb und Weiterentwicklung der Databricks basierten Datenplattform inklusive Workspaces, Jobs und Berechtigungen.

  • Datenpipelines: Entwickle robuste ETL und ELT Pipelines für Banking, Treasury, Payments, Exportfinanzierung und weitere Datenquellen.

  • Architektur: Gestalte Data Lake und Lakehouse Strukturen sowie skalierbare und performante Datenmodelle.

  • Data Quality: Implementiere automatisierte Qualitätsprüfungen und stelle Vollständigkeit, Aktualität und Konsistenz der Daten sicher.

  • Monitoring: Baue Monitoring und Alerting für Pipelines, Jobs, Latenzen und Fehler auf.

  • Governance: Dokumentiere Datenflüsse und Lineage und unterstütze bei Datenklassifizierung, Zugriffskontrollen und regulatorischen Anforderungen.

  • AI Enablement: Stelle geeignete Daten und Schnittstellen für AI Use Cases und MLOps bereit.

  • Zusammenarbeit: Unterstütze Fachbereiche bei Datenanalysen und arbeite eng mit Architecture, Platform, Risk und Compliance zusammen.

Dein Profil als Data Ingenieur

  • Ausbildung: Ein Studium der Informatik, Data Engineering, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation bildet die Grundlage.

  • Architektur: Erfahrung mit Data Lake oder Lakehouse Architekturen, Datenmodellierung und Data Quality.

  • Cloud: Erfahrung mit Infrastructure as Code in Cloud Umgebungen ist wichtig, idealerweise ergänzt durch Azure- oder AWS-Kenntnisse.

  • Betrieb: Erfahrung mit Monitoring, Fehlerbehandlung und der Operationalisierung produktiver Datenpipelines.

  • Pluspunkte: Erfahrungen mit Banking, Finance, Power BI, DORA, SFTP oder AI und ML Datenpipelines.

Du hast eigene Vorstellungen davon, wie eine moderne Datenplattform aufgebaut sein sollte und möchtest diese auch umsetzen können? Dann wartet hier der technische Gestaltungsspielraum auf dich, den du bei vielen etablierten Strukturen vergeblich suchst.

title: Engineering Manager – AI
descriptionHtml:
Job Title: Engineering Manager – AI

Reports to: Head of Engineering

Location: UK / Europe

Company Overview:

Radiant is redefining how AI infrastructure is built.

We design and operate AI-native cloud platforms engineered for sovereignty, performance, and scale. Our infrastructure powers GPU-native workloads, multi-tenant control planes, and high-performance AI systems designed for the most demanding environments.

We are not building a generic cloud. We are building purpose-built AI infrastructure — from powered land, to compute, to software.

As we scale, we're building this organisation from the ground up. We're looking for people who'd rather build the playbook than inherit one — who are comfortable doing the work themselves as well as directing others, and who can adapt as fast as our strategy does. This is a startup model: attitude and adaptability matter more to us than years of experience or the size of the team you've previously managed.

About the Role

As an Engineering Manager, you lead a team building and operating core parts of Radiant's cloud platform. You combine people leadership, technical judgement, delivery ownership and cross-functional collaboration. You work closely with product, infrastructure, SRE, security and other engineering teams.

This is a hands-on leadership role. It focuses on building strong teams, delivering reliable platform capabilities, and creating an environment where engineers do their best work.

What You'll Do

As an Engineering Manager – AI, you will lead a team building and operating the platforms customers use to train and serve AI models on our GPU infrastructure, joining one of our AI teams: MLOps Training or MLOps Inference. We hire strong managers first, then agree your team with you based on your strengths and interests.

You'll combine people leadership, technical judgement, delivery ownership, and cross-functional collaboration, working closely with product, infrastructure, SRE, security, and other engineering teams. Each team has around nine engineers: principal, senior and mid-level software engineers, an SDET, a DevOps engineer, and a platform engineer.Your first team is a starting point, and moves between teams are normal here.

Our Engineering teams are grouped as follows:

  • Infrastructure: Compute, Infra, Network & Storage

  • Platform: Cloud, Observability & Security

  • AI: Training & Inference

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of around nine engineers across software, platform, DevOps, and test.

  • Own delivery end to end: planning, prioritisation, quality, and operational readiness.

  • Partner with Product to turn priorities into clear technical plans and achievable milestones.

  • Provide technical leadership on architecture, reliability, scalability, and engineering trade-offs.

  • Set strong engineering practices for design, testing, observability, documentation, and incident learning.

  • Hire, onboard, and retain high-performing engineers. Hiring is a large part of the first year: expect around two hours a day on it.

  • Support career development through regular feedback, coaching, and progression planning.

  • Bring AI-assisted engineering into daily work, within our guardrails.

Your Profile

  • Experience leading engineering teams building cloud platforms, infrastructure, developer tooling, or distributed systems.

  • Proven experience in people management, hiring, coaching, and performance development.

  • A strong technical background: you engage credibly in architecture and design discussions.

  • A good understanding of:

  • Cloud infrastructure: compute, storage, networking, Kubernetes, containers

  • Platform engineering: APIs, automation, IAM, observability, reliability

  • Distributed systems: scaling, consistency, failure handling

  • Engineering operations: incident response, capacity, performance, production ownership

  • Strong delivery and prioritisation skills across competing priorities.

  • Comfortable working closely with product and other engineering leaders in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment.

  • Experience with GPU, HPC, or AI infrastructure is a bonus. Nobody has depth in every area above: tell us which you know and which you want to learn.

What You Bring

  • People leadership: Build strong teams and help engineers grow.

  • Technical judgement: Challenge designs and guide trade-offs without owning every implementation detail.

  • Execution: Create clarity and drive complex work to completion.

  • Systems thinking: Understand how platform components and teams fit together.

  • Operational mindset: Care about reliability, maintainability, and production quality.

  • Ownership: Take responsibility for both team health and engineering outcomes.

  • Curiosity: Learn new domains fast. GPUs, networks, and storage excite you rather than worry you.

  • Builder mindset: Much here is not built yet, and you enjoy creating the process, not just running it.

Qualities we look for:

  • Set the standard: Every single day, you spot opportunities to constructively shake things up

  • Inspire the change: There's no blueprint for the future. You'll embrace challenges and change

  • You're real and you're true to yourself: We cherish and celebrate diversity so you'll feel right at home whoever you are and whoever you're talking to, you treat everyone the same.

Why should you join us?

What sets us apart is our blend of modern technology, competitive benefits, and an open, welcoming work culture that enables our people to thrive.

Here are just some of the great things you can expect from us:

  • 25 days of annual leave

  • A culture that emphasises results over hierarchy, process & ego: we place great emphasis on the quality, ingenuity and creativity of work.

  • Open communication, regular feedback: we value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and a growth mindset makes us better together.

  • Learning Time: we all have dedicated learning time to focus on new skills, projects or interests that lay outside of your day-to-day job.

  • Health & Wellbeing: we want everyone to feel healthy and happy, so we offer private medical insurance via Bupa.

  • Cycle to Work Scheme: we're committed to building a sustainable business, so we encourage cycling to work.

  • Gympass subscription to a variety of gyms and wellbeing apps

  • Participation in the company shares program

  • Enhanced parental pay & leave

Our process: Talent screen → Hiring Manager → Technical interview (Principal Engineer and Engineering Lead) → Final.

title: Founding Tech Lead (GrowthBricks)
descriptionHtml:
Founding Tech Lead (GrowthBricks)

Are you a hands-on engineer who loves zero-to-one challenges? Do you want to build systems with real context and memory that do more than reason, use tools, and drive actual business outcomes? 

About JetBrains

We create intelligent software development tools for developers and teams. More than 15 million users, over 300,000 companies, and 88 of the Fortune Global Top 100 rely on our products to solve real, complex problems. Our mission is simple: make development teams more productive and AI adoptable at scale.

GrowthBricks is a new project at JetMinds, backed by JetBrains, designed to give GTM teams and AI agents a shared business brain. Business context usually gets fragmented across CRMs, documents, dashboards, and people's heads. GrowthBricks brings that context together so agents and people can make decisions and execute effectively across the sales, marketing, and product stack.

About GrowthBricks

GrowthBricks is a shared business brain for GTM teams and AI agents.

It brings together the context that usually lives across CRM, docs, dashboards, tools, and people’s heads: who we sell to, why customers buy, what matters now, what we tried, and what worked. Agents and people use that context to decide what to do next and execute across the GTM stack.

GrowthBricks is a new project at JetMinds, backed by JetBrains.

About the role

We’re looking for a hands-on Founding Tech Lead to build GrowthBricks from zero.

You’ll work directly with the product founder and own the technical side of the product: architecture, core systems, integrations, and the agent layer.

The core challenge is turning fragmented, changing business context into reliable memory and agent actions across tools and measuring whether those actions actually drive business outcomes.

You’ll write a lot of the early code yourself, make the key technical decisions, and shape the product as we learn what works.

What you’ll work on

  • Design the core architecture: business context, agents, tools, integrations, and feedback loops.
  • Build agentic workflows that can reason over company context and act across CRM, sales, marketing, and product systems.
  • Build context extractors from GTM team artifacts like sales calls, emails, internal documents, CRM state, marketing campaigns, etc.
  • Work on prompting, context management, memory, tool use, and orchestration.
  • Connect GrowthBricks to the existing GTM stack rather than rebuilding everything around it.
  • Decide where to use MCP, APIs, frameworks, or third-party tools and where a custom solution is worth it.
  • Prototype fast, discard weak ideas, and turn the useful ones into product primitives.

We expect that you

  • Are a strong hands-on engineer who enjoys zero-to-one work.
  • Have built with LLMs, agents, or agentic workflows used by real people, and improved them based on failures, evaluations, and user feedback.
  • Understand how context, prompting, tools, and agent behavior fit together.
  • Can design backend systems, APIs, data models, and integrations.
  • Are comfortable making decisions before all the answers are known.
  • Prefer simple, pragmatic solutions over unnecessary complexity.

We’re especially interested if you

  • Have worked in solution engineering, sales engineering, pre-sales, or built software for GTM teams.
  • Understand the modern GTM stack: CRM, enrichment, outbound, automation, and product signals.
  • Have automated sales or marketing workflows, ideally with agents or LLMs.
  • Have owned a technical product from a blank repo to something people actually used.

GTM experience is not mandatory, but if you already understand how sales and marketing teams work, that is a strong advantage.

What we offer

  • A competitive salary and strong benefits package.
  • The runway and resources of an established company, with startup-level autonomy.
  • A founding role with direct influence over both product and architecture.
  • Real users and real workflows from day one.
  • Freedom to choose the stack, tools, and technical approach.
  • A chance to help define what an agent-native GTM product should look like.

title: Hands-on Engineering Manager, Infrastructure
descriptionHtml:
Location: 100% remote (EMEA)

Classification: Full-time

Pay Range: 82.000€ to 140.000€ - determined by several factors, including location

Miaplaza is dedicated to making education engaging and accessible through innovative online learning platforms. We develop personalized learning experiences for students, helping them grow in a supportive and interactive environment. Our vision is to elevate online learning by applying the most successful approaches in virtual education to create an accessible and inclusive education curriculum platform where all students can be successful!

As an engineering manager at Miaplaza, your team will build technology with a direct impact on the lives of hundreds of thousands of students. Every step of the way, you will have the opportunity to influence our direction. Through our platforms, we create engaging, safe, and thoughtfully designed learning experiences that help children grow academically, creatively, and personally. Every feature we ship, every system we scale, and every improvement we make contributes to shaping how the next generation learns and discovers their potential. If our platform is down, a child might not go to school that day. We’re looking for leaders who want their work to matter in classrooms and homes, who care about access to quality education, and who are excited to craft technology that makes a difference in young people’s lives. Here, your impact doesn’t just power a product; it shapes future generations!

What you’ll work on:

We’re moving everything towards GCP and Kubernetes. We’re growing towards a scale that no longer matches our legacy architecture and actively investing in modernization. We’re migrating on-premise workloads to GKE, strengthening security and business continuity best practices, and moving toward platform self-service for our development teams. A core goal is to consolidate and shrink the stack, and every migration decision is measured against whether it lowers the daily burden on the team. You’ll need to work with your team balancing both platform initiatives and the operational needs of the engineering teams you serve. You’ll report to our head of engineering and be expected to split your time roughly 50/50 between people management and hands-on development. Prioritization always goes to leading and supporting your engineers. Your team will consist of four engineers.

What’s unique about management at Miaplaza:

Miaplaza is a US-based education company, which means we probably are doing things differently than you’ve done in your past experience. Here are a few differences you may notice:

  1. You will first onboard within your team as a senior engineer for 2 months. You will start to onboard as a manager during month two and will take over the team roughly at 10 weeks. This is non-negotiable as both periods of time are equally important.

  2. We expect our EMs to spend approximately 50% of their time hands-on, even after they’ve completed onboarding as a senior engineer.

  3. We emphasize the importance of pedagogical principles. A responsibility is to grow your engineers and those around you.

  4. One of such pedagogical principles is that we expect you to have full oversight into your direct reports' work; you can’t properly teach if you don’t see the process behind the output.

  5. Feedback is the norm. You’ll be expected to give meaningful, specific reinforcement and constructive feedback whenever you notice something. You should also expect to receive feedback. Ultimately, everything we do is optimizing ourselves, our teams, our processes, and our company to best support our students.


  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

  • 2+ years of experience being a mentor/leader, of which:

    • 1+ years leading a team, formally or as a tech lead

  • 7+ years of experience in DevOps, SRE, or Infrastructure Engineering, of which:

  • 3+ years running production workloads on Kubernetes (GKE preferred)

  • 3+ years of experience with a major cloud provider and Infrastructure as Code. GCP is our primary cloud and we expect senior-level knowledge of IAM, networking, KMS, GKE, CloudSQL and Secret Manager

  • 3+ years of experience operating at a Senior, Staff, or Principal Engineer level.

  • Experience with CI/CD pipeline design and operations

  • Experience with GitOps (FluxCD or ArgoCD)

  • Experience working directly with engineering teams and other managers as your customers on scoping and prioritization

  • Experience leading incident response, including running postmortems

What makes you stand out:

Experience leading a team through a significant architectural migration

Experience with consumer platforms at scale

Experience building in regulated environments

Experience operating self-hosted observability stacks (Prometheus, Thanos, Loki, Grafana, Tempo, OpenTelemetry)

Experience building internal developer platforms or self-service tooling

Experience supporting .NET/C# application deployments

Experience with database operations (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, RabbitMQ)

Experience with Istio or other service meshes

Responsibilities

  • Work with your team to design, build, and operate the infrastructure the rest of engineering depends on: clusters, pipelines, databases, edge, and observability

  • Your customers are the other engineering teams. Work with the other Engineering Managers and product development leadership to scope and prioritize platform work

  • Set the quality bar for your team. Lead by example.

  • Manage, lead, and mentor your team while working side by side with them in code quality, clean infrastructure-as-code, soft skills, best practices, etc

  • Lead team trainings, set SMART goals, hold performance reviews, and provide individual feedback recurrently to each of your devs

Our hiring process

As a remote company, we receive a large number of applicants, and finding the best fit for this role is our top priority — that’s why our process is longer than usual. At every stage, we try to be respectful of your time and grateful you’re spending it with us.

  • Application and CV Review - Our team will review your application responses and CV, then follow up with an update.

  • Initial Technical Screen (20 minutes) - A quick screening call to answer some administrative questions and confirm your basic technical knowledge. You'll be asked some administrative questions and 7 short technical questions related to the role.

  • Behavioral Interview (1 hour) - Meet with a member of our HR team to discuss your experience and share your approach throughout your career so far.

  • 1st Technical Interview (1 hour) - Meet with a member of the Infrastructure team to answer focused technical questions tailored to our work.

  • Scenario-based Technical Interview (1 hour) - Meet with a member of the Infrastructure team and the team's engineering manager to work through two hypothetical DevOps scenarios and how you would tackle them.

  • Leadership Interview (1 hour) - With our head of engineering and executive leadership.

  • Reference check - We'll reach out to the 3 references you provided, at least one being a former or current manager and any former or current direct reports.

  • Offer & background check - Once you sign your offer, we'll run a background check in accordance with applicable law.

We give honest, timely feedback at every step. Job searches are hard; we don't want to make yours harder.

Compensation and setup

The pay range for this role is €82,000 - 140,000. Miaplaza’s compensation philosophy ensures equity and competitiveness while considering regional differences in labor costs. Placement within a range is determined based on factors such as demonstrated skills, internal equity, and local labor market rates for the candidate’s geographic area.

Miaplaza is a growing, self-funded EdTech company. We're an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. If you need accommodations at any point in the process, just let us know.

title: Marketing Manager (gn) - More Nutrition Suisse
descriptionHtml:
Suisse de préférence, France à discuter, télétravail

Début : dès que possible | Niveau : Intermédiaire | Lieu : Suisse, télétravail | Temps de travail : temps plein (40 h/semaine)

More Nutrition bénéficie déjà d’une très forte présence en Suisse, avec un chiffre d’affaires à 8 chiffres, une croissance à deux chiffres et des investissements importants. Notre présence s’est jusqu’ici ancrée en Suisse alémanique ; nous souhaitons à présent poursuivre notre expansion en renforçant notre présence en Romandie.

En tant que Marketing Manager, tu seras rattaché(e) au VP International et seras responsable du développement et de la mise en œuvre de notre stratégie de marque pour More Nutrition en Suisse, avec un focus particulier sur la Romandie. Tu commenceras également à nous positionner sur le marché français.

Dans ce rôle, tu exécuteras nos campagnes de marque, piloteras les initiatives marketing locales et garantiras une expérience de marque cohérente. Tu travailleras en étroite collaboration avec les équipes commerciales, DTC, marketing, produits…, les agences et autres partenaires locaux.

Tu as une bonne compréhension des nuances culturelles entre la Suisse alémanique, la Romandie et la France. Tu as de l’expérience en biens de consommation ou FMCG dans des environnements dynamiques et as travaillé à la fois avec de grandes enseignes et des plateformes D2C. Tu es à l’aise dans des postes nouvellement créés, tu sais collaborer avec différentes fonctions et tu es orienté(e) action.

Merci de nous envoyer ton dossier de candidature en anglais.

Ta mission

· En tant que gardien(ne) de la marque, tu développes et mets en œuvre la stratégie de marque pour la Suisse, en associant guidelines globales et insights consommateurs locaux
· Tu définis le calendrier d’activation et pilotes la planification et l’exécution de campagnes omnicanales (médias de masse, marketing d’influence, TikTok et point de vente inclus)
· Tu briefes et pilotes les agences pour créer des contenus conformes à la marque et adaptés localement (en allemand et en français)
· Tu suis les indicateurs de marque (notoriété, capital de marque, engagement) ainsi que les KPI de campagne et tu les optimises continuellement
· Tu travailles en étroite collaboration avec des équipes transverses pour garantir une expérience de marque cohérente sur tous les canaux
· Tu adaptes l’assortiment local en fonction des besoins et du potentiel du marché suisse (et français)

Ton expérience & tes compétences

· La maîtrise du français est obligatoire. Idéalement, tu as de l’expérience à la fois en Suisse romande et en France. Tu comprends les différences de comportement entre consommateurs suisses et français.
· Tu as 4 à 6 ans d’expérience professionnelle en tant que Brand Manager ou Marketing Manager en FMCG / biens de consommation, idéalement en Food & Beverage.
· Tu as géré une ou plusieurs marques en Suisse ou en France générant un chiffre d’affaires d’au moins 30 millions CHF.
· Tu as une solide expérience dans la gestion d’un business D2C et de campagnes omnicanales (médias de masse, marketing d’influence, réseaux sociaux comme TikTok et Meta, ainsi que point de vente + pure players).
· Tu te distingues par un fort esprit opérationnel, d’excellentes compétences en gestion de projet et un fort esprit de collaboration.
· Tu es analytique et maîtrises les outils de marketing digital.
· Tu parles couramment français et utilises l’anglais avec aisance au quotidien dans un contexte professionnel. Parler allemand est un atout.

Pourquoi nous ?

Chez The Quality Group, plus de 1 200 personnes partagent une mission commune : repenser la nutrition – plus saine, plus intelligente et avec une réelle valeur ajoutée pour la communauté. Nous croyons en l’esprit d’équipe, à la responsabilité individuelle et au courage de repousser les limites. Chaque contribution compte, quel que soit le site ou le service. Selon l’endroit où tu nous rejoins, différents avantages t’attendent, notamment :

· Des réductions attractives pour les collaborateurs sur les produits ESN & More
· Des horaires flexibles & des possibilités de télétravail
· Des options de workation et plus encore

Au cours du processus de recrutement, tu découvriras les avantages concrets proposés sur ton site et ce que signifie faire partie de TQG : une entreprise qui façonne l’avenir de la nutrition avec passion, qualité et courage.

À propos de nous

The Quality Group (TQG) est un fournisseur innovant de produits de nutrition sportive qui réunit depuis 2021 les marques à succès ESN et More Nutrition. ESN est depuis 2004 le leader du marché allemand de la nutrition sportive et propose des produits tels que des protéines en poudre, des barres et des compléments alimentaires adaptés aux objectifs de fitness ambitieux. title: Senior FP&A Manager (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
OUR PURPOSE AT PLANCRAFT

Building the backbone of European trades together – with AI-first software.
We’re not just building software – we’re on a mission to create space for contractors & tradespeople by equipping them with AI solutions that work the way they do: fast, practical, and AI-first. With Tier 1 Investors from Europe and the US, like Headline and Creandum as well as 30,000+ tradespeople as customer base, we’re scaling across Europe to turn scattered tradespeople into thriving communities. We believe in zero admin, not zero personality – and we build every feature with the people in mind who wear the boots, not the suits. We’re #stoked to shape the future, #together as a team, and #humble in our mission to support the builders of tomorrow.

  

YOUR MISSION AT PLANCRAFT

How fast can we grow, where should we invest, and what needs to change when performance moves off plan? As Senior FP&A Manager, you will help plancraft answer these questions as we scale across Europe.

You will build the financial view that connects our growth ambitions to what is happening in the business. Working directly with leadership, country teams, and budget owners, you will challenge assumptions, uncover what drives performance, and turn your analysis into recommendations that shape where we put our resources.

There is plenty to build along the way. You will co-own planning, forecasting, and management reporting, make Abacum a live working tool for the business, and use AI and automation to get from data to useful insights faster. Working closely with our Director of Finance and another FP&A Manager, you will have the scope to shape how FP&A operates and make it a function people turn to when they need to make a decision.

Your Responsibilities

  • Own planning and forecasting: Lead annual financial planning, budgeting, monthly forecasting, and quarterly reviews. Connect leadership’s ambitions with realistic assumptions and inputs from across the business.

  • Explain performance and recommend action: Analyse actuals against budget and forecast, investigate variances at account and cost centre level, and translate your findings into clear recommendations.

  • Build visibility across markets: Own country P&Ls and the planning and reporting structures behind them, helping stakeholders understand performance as we expand.

  • Make Abacum the place where planning happens: Own and develop our live planning model, keep it connected to reliable actuals, and make it useful for leadership and budget owners in their daily work.

  • Deliver reporting people can act on: Prepare the monthly management pack and board and investor reporting. Bring together financial performance, business drivers, and SaaS metrics such as CAC, payback, and LTV into a clear story.

  • Partner with the business: Work with budget owners on planning inputs, spending, and performance. Challenge assumptions constructively and raise risks and opportunities early.

  • Automate recurring work: Use AI and automation to improve data preparation, reporting, and planning workflows, with clear checks that keep outputs accurate and explainable.

  • Support the wider Finance agenda: Work with the Director of Finance on projects, implementations, and the financial analysis behind funding rounds. Partner with Accounting and Finance Operations on reconciliations, data quality, and audit readiness.

Your Profile

  • Exceptional communication and business partnering: You communicate clearly and confidently in English with leadership and budget owners. You make complex financial topics easy to understand, challenge assumptions constructively, and turn insights into practical recommendations. You enjoy working closely with people across the business. Communication is a significant part of this role.

  • Strong FP&A ownership: You bring extensive FP&A experience (5+ years) and have independently run planning, budgeting, forecasting, and management reporting, and can explain how your analysis informed business decisions.

  • Hands-on modelling skills: You build and maintain financial models and reports yourself, understand their underlying assumptions, and can connect operational drivers to financial outcomes.

  • SaaS, software, or tech experience: You understand the economics of a software business and can interpret the metrics that matter for its growth and performance.

  • Planning system ownership: You have owned a platform such as Abacum or a comparable planning tool, including developing models, improving workflows, and enabling stakeholders to use it.

  • An AI and automation mindset: You actively look for ways to improve recurring work and can judge where automation adds value and where human review is needed.

  • A broad Finance foundation: You understand how accounting, tax, and financial operations affect planning and reporting, and work effectively with specialists across these areas.

  • Proactive, reliable execution: You take ownership of deadlines, bring updates without being asked, and stay clear and organised when priorities compete. You are fluent in English.

Nice-to-haves

  • Exposure to board reporting or fundraising support.

  • Familiarity with Abacum, BigQuery, or connecting planning tools to accounting and operational data.

  • Another European language.

Who this role is for

You have seen what good FP&A looks like, and you are ready to build it in a business that is scaling fast. You enjoy creating the model, getting close to the business, and turning incomplete information into a recommendation people can act on.

You are comfortable taking ownership before everything is neatly defined. When inputs are missing, you bring the right people together. When assumptions do not hold up, you challenge them. When a process slows everyone down, you improve it. You can deliver the next forecast while building a better way to run the one after it.

At plancraft, that means shaping planning across growing European markets, making Abacum useful for budget owners, and putting AI and automation to work in everyday Finance. You will have room to make decisions, test better approaches, and see your work influence how we grow. That freedom comes with the expectation that you move things forward, communicate proactively, and follow through.

WHY PLANCRAFT?

  • Team Spirit: We’re driven by passion, commitment, and a shared mission. Team spirit matters to us — and we make it visible: with four major team event weeks per year, casual monthly on-site and remote formats, and a strong recognition culture where we regularly celebrate both the big and small wins together.

  • Ownership: You’re encouraged to take ownership from day one. In a flat hierarchy and high-trust environment, you’re empowered to make meaningful decisions and drive real impact.

  • Learning & Growth: We invest in your personal and professional development through a strong feedback culture with 6-monthly 360° growth reviews, a personal learning budget (1.500€/year), 2 paid days of educational leave, and targeted enablement formats. Our goal is to help you unlock your full potential.

  • AI Enablement: Our internal tools and workflows are AI-enabled by design. We support every team and individual in applying AI at the next level in their daily work.

  • Tech & Tooling: You’ll receive a MacBook, premium headphones, and everything else you need — from hardware to tools — to be effective in your daily doing.

  • Flexibility: Whether remote, hybrid, abroad or on-site — you work where you’re at your best. Our Hamburg office (with a rooftop terrace) is always open, and you decide each week how often you come in. And if you need a change of scenery, working abroad worldwide up to 2 months is always an option.

  • Recharge: To ensure the needed rest, we offer 30 vacation days per year (based on a 5-day week) plus Dec 24th off. We also subsidize your Urban Sports Club membership and organize internal sport meetups.

  • Mobility: You can lease a "JobRad" (Bike) and get a subsidized "Deutschlandticket" or "BahnCard" for public transport to be supported in your commute.

  • International Environment: We’re becoming more international every month, with team members already in Italy, Spain, the Netherlands, and Austria — which is why English is our internal company language.

We’re #stoked to shape the future, #together as a team, and #humble in our mission to support the builders of tomorrow. For a first impression of us, take a look at our Instagram and LinkedIn page.

Diversity makes us better.
We welcome people of all backgrounds, identities, abilities, and experiences, and we believe that different perspectives lead to better ideas, stronger products, and a healthier workplace. If you’re excited about our mission but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every requirement, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might be exactly who we’re looking for.

______

On the application process
We want your candidate experience with us to be smooth, transparent, and enjoyable. We aim to get back to you regarding your application within 5 business days. Our interview process typically takes about 4 weeks from start to finish, though this may vary by role. You can learn more about our process here. If you need adjustments or flexibility at any stage, please don’t hesitate to let us know — we’ll do our best to make it work for you.

Note on creating a test account:
If you would like to create a test account as part of the challenge, please enter "Applicant" in the relevant field during registration and select "Other" under Trade. This ensures that our sales team does not mistakenly register you as a craft business and reach out to you unnecessarily.

title: Research and Development Engineer in Artificial Intelligence - 12 months contract
descriptionHtml:
Who we are ?

Télécom Paris, part of the IMT (Institut Mines-Télécom) and a founding member of the Institut Polytechnique de Paris, is one of France's top 6 general engineering schools.

The mainspring of Télécom Paris is to train, imagine and undertake to design digital models, technologies and solutions for a society and economy that respect people and their environment.

Modern distributed systems are increasingly complex, with multiple interconnected components, services, and autonomous agents interacting in dynamic environments. Ensuring their cybersecurity requires analysing potential attacks, understanding the strategies available to attackers and defenders, and verifying that critical security properties are preserved. Formal verification provides rigorous methods for addressing these challenges, allowing engineers to reason about system behaviours and establish mathematical guarantees. However, applying these techniques to realistic systems remains challenging. Verification problems can involve large state spaces and complex strategic interactions, while constructing formal models and specifying security properties often requires specialised expertise.

The VITAMIN-C (VerIficaTion of A MultI-ageNt system for Cybersecurity) project aims to address these challenges by combining formal verification with artificial intelligence. Building on VITAMIN, an existing modular model-checking platform for multi-agent systems, the project develops methods and tools for analysing cybersecurity properties in distributed and autonomous systems. Attackers and defenders are represented as agents with specific capabilities, objectives, and available actions. Their interactions are analysed using attack graphs, temporal and strategic logics, and model-checking techniques. The project also investigates how AI can improve the efficiency and accessibility of these verification processes.

A central objective of VITAMIN-C is to integrate AI techniques into the verification workflow. On the computational side, AI models will be investigated to guide the exploration of large state spaces and prioritise promising verification strategies. By learning from previously verified models and their associated results, these components can help identify relevant search directions and reduce the computational effort required by verification algorithms. On the usability side, the project explores AI-assisted interfaces that support engineers in constructing formal models and specifying security properties. These interfaces may exploit natural-language processing and large language models to interpret engineering descriptions, suggest formal representations, and assist users throughout the verification process. In both cases, the correctness of verification results remains the responsibility of the underlying formal methods, which validate the outcomes produced or suggested by AI components.

Within this context, the R&D engineer will contribute to the design, implementation, and evaluation of AI techniques for VITAMIN-C. The work will focus on developing AI components for verification guidance, investigating natural-language and LLM-based assistance for formal modelling, and integrating these capabilities into the existing platform. The engineer will also participate in the preparation of training and evaluation datasets, the development of experimental benchmarks, and the assessment of the proposed approaches in terms of effectiveness, computational efficiency, and reliability. The overall objective is to make formal verification more scalable and accessible while preserving the rigorous guarantees provided by the verification framework.

Your main responsibilities will include :

  • Carry out R&D work in artificial intelligence for formal verification

  • Contribute to the research profile of Télécom Paris and Institut Mines-Télécom


The candidate must have a solid understanding of artificial intelligence, Python programming, data processing and analysis, and software engineering. They must also be fluent in English and able to develop, train, evaluate, test and document AI components within a collaborative environment.

Experience in deep learning, natural language processing (NLP/LLM), graph learning, learning-guided search or the deployment of machine learning models would be an advantage. An interest in formal verification, cybersecurity, trustworthy AI, Docker and teaching activities would also be appreciated.

The role also requires strong organisational, analytical and problem-solving skills, as well as a good team spirit. The candidate must be able to communicate clearly, explain technical concepts in layman’s terms, draft documentation and contribute to teaching activities.

Required qualifications and experience : the candidate must hold a five-year post-secondary qualification (Bac+5) or equivalent. Applications from candidates with a four-year post-secondary qualification (Bac+4) and at least four years’ professional experience, a three-year post-secondary qualification (Bac+3) and at least six years’ experience, or a two-year post-secondary qualification (Bac+2) and at least ten years’ experience will also be considered.

Why join us?
You'll be working in a fast-growing, pleasant, green and accessible environment (especially for people with disabilities) just 20 km from Paris (RER B and C suburban train lines, close to major roads). You will benefit from :

  • 49 days annual leave (CA + RTT)

title: Research Engineer, Inference Foundation
descriptionHtml:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

The Inference Foundation team owns the core of Mistral's inference stack: the inference engine and its orchestration, from the feature set and configuration that serve our models in production to the release machinery that keeps the stack current and production-grade.

This is a hybrid position spanning production LLM serving, engine and platform development, and capacity engineering. You will work on three intertwined problems:

  1. Optimize the inference stack at scale — feature development and fixes in the engine and orchestrator, squeezing more throughput and lower latency out of every GPU under strict quality-of-service targets.

  2. Make capacity elastic — scaling up and down should be cheap and fast, not a performance cliff.

  3. Power the training of our frontier models — high-performance serving that keeps RL and post-training loops running at full speed.

 

What You Will Do

Inference engine & orchestration

  • Develop and fix the core of the inference stack — engine and orchestrator — including feature selection, configuration, and tuning for maximum performance at scale

  • Own the release process for the serving stack: validated, regression-free releases through automated performance gates and progressive rollout

  • Drive improvements and fixes upstream when the open-source engine is the right place for them

Performance & capacity at scale

  • Optimize serving efficiency across the fleet — driving down pod startup time, tackling cold-cache regressions on scale-up, smarter caching and offloading

  • Optimize and maintain the optimal serving topology — overlap communication and transfers with computation, ensure optimal placement, connectivity, and routing

Serving for frontier training

  • Build the serving infrastructure that powers RL and post-training for our frontier models

  • Optimize inference performance across the full spectrum of our workloads

 

What We're Looking For

  • Experience building and running ML/LLM services at scale, with clear latency and availability targets

  • Hands-on experience with inference engines such as vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, or others

  • A solid grasp of inference internals: prefill vs. decode, KV-cache behavior, batching, scheduling, speculative decoding, parallelism strategies

  • Familiarity with distributed and disaggregated serving architectures

  • Comfortable debugging across the full stack — CUDA/NCCL, kernels, containers, networking, storage

  • Python for systems tooling and backend services; PyTorch

  • Kubernetes for running infrastructure at scale

  • GPU and networking fundamentals: CUDA runtime, NCCL, InfiniBand/RDMA

It Would Be Great If You Have

  • Demonstrated vLLM/sglang know-how — upstream contributions, or a track record of running in demanding production environments

  • Hardware-aware optimization for various model architectures

  • Experience serving MoE models at scale (expert parallelism, expert placement/load balancing)

  • CUDA/Triton kernel development; Nsight Systems/Compute profiling

  • Rust and/or C++ in production systems

title: Residential Architect
descriptionHtml:
TLDR; Davis is looking for a residential specialist, excellent in plan and in drawing, who wants to practice the craft differently than in an agency. We expect around three to four years of experience.

About Davis

Davis is an AI-native real estate company accelerating early-stage development and architectural design. Today developers coordinate 4-5 fragmented stakeholders over weeks or months. Soon they'll need only one: Davis.

We turn every input that shapes a development decision into decision-ready outputs: investor-grade feasibility studies, investment analysis, and architect-certified designs, delivered in days. Every stage pairs our proprietary AI systems with expert review, so velocity never comes at the cost of reliability.

We closed a $5.5M pre-seed co-led by Heartcore Capital and Balderton Capital, with Yellow, Evantic and Entrepreneurs First, alongside angels from the founding teams of Spacemaker, Black Forest Labs, Hugging Face, Supabase, Cleo and Spore Bio. We already work with leading developers and expect to support hundreds of projects over the coming year, deepening our research, our hiring, and our coverage of the development process end to end.

The role

This role sits at the meeting point of two worlds Davis is working to bring together: architectural expertise and artificial intelligence. It is not a conventional architect role. It spans three complementary dimensions: guaranteeing the quality and architectural credibility of our deliverables, now generated in hours; co-producing the architectural plans that go with them; and actively contributing to the development of our plan-generation technology. It is an architect role whose impact reaches well beyond your own output.

You will run a portfolio of residential projects, under the supervision of a lead architect, from feasibility through to schematic design.

The core of the role

  • Read the local planning documents (zoning plans, development-orientation schemes, easements) and derive the project assumptions from them.

  • Develop massing, circulation principles and capacity scenarios consistent with the regulatory framework.

  • Certify the architectural credibility of what the pipeline produces, confirming that each plan is sound and setting out the reasoning behind it.

  • Develop the project phase after phase, from a first capacity scenario through to a resolved project at schematic design.

  • Produce the graphic documents (plans, images, diagrams) that make the project clear and compelling.

  • Arbitrate between scenarios against programmatic, regulatory and economic constraints.

Contribute to the technology

  • Formalize best practice, translating what a strong residential plan respects into criteria our AI teams can use.

  • Qualify the model's outputs, defining the standard a strong plan meets and validating each result against it, with the reasoning.

  • Work across the product, tech and real estate teams, inside the tool's continuous-improvement cycles.

Work as a team

  • Take part in project reviews and exchange with the other architects to improve the methods and the quality of the deliverables.

  • Contribute to the team's graphic standards.

Who We Are Looking For

  • Education: a degree in architecture.

  • Experience: around 3 to 4 years in an agency, ideally one specialized in residential work. You have a real command of the residential floor plan and can, from a site and a brief, produce credible, well-drawn capacity scenarios.

  • Software: mastery of Rhino and Revit is essential, and AutoCAD is expected.

  • Appetite for digital tools and AI: you do not need to code, but the drive to fold these tools into your practice and push it forward is essential.

  • Speed and synthesis: our clients are real estate developers, whose demands are first about speed and efficiency. You need to produce a credible, well-drawn scenario in hours, cut to the essential on ambiguous cases, and know what level of detail serves the decision at each phase.

Domain skills

  • Command of the residential floor plan, circulation, orientation, building depths, cores, the unit-type mix from studio to four-bedroom, tenure types (market-rate, social, intermediate, and affordable home-ownership).

  • Command of the planning documents and how they apply, massing envelope, height, setbacks, spacing rules, footprint, permeable ground, parking, land-use categories.

  • From rule to impact, linking a rule to its concrete effect on a plan or a buildable capacity.

  • Project phases, a solid grasp of the phases from feasibility to schematic design, and what each one implies in level of detail.

  • Graphic production, images and diagrams that explain the project and make it legible.

Complementary skills

  • Rigor and a sense of synthesis, especially on ambiguous cases.

  • Structuring information, organizing what you produce so that others, human or machine, can use it.

  • An ability to work across the product, tech and real estate teams.

Why Join Davis?

  • Work on a real transformation of the real estate profession and co-build a next-generation feasibility standard with a high-caliber technical team.

  • Have a direct, visible impact on every deliverable and take part in the continuous progress of the technology.

  • Be exposed to a rare volume and diversity of projects.

  • Join a driven, ambitious team, in a young, growing company where the methods and the tools are still being built and where your expertise truly counts. Enough to learn fast and shape the way we work.

Package

  • Full-time fixed-term contract, with the possibility of moving to permanent

  • Competitive compensation based on profile

  • Offices in the center of Paris 2e

  • Private health insurance covered

  • Meal vouchers

  • Gym membership covered

  • 50% of commuting costs reimbursed

More information about Davis, the team and the market we’re going after:


Team

Mehdi (CEO) grew up in a family of architects and has lived this problem firsthand. He's a repeat founder who bootstrapped his first startup at 20, and graduated from Sciences Po and HEC Paris. Amine (CTO) is an AI researcher from École Polytechnique who worked extensively on discrete diffusion and turned down a PhD with Google DeepMind to build Davis. They started working together in July 2025 at Entrepreneur First's first European residency, a two-month lock-in in a German castle.

Today we're a team of 12: technical profiles from Polytechnique, ENS and INRIA alongside architects and deep real estate expertise.

We're small with an extremely high bar. If you want to work deeply on hard problems and see your work reach clients within days, you're the one we need.

Why We'll Win

Real estate is a $13 trillion industry that technology has largely bypassed. The professional services that feed it (design, engineering, feasibility, permitting) represent hundreds of billions in spend that no one has seriously automated.

Proptech spent the last decade selling SaaS on the edges of these workflows. It didn't work, for two reasons: no professional wants another tool to learn, and no tool can automate work that runs on expert judgment. Davis makes a different bet. We don't sell tools, we sell the work: AI-generated, expert-validated, delivered in days instead of weeks. title: Responsable Comptable H/F
descriptionHtml:

Alta Ares is an air defense Neoprime. We build AI-guided interceptors to counter drones and cruise missiles, along with the software platform that powers them.

Our customers are NATO-aligned militaries and defense institutions, and our systems are regularly deployed during live exercises and operational demonstrations across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.

Founded in 2024, we have grown to 160 people, raised over $60M, and increased revenue 40× this year. We are now entering a new phase of international expansion, industrial scaling, fundraising, and product development.

The Role

In a context of hypergrowth, we are looking to recruit our first Accounting Manager to structure and develop the Group's accounting function.

Working closely with our external accounting firm, Operations teams and local accounting teams, you will ensure the accuracy and reliability of the financial statements and the quality of accounting processes.

Initially, this will be a very hands-on role, with the opportunity to build, recruit and directly manage your own team as the company grows.


Key Responsibilities


Accounting & Financial Close

  • Oversee the general accounting of the French entity and supervise accounting activities across subsidiaries.

  • Organise fast and reliable monthly closing processes (accrued expenses, prepaid expenses, deferred income, provisions, payroll, intercompany transactions).

  • Prepare annual financial statements in collaboration with the external accounting firm and act as one of the main points of contact for statutory auditors.

  • Manage fixed assets and develop management/cost accounting processes, working closely with the Finance & Operations Associate responsible for FP&A.


Inventory & ERP

  • Structure inventory accounting and valuation processes in collaboration with the Operations team.

  • Oversee stock counts and cut-off procedures at company sites and at subcontractors' facilities.

  • Play a key role in completing the ERP implementation and driving its continuous improvement.


Multi-Entity Accounting & Group Reporting

  • Establish and monitor intercompany transactions, reconciliations and eliminations.

  • Develop an integrated financial overview of the Group's subsidiaries (currently more than six, with additional entities being established), with a view to implementing consolidated financial reporting in the future.

Treasury, Tax & Financing

  • Prepare and execute payment runs and contribute to cash flow forecasting.

  • Ensure tax compliance (including VAT, export-related VAT, corporate income tax and other taxes) in collaboration with the external accounting firm.

  • Contribute to financing and grant application processes.


Processes, Internal Controls & Automation

  • Formalise and implement processes covering procurement, sales, expense claims, payroll and payment controls.

  • Ensure process compliance, particularly regarding electronic invoicing and transaction processing.

  • Proactively identify opportunities to automate accounting and ERP processes, including through the use of AI.

Management & Organisation

  • Take full ownership of the accounting function, working independently and operationally from day one.

  • Support the development of the accounting organisation, with the opportunity to recruit and manage your own team as the business grows.

 

Candidate Profile

  • Master's degree (Bac+5) in Accounting or Finance (DSCG, Master's in Accounting, Control and Auditing – CCA, or equivalent).

  • 5–10 years of professional experience, including experience in an accounting or audit firm and in an in-house corporate environment, ideally within an industrial business experiencing rapid growth.

  • Excellent knowledge of French accounting standards, financial closing procedures and taxation, with a good understanding of inventory accounting.

  • Comfortable working with ERP systems and modern digital tools, with advanced Excel skills.

  • Hands-on, detail-oriented and pragmatic, with the ability to build processes and structures from scratch.

  • Motivated by the opportunity to develop and lead a team.

  • Fluent in professional English.

 

Nice to Have

  • Experience implementing an ERP system.

  • Experience in a multi-entity and international environment, with some knowledge of IFRS or financial consolidation.

  • Knowledge of the defence industry or export-related activities.

  • Experience working in a scale-up following a fundraising round.

  • Strong interest in automation and AI-powered tools.

Nous offrons à des personnes passionnées par la résolution de problèmes l’espace nécessaire pour donner le meilleur d’elles-mêmes, au sein d’équipes diverses et inclusives réparties à travers l’Europe.

Missions 🚀

  • Rédiger et maintenir l’ensemble des procédures et modes opératoires du département
  • Former et accompagner l'équipe sur le traitement des alertes de surveillance des opérations et à la rédaction des examens renforcés
  • Faire évoluer les outils et automatiser les traitements, en accompagnant l'équipe dans le changement
  • Participer à la consolidation des données pour les comités des risques

4) Reporting réglementaire

  • Coordonner avec, l’équipe en charge de la LOD2, la production de données fiables et leur analyse, pour les reportings et les demandes des superviseurs

  • Appuyer l'équipe sur les dossiers complexes et sensibles avant escalade

À propos de toi 👇

  • Keep our pay bands consistent internally and competitive in the market as we grow.

  • Shape and administer executive and senior leadership bonus schemes, with clear, compliant proposals ready for approval.

  • Own our equity scheme day to day, from issuing shares and certificates to making it easy for employees to understand.

  • Manage our benefits offering (pension, healthcare, insurance, wellbeing, salary sacrifice) and the relationships with providers, brokers and consultants.

  • Build and maintain reward dashboards that give People and business leaders a live view of pay, bonus and equity data.

  • Bring together market data from providers like Aon Radford and Ravio with our real-time internal data, and turn it into insight that helps the business make better decisions.

  • Automate manual reward processes and use AI in your day-to-day work, freeing up time for strategic work.

  • Keep us compliant with UK reward legislation (HMRC reporting, P11D, Gender Pay Gap, pay transparency) and explain reward and benefits clearly to employees.

  • Own reward projects from idea to delivery, and keep improving how we do things as we scale.


What you’ll bring

Essential criteria:

  • Demonstrable experience in a Reward or Compensation & Benefits role

  • Experience using reward market data providers such as Aon Radford and Ravio

  • Intermediate-to-advanced Excel skills (VLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH, pivot tables, graphs and charts)

  • Experience managing annual reward cycles in a mid- or large-sized organisation

  • Hands-on experience automating reward or People processes, for example with Excel macros, scripting or workflow tools

  • Experience using AI tools to improve how you work, with examples of what you've changed or sped up

  • A track record of owning reward projects or process improvements from start to finish


Ideally, you’ll have:

  • Experience in a start-up or scale-up, where processes aren't always mapped and you create structure from disparate data

  • Experience working in a tech company or alongside technical teams

  • Reward experience beyond the UK, such as international or multi-country pay and equity

  • Experience building reward dashboards in a tool like Power BI, Tableau or Looker

  • Experience setting up and overseeing Remuneration Committee (RemCo) governance and working with RemCos on executive reward

  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, from presenting strategy to the CFO to answering an employee's benefits query


Our Values

Five values guide how we work at Kaluza:

 

  • Play to win: Collective pride in decarbonising energy at scale.

  • Solve the real problem: Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes.

  • Build trust every day: Consistency, transparency and doing what we say.

  • Own the outcome: Full accountability, wins and setbacks, without ego.

  • Go further together: Collaboration, respect and different perspectives.

 

Our Perks

 

  • Time off and family: 26 days’ holiday, plus 26 weeks’ full pay for new parents with no qualifying service period

  • Health and security: Private medical insurance with virtual GP, life assurance, pension scheme, free mortgage advice and eye tests

  • Pay and flexibility: Discretionary bonus, a Flex Fund of 5% [of salary] to spend on the benefits you want most, retail discounts through Perks at Work

  • Growth and setup: Personal learning budget, home office budget

  • Climate: Furthr, our climate action app

Come as you are


We want to meet people from all walks of life. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be, and we recognise talent on merit and potential. If you’re excited about the role but don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you.

title: Sales Manager - Buy Side
descriptionHtml:
📈 Who We Are:

We are rebuilding the energy transaction, making it transparent and fair.

We're rebuilding how energy is bought and sold. That means cutting out middlemen, connecting businesses directly with renewable generators, and ensuring every transaction is traceable and transparent.

We're a 160+ person team - operators, data scientists, engineers, customer champions and energy experts - backed by top-tier investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Hitachi Ventures, Allianz, AlbionVC and Atomico. We closed a $75M Series B round in early 2026, taking our total funding to $94M, and we now power energy for over 4,000 UK businesses across 8,500+ sites, with over £75m in value returned to businesses and generators so far.

We're a technology company solving the energy industry, not an energy company. Some people call us a neo-utility, the neo-bank idea, applied to energy.

The industry is noticing. We were crowned Europe's Most Exciting Tech Company at the GP Bullhound Allstars awards, came in at #6 on LinkedIn's Top Startups 2026 in the UK, #7 on the Scaling Europe 50 of Europe's fastest-growing companies, and #14 on Sifted's AI 100.

Learn more about us on our website.

🎙️ The Role

We're hiring a Buy Side Originator to join the Commercial team in our Buy engine.

tem lets businesses buy renewable energy directly from the generators that produce it - transparent pricing, fair terms, no middlemen. Demand from smaller businesses is growing fast, and we need someone to own it.

You will run a high-velocity sales motion end-to-end: qualify, progress, close, and hand off cleanly. You'll work directly with business customers buying energy through tem, backed by a CRM and AI-assisted outreach tooling that keeps your pipeline full while you focus on the conversations that close deals.

In your first 12 months, you might:

  • Close your first SMB deals within your opening weeks, working a live pipeline from day one.

  • Own the long tail of a fast-growing SMB pipeline, keeping deals moving instead of going stale.

  • Put signed volume on the board that counts directly towards the Buy engine's goals.

  • Sharpen our SMB playbook with front-line feedback on what buyers ask and where deals stick.

  • Grow towards owning bigger slices of the origination motion.

🚀 Responsibilities

  • Close with pace: own smaller direct SMB opportunities from first contact to signature, keeping momentum with clear next steps.

  • Qualify fast: run discovery calls to understand each customer's site, contract timing and usage, and triage leads into chase, nurture or drop.

  • Sell honestly: explain the tem proposition clearly, handle the objections SMBs actually raise, and walk away when a deal isn't right for the customer.

  • Keep it clean: maintain tight CRM hygiene - notes, stages and timelines always current - so nothing slips and handoffs into onboarding are smooth.

  • Work smart: use AI and outreach tooling to cover more pipeline than a traditional rep could, without losing judgement on the calls that matter.

  • Feed the loop: share what customers are asking for and where deals get stuck, so the proposition keeps improving.

🎯 Requirements

Must-Haves

  • Experience in direct B2B sales where you owned deals end-to-end, qualify to close.

  • Comfortable speaking with customers every day and working a high-volume pipeline without letting deals go stale.

  • Strong discovery and objection-handling instincts - you can explain a cost-savings proposition to a non-technical buyer.

  • Disciplined CRM habits: clear notes, accurate stages, honest reporting.

  • Low ego, direct and coachable - honest with customers even when it costs the deal.

Desirable

  • Experience selling into SMBs in energy, utilities or another price-sensitive market.

  • Familiarity with sales automation and AI-assisted outreach tooling.

  • Experience running renewal or retention motions alongside new business.

✨ Benefits & Perks

  • Stock options so everyone has ownership in our mission.

  • 25 days holiday plus public holidays. Swap public holidays for the ones that matter most to you, and enjoy your birthday off.

  • Remote first and flexible working, with clear core hours and no internal meetings on Friday afternoons.

  • Up to £1,200 or €1,200 per year for your remote setup.

  • Up to £150 or €150 per month for wellbeing.

🗣️ Interview Process

  • First call with our Talent Team.

  • Behaviour Interview with the Hiring Manager (30 mins).

title: Sales Team Lead
descriptionHtml:
About Andercore

Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry.

Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell.

We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought.

We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded.

Where we are today:

  • Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover run rate, the majority of it from repeat customers

  • Seven European markets live, sourced from suppliers across Asia and beyond

  • 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), London, and Shanghai

  • $90M raised in equity and debt, including our $40M Series B, from Atomico, Project A, Target Global, and Inven Capital - with working capital facilities from UniCredit and KfW

The margin is in the bits. The moat is in the atoms. We are building the supplier of record for industrial materials - and redefining how global trade works in one of the largest and most essential industries on earth.

The Sales Team Lead is a pivotal commercial role responsible for leading, coaching, and developing a sales team. The position focuses on driving sales performance, optimizing pipeline management, and ensuring operational excellence to support sustainable revenue growth.

You will work closely with Sales Leadership and cross-functional teams to execute strategic initiatives, maintain KPI ownership, and foster a high-performance culture. This role is ideal for a hands-on leader who thrives in fast-paced environments, enjoys developing top talent, and brings a strong commercial mindset.

We offer a clear career growth path, competitive compensation with performance-based incentives, and the opportunity to make a meaningful impact at our Berlin headquarters, backed by leading international investors.

Key Responsibilities

1. Sales Performance & Operations

  • Drive commercial performance and contribute to sustainable revenue growth.

  • Lead day-to-day sales execution and monitor weekly and monthly KPIs.

  • Own pipeline management and ensure accurate, disciplined forecasting.

  • Maintain visibility over pipeline health, market developments, and overall sales performance.

  • Collaborate with Sales Leadership to improve sales processes and operational efficiency.

  • Implement and reinforce best practices, reporting standards, and performance tracking to ensure consistent execution.

2. Team Leadership & Coaching

  • Lead and inspire a high-performing sales team in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment, setting clear expectations and standards for success.

  • Drive a strong performance culture built on accountability, consistency, and continuous improvement.

  • Coach and develop team members through regular 1:1s, deal reviews, live feedback, and hands-on support.

  • Partner with Sales Leadership on hiring, onboarding, and developing top talent to ensure long-term team strength.

  • Identify growth opportunities within the team and actively support career development and internal progression.

What Success Looks Like

  • Consistent achievement of sales targets and pipeline objectives.

  • A highly engaged and high-performing sales team.

  • Strong forecasting accuracy and operational discipline.

  • Improved sales productivity, conversion rates, and overall team efficiency.

Who You Are

  • 4–6+ years of experience in B2B sales, business development, or sales leadership roles.

  • Proven experience managing, mentoring, or coaching sales teams in fast-paced environments.

  • Strong understanding of sales KPIs, pipeline management, and sales operations.

  • Hands-on, proactive mindset with strong leadership and coaching capabilities.

  • Familiarity with CRM systems; experience with Salesforce is a plus.

  • Additional European language (German, Italian, or French) is a strong plus.

  • Comfortable working in a high-performance, office-based environment.

We are an equal-opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, or any other characteristic. We believe that diversity drives innovation, creativity, and collective strength.
