This is a remote opportunity and we would be interested in applications from the UK, Ireland, Sweden, Spain and Germany.

The opportunity:

Grafana Labs is building a native experimentation platform: a Grafana app that lets teams define A/B tests, connect them to feature flags and product telemetry, and get trustworthy, statistically sound answers about what their changes actually did.

It started as a hackathon project and is now used by Grafana engineering and product teams in our internal environment to run real experiments. The next step is to make it a first-class product: one we rely on every day internally and, over time, one we offer to Grafana Cloud customers alongside Frontend Observability, Session Replay and our other user-experience capabilities.

You'll join the Product Analytics team, a group of highly technical product analysts who help teams across Grafana understand how our products are used and run experiments on them. As the team's dedicated software engineer, you'll own the engineering of the experimentation app and have a lot of influence over where it goes. You'll partner closely with data scientists on the statistics, data engineers on event pipelines and the data warehouse, software engineers across Grafana on feature flags, Frontend Observability and the App Platform, and product stakeholders who rely on experiment results to make decisions. This is a hands-on engineering role that ships production code. It is not an analyst role.

About the product:

The experimentation app is built on the Grafana App Platform:

  • Frontend: a TypeScript and React app plugin using @grafana/ui, plus a custom datasource plugin that powers experiment statistics panels.
  • Backend: Go, built with the Grafana App SDK. Experiments are Kubernetes-style custom resources defined in CUE, with an operator, admission webhooks, and support for declarative, GitOps-style management.
  • Feature flags: integration with OpenFeature and the OpenFeature Remote Evaluation Protocol (OFREP), Grafana's multi-tenant feature toggle service, and an embedded GO Feature Flag evaluator.
  • Statistics engine: a Bayesian analysis engine (TypeScript, with a Go port) that produces a direction-aware verdict per metric, probability to be best, credible intervals, expected loss and sample-size recommendations.
  • Data: experiment exposure and outcome events flow from product instrumentation through RudderStack into BigQuery, or from Grafana Faro into Loki, and are queried live through Grafana datasources.
  • AI: experiment authoring assisted by Grafana Assistant, which discovers relevant data and drafts the experiment configuration for a human to review.

What You’ll be doing:

  • Evolve the experimentation app from internal tool to product. Full ownership of features end to end across the React frontend and Go backend, from problem framing and design through rollout, measurement and iteration.
  • Build the experimentation experience. Develop intuitive workflows for defining hypotheses, configuring experiments and metrics, managing their lifecycle, and exploring results. Make these experiences useful for product managers and analysts as well as engineers.
  • Make instrumentation easier to adopt and trust. Evolve the experimentation SDK and its OpenFeature and Faro integrations. Help teams connect variant assignment, actual exposure, and outcome events with consistent identity and event contracts.
  • Connect experiments to the rest of Grafana’s user-experience stack. Integrate with Grafana Faro and Frontend Observability so flag exposures and outcomes are captured automatically, and link experiment results to Session Replay and critical user journeys so teams can see why a variant won, not only that it won.
  • Harden the statistics and analysis path. Work with our data analysts to extend the statistics engine, and make analysis scalable, cost-aware and correct. Examples include moving computation server-side, scheduled analysis, alerting on experiment health, and guardrails against misleading results.
  • Use AI where it genuinely helps. Extend the Grafana Assistant integration for authoring, explaining and reporting on experiments.
  • Raise the engineering bar. Mentor teammates, including analysts who contribute code, through code review, pairing and design docs. Write the architecture decision records (ADRs), docs and demos that help other teams adopt experimentation.
  • Own what you ship. Take part in on-call for the services you build, and support the internal teams that run experiments on them.

We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction. We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups, always with strong code review and quality standards. You’ll also have access to the latest frontier models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google.

What makes you a great fit:

We highly value people who are intellectually curious, default to transparency, have a strong bias towards action, and are kind and enjoy working as a team.

  • Strong full-stack engineering experience. You’ve built and operated production web applications with TypeScript and React, and backend services in Go (or a similar language, with willingness to work in Go). You value maintainability, automated testing and secure development practices.
  • Experience building an in-house platform or integrating existing experimentation and A/B testing platform (for example Statsig, Eppo, GrowthBook, Optimizely, LaunchDarkly experiments, or an in-house platform).
  • Product and data intuition. You care whether what you shipped actually moved the needle, and you’re comfortable working with event data, SQL and data warehouses such as BigQuery.
  • Technical ownership. You’ve delivered complex projects with minimal supervision, broken them into short feedback loops (analyze, design, ship an MVP, learn, iterate), and helped teammates work more effectively.
  • Operational responsibility. You’ve been on call, supported software in production, and know how to make systems observable and debuggable.
  • Pragmatic AI usage. You use AI coding tools thoughtfully, validate their output, and share practices that improve the team’s speed and quality.
  • Clear communication. You can explain technical and statistical tradeoffs to engineers, analysts and product managers in a fully remote, asynchronous environment.

Bonus Points For:

  • Hands-on experience with feature flags and OpenFeature.
  • A working understanding of experiment statistics: Bayesian or frequentist testing, sample sizing, variance reduction, and common pitfalls such as peeking and sample ratio mismatch.
  • Experience with Kubernetes concepts: custom resources, operators, admission webhooks, GitOps.
  • Experience building Grafana plugins or apps, or with the Grafana App SDK or Scenes.
  • Familiarity with frontend observability and product analytics tooling, such as Grafana Faro, RUM, session replay, RudderStack or Segment.
  • Open source contribution or maintainership.
  • Experience as a user of Grafana, Prometheus, Loki or Tempo, whether at work or on a homelab.

Wer wir sind

Rockstardevelopers, gegründet 2015 in Mannheim, weitere Büros in Stuttgart und München. Wir sind ein Software-Entwickler mit Erfahrung aus hunderten von individuellen Projekten für Enterprise- und Mittelstands-Kunden.

Kurze Wege, ehrliches Feedback, keine politischen Spielchen. Keine Hierarchie-Ebenen zwischen dir und den Leuten, die Entscheidungen treffen.

Du arbeitest in einem agilen Release Train nach SAFe bei einem großen Mobilitätsunternehmen. Es geht um Fahrplan-, Vertriebs- und Abrechnungssysteme auf einer Cloud-Native-Plattform mit Kubernetes. Du arbeitest mit mindestens zwei weiteren Teams zusammen, die von deiner Arbeit abhängen.

  • Backend-Services mit Java (17+) und Spring Boot entwerfen und weiterentwickeln

  • REST-APIs mit Versionierung und OpenAPI-Dokumentation, Absicherung mit OAuth2, JWT und Spring Security

  • Datenmodelle in PostgreSQL, SQL-Optimierung, Migrationen mit Flyway oder Liquibase, Spring Data JPA / Hibernate

  • API-Contracts und Schnittstellen mit den anderen Teams abstimmen

  • Testgetriebene Entwicklung mit JUnit 5, Mockito, Testcontainers und Contract-Tests

  • Container-Images bauen und Deployments in Kubernetes pflegen, inklusive CI/CD

  • Rufbereitschaft und 2nd/3rd Level Support nach Absprache

Die Arbeit läuft überwiegend remote. Vor Ort bist du für die PI-Plannings, etwa zwei Tage im Monat.

Wo du landest

  • Großkonzerne aus Mobilität und Logistik

  • Öffentlicher Sektor / Behörden (z. B. Bundesagentur für Arbeit, ITZBund, Bundesdruckerei)

Unsere Kunden besetzen diese Projekte fast nur mit Festangestellten. Deshalb suchen wir dich in Festanstellung.

Was du mitbringst

Senior-Level. Unsere Kunden brauchen Leute, die ab Tag eins liefern und eigenständig arbeiten.

Das erwarten wir:

  • Java und Spring Boot in Backend-Services, mehr als fünf Jahre

  • PostgreSQL oder vergleichbar: Datenmodelle, Queries, Indexierung, Migrationen, mehr als drei Jahre

  • Zusammenarbeit mehrerer voneinander abhängiger Teams in Enterprise-Umgebungen, mehr als fünf Jahre

  • Testgetriebene Entwicklung, mehr als drei Jahre

  • Docker und Kubernetes, mehr als drei Jahre

Von Vorteil (kein Muss):

  • SAFe und PI-Plannings

  • Monitoring mit Grafana, Prometheus, Loki oder Tempo

  • Apache Kafka oder RabbitMQ

  • GitLab CI

  • KI-Werkzeuge in der Entwicklung (Copilot, ChatGPT, Amazon Q)

AI-Tools sind Pflicht, kein Bonus

Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor: Damit musst du produktiv arbeiten können. Nicht weil wir hip sein wollen, sondern weil unsere Kunden das erwarten und wir auch so arbeiten. Wenn du AI-Tools für einen Hype hältst und lieber alles selbst tippst: falsche Firma. Intern investieren wir in deine AI-Skills.

title: Senior/Lead Security Engineer - Pentester
descriptionHtml:
Menlo Security is the leader in Browser Security for human and agentic workforces. Our mission is to enable humans and agents to connect, communicate, and collaborate securely, without compromise. The Menlo Browser Security Platform protects organizations from cyberattacks by stopping threats across the web, documents, and email before they reach the user. With Menlo Agent Runtime Security (MARS), that protection now extends to the AI agents working alongside every employee. Menlo Security is trusted by major global businesses, including Fortune 500 companies and government agencies, to protect their most valuable asset, their data, and is backed by top-tier investors.

Summary

We're looking for a forward-thinking Security Engineer to join our security team, focused on offensive and defensive testing, penetration testing of product features, and the cloud architecture behind the product. You'll operate across a complex multi-cloud environment (AWS & GCP) spanning traditional VMs and modern managed and unmanaged container-based architectures, partnering with fellow Penetration Testing and Cloud Security engineers to run targeted assessments during the testing window immediately before each release. The role reaches beyond the application layer into the Control Plane, reviewing cloud configurations, IAM policies, and orchestration layers against security baselines, and extends to the frontline of external defense by triaging bug bounty submissions and outside vulnerability reports. AI and large language models are core to how this team works day to day — you'll use them to accelerate reconnaissance, generate attack vectors, analyze configurations, and draft vulnerability reports, while applying human judgment to validate findings and communicate risk clearly to product teams. Speed matters here: the team's operating cadence is built around identifying, validating, and reporting vulnerabilities quickly enough to keep pace with release velocity.

Outcomes & KPIs

Key Outcome(s) Owned:

  • Ensure new product features and the underlying multi-cloud (AWS/GCP) infrastructure are rigorously security-tested before release, and that vulnerabilities surfaced internally or via bug bounty are triaged and communicated with speed and precision.

Success Metrics / KPIs:

  • Percentage of roadmap features assessed within the pre-release testing window.

  • Mean time to triage and validate bug bounty / external vulnerability reports.

  • Reduction in critical/high-severity vulnerabilities escaping to production post-release.

  • Time saved per assessment cycle through AI-assisted tooling and automation.

  • Quality and actionability of vulnerability reports and PoCs, as rated by product teams.

What You'll Do

  • Conduct deep-dive penetration tests of products across a multi-cloud (AWS & GCP) environment, working in tandem with a peer pentester.

  • Review IAM policies, service configurations, and cloud-native permission structures across the Control Plane to ensure cloud configurations meet security baselines.

  • Execute dynamic testing against web interfaces and API endpoints (Data Plane & Web UI).

  • Assess the security posture of hybrid infrastructure spanning containers and virtual machines.

  • Triage findings, build clear and reproducible proofs-of-concept, and partner with product teams to explain risk and drive remediation.

  • Use AI and large language models to automate reconnaissance, generate attack vectors, analyze configurations, and draft vulnerability reports, applying strong prompt-engineering skills to security contexts.

  • Monitor bug bounty pipelines and external reports, validating findings and managing researcher communication.

Functional Competencies

Required:

  • Multi-Cloud Fluency: Deep architectural understanding of GCP and AWS. Capable of pivoting seamlessly between providers, performing manual configuration reviews of complex IAM/Resource hierarchies, and leveraging native APIs or modern CSPM frameworks to validate security controls.

  • Container Security: Proven experience auditing and hardening managed container services (GKE Autopilot/Standard, EKS, ECS) and self-hosted/unmanaged workloads (K8s, k3s, OCI-runc).

  • AI Tooling: Demonstrated ability to integrate AI/LLM tools (e.g., Gemini, Claude) into the pentesting lifecycle to increase speed and coverage.

  • Web Application Security: Expert-level knowledge of web application security principles and offensive testing methodologies, with deep proficiency in OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities, modern web framework exploitation, and API security (REST, WebSockets). Extensive hands-on experience conducting manual security assessments using Burp Suite Professional, OWASP ZAP, or similar tooling. Strong understanding of browser security mechanisms (CSP, CORS, SameSite cookies, Subresource Integrity), secure authentication/authorization patterns (OAuth 2.0, OIDC, JWT), and security header configurations (HSTS, X-Frame-Options, Permissions-Policy). Proven ability to identify complex security flaws beyond automated scanner detection, validate findings through proof-of-concept development, and provide actionable remediation guidance to engineering teams.

  • Security Automation: Proficiency in Python, Go, or Bash to eliminate "toil" — writing custom scripts and tooling to automate vulnerability discovery, validate security controls, and streamline testing workflows.

  • Infrastructure as Code: Solid grasp of Terraform and cloud-native deployment patterns; able to interpret and audit complex HCL files to identify misconfigurations before they are provisioned.

  • Communication: Ability to write high-quality technical reports that Product Teams can easily understand and act upon.

Preferred / Nice to Have:

  • Experience with Gatekeeper policies and Binary Authorization.

Our Compensation and Benefits

At Menlo Security, Base Salary is one part of our competitive total compensation and benefits package and is determined using a salary range. The base salary range for this role is 158,000 CAD - 237,000 CAD.

In accordance with Canadian law, the range provided is Menlo Security’s reasonable estimate of the base compensation for this role. The actual amount may be higher or lower, based on non-discriminatory factors such as experience, knowledge, skills, abilities, and location. All employees may be eligible to become Menlo Security shareholders through eligibility for stock-based compensation grants, which are awarded to employees based on company and individual performance.

Menlo Security does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firm recruiters. Fees will not be paid in the event a candidate submitted by a recruiter without an agreement in place is hired; such resumes will be deemed the sole property of Menlo Security.

Menlo Security is an equal opportunity employer. All aspects of employment will be based on merit, competence, performance, and business needs. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, marital status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic information, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other status protected under federal, state, or local law.

Follow us on LinkedIn!

Why Menlo?

At Menlo, we don't settle for the status quo — in our technology or our culture. How we think and act is just as important as what we build. Our culture is defined by five core mindsets: Proactive Leadership, Straight Talk, United Impact, Elevated Talent, and Customer-Compelled. We take ownership and drive outcomes without waiting to be told. We communicate directly and seek hard truths. We break down silos and win together. We hold a high bar for ourselves and the people around us. And we treat every customer interaction as mission-critical. If you're someone who sees it, owns it, solves it, and does it — you'll thrive here.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, color, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or on the basis of disability.

Menlo Security’s policy is to only accept resumes from agencies via Ashby (ATS). Agencies must have a valid services agreement executed and must have been assigned by the Talent team to a specific requisition. Any resume submitted outside of this process will be deemed the sole property of Menlo Security. In the event a candidate submitted outside of this policy is hired, no fee or payment will be paid.

title: Senior Lifecycle Manager
descriptionHtml:
Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US.

As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations.

Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow.

The Role

Synthesia is growing fast, and lifecycle is how we turn that growth into lasting customer relationships, guiding every user from first signup to real value. Every month we send 150+ emails to 1+ million contacts, and as we launch new products and enter new markets, that scale and its impact on revenue will keep rising.

As Senior Lifecycle Manager, you’ll build one of the most exciting lifecycle programmes in Europe. You’ll own the product-led growth motion after signup: the journeys that turn new users into activated, paying and expanding customers. You’ll build automations triggered by what users do in the product and set the standard for how every customer-facing email Synthesia sends works together as one experience. You’ll partner with Product, Product Marketing and Data teams to build a lifecycle engine that grows with the company.

What You'll Do

  • Customer journeys: Design, build and optimise lifecycle journeys that support customers throughout their experience with Synthesia, from activation, adoption and engagement through to expansion, retention and winback.

  • Lifecycle automation: Own the end-to-end implementation of lifecycle programmes, from audience segmentation and behavioural triggers to workflow logic, suppression rules, QA and performance monitoring.

  • Experimentation: Develop and execute structured experiments to continuously improve lifecycle performance. Test messaging, timing, segmentation and journey design, analyse results and turn learnings into actionable improvements.

  • Data-driven personalisation: Leverage product usage, customer attributes and engagement signals to deliver increasingly relevant lifecycle experiences.

  • Lifecycle quality and deliverability: Own campaign QA and testing processes, support email deliverability and sender reputation and help establish best practices for segmentation, frequency management and customer experience.

  • AI-powered lifecycle: Explore and apply AI to make lifecycle marketing more effective and efficient. From content creation and dynamic personalisation to workflow automation, identify opportunities to improve both the customer experience and how we work.

We’d love to hear from you if you have

  • You deliver impact: You understand how lifecycle marketing contributes to activation, adoption, retention and revenue, and you can demonstrate measurable results from programmes you’ve owned

  • You’re analytical and curious: You use data to understand performance, challenge assumptions and continuously improve what you build

  • You think in customer journeys: You look beyond individual emails to understand the customer experience, identify friction and create relevant, connected communications

  • You’re technically excellent: You’re confident building sophisticated automation, managing complex segmentation and working with customer and product data. You care about the details that make programmes effective and reliable

  • You take ownership: You’re comfortable independently leading initiatives from concept through execution, proactively solving problems and making informed decisions

  • You collaborate naturally: You know how to work across functions, build strong relationships and move complex projects forward without direct authority

  • You care about quality: From deliverability and data accuracy to messaging and customer experience, you hold your work to a high standard

  • You’re excited about AI: You actively explore how emerging technologies can improve personalisation, experimentation and the way lifecycle marketing operates

We’d be particularly excited if

  • 6+ years of experience in lifecycle, CRM or email marketing, ideally in B2B SaaS or product-led companies

  • Strong hands-on experience with HubSpot, including complex workflows, list building, segmentation and campaign execution

  • Proven experience building and optimising always-on automated programmes, including onboarding, nurture and re-engagement, alongside one-off campaigns

  • Experience owning lifecycle initiatives end to end, from briefing and journey design to implementation, QA, reporting and optimisation

  • Strong analytical skills, with experience using product, CRM and engagement data to build audiences, evaluate performance and run structured experiments

  • Practical experience using AI to improve lifecycle execution, operational efficiency or customer personalisation

  • Working knowledge of email deliverability, including SPF, DKIM and DMARC, and privacy regulations such as GDPR and CCPA/CPRA

  • Proven ability to manage complex cross-functional projects and influence stakeholders across different teams

Nice to have

  • Experience with customer data platforms

  • Experience with Salesforce, particularly connecting CRM and account data to lifecycle programmes

  • Experience with in-product messaging and multichannel lifecycle journeys

  • SQL skills for self-serve behavioural analysis and insights

Compensation

We offer a competitive salary, equity and benefits. Your offer will reflect your experience, skills and the scope of the role. The range for this position is £70,000 - £90,000 GBP, and we are open to discussing where you land within it, or beyond it, for exceptional experience.

title: Senior Manager, CRM Marketing, Europe
descriptionHtml:
About Crunchyroll

Founded by fans, Crunchyroll delivers the art and culture of anime to a passionate community. We super-serve over 100 million anime and manga fans across 200+ countries and territories, and help them connect with the stories and characters they crave. Whether that experience is online or in-person, streaming video, theatrical, games, merchandise, events and more, it’s powered by the anime content we all love.

Join our team, and help us shape the future of anime!

About the role

Crunchyroll is seeking a Senior Manager, CRM Marketing to lead localized CRM engagement for our European markets, one of our fastest-growing regions. Based in London, this role will own the CRM campaign calendar for the region, balancing high-velocity title moments and catalog beats while bringing our biggest anime moments to life across owned channels.

You will plan and execute high-impact, fan-first campaigns that support title launches and catalog discovery—including new season/series drops, dub drops, mid-season arcs, and finales for top-tier titles. Success in this role requires strong segmentation and analytical judgment, plus the ability to translate IP into messaging that creates an emotional connection with fans.

You’ll also act as a subject matter expert for the Europe market, championing transcreation and locally resonant storytelling (not just translation), cultural nuance, and fan-first engagement. You’ll partner closely with our global Lifecycle Marketing team that owns always-on lifecycle journeys; in this role, you will serve as a regional advisor and ensure key title moments and local insights are reflected in the broader lifecycle strategy.

What You’ll Do

  • CRM Campaign Calendar Ownership: Own the CRM campaign calendar for Europe across tentpole releases, seasonal beats, and catalog programming, aligning timing, targeting strategy, and channel plans with local and global priorities (across multiple markets, languages, and time zones).
  • Go-to-Market Campaigns: Collaborate with regional marketing, brand, programming, and curation teams to design localized go-to-market moments for major content launches, seasonal events, partnerships, and fan activations.
  • Segmentation & Audience Strategy: Apply best practices in personalization and segmentation to build targeted campaigns informed by fan behavior, affinities, regional nuances, and language/dub preferences. Partner with Data Science and Growth teams to refine audience definitions, identify opportunities, and improve precision over time.
  • Regional Market Expertise: Serve as Crunchyroll’s CRM market lead for Europe, advising on cultural nuances, local market behaviors, local platform norms, channel norms, and fan engagement opportunities.
  • Localized Lifecycle Strategy: Provide regional inputs into Europe lifecycle journey strategies across acquisition, onboarding, engagement, retention, and winback, working closely with our Lifecycle Marketing team. Ensure best practices in personalization, segmentation, and lifecycle orchestration.

Own content-triggered messaging strategy that supports title moments and engagement in alignment with lifecycle standards and guardrails.
  • Cross-Functional Partnership: Work with Regional Marketing, Product, Brand, Content, Creative, Data Science, and GTM teams to create cohesive fan experiences and ensure lifecycle campaigns align with both local and global priorities.
  • Performance & Optimization: Analyze CRM campaign performance, identify opportunities, and apply insights to continuously improve effectiveness and fan impact through test-and-learn approaches, including cohort analysis and incrementality-minded measurement.
  • Innovation & Experimentation: Stay ahead of market dynamics and messaging ecosystems (multilingual markets, consent and preference management, deliverability best practices, local payment behaviors, and evolving platform changes across iOS/Android) to evolve CRM campaign strategy and execution.

About You

  • 8+ years of experience in CRM, retention, or subscriber engagement marketing, ideally within streaming, digital subscription, gaming, e-commerce, or entertainment.
  • Strong experience with Braze (or comparable orchestration platforms) with a focus on campaign planning/execution, segmentation, triggers, and multi-channel delivery.
  • Deep knowledge of European consumer behaviors, digital marketing platforms, and messaging ecosystems (including WhatsApp where applicable), with experience operating in privacy-first environments.
  • Strong creative acumen and storytelling ability—capable of translating IP into fan-first messaging that builds emotional connection and drives action.
  • Strong analytical skills to interpret performance data, develop insights, and translate them into targeting and creative optimizations.
  • Proven ability to collaborate across regional and global teams in a fast-paced, matrixed environment.
  • Passion for anime, entertainment, or fan-first brands is highly valued. 
  • Additional proficiency in relevant regional languages is a plus.

The Lifecycle Marketing team curates personalized journeys that strengthen fan loyalty and lifetime value. With data-driven insights and fan-first creativity, we connect users to the right experiences at the right moments across owned channels.

title: Senior Manager, Customer Support, Deliveroo Operations
descriptionHtml:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Why Deliveroo?

Our mission is to transform the way people shop and eat, connecting consumers, restaurants, shops, and riders to bring the neighbourhood to their door. We're redefining convenience by giving customers the ability to buy what they want, as they want it, when and where they want it.

Deliveroo is a technology-driven company at the forefront of one of the world's most dynamic industries. We are a relatively small team making a very large impact, moving fast, valuing ownership, and tackling some of the most interesting challenges in global commerce. We're driven by innovation, autonomy, and the ambition to deliver exceptional experiences for our customers, partners, and riders alike.

What You'll Be Doing

You will own frontline operational performance across two closely linked parts of Deliveroo's customer support network: an in-house Global Escalations team of around 50 agents based across the UK and Georgia, and the outsourced network delivering support on our behalf through three BPO partners and three Shared Service Centres, circa 1,500 agents across multiple locations, including the team leads and ops managers embedded within those outsourced functions.

Global Escalations sits at the heart of Deliveroo's most critical customer moments. The team manages our most sensitive, high-risk, and high-impact contacts, including complaints escalated to the Executive team. As the leader directly accountable for this recovery-focused centre of excellence, you will ensure the team operates with exceptional skill, judgement, and empathy, protecting Deliveroo's reputation, driving improvement through root cause analysis, and embedding a culture of integrity and customer-first recovery across the organisation.

For the outsourced network, you own how performance is delivered day to day, working closely with the team leads and ops managers embedded in each BPO and Shared Service Centre, not just the vendor relationship at arm's length. You own the operational rigour needed to make the network the best in class, from an experience and consistency perspective, across every market it supports.

Your key objective is to drive qualitative improvements to the customer experience, measured through CSAT, while balancing cost metrics like average handling time (AHT) and refund costs, rather than trading one off against the other. You will be the voice of Support to Deliveroo's market General Managers, taking full accountability for the Support experience in your markets, and you will partner closely with cross-functional Support & Operations teams, including Workforce Management, Training, Quality, and Policy, to drive initiatives that positively impact all three sides of the marketplace: customers, riders, and merchants.

You Will…

  • Own frontline operational performance delivered through the in-house Global Escalations team (UK and Georgia) and the outsourced network (3 BPOs, 3 Shared Service Centres, circa 1,500 agents), including the team leads and ops managers within those outsourced functions
  • Lead and develop the Global Escalations team directly, managing our most sensitive and reputation-critical contacts with judgement, empathy, and rigorous root cause analysis
  • Drive qualitative improvements to the customer experience, tracked through CSAT, while balancing cost metrics like AHT and refund costs
  • Act as the voice of Support to Deliveroo market GMs, taking full accountability for the Support experience in your markets and representing their priorities back into the function
  • Partner with Support & Operations cross-functional teams, including Workforce Management, Training, Quality, and Policy, to drive initiatives that improve the experience for customers, riders, and merchants
  • Design and run performance frameworks that hold BPO and SSC team leads and ops managers accountable for quality, SLA adherence, and CSAT, fostering a culture of partnership rather than pure oversight
  • Standardise processes and playbooks across outsourced partners and sites where it drives consistency, while respecting genuine market and site-specific differences
  • Diagnose and help bring down attrition and quality issues across the outsourced network, working with BPO and SSC leadership on the retention, engagement, and workforce planning changes needed
  • Partner with Product and Technology to shape the roadmap for customer support systems and channel strategy, identifying opportunities to enhance efficiency and automation across both in-house and outsourced teams
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with stakeholders across HR, Legal, and Policy to ensure service delivery evolves in line with business priorities
  • Drive data-informed improvement through analysis of contact drivers, escalation themes, and customer sentiment, translating insight into action for both Global Escalations and the outsourced network
  • Represent the function at relevant Weekly Business Reviews and senior forums, providing visibility on performance, risk, and recovery across both the in-house team and the outsourced network
  • Participate in the 24/7 Leadership Team on-call rota
  • Shape functional strategy and set OKRs for contact centre Support across Deliveroo markets, growing the remit from directing your own team to leading leaders, in line with DoorDash's Team Management career framework
  • Grow and develop the managers and leaders within your network, including Team Leads inside Global Escalations and the team leads and ops managers at each BPO and Shared Service Centre, building the next generation of people leaders

Skills & Experience You'll Need

  • Extensive contact centre, BPO, or shared service centre leadership experience in a fast-paced, consumer-facing environment
  • Proven experience managing outsourced or vendor relationships at scale, including the team lead and ops manager layer embedded within partner organisations, not just the commercial relationship
  • Experience leading escalations or complaint handling in a reputation-sensitive environment, with strong judgement and the ability to drive recovery from the most sensitive customer moments
  • A track record of bringing consistency and governance across multiple outsourced partners while respecting genuine local and market differences
  • Experience diagnosing and reducing attrition while improving quality, in a large-scale, multi-site support operation
  • A data-driven approach to balancing customer experience (CSAT) against cost metrics such as AHT and refund rate, without trading one off blindly against the other
  • Experience representing a support or operations function to senior commercial stakeholders, such as General Managers or market leadership, taking full accountability for their experience of the function
  • Experience partnering with cross-functional teams such as Workforce Management, Training, Quality, and Policy to drive improvements across a multi-sided marketplace
  • Exceptional stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders and work cross-functionally with Product, Legal, Policy, and People teams
  • Strong analytical ability, comfortable turning contact driver, escalation, and sentiment data into action
  • Strong people leadership skills, with experience building and developing a dispersed in-house team and driving performance indirectly through partner leadership
  • A self-starter mindset, a can-do attitude, and willingness to be hands-on in a fast-moving, multi-geography environment
  • Proven strategic mindset with a track record of shaping and executing operational strategies across multiple markets and vendors
  • Deep operational understanding, including customer service design, vendor management, and process optimisation
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver results in high-volume, complex environments with multiple priorities
  • Experience partnering with Product and Tech to drive tooling, system, and automation improvements
  • A mindset focused on continuous improvement, customer advocacy, and operational excellence
  • Demonstrated ability to operate at a 'leads leaders' level per DoorDash's Levels and Expectations framework (Team Management track): shaping strategy and OKRs beyond your own team, and developing managers who in turn develop their own teams
  • Meets the senior people-leadership bar DoorDash expects at this level: effectively leads a high-performing team, fosters a culture of belonging and engagement, and takes full accountability for the people outcomes of a large, dispersed organisation

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!

title: Senior Manager, People Advisors
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $200M+ in ARR, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.

  • We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.

  • We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

  • We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.


The role
You will establish Legora's first local People Advisory layer, building the team and its capability from the ground up. Reporting to the Director of People Operations, you will define market coverage, lead hiring and onboarding, and develop a distributed team of People Advisors. Your team will provide practical local advice, handle casework and build managers' confidence in handling people matters.

You will establish an AI-first way of working across Advisory: simplifying processes, turning local knowledge into reusable guidance, and using AI to improve preparation, documentation and access to advice.

You will partner with Employee Relations & Compliance on jurisdictional standards, certification and sensitive casework; People Business Partners on local business needs; and People Operations on service delivery. With People Tech & Data, you will turn requirements into reliable tools and workflows for employees and managers.


What you'll own

  • Team build and capability. Establish the Advisory team from the ground up. Coach Advisors towards independent delivery, setting clear expectations for service and judgement.

  • Local advisory delivery. Build a trusted, visible People presence in each market, with Advisors who understand local business needs and build strong relationships with employees and managers.

  • Casework quality and escalation. Oversee probation, performance and absence cases. Ensure clear records and immediate escalation to Employee Relations & Compliance when matters become formal, contested or legally sensitive.

  • Manager enablement. Equip Advisors to coach managers through people matters. Turn recurring questions into practical guidance and AI-supported resources, equipping managers to take ownership of their decisions.

  • Local policy and process. Close gaps in local policies, playbooks and processes with the relevant owners. Keep guidance current and usable, securing Employee Relations & Compliance approval where required.

  • Jurisdictional readiness. Partner with Employee Relations & Compliance on Advisor certification, training and calibration, addressing gaps in capability and casework quality early.

  • Partnership with People Operations. Give Specialists clear local guidance and escalation routes. Partner on self-service content and workflows so routine requests resolve quickly and judgement-based matters reach Advisors.

  • Local delivery. Coordinate Advisor support for people programs, organisational changes and new markets with People Business Partners, People Programs and Market Expansion.

  • Performance and insights. Use case reviews, service data and feedback to improve quality, response times and manager experience. Share emerging risks and measure the impact of AI and process improvements.


What you'll bring

  • 7+ years in HR generalist, People Advisory or operational HR roles, including leading a team across markets in a growing international company.

  • Strong experience of coaching and advising managers, challenging constructively and overseeing probation, performance and absence cases, with clear judgement on when specialist support is needed.

  • Knowledge of employment practices across multiple jurisdictions, and the ability to work effectively with local experts.

  • A track record of building local HR capability and closing policy and process gaps with practical, usable guidance.

  • Practical experience applying AI to advisory work, knowledge management or case administration, with the ability to test outputs, drive adoption and demonstrate improvements.

  • Comfort working in a tiered People model, with clear boundaries between operations, local advisory, People Business Partners and specialist teams.

  • A hands-on leadership style, strong stakeholder relationships and a high bar for documentation, confidentiality and the quality of advice.

  • Fluency in English, which is our working language.

Why this role

People Advisory brings local expertise closer to the employees and managers who need it, helping the business move fast with confidence. You will build that capability from the ground up: hiring and developing trusted Advisors across our markets, combining local judgement with consistent standards, and using AI to make expertise easier to access. It’s an opportunity to shape a new team at one of the most exciting companies in tech and set the standard for how local people support scales globally.

Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer

At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Senior Manager, Revenue Operations, DashOS EMEA
descriptionHtml:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

About the Team

DashOS is DoorDash's merchant technology platform. It brings together the products restaurants and local businesses use to run their own business, sell on their own channels and keep their guests coming back, including online ordering, websites and apps, and loyalty. DashOS connects these tools with the demand and growth learnings of the DoorDash, Wolt and Deliveroo marketplaces, so merchants can grow both on our marketplaces and on their own channels.

In EMEA, we are building DashOS market by market. The team is small and works like a startup within the larger DoorDash. When joining DashOS, you will help shape a new business from an early stage: what we offer merchants to fuel their growth, how we take it to market and how we support merchants once they are live.

Our Strategy & Operations team builds the DashOS business end to end in EMEA: what we focus on, how we measure success, and the playbooks that make growth repeatable. We work in small cross-functional pods that find improvement opportunities, launch and iterate, together with Product, Engineering, Analytics, Finance, Legal, Marketing, our merchant and consumer teams.

About the Role

We are now looking for a Senior Manager, Revenue Operations to build the commercial engine behind DashOS. You will own the systems, numbers and operating rhythm that turn a multi-product strategy into predictable revenue, across all DoorDash, Wolt and Deliveroo markets in EMEA.

What you'll be doing

As the Senior Manager, Revenue Operations for DashOS EMEA, you will partner directly with DashOS commercial leadership to co-own the go-to-market plan and run the operating cadence for the sales and account management teams selling DashOS. This is a senior individual contributor role for a builder: you will set up the tracking and planning foundations, then use them to make the sales organisation measurably better.

Day-to-day in this role you'll:

  • Build the revenue tracking infrastructure: own our CRM setup and the data flows into our BI stack, so pipeline, activities and revenue for every DashOS product live in one place
  • Run the commercial operating cadence, including pipeline tracking, pacing and weekly forecasting with sales and account managers, and own the DashOS commercial narrative to EMEA leadership
  • Own sales planning across markets: set targets and quotas through bottom-up and top-down allocation, and design books of business, territories and coverage models that match our growth goals
  • Turn sales performance data into action by building dashboards that act as the single source of truth for account-level performance and risk, and surfacing insights that managers and sellers can act on
  • Design and roll out incentive systems, including MBOs, SPIFFs and variable compensation, together with Finance, so sales and account managers own DashOS revenue alongside marketplace revenue
  • Make DashOS part of the core commercial motion, so it shows up in every account manager's book of business, account plans and business reviews rather than running on the side
  • Automate and scale with AI, removing manual work for sellers and managers (e.g. pre-populated account plans, automated pipeline views) so teams spend their time with merchants

Our humble expectations

  • Significant experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Strategy & Operations or a similar commercial role, ideally in a fast-growing tech company. A management consulting background is a plus.
  • A track record in sales planning: quota and target setting, territory and book-of-business design, and forecasting cadences for a multi-market sales organisation.
  • Hands-on with data and systems. You are comfortable with SQL and BI tools (e.g. Looker, Tableau) and have worked deeply in a CRM such as Salesforce. You build things yourself rather than only writing specs.
  • Experience designing incentive models, variable pay structures, SPIFFs and performance tracking across commercial teams.
  • A builder and generalist who is comfortable with ambiguity, can take a broad mandate and turn it into concrete outputs, and doesn't need a fully built stack to deliver.
  • A clear communicator and trusted partner to senior leaders, able to translate data into a commercial narrative and build alignment across Sales, Finance and Product.
  • Strong understanding of distinct sales motions, including Enterprise Sales, SMB Sales and Account Management. Experience with multi-product or platform sales is a plus.
  • Bonus: experience using AI and automation to scale commercial operations.

Why join us

You will do work that matters and help build one of DoorDash's next big bets. Working here, you can expect to:

  • Make a visible impact every day, directly improving how merchants run and grow their business.
  • Learn fast in an entrepreneurial environment, with autonomy, pace and real responsibility.
  • Build a career, not just a role, as DashOS grows across EMEA.
  • Deliver together in an inclusive, diverse and values-driven culture, with big hearts and small egos.

Next steps

If you are excited about building a new business from an early stage and taking real ownership, click below to apply, add your CV and get the conversation going! We review applications on an ongoing basis. 💙

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

title: Senior Manager,  UK Security (R6499)
descriptionHtml:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and  

Shield AI is a defence technology company building intelligent autonomous systems for defence programmes. We are seeking a Senior Manager, UK Security to establish and lead the UK industrial security capability required to pursue and deliver sensitive Ministry of Defence, allied-government, and prime-contractor programmes.

This hands-on leader will serve as Shield AI's senior UK security adviser and, subject to government approval and contractual need, perform the appropriate Facility Security Controller and Personnel Security Controller responsibilities. The role will align UK operations with Shield AI's global framework while preserving UK sovereign requirements and government direction.

What You'll Do

  • Establish and manage Shield AI's UK security programme across personnel, physical, information, cyber-enabled, and operational security.

  • Lead readiness for Facility Security Clearance (FSC) and Industry Personnel Security Assurance (IPSA), including gap assessments, secure-site preparations, evidence, corrective actions, and continuing assurance.

  • Serve as the principal interface with MoD contracting authorities, the Industry Security Assurance Centre (ISAC), United Kingdom Security Vetting (UKSV), customers, and prime contractors.

  • Establish and administer the authorised national security vetting process through NSVS, including role validation, sponsorship, clearance verification, transfers, renewals, aftercare, and cessation.

  • Partner with programme owners to identify positions requiring BPSS, SC, enhanced SC, DV, or other directed vetting, based on contractual need and need-to-know.

  • Advise Capture, Business Development, Contracts, Legal, and Programme teams on Security Aspects Letters, DEFCONs, classification guidance, flow-down obligations, costs, schedules, and risks.

  • Develop UK company security instructions, policies, risk assessments, appointment letters, procedures, registers, training, and inspection-ready records.

  • Lead secure-facility and classified-asset controls, including access, storage, accounting, transmission, destruction, visitor management, Requests for Visit, IVCO coordination, and classified logistics.

  • Coordinate with Cybersecurity and IT on secure systems, remote-working controls, government assurance, incident response, and remediation.

  • Work with product security, engineering, Cybersecurity and programme teams to identify UK customer security requirements early, support Secure by Design activities, and ensure product security risks, decisions and assurance evidence are tracked through the lifecycle.

  • Manage UK security incidents, aftercare reporting, foreign ownership or influence concerns, insider and supply-chain risks, and required government notifications.

  • Build metrics, budgets, vendors, and the UK security team as the business grows; support occasional out-of-hours response and UK or international travel.

  • Maintain a UK security risk register covering personnel, physical, information and programme security. Work with Cybersecurity and IT to identify and track relevant cyber risks, and advise or escalate material risks to UK leadership and the Board Level Contact.

Required Qualifications

  • Eight or more years of progressively responsible industrial, government, defence, intelligence, or corporate security experience, including ownership of a UK defence-security programme.

  • Experience serving as, or directly supporting, a UK Facility Security Controller, Personnel Security Controller, Security Controller, or comparable senior supplier-security role.

  • Practical experience with FSC or IPSA readiness and assurance, UKSV sponsorship, NSVS administration, SC or DV aftercare, and government inspection activity.

  • Strong knowledge of the Government Security Classifications Policy, GovS 007: Security, the UK Security Policy Framework, and MoD supplier and contract-security requirements.

  • Experience establishing or operating secure facilities and controls for classified information, systems, material, visitors, and international engagements.

  • Strong leadership, judgement, discretion, writing, and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to translate requirements into practical processes in a fast-paced technology environment.

  • British nationality, or qualifying dual nationality including British nationality, subject to government restrictions for designated security-controller duties.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Current SC or DV clearance and prior appointment as a Facility Security Controller or Personnel Security Controller for an FSC- or IPSA-assured supplier.

  • Experience standing up a security programme or secure facility and supporting multinational defence, NATO, allied, or AUKUS-related work.

  • Relevant degree, professional certification, or recognised security-body membership; working knowledge of U.S. industrial security and export-control requirements is advantageous.

  • Working knowledge of applicable MOD security policy, including JSP 440, and the ability to identify and implement the security requirements specified in contracts.

  • Familiarity with the MOD Cyber Security Model, Defence Standard 05-138, Defence Cyber Certification, Cyber Essentials and supplier security obligations.

title: Senior Marketing Manager, Integrated Marketing
descriptionHtml:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our Brand & Experience team builds the emotional connection between Deliveroo and our customers, riders, and partners. With a deep understanding of our audience and a passion for creativity, we bring our brand to life across every touchpoint. Whether it's a push notification, social campaign, or packaging design—we craft compelling experiences that shape perceptions, spark engagement, and make Deliveroo a loved, global brand.

We're looking for a Senior Marketing Manager, Brand Integrated Marketing to join our London team. This is a hybrid role. In this role, you'll help us take ideas from global strategy through to local activation across markets, delivering integrated campaigns that drive measurable business growth.

What You'll Be Doing

What You'll Need to Thrive

  • Stakeholder Influence: Demonstrated ability to influence and align senior cross-functional stakeholders and matrix teams without direct line management authority.

  • Strategic & Tactical Execution: Proven ability to operate independently on complex or ambiguous briefs, balancing day-to-day execution with longer-term brand strategy.

  • Commercial Acumen: Strong expertise in linking brand initiatives and marketing campaigns directly to measurable business growth and commercial impact.

Nice to Have

  • Experience navigating three-sided marketplace dynamics or fast-paced consumer tech environments.

  • Background working across international or multi-market structures.

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you'll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that's constantly evolving.

We're food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

🔧 Make a visible impact every day

Your work directly improves experiences for customers, partners and riders.

🌱 Learn fast in an entrepreneurial environment

Work close to the market with autonomy, pace and real responsibility.

🧠 Build a career, not just a role

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

title: (Senior) Marketing Manager mit Entwicklungsperspektive (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:

Du hast Lust auf genau diese Vielfalt? Du denkst strategisch, packst operativ mit an und möchtest nicht nur Konzepte entwickeln, sondern selbst etwas bewegen?

title: Senior Mechanical Engineer - Robotics (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
What We’re Building Towards

At Omegga, we're on a mission to reinvent how AI and spectroscopy can drive positive change for animals, people and the planet. We started with a clear objective: eliminate chick culling on a global scale through early, non-invasive detection. This outdated practice still impacts billions of lives, and we're here to change that. We're not building for the niche, we're building for the global standard.

Today, our systems are already in use, and the focus is on scaling performance, robustness, and deployment across an international customer base. For us, scaling means more than growth. It means changing an industry for the better.

We are looking for people who take ownership, think in systems, and want to help turn a working product into the industry benchmark. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.

What We’re Looking For

We're looking for a hands-on engineer to take full ownership of new robotic subsystems from first idea to production-ready hardware. You combine strong mechanical design skills with practical lab experience and a keen sense for manufacturability. Above all, you're someone who doesn't wait to be told what's next. You see what needs to happen, take initiative, and enjoy working openly in a fast-moving, international team that's growing together.

You take ownership end to end, hold yourself to a high standard, and focus on outcomes that matter for the customer. You communicate openly, give honest feedback, and build trust through your actions. You believe the best work happens in an environment where people support each other, share knowledge, and grow together.

What You’ll Build

  • Own the full development cycle of robotic subsystems, from concept through rapid prototyping, iterative improvement, and deployment

  • Design complex mechanical systems and integrate mechanical and electrical components into functional robotics solutions

  • Build and test prototypes hands-on, including assembly, troubleshooting, and iterative validation

  • Collaborate with the electronics and software team on system integration and performance

  • Optimize designs for manufacturability and assembly to enable scalable production

  • Manage outsourcing partners and suppliers to transition prototypes into production-ready systems

What You Bring

  • Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Robotics, or related field

  • 3+ years experience in automation/robotics, with strong track record designing complex electromechanical systems, from prototype to production

  • Hands-on mindset with a passion for building, testing, and troubleshooting real-world systems and solid CAD skills (e.g. SolidWorks, Onshape, Fusion)

  • Proven experience of optimizing designs in compact electromechanical systems, environmental sealing, and design for manufacturing

  • Experience with manufacturing, supplier collaboration, and design for scalable production

  • A proactive, ownership-driven mindset. You naturally identify what needs to happen next, collaborate openly in an international team, and are eager to grow alongside it

Not ticking every box? That's okay. If this role excites you and you bring most of what we've described, we want to hear from you.

What You’ll Get

Mission & Technical Challenge: At Omegga, you work on problems that are both technically demanding and globally relevant. We build deep-tech solutions with real-world impact, pushing the boundaries of what's currently possible.

Relocation Support: Moving to Munich? We help you find an apartment in the Werksviertel within walking distance of the office. We connect you with the right contacts and take the stress out of apartment hunting.

Work Environment: Located in Munich's Werksviertel, we combine a focused, high-performance culture with flexibility. Up to 50% remote work, depending on role and execution needs.

Ownership: VSOPs (Virtual Stock Options) so you share in the value you help create.

Time Off: 28 vacation days per year, plus December 24th and 31st off.

Benefits & Growth

  • Monthly meal budget for whatever keeps you going, from quick lunches to proper team dinners

  • Monthly perks budget to spend where it actually matters to you — fitness, mobility, or the occasional "I earned this" purchase

  • Annual learning budget to invest in your growth, from conferences to deep dives into new domains

  • Free drinks, coffee, and snacks in the office to keep you focused throughout the day

title: Senior Mobile Security Developer
descriptionHtml:
Waracle are looking for a Senior Mobile Security Developer for an exciting new role joining our world-class digital technology consultancy, home to a diverse, smart, curious and ambitious community of specialists in technology-driven transformation.

We work with ambitious clients to help them solve their biggest business and customer challenges. We help our clients to innovate and create intelligent digital products and services. We thrive on complex challenges and deliver business-critical IT transformation projects, moving seamlessly from strategy, design and delivery to operations.

This is a Hybrid role, offering the flexibility to balance your professional and personal life, with 2 days a week spent connecting with colleagues in our London or Edinburgh office oron client site.


The Role

As a Senior Mobile Security Developer, you will define squad-level technical architecture and technical approach. You are a technical expert who ensures quality, security, and compliance across projects, driving robust and scalable solutions.

This role will be pivotal in building, delivering, and driving the security of our mobile platform, while being an integral part of our full-stack mobile practice, contributing to end-to-end development and security excellence across both front-end and back-end mobile systems.

Key aspects of the role include:

  • Design and Delivery of a World-Class Security Framework: Lead the design and delivery of security services, including mobile penetration testing, research, consultancy, and advisory engagements.

  • Technical Strategy & Architecture: Define secure technical approaches, identify risks, and develop effective threat models and mitigation strategies.

  • Strategic Planning: Translate business objectives into technical strategy and ensure technical roadmaps align with long-term client goals.

  • Agile Practices: Expertise in Agile methodologies, with a focus on resolving impediments and driving adoption across teams.

  • Client Engagement: Communicate effectively with clients, manage expectations, and provide practical, risk-based security recommendations.

  • Continuous Improvement & Collaboration: Drive innovation, adopt emerging security practices, share knowledge, and support team success.


What you'll bring:

We are seeking a highly technical expert with a strong focus on mobile platform security. You should bring:

  • Mobile Security Expertise: Strong hands-on knowledge of Android and iOS security fundamentals, common mobile threats and vulnerabilities, security architecture, controls, and mitigation techniques.

  • Mobile Security Testing: Practical experience in mobile penetration testing, security assessments, threat modelling, and implementing or assessing security controls.

  • Security Problem Solving: A systematic and analytical approach to identifying, investigating, and resolving mobile security issues.

  • Authentication & Cryptography: Strong understanding of authentication, authorisation, cryptography, encryption, and secure design principles, with the ability to recommend appropriate cryptographic controls.

  • Continuous Improvement: A proactive approach to improving security practices, tooling, controls, and ways of working.

Desirable knowledge & experience:

  • Mobile Security Tooling & Analysis: Experience with reverse engineering, analysis techniques, and tools such as Burp Suite Pro, Frida, Objection, JADX, IDA Pro, Hopper, Radare, ADB, Apktool, YARA, Xcode, and Android Studio.

  • Mobile Development & DevSecOps: Knowledge of Android/iOS development, secure development practices, DevSecOps tooling, testing, and automation frameworks.

  • Development & Reverse Engineering: Familiarity with C, Java, Kotlin, Objective-C, Swift, JavaScript, Python or Bash, and ideally ARM/ARM64 assembly.

  • Security Research: Awareness of emerging security technologies, Cloud security, and developments in mobile operating systems, APIs, tools, and security libraries.

What to expect from our hiring process

  • 1. First Hello: An informal chat with your dedicated Talent Attraction Partner to talk about Waracle, what you want out of your next move, salary, benefits, and office hybrid working model.

  • 2. Craft Showcase: A chance to demonstrate your real-world expertise. Depending on the role, this will be a focused take-home task (capped at 2–3 hours to respect your time) or a practical presentation.

  • 3. Talking Impact: A collaborative deep dive into how you solve problems, work with others, and raise the bar, guided by our core values and competency framework.

Your Talent Attraction Partner will be in your corner through every step right up to your Welcome Ritual on day one

Our Benefits

We believe in supporting our team, inside and outside of work. Here's a glimpse of what you can expect:

  • Rest & Recharge: You'll receive 27 days of annual leave, plus 8 bank holidays, totaling 35 days of holiday to unwind and pursue your passions.

  • Financial Future & Security: Plan for retirement with our company-matched 5% pension contribution. For added peace of mind, we also offer a Death in Service benefit, providing 2 x your annual salary for your loved ones.

  • Health & Wellness: Our Medicash Health Cash Plans help cover everyday healthcare costs, complemented by an Employee Assistance Programme for confidential support, and Group Sickness Cover for peace of mind.

  • Flexible Working: We champion hybrid working, providing a home office setup budget to ensure you're comfortable and productive wherever you are.

  • Learning & Development: Invest in yourself with access to Udemy Business and a dedicated learning and development budget for continuous growth.

  • Lifestyle Perks: Make the most of our Cycle to Work Scheme, and enjoy exclusive gym and retail discounts.

  • Family First: Our enhanced parental leave policies include support for fertility journeys, recognising diverse family needs.

  • Community & Connection: We foster a vibrant culture with regular fun meet-ups and lunch on us in the office once a month. You'll also have the opportunity to make a local impact through Spirit of Waracle, our initiative for getting involved in charitable causes locally, building strong team bonds and giving back.

We are an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from all suitably qualified persons regardless of their race, gender, disability, religion/belief, sexual orientation or age.

title: (Senior) Online Marketing Manager (m/w/d) - Brand Lead im Coaching/Beratungsbereich
descriptionHtml:
Für eine der größten Wachstums-Brands im deutschsprachigen Markt suchen wir jemanden, der Online Marketing nicht nur in einzelnen Bereichen denkt, sondern das große Ganze steuert.

Du übernimmst Ownership für die Brand, hast ihre Zahlen und Funnel im Blick und erkennst, wo der nächste Wachstumshebel liegt. Und dann wartest du nicht darauf, dass jemand anderes ihn umsetzt. Du packst selbst mit an.

Copy muss besser werden? Du passt sie an.
Ein Funnel konvertiert nicht? Du findest heraus, warum.
Wir brauchen neue Creatives? Du entwickelst das Briefing.
Die Zahlen zeigen ein Problem? Du gehst ihm auf den Grund.

Dabei arbeitest du mit Spezialisten aus Media Buying, Creative, Copy und Online Marketing zusammen, aber am Ende bist du die Person, die die große Vision der Brand koordiniert.

Aufgaben

Du...

  • arbeitest zu 100 % auf einer einzigen Brand und tauchst entsprechend tief in ihr Universum ein. Du kennst die Zielgruppe, die Funnel, die Kampagnen und die Zahlen.
  • behältst mehrere laufende Funnel, Kampagnen und Launches gleichzeitig im Blick und weißt jederzeit, was gerade läuft, wo es hakt und was als Nächstes ansteht
  • führst eigenständig die wöchentlichen Marketing- und Projektmeetings mit dem Kunden
  • koordinierst Media Buyer, Creative Strategists, Copywriter und weitere Spezialisten und erstellst klare Briefings
  • sorgst dafür, dass Aufgaben klar verteilt, Deadlines eingehalten und Projekte konsequent abgeschlossen werden
  • behältst sämtliche relevanten KPIs im Blick und erkennst frühzeitig, wenn sich Kampagnen in die falsche Richtung bewegen
  • überprüfst die Arbeit der beteiligten Spezialisten und kannst ihre Ergebnisse fachlich beurteilen
  • gehst bei Bedarf auch selbst in die Umsetzung und optimierst beispielsweise Copy, Landingpages, E-Mails oder bestehende Funnel, wenn du dort einen Hebel siehst
  • entwickelst Ideen für neue Testings, Kampagnen und Optimierungen, um die Ziele der Brand gemeinsam mit uns zu erreichen

Qualifikation

Das solltest du mitbringen:

Wir suchen ausdrücklich keinen Junior und keinen reinen Projektmanager. Du solltest bereits fundierte Erfahrung im Online Marketing mitbringen und bereits selbst Verantwortung übernommen haben.

  • Mindestens 3 Jahre praktische Erfahrung im Online Marketing
  • Fundiertes Verständnis für Funnel, Direct Response Marketing und Customer Journeys
  • Erfahrung mit relevanten KPIs wie CPL, CPA, ROAS und Conversion Rates und die Fähigkeit, daraus konkrete Optimierungen abzuleiten
  • Praktische Erfahrung im Copywriting – insbesondere Hooks, Angles, Offers, Landingpages und E-Mail-Marketing
  • Erfahrung mit der Planung und Umsetzung von Funnels, Kampagnen und Launches
  • Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit bzw. Steuerung von Media Buying, Creative, Copy und externen Dienstleistern
  • die Fähigkeit, bestehende Marketingmaßnahmen fachlich zu beurteilen und selbst zu optimieren
  • eine hohe Bereitschaft, dich schnell und eigenständig in neue Systeme einzuarbeiten
  • idealerweise Erfahrung in einer Agentur, im Coaching-/Beratungsmarkt oder in einem schnell wachsenden Online-Business

Benefits

So arbeitest du bei uns

  • Attraktive Vergütung mit Performance-Provision
  • Vollzeit: 40 Stunden pro Woche
  • unbefristete Festanstellung
  • Remote oder hybrid: Du kannst remote arbeiten oder regelmäßig unser Office in Hamburg nutzen
  • Deutschlandticket: Wenn du hybrid arbeitest, übernehmen wir dein Deutschlandticket
  • Wellpass: Wenn du nach der Arbeit (oder davor) noch Energie übrig hast, kannst du über uns den EGYM Wellpass nutzen
  • Weiterbildung: Du bekommst die Möglichkeit, dich fachlich weiterzuentwickeln und Weiterbildungen innerhalb unserer Branche zu nutzen
  • Mittendrin statt nur am Laptop: Du hast immer wieder die Möglichkeit, bei Masterclasses, Live-Events oder Retreats unserer Kunden dabei zu sein
  • Jährliche Workation: Einmal im Jahr fahren wir als Team gemeinsam für ein paar Tage weg

Wir sind ein kleines Team, das Marketing liebt, eng zusammenarbeitet und richtig Bock auf Wachstum hat. Wir arbeiten mit bekannten Namen der Branche und wollen gemeinsam mit ihnen noch einiges erreichen.

Deshalb passt du gut zu uns, wenn...

  • du Ownership übernehmen willst und es dich antreibt, am Ende auf eine Brand zu schauen und zu wissen: Meine Arbeit hat zu diesem Wachstum beigetragen.
  • du proaktiv arbeitest und nicht auf das nächste Briefing wartest. Du erkennst selbst, was gerade gebraucht wird, setzt Prioritäten und kommst ins Handeln.
  • du Marketing wirklich liebst, dich mit neuen Entwicklungen beschäftigst und gleichzeitig eine Affinität für die Persönlichkeitsentwicklungs-, Coaching- und Beratungsbranche mitbringst.
  • du ambitioniert bist, Dinge ausprobieren, testen und immer wieder besser machen willst – weil Stillstand für dich einfach langweilig ist.
  • du Bock auf ein Team hast, das gemeinsam All-In geht, sich gegenseitig den Rücken freihält und zusammen an einem Ziel arbeitet.

Klingt nach dir?

Dann wollen wir dich besser kennenlernen und vor allem wissen, was du bisher wirklich gemacht hast.

Schick uns neben deinem Lebenslauf gerne Arbeitsproben, Cases oder Projekte, an denen du maßgeblich beteiligt warst. Und erzähl uns kurz:

  • Welche Funnel oder Launches hast du bereits begleitet oder selbst umgesetzt?
  • Welche Aufgaben hast du dabei konkret übernommen?
  • Mit welchen Werbebudgets und KPIs hast du gearbeitet?
