title: Senior Operations Responder
descriptionHtml:
ABOUT TIDE

At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.

Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, Germany and France.

Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.

Tide facts:

  • Tide is available for UK, German and French SMEs
  • Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing
  • Over $300 million raised in funding
  • 3,000 Tideans globally
  • We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

ABOUT THE ROLE

The Tide Security Engineering team is made up of three core areas: Product Security, Identity, Threat Detection & Response

Product Security consists of application and cloud security experts. Their mission is to protect the products we build, covering everything from secure design reviews to threat modelling and penetration testing, ensuring security is embedded from the ground up.

Threat Detection & Response (this role!) focuses on protecting the company by building a robust detection and automation platform. We’re proactive in our defence, constantly hacking ourselves to improve our security posture and staying ahead of emerging threats. Our goal is to make Tide resilient against the ever-evolving threat landscape.

Identity is responsible for managing Tide's staff identity platform, ensuring that access to systems and infrastructure is secure, seamless, and aligned with modern security practices. The team uses strategies like zero trust, multi-factor authentication, and granular role-based access controls to safeguard our internal operations.

While each area has its own focus, collaboration is key - it's why we share the same Slack channel and hold our standups together as one cohesive team, ensuring alignment and seamless communication across all security functions.

As a Security Operations Responder, you’ll be on the front line of defending Tide. Your primary focus is actively investigating threats through our security data lake and SOAR platform – but we don’t want anyone working the same alert by hand twice. Your goal is to make investigation effective at scale: cutting manual effort through automation, and working hand-in-hand with our Detection Engineering team to improve the true positive / false positive efficacy of what lands in the queue.

When the security queue is empty, you’ll be building – automations, enrichment and your own detections. An open mind and a curious approach are key: every investigation is a chance to make the next one faster and sharper.

As a Security Operations Responder, you’ll be:

Investigating and responding to threats (your primary focus)

  • Actively triaging and investigating security alerts and threats through our security data lake and SOAR platform, across AWS, GCP, SaaS (such as Google Workspace and Okta), internal applications and employee endpoints (Windows, macOS).
  • Driving every investigation to a clear, well-evidenced outcome – establishing scope, impact and root cause, and taking containment and remediation actions quickly and confidently.
  • Leading the response to complex or high-severity incidents where needed, coordinating across security, IT and engineering teams through containment, remediation and recovery.
  • Documenting investigations clearly and consistently, and contributing to the runbooks and investigation standards the whole team works to.

Scaling investigation through automation & Improving detection efficacy 

  • Reducing manual investigation by building SOAR playbooks, security automations and services – from data enrichment and context gathering through to automated response, such as removing phishing emails from employee mailboxes. We want you to run with the “anything is possible” mantra.
  • Spotting repetitive work in the queue and turning it into automated workflows, so the team’s time goes on the investigations that genuinely need human judgement.
  • Identifying gaps in log sources, parsing and enrichment in the data lake, and working to close them so investigations have the visibility they need.
  • Feeding investigation outcomes back to the Detection Engineering team – flagging noisy rules, tuning false positives and highlighting coverage gaps – to continuously improve TP/FP efficacy.
  • Tracking investigation metrics (such as MTTD, MTTR, TP/FP rate and automation coverage) and using them to prioritise where to improve next.

Building when the queue is clear

  • Writing, testing and shipping your own detections alongside Detection Engineering, following our test-driven, detections-as-code practices.
  • Proactively hunting for sophisticated threats across our infrastructure, using threat intelligence and lessons from past investigations to stay ahead of attackers.
  • Building or enhancing internal tools that streamline investigation, improve data visibility and increase response efficiency.
  • Sharing knowledge and mentoring other members of the team, raising the bar for how we investigate and respond.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

  • Significant hands-on experience in security operations, incident response or threat investigation, ideally in a cloud-native environment.
  • Strong investigative instincts and log analysis skills at scale, with the ability to query a security data lake or SIEM fluently – strong knowledge of one of the following: Splunk, Scanner, Sentinel, SecOps.
  • Strong understanding of modern attack and defence techniques which apply to Cloud (AWS, GCP), SaaS (such as Google Workspace and Okta) and desktop (Windows and macOS) environments, and the ability to map activity to frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK.
  • Strong experience in security automation, from writing scripts (e.g. Python) to creating end-to-end automated workflows. Familiarity with SOAR platforms and automating investigation and response tasks.
  • Experience writing or tuning detections, and a clear view of what separates a high-fidelity alert from a noisy one.
  • Calm, methodical judgement during live incidents, including knowing when and how to escalate.
  • An open mind and a curious approach – you enjoy pulling on threads, and you don’t stop at “false positives” without understanding why.
  • Hands-on attitude and the ability to drive solutions to completion.
  • Passion for passing on knowledge to fellow colleagues.
  • Excellent spoken and written communication skills, including clear investigation write-ups for both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Bonus points if you have a repository showcasing automations, detections or tooling you’ve built.


WHAT YOU’LL GET IN RETURN: 

  • Competitive salary 
  • Group Life Insurance 
  • Vitality Health Insurance, with a proactive focus on mental and physical wellbeing
  • 24/7 Employee Assistance Programme
  • 25 days holiday with the ability to buy extra days
  • We invest in your development with a £1,000 professional L&D budget per year
  • Access to ‘salary sacrifice’ benefits such as Cycle to Work scheme and pension contribution
  • Spacious brand-new office in Liverpool street with an all-day snacks bar
  • Enhanced family-friendly leave
  • 3 days for L&D or volunteering time off per year
  • Flexible working options
  • Sabbatical leave 
  • Share options

TIDEAN WAYS OF WORKING

At Tide, we champion a flexible workplace model thatsupports both in-person and remote work to cater to the specific needs of our different teams. 

While remote work is supported, we believe in the power of face-to-face interactions to foster team spirit and collaboration. Our offices are designed as hubs for innovation and team-building, where we encourage regular in-person gatherings to foster a strong sense of community.

#LI-MP1

#LI-Remote

TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE

At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members’ diverse needs and lives. 

We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone’s voice is heard.

At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. We welcome all individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability. Our inclusive culture is key to our success, helping us build products that meet our members' diverse needs. We are One Team, committed to transparency and ensuring everyone’s voice is heard.

title: Senior Platform Reliability Engineer, Fabric & Interconnection
descriptionHtml:
Firmus Technologies

Firmus Technologies is a global leader pioneering the development and operation of efficient AI infrastructure across Asia Pacific.  

Founded in Australia in 2019, our mission is to create the most efficient AI infrastructure by combining cutting-edge technology with a steadfast commitment to sustainability. 

At Firmus, we are unique in our approach. We design, build, and operate a new class of digital infrastructure – the AI Factory. Through our model-to-grid technology approach, we have pushed the boundaries of multi-generational liquid cooling systems, energy management, AI software orchestration, and construction. For our customers, this approach allows us to make every watt count and deliver low-cost AI tokens globally. 

Firmus AI Cloud

Our large-scale GPU cloud platform, Firmus AI Cloud, is purpose-built to deliver energy-efficient AI compute at scale to customers. 

It empowers developers, enterprises, educational institutions, and government users to train and deploy AI models with unmatched efficiency and cost savings. With an ever-growing suite of services and applications, we are committed to delivering a cloud experience that is market-leading, proprietary, and built to scale. 

AI FactoryOS Operations 

AI FactoryOS is Firmus' proprietary operating system for the AI Factory. It governs GPU telemetry, cooling, power and grid interaction as one integrated layer, so that every Firmus site can be optimised and monitored as a single system. 

AI FactoryOS Operations runs that platform in production and owns the 24/7 reliability of AI FactoryOS, Firmus AI Cloud and the platforms built on them, together with the service levels the estate is measured against. 

The remit is an engineering one. The function builds the guarded automation, remediation and operational tooling that turn manual response into a software-defined capability, and builds and operates the shared services the estate's own operation depends on. The function works closely with the engineering teams that build the platform, supplying the production evidence that shapes what they fix and what they build next. 

Role Summary  

Firmus runs large-scale, state-of-the-art AI infrastructure built on the latest generation of GPU rack-scale systems and operated as one estate to power the next generation of AI innovation. The Senior Platform Reliability Engineer, Fabric and Interconnect, owns the reliability of the fabrics this estate runs on: the GPU-to-GPU interconnect domains, the high-performance network fabrics carrying training and inference traffic, and the DPU-based host networking that binds compute to the rest of the platform. 

This is a hands-on senior role with deep technical expertise. Automation is a first-class part of the role: the team builds and maintains the guarded automation and remediation tooling that turn manual fabric response into a self-healing capability, and the role engages fabric vendors at engineering level, reproducing faults to their standard and holding them to their answers. 

Key Responsibilities 

  • Responsible for the reliable operation, automation and continuous improvement of the estate's GPU interconnect and network fabrics (for example NVLink and NVSwitch domains, InfiniBand and Spectrum-X). 
  • Build and maintain the guarded automation and remediation tooling for fabric faults, contributing to the software-driven remediation of AI clusters, including fault isolation and fabric reconvergence. 
  • Diagnose and tune performance across the interconnect stack, from application collective communication down to link level, working with technologies including NVLink, InfiniBand, RoCE and congestion control tuning. 
  • Operate DPU-based host networking across the fleet, including offload path configuration and driver and firmware compatibility. 
  • Execute firmware upgrade waves, fabric expansions and capacity changes to the supported paths and scaling patterns defined by AI Infrastructure, owning the production window, the staged or canary path, verification against declared success criteria, and rollback execution. 
  • Provide the deepest technical expertise for fabric and interconnect faults, correlating a collective communication failure to a specific physical link and diagnosing the faults that require internals-level knowledge to root cause, and driving the permanent fix to closure through AI Infrastructure. 
  • Lead vendor escalations at engineering level, reproducing faults to the vendor's standard and pushing back credibly when a diagnosis does not explain the observed behaviour. 
  • Lead technical recovery during major fabric incidents, drive the changes that remove repeat causes, share the follow-the-sun on-call roster, and mentor the engineers who carry frontline diagnosis, documenting operational procedures, runbooks and performance results. 

Skills & Experience 

  • Strong skills in high-performance networking and systems engineering, with 8+ years of experience including substantial ownership of production network or interconnect infrastructure in a 24/7 environment. 
  • Deep operational experience with high-performance GPU interconnect fabrics (for example NVLink and NVSwitch), including domain topology and failure diagnosis. 
  • Extensive experience with high-performance networking fabrics (for example InfiniBand or RoCE-based Ethernet such as NVIDIA Spectrum-X), including routing internals and congestion control tuning. 
  • Experience with DPU or SmartNIC-based host networking, including offload paths and driver and firmware coordination. 
  • Experience planning and executing firmware upgrade waves and capacity expansions on production fabrics with defined rollback. 
  • Strong skills in infrastructure automation and infrastructure-as-code practices, with change delivered through peer review and progressive rollout. 
  • Practical experience with scripting or programming for operational automation and tooling, such as Python, Go or Bash. 
  • Proven ability to act as a senior escalation point in production, including major incident response, on-call participation, vendor escalation at engineering level, and the production of runbooks that others can execute successfully. 
  • Clear technical judgement and communication skills, with the ability to explain complex fabric failures to engineers and non-specialists. 

Preferred Experience 

  • Experience operating fabrics for large-scale distributed training or inference workloads. 
  • Experience with NVIDIA rack-scale or multi-node GPU systems and their interconnect topology. 
  • Experience in a multi-tenant service provider, cloud or colocation environment. 
  • Knowledge of data centre and hardware fundamentals, including cabling and optics, firmware management and hardware fault workflows. 
  • Relevant vendor certification. 

Location & Reporting 

Location: Based in Australia or Singapore, with travel to Australian AI Factory sites as required. 

On-call: The function runs 24/7. First line monitoring and first response sit with the operations centre. This role shares the after-hours escalation roster for its domain with the other senior engineers in the function.

title: Senior Product Designer
descriptionHtml:
We're unlocking access to the NHS, because healthcare is not truly free until it's truly accessible 💙

The world’s best healthcare, for free. It's not a new idea, it's called the NHS. But the largest healthcare provider is fundamentally broken. Patient satisfaction is at an all time low, and the biggest reason cited is lack of access. So we’re on a mission to fix it with technology that actually works.

We're building the front door of UK healthcare, creating a future where one billion NHS appointments are transparent and instantly bookable, and patients are guided to the right service first time using AI.

We're developing critical national infrastructure. Today, 26% of GP practices in England use our patient registration software, while one in five GP practices in London use Bookable Search to help new patients find and book appointments seamlessly.

Our latest product, Bookable Navigator, extends this vision by automatically booking appointments for existing patients.

We operate from within a working GP practice in East London 🏥 We're backed by Y Combinator, Innovate UK and the NHS Clinical Entrepreneur Programme, and were previously ranked the 8th fastest-growing startup in the UK and 33rd fastest-growing in Europe 🚀

⛩️ Our Principles

Exciting challenges lie ahead. Guided by our principles, we’ll meet these challenges with a thoughtful and caring approach. These principles drive everything we do at Healthtech-1:

  1. 💙 Care deeply

  2. 🏋️‍♀️ Work hard

  3. 🤝 Be your word

  4. 💬 Trust in radical truth and transparency

  5.  🚀 Do your life's best work

  6. 🥳 Find the fun

Read more about our principles and our "why" in the Healthtech-1 Handbook.

The role

We're hiring a Senior Product Designer to work directly with our CEO to own the design of the Bookable Navigator Inbox: this is the place where GP practice teams receive, triage and act on every patient request. It's used all day by receptionists, care navigators and clinicians, and every rough edge costs them precious time with patients.

This is for a designer who has spent 5+ years shipping within fast-paced product teams and is looking for the next level up in their career. You'll have a lot of ownership, be expected to stay close to users, and work closely with engineering. If you are hungry, want to work hard, and want a role of a lifetime, we'd love to hear from you.

What you'll do

Get close to users

  • Talk to practice staff regularly: run interviews, sit in on real shifts, and watch how the Inbox gets used

  • Research and scope product tickets before they reach engineering, so we build the right thing

  • Become the user: dogfood the product until you know its friction better than anyone

Use data

  • Dig into product metrics to find where people get stuck, then turn that into design work

  • Measure whether what you shipped actually made things better

Design and ship

  • Take ideas from scrappy MVP through to polished, high-fidelity design

  • Make things simple, beautiful and usable, for people working under real time pressure

  • Work side by side with engineers, from first sketch to what goes live

  • Use AI tools like Claude every day to research, prototype and move faster

About you

  • You've cut your teeth on at least two great products, shipped and used by real people

  • You've worked in a product team, and you've worked at a startup

  • You're obsessed with UI and think about design constantly, down to the spacing on a button

  • You're excited about talking to users and getting close to the problem

  • You have the fire to improve: you seek out feedback and want to get much better quickly

  • You're comfortable with numbers and can make a case from data

  • You already use AI tools in your workflow

Bonus: the best candidates will think like a product manager. You ask why before how, can scope a problem down to what matters, and have opinions about what to build next. We'll explore this in the interview process.

Progression

As AI changes how software gets built, the line between design and product is blurring, and this role sits right on the edges. You'll start owning the Inbox experience, and grow towards owning product decisions end to end.

We want people who could one day found their own company. Here you'll get the reps to do it: real users, real problems in the NHS, and the freedom to work directly with our CEO to shape what we build.

The details

  • Salary: competitive, plus equity

  • Location: London (Stratford), in the office 4 days a week with 1 day (Wed) working from home

💙 A bit about us

💙 We’re all NHS staff. We’re inside-outsiders. Trusted with one of the biggest datasets in the world.

🏥 Our office is within a GP practice. This is our unfair advantage. Got a question? Pop down the corridor. Want to learn how your work affects real patients? Pop downstairs to reception.

💪🏼 4 days in the office and 1 day WFH (for most roles). We highly prioritise in-person communication and prefer candidates who want to work 4+ days a week in the office. Our anchor days are Mon, Tues, Thurs and Fri. Homemade breakfast and lunch are on the house every day when you're in the office, ensuring you're fuelled for success!

🌀 We work in growth cycles. Every 8 weeks we do the same set of activities. 1 week outside of Business-as-Usual to research, strategise, plan our work. 7 weeks to knuckle down and deliver it.

🤝 We’re highly collaborative. One of the benefits of a high trust team is we often work autonomously, but as a team we’re very collaborative by nature. Two heads are often better than one, and we frequently lean on each other to solve problems together.

🤜🏽 We’re backed by industry leaders. We’re on the DigitalHealth.London Accelerator, backed by the NHS Clinical Entrepreneur Program, winners of the London Business School Healthtech Challenge, Innovate UK, and Y Combinator (S23).

🚀 An opportunity for real upside

💉 Paid volunteer days. We offer an additional 2 paid days off per year where you can give back to your mission of choice.

🎢 Every 8 weeks we take a day off to socialise as a team. In the past we’ve hiked box hill, raved at All Points East and spent one rainy day at Thorpe park. This works out as 6 working days a year.

📚 Learning budget of £250 annually and time off to spend it - we care about this; this is flexible and based on need but everyone will receive a yearly allocation towards their continual growth.

🍽️ Homemade breakfast and lunch are on the house when you're in the office, ensuring you're fuelled for success!

🥡 Team takeaways every Monday night

🥗 Health and fitness budget of £60 per month - see more here

🧘‍♂️ An additional 7 days of paid leave is available if you want to take time to learn how to meditate.

💫 Tooling; You’ll have your choice of operating systems and any additional tools you need to do your best work (e.g. keyboard, additional monitors, mouse etc). If you’re on our Engineering teams you’ll receive the latest MacBook Pro and our Growth & Ops teams receives a MacBook Air.

🩺 We know health and family come first which is why we have a generous sick leave policy with additional days that can be taken for mental health leave.

✈️ We prioritise time outside of work to bond, once a year we’ll holiday together! Destination chosen by popular vote. In 2025, we spent 8 days in a surf camp in France!

👎 No private medical insurance, because we believe in the NHS and we are here to improve it!

🐥 Parental leave: Post passing probation it is: statutory - 6 weeks 90% pay then, SMP for 33 weeks; if you've been an employee for a year: 12 weeks 100% pay then, SMP for 27 weeks; and if you have been here for 2 years: 18 weeks 100% pay then, SMP for 21 weeks. This will improve over time. We also include up to £9,000 of childcare contribution for primary caregivers to support a five-day return where possible.

👪 Fertility leave. We understand how difficult a fertility journey can be. This is why we give an extra 5 days off per year if you or your partner are going through fertility treatment.

🐖 Pension - We operate a standard 3% employer contribution and employees auto-contribute 5% of their salary. We use Nest as our provider.

🏡 Local living benefit - A one-off benefit to support living closer to the office: £5,000 if you live within a 30-minute walk, or £2,500 within a 30-minute bike. It is optional, available immediately on signing, and not linked to performance or progression.

🚕 If you choose to work late in the office, you can expense dinner after 7pm and an Uber home after 9pm, or earlier if you feel unsafe travelling in the dark. This is optional and about wellbeing, not performance or expectations.

⛵️And of course, an adventure of a lifetime!

🌈 Inclusive & Diverse by Design

We care about building a product that is loved and a culture that is rich in perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds.

Our team represents more than ten different cultures. We come together every lunch time for a home cooked meal, rotated among team members!

We want everyone in our team to know that they belong. We are purposeful about this and are proactively building a company that is inclusive of all people; from race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, neurodiversity, disability, colour, and national origin - essentially every type of diversity. We don’t just want people who fit in, we want them to fit together. We're active in continually improving the way we make this happen.

title: Senior Product Manager - Data Lake (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
Notre Team Data lake recherche un·e Senior Product Manager (f/m/d) en CDI basé·e à Lille ou Paris

Chez Decathlon, nous croyons au pouvoir du sport pour unir et inspirer. Notre mission : au travers du sport rendre le bien être accessible au plus grand nombre, partout dans le monde. Pour y parvenir, la data est au cœur de notre stratégie, elle guide chaque décision, de la conception du produit à l'expérience client.

Au cœur de l’entité Decathlon Digital, nous recherchons notre futur.e Senior Product Manager pour rejoindre les équipes Data Factory.

Cette plateforme technologique, globale à tout le groupe de manière internationale, soutient le développement de l’usage de la Data et de l’IA chez Decathlon, du calcul du chiffre d’affaires à l’aide de conception de produits innovants.

Nous sommes garants des outils, de la scalabilité, de la mise en place et du respect des bonnes pratiques de développement. Nous accompagnons au quotidien l’ensemble des acteurs métiers tels que Data Analysts, Data Engineers, Analytics Engineers, Data Scientists.

La Data Factory est conçue comme une Modern Data Stack, avec un lakehouse comme centre de gravité.

Elle est ensuite divisée en plusieurs équipes, chacune étant pilotée par un leader technique, avec comme ambition de travailler avec un.e Product Manager attitré.e.

Notre équipe Data Lake est donc la brique fondamentale de cette mission.

Notre mission ? Mettre à disposition des solutions de stockage pour l’ensemble de la Data Platform de Decathlon, tout en garantissant la gouvernance, robustesse et scalabilité par défaut. Véritable pilier de la gouvernance technique du patrimoine de données, notre équipe gère les métadonnées via le metastore Unity Catalog et les data contracts, permettant ainsi de construire une observabilité globale de la plateforme (usage, lignage, etc.). Un terrain de jeu technique à fort impact et aux défis d'envergure internationale !

L'équipe est composée actuellement de :

  • 1 Product Manager
  • 1 Data Architect
  • 1 Data Engineer
  • 1 Software Engineer
  • 2 Ops Engineer

Exemples de challenges actuels :

  • Améliorer notre offre de support pour faciliter le parcours utilisateur (documentation, gestion des incidents, ...)
  • Discussion avec les équipes Data/IA des pays et domaines sur leurs challenges du moment (données sensibles, données privées, ...) pour définir les priorités de nos équipes
  • Comment faciliter la gouvernance des données ? Par exemple intégrer des règles automatiques de validation des données, data contractualization, ...
  • Rationalisation de notre offre et décommissionnement du legacy

TA FUTURE CONTRIBUTION

Notre ambition groupe, celle d’améliorer l’expérience digitale de nos clients, nous amène à une nouvelle approche orientée clients, une approche produit.

Le/La Product Manager de l'équipe Data Lake:

  • Acquiert une compréhension de son périmètre, de l'état de l’art sur le marché, du fonctionnement technique des outils associés.
  • Représente nos utilisateurs métiers, comprend leurs challenges et les retranscrit aux équipes techniques.
  • Accompagne la mise en œuvre de nouvelles fonctionnalités ou produits sur tout le cycle de vie (démo, formation, communication, documentation, …).


Tu seras garant·e de l'évolution et de la robustesse de ce produit critique pour l'ensemble des équipes Decathlon.

Tes missions principales s'articuleront autour des axes suivants :

  • Vision & Delivery : Tu pilotes le cycle complet du produit, de la Discovery à la coordination du Delivery en lien étroit avec le Leader. Tu traduis les enjeux business et techniques en une roadmap claire, priorisée et axée sur la valeur.

  • Projets Stratégiques : Tu lead l'End-of-Life (EOL) de notre Legacy, orchestres la migration vers la nouvelle infrastructure et designs les nouveaux espaces et fonctionnalités sur Unity Catalog.

  • Gouvernance & Excellence Opérationnelle : Tu assures la gouvernance fine du metastore, la gestion des droits d'accès et intègres au cœur de ta roadmap les enjeux de sécurité, de performance, de maintenance et de FinOps (optimisation des coûts cloud).

  • Leadership Fonctionnel & Synergies : Tu assures le management fonctionnel de l'équipe technique au quotidien et tu pourras être amené·e à animer un groupe transverse de PM sur des sujets communs afin de garantir l'alignement de notre vision produit globale.

  • Mesure de l'impact : Tu définis et suis les indicateurs clés de réussite focalisés sur la fiabilité, la robustesse de la plateforme et la mesure précise de l'usage de tes produits. Tu co-animes le budget du produit avec le leader.

CE QUE TU APPORTES

  • Expérience : Tu justifies d'au moins 5 ans d'expérience comme Product Manager, avec une légitimité et une réussite reconnues sur des produits complexes ou de plateforme.

  • Expertise Technique & Data : Tu possèdes une forte appétence technique ainsi qu'une solide compréhension des enjeux liés à la gestion des données, aux accès et à la gouvernance. Savoir manipuler la donnée est un réel plus pour ce poste.

  • Culture Tech & IA : Tu maîtrises les outils d'Intelligence Artificielle appliqués au Product Management et tu appréhendes parfaitement les défis techniques sous-jacents (sécurité, infrastructure, scalabilité).

  • Soft Skills : Orienté·e utilisateur, tu as un fort sens du service. Tu aimes écouter, creuser des sujets de fond et proposer des solutions innovantes.

  • Communication & Fédérateur·rice : Tu disposes d'excellentes capacités de communication pour vulgariser des concepts complexes, dialoguer aussi bien avec des profils techniques que métiers, et fédérer autour de ta vision.

  • Langues & Mindset : Un niveau d'anglais courant (B2 minimum, écrit et oral) est requis pour évoluer dans notre contexte international. Tu es motivé·e, curieux·se, ambitieux·se et tu as le goût du challenge.

  • L'étincelle Decathlon : Tu es passionné·e de sport, tu as envie de partager tes passions en équipe et de rejoindre une entreprise à impact positif !


STACK TECHNIQUE

  • AWS S3, Glue
  • Databricks Lakehouse, Unity Catalog
  • Data contracts
  • Business Intelligence : Tableau
  • Compute et Orchestration : Spark / Scala,  Python,  Airflow, dbt
  • Ops : Terraform, Kubernetes
  • Product Management : Jira Product Discovery, Github, Confluence
  • IA : Gemini, Github Copilot

CE QUE NOUS T’OFFRONS

  • Organisation de travail hybride ;

  • Matériel fourni en accord avec tes missions et nos engagements sociétaux (Mac ou Windows) ;

  • Une équipe de projet locale au sein d'un réseau mondial (possibilité de carrière internationale) ;

  • Développement des compétences et accompagnement (diversité des projets, formations internes et externes, etc.) ;

  • Package de rémunération (actionnariat salarié, bonus mensuels/trimestriels).

NOTRE ENGAGEMENT EN FAVEUR DE L'INCLUSION ET DE L'ACCESSIBILITE

Chez Decathlon, nous reconnaissons l'immense valeur qu'apporte la diversité à nos équipes et nous nous efforçons continuellement de favoriser et de cultiver un lieu de travail inclusif et équitable : c'est pourquoi l'Inclusion est l'un de nos Fondamentaux Humains. Nous encourageons les personnes de tous horizons et de toutes capacités à postuler, car nous sommes convaincu·es que la diversité des pensées, des cultures, des identités et des expériences vécues nous rend plus fort·es.

Decathlon s'engage également à offrir un processus de sélection inclusif et accessible à tous les candidat·es. En cas de besoin d'aménagement, tu peux en faire la demande via le formulaire de candidature, celle-ci sera confidentielle. Ces demandes n'affectent pas le résultat du processus de recrutement.

DECATHLON DIGITAL 

Imaginez si la technologie nous permettait de repousser les frontières et d'offrir des expériences sportives inédites. C'est précisément notre ambition chez Decathlon Digital ! Nous sommes une équipe de plus de 5 000 experts en ingénierie logicielle, gestion de produits, données, cloud et cybersécurité, répartis à Paris, Lille et Amsterdam. Ensemble, nous créons la plus vaste plateforme sportive numérique, en exploitant les innovations technologiques pour optimiser la chaîne de valeur, concevoir des expériences connectées et donner une seconde vie à nos produits.

Changeons la donne pour de bon. Notre passion du sport nous guide et nous voulons qu’elle perdure. C’est pourquoi nous nous engageons à bâtir un modèle technologique plus durable, en réduisant notre impact direct sur l'environnement, et en créant un espace sûr et inclusif pour apprendre et nous épanouir ensemble. Rejoins l’équipe et façonnons le futur du sport.

title: Senior Product Manager, Enterprise
descriptionHtml:
Blockstream was founded in 2014 by Dr. Adam Back and a group of fellow cryptographers and engineers passionate about Bitcoin and its potential to change the future of finance. Focusing on building fundamental Bitcoin infrastructure, Blockstream quickly grew into one of the leading technology power houses of the industry.

First announced at the Bitcoin 2025 conference in Las Vegas in May, Blockstream Enterprise is a Bitcoin-focused software suite enabling banks, prime brokers and corporations to safely and securely custody Bitcoin and manage tokenization and treasury operations.

We are seeking a Senior Product Manager to join our Enterprise product team in EMEA, to lead the ongoing development and adoption of our Enterprise solution in the EMEA region.

What You’ll Be Doing (Responsibilities):

70% – Technical Product Management

  • Translate vision into actionable roadmap, own the product narrative and communicate effectively to all levels of the organization

  • Engage with engineering in technical conversations, understanding implications of technical decisions, and align Engineering work to product goals

  • Lead project execution, anticipating and resolving roadblocks, coordinating the work of teammates, and clearly communicating goals and status with the organization

  • Identify product opportunities, translating them into clear milestones and artefacts that align with Business Objectives

30% – Discovery & Research

  • Support Continuous Discovery habits, engage in market and customer research, follow regulatory/market news, identify trends

  • Conduct customer discovery workshops, document findings, translate insights into signals and identify gaps in the product roadmap

  • Drive product requirements, drive product documentation and own the workstream, collaborating with Engineering, Design, Business and Marketing teams

  • Gather qualitative and quantitative data to be able to support or challenge product assumptions/feature requests

What We Look For In You (Required Qualifications):

  • 7+ years of experience as a Product Manager in a regulated environment with a proven track record of delivering impact

  • Understanding of blockchain-based technology, crypto custody best practices, and the tokenization lifecycle

  • Exceptional communication skills and aptitude for conveying complex technical concepts

  • Comfort with the pace, scrappiness and dynamic environment within a growing startup.

  • Workplace Lugano or Geneva, Switzerland

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills

Nice To Haves (Preferred Qualifications):

  • Prior work experience on Bitcoin-related products

  • Experience with other enterprise-focused crypto products and their application / adoption among businesses from the TradFi sector

  • Deep understanding of traditional financial systems, services & products

  • A holistic understanding of the major interoperable cash generating units within global money center banks: Commercial banking, investment banking, prime brokerage and asset management

  • Prior knowledge of Liquid and its role in the Bitcoin ecosystem

  • Languages: Russian and/or Ukrainian

title: Senior Product Marketing Manager, Sales Enablement (AI & Research)
descriptionHtml:
Senior Product Marketing Manager, Sales Enablement (AI & Research)

Team: Marketing

  Prolific

Prolific isn’t just enabling AI innovation – we’re redefining it. While foundational AI technologies are becoming commoditized, Prolific’s human data infrastructure provides the high-quality, diverse data required to train the next generation of AI models. Through our platform, we empower researchers and companies to access a global, ethically curated participant base, ensuring cutting-edge AI research and training grounded in inclusivity and precision.

The role

This is a brand new role, and you’ll be the first person to do it at Prolific.

Right now, the insight that could help us win more deals is scattered. We have valuable learnings about why we win, why we lose, and why deals stall, but they aren’t turned into the pitch, proof and materials that sellers use every day. You’ll fix that. You’ll become the person who knows our market position inside out and turns it into tools that help sellers win.
This is a revenue role. It sits at the point where product marketing meets sales enablement, across both our AI and research businesses. You’ll dig into win-loss, competitive intelligence and customer proof, then turn it into pitch decks, one-pagers, battlecards, case studies and training that reps use on their next call. You’ll also help new AEs and SDRs get up to speed faster.

You’ll be measured on win rate, sales cycle length, rep ramp time and how well equipped our sellers are in front of a buyer.

Our AI PMM leads strategic lab and enterprise AI pursuits, and our vertical PMMs tailor messaging for specific audiences. You own the foundation they all build on: the shared, trusted system of resources every other deal runs on.

What you’ll bring to the role

  • 6+ years in an enablement-facing role (product marketing, sales enablement or competitive intelligence) at a B2B company
  • Experience enabling sellers across more than one product or product line, at a startup, scale-up or enterprise
  • Experience doing the full job, not just the final slides: you’ve gathered the data and insight yourself, then turned it into materials sellers use
  • Enablement you’ve built that measurably moved win rate, ramp time or deal velocity. You can show who used it and what changed
  • Hands-on experience running buyer interviews. You ask about past behaviour, not hypothetical opinions, and you can get a lost buyer to tell you the real reason
  • Comfort with data: you can pull from a CRM and call-intelligence tools, build an analysis or business case, and defend your conclusions
  • Clear writing for busy readers: short, specific and easy to act on
  • Credibility with sellers and senior leaders, and the ability to get sales, product and customer success to act without managing any of them. You’ll spend a lot of time with sales

    What you’ll be doing in the role 

  • Build and own sales enablement across AI and research: onboarding, ongoing training and launch readiness (with the AI PMM), plus a single source of truth that reps actually use
  • Audit what exists today, decide what stays and what goes, and set up a way to keep it current
  • Build and maintain the core sales toolkit: pitch narrative, decks, one-pagers, discovery guides, battlecards, objection handling, white papers and business-case tools
  • Design and run our win-loss programme: buyer interviews after closed-won, closed-lost and no-decision outcomes, combined with CRM and call data and a regular readout to leadership. You’ll also run one outreach calendar for every AI buyer interview, including the AI PMM’s, so no buyer is asked twice
  • Own competitive intelligence against data labelling vendors, research panel providers and in-house alternatives, including a live view of competitor pricing and positioning that feeds the AI PMM’s category point of view
  • Turn findings into specific changes, such as a new talk track, a revised discovery question or a pricing recommendation, then check whether the change moved the number
  • Own customer proof: case studies with AI and research customers, a sourced library of proof points, the reference programme for live deals, and advocacy through quotes, reviews and speakers
  • Sit in on sales calls every week and feed deal-level evidence into product: feature gaps, blockers and pricing friction, ranked by revenue impact
  • Define and report the numbers: win rate, competitive win rate, deal velocity, rep ramp time and content usage, including the AI segment win rates the AI PMM is measured on. Work with RevOps to clean up CRM fields for loss reasons and competitor.

Why Prolific is a great place to work

We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioral data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.

We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviors into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breath and the best of humanity.

Working for us will place you at the forefront of AI innovation, providing access to our unique human data platform and opportunities for groundbreaking research. Join us to enjoy a competitive salary, benefits, and remote working within our impactful, mission-driven culture.

descriptionHtml:
**Please note this position requires weekly travel to/attendance at project sites. Locations could vary across the Nordics and EMEA**

About Nscale

At Nscale, we are building the infrastructure for Europe’s AI revolution. Nscale are developing cutting-edge sovereign generative AI solutions, powered by a new generation of high-performance, sustainable data centres and GPUs built specifically for AI workloads.

The growth of artificial intelligence is driving unprecedented global demand for compute and GPU infrastructure. Nscale is positioned at the heart of this transformation — building the platforms that will enable the next decade of innovation.

Nscale are working closely with the world’s most advanced AI technology providers, integrating next-gen compute hardware and GPU clusters in both partner and Nscale built facilities. This is an opportunity to join Nscale’s journey, play a key role in delivering transformative AI infrastructure, and help shape a company designed to scale rapidly across Europe and beyond.

Role Overview

The Senior Project Manager will play a leading role in managing the construction of Nscale’s data centre facilities, with a particular focus on fit-out / partnered projects. Reporting to the Project Director, this role may be sat across individual projects or multiple concurrently depending on scale and scope of project pipeline, and will be responsible for ensuring projects are delivered successfully by coordinating design, engineering, and construction activities through each stage of project execution.

You will manage scope, schedule, progress, quality, and risk, ensuring consistency with Nscale’s standards, governance, and delivery objectives.You will coordinate with internal team members and external partners to deliver on time, safely, and to specification.

You will maintain visibility of project budgets, forecasts, and reporting to ensure informed and proactive decision-making. Collaboration across internal teams — including Engineering, EH&S, Finance, and Operations — will be key to delivering world-class, sustainable infrastructure that supports Nscale’s AI mission.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead data centre project delivery from design through construction, commissioning, and operational handover.

  • Manage project scope, schedule, and quality, ensuring alignment with design intent and business objectives.

  • Coordinate and lead discipline Project Management (MEP, CSA) when required and ensure all packages of work integrate smoothly.

  • Maintain oversight of project budgets and schedules in coordination with the Commercial Manager, reporting progress and highlighting key risks.

  • Work closely with Design for design reviews, approvals, and documentation control.

  • Collaborate with general contractors to assess and manage local construction capabilities, resource planning, and performance.

  • Drive adherence to program milestones, identifying potential delays and developing recovery plans.

  • Build and maintain a strong safety culture, ensuring compliance through active engagement and auditing.

  • Chair regular status meetings, issue reports, and maintain clear communication between stakeholders and leadership.

  • Support compliance with building codes and regulatory requirements, advising on design implications or alternative solutions.

  • Lead risk identification and resolution, ensuring issues are captured, tracked, and addressed early.

  • Work collaboratively with internal departments (Engineering, EH&S, Finance, Operations) to ensure seamless project delivery and transition to operations.

Experience & Qualifications Required

  • Over 8 years of experience managing large-scale, mission-critical construction projects, including expertise in data centre developments and fit-out works
  • Ideally you will have delivered projects integrating TCS loop liquid cooling networks
  • Degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Architecture, or a related discipline.
  • Proven ability to manage complex, multi-discipline delivery teams 
  • Strong knowledge of construction sequencing, scheduling, and coordination.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to lead effectively in fast-paced environments.
  • Proficiency in project management and reporting tools
  • Understanding of commercial and contractual principles sufficient to ensure alignment with cost and schedule targets

title: Senior Project Manager, Strategic Initiatives
descriptionHtml:
Who is Sonar?

Sonar enables organizations to ship agentic code with confidence. Code creation is abundant, but confidence is scarce. Our core platform, SonarQube, verifies over 750 billion lines of code every day, delivering agentic verification and governance for all code. Trusted by more than 7 million developers and 75% of the Fortune 100, including teams at Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company, Sonar enables organizations to reduce outages, improve security, and lower the cost and risk of agentic software development.

Founded in Geneva and now headquartered in Austin, Texas, Sonar has a global team working across offices and hubs, including Silicon Valley, London, Bochum, Barcelona, Singapore, Tokyo, and the Washington, D.C. area. At Sonar, we’re enabling enterprises to build agentic software factories that can move quickly while maintaining the control, consistency and evidence required to ship with confidence.


Position description

Sonar is becoming an AI-first company. Strategy Enablement turns Sonar's strategic ideas into real, lasting results: company-critical initiatives, business transformations, acquisition integrations and new market expansion. As Sr. Project Manager, Strategic Initiatives, you will lead some of these initiatives from fuzzy intent to measurable outcome with pace and focus, as a trusted thought partner to leadership. Everything we do ultimately serves our internal and external customers, and you will keep them at the center of the solutions you design. You will reinvent both how projects are run and what they deliver: you use AI agents every day in your own work, and you design solutions AI-first, ambitious yet practical. Your first focus will be the AI transformation of our Go-To-Market organization, with our Business Technology team (including SALT, its AI team) and the Data & Insights team. Over time, you will lead initiatives across the company, in domains you may not know yet.

What you will do

  • Frame ambiguous strategic intents into clear problems, objectives and business cases, starting from the impact on our customers and the business.

  • Bring the customer voice into every initiative: use customer feedback and data to shape solutions, and make sure internal changes improve how customers buy, use and renew with Sonar.

  • Ground decisions in data: establish baselines, size opportunities, define success metrics up front and measure impact after go-live.

  • Lead complex, cross-functional initiatives end to end, driving pace and keeping the focus on customer and business outcomes.

  • Re-plan quickly when priorities or context change, and recommend stopping work that no longer pays off.

  • Redesign processes AI-first, from the outcome back: decide what AI agents do, where humans and AI work together and where human judgment stays essential, with guardrails proportional to business risk.

  • Build working prototypes (skills, agents, lightweight apps, automations) to test ideas early with users, then partner with Business Technology to industrialize what works.

  • Use AI agents systematically in your own business analysis and project management work, and share reusable skills and workflows to raise the AI bar around you.

  • Bridge leadership and operational teams: engage stakeholders early, manage competing priorities and keep sponsors and teams aligned.

  • Stay agile and pragmatic: run initiatives with simple, effective tools and communication rather than heavy process and admin, pick the approach that drives the behaviors and actions needed, re-plan quickly when context changes, and recommend stopping work that no longer pays off.

  • Master business analysis and project management foundations, and apply them pragmatically: just enough process, simple tools and clear communication, never process for its own sake.

  • Own change management as part of delivery (communication, training, champions, reinforcement) until new ways of working stick, with particular care for the human side of AI-driven change.

Experience and qualifications

The ideal candidate will:

  • Have 10+ years of experience leading complex, cross-functional, international transformation or strategic initiatives, ideally combining strategy or transformation consulting with in-house experience in a fast-growing tech or SaaS company.

  • Bring a proven track record of measurable outcomes (revenue, cost, efficiency, adoption, customer experience), not just projects delivered.

  • Have a strong customer mindset: see internal work as a way to serve customers, and use that lens to set priorities.

  • Use AI agents and assistants (e.g. Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) hands-on every day, with concrete examples of skills, agents or workflows they have built.

  • Have designed or delivered AI-enabled processes, with a pragmatic view of AI's value, limits and risks.

  • Be strongly data-driven: analyze business data themselves (spreadsheets, SQL or BI tools, AI-assisted analysis) to build business cases and track results.

  • Demonstrate strong change management, stakeholder management and communication skills, having led people through significant change and influenced executives and operational teams alike.

  • Master business analysis and project management foundations, and apply them flexibly rather than by the book.

  • Thrive in ambiguity: decide with partial information and adapt the plan without losing sight of the goal.

  • Show strong curiosity and learn new domains quickly. Go-To-Market experience is a plus.

  • Be fluent in English, written and spoken. French is a plus.

In-office culture

We're intentional about this. We believe the best teams are built in the room together. Three anchor days — Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays — create the collaboration rhythm that makes a hub office worth having.

Candidates need to be genuinely based in the location the role is posted — if that's not where you are today, we're happy to support relocation for the right person.

We value diversity, equity, and inclusion

title: Senior Quantum Physicist
descriptionHtml:
About IonQ: 

IonQ, Inc. [NYSE: IONQ] is the world’s leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. IonQ’s newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including Amazon Web Services, and AstraZeneca achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, setting a world record in quantum computing performance.

Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before.  

Location: This role is based at our Oxford, UK office with the option to work a few days a week remotely.
Travel: Up to 5%
Job ID: 1777

The Role:

We are pioneering advancements in quantum computing by utilizing trapped ion technology and our proprietary laser-free quantum control methods. Our research and development efforts build on our fully integrated quantum processors that can be fabricated within standard silicon foundries. This unique approach allows us to leverage the highest-performing qubit technology while ensuring scalability and manufacturability using existing semiconductor fabrication technology. We approach quantum computing with a focus on minimizing errors, striving to achieve ultra-low gate errors at scale. Our immediate objective is to develop functional quantum computers within the NISQ regime, aiming to construct fault-tolerant machines that require minimal QEC overhead. Our recent breakthroughs include achieving 99.97% fidelity in two-qubit gates and 99.9992% fidelity in single-qubit operations without error correction, setting new industry standards for performance.

We are looking for Quantum Physicist to join our UK Science team at IonQ. Our Quantum Scientists work at the forefront of our research efforts to develop the next generation of quantum computers. 

They are responsible for validating and optimising the performance of our computers, playing a critical role in ensuring we are able to meet our research and development goals and timelines. Our Scientists’ work spans a broad range of areas from designing, coding, debugging and executing experiments, to developing and validating novel control schemes. They are responsible for documenting and sharing their findings with the aim of pushing the boundaries of system performance.

Responsibilities:

As a Senior Quantum Scientist, you will typically be responsible for a combination of these different responsibilities:

  • Prototyping and characterising coherent control and cooling schemes for trapped-ion qubits using laser and microwave fields.
  • Calibrating and benchmarking quantum systems, focusing on achieving the highest fidelities for quantum circuit primitives (e.g. ion transport or gate operations) and full circuits.
  • Validating emerging trap technologies, including integrated electronics and photonics for large-scale architectures.
  • Analysing experimental data, debug complex hardware/software interactions, and ensure reliability of qubit operations.

Requirements:

To be successful in this role, you will need a PhD in physics or a related discipline, with a strong foundation in atomic or qubit-related physics. Prior postdoctoral or industry experience is valuable, but we are open to applicants moving directly from a PhD.

We’re looking for someone with a solid background in quantum control, and hands-on experience in calibration, benchmarking, or coherent control of qubits, would be desirable. We’re looking for motivated scientists who can contribute to the progress of this fast moving, highly technical team and help the organisation meet our research goals.

You’d be a great fit with:

  • Proven expertise in experimental AMO physics or quantum computing. Experience with trapped ions is beneficial though not essential.
  • Prior experience in one or more of the following: spectroscopy or coherent control of multi-level systems, characterisation of control hardware, gate fidelity benchmarking or running quantum circuits on hardware.
  • Strong proficiency in programming and data analysis, experience of Python or Rust is desirable.
  • Strong collaborative skills, with the ability to work independently and as part of a fast-moving team.
  • A track record of scientific communication through publications, talks and conferences would be advantageous.

Benefits:

Be part of a team that’s shaping the future of quantum. We offer more than just a role, you’ll join a world class community of scientists, engineers and innovators working to unlock the full potential of quantum computing.

We offer a range of benefits, including opportunities to further your career alongside industry leaders, a competitive salary with IonQ stock options, an annual performance bonus, generous annual leave, flexible hybrid working, private medical and dental insurance for you and your family, and much more.

Join us and be part of the future of quantum computing.

We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds.

title: Senior Sales Manager, Regional Enterprise
descriptionHtml:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

Senior Sales Regional Enterprise Manager

At Wolt, we create technology that brings local communities, merchants and customers closer together. What started with restaurant delivery has grown into a broader local commerce platform, helping customers discover and access more of what their cities have to offer.

As our Retail business continues to grow, we're looking for a Senior Sales Regional Enterprise Manager to expand our selection of high-value regional retail partners. You'll join our Sales team and take ownership of some of the most important regional acquisition opportunities across priority retail verticals, helping shape what customers can find on Wolt in their cities. This role can be based in Berlin, Cologne, Frankfurt, Hamburg or Munich .

What you'll be doing

In this role, you'll own the acquisition and development of high-value regional Enterprise retail partners in Germany, from identifying and engaging the right prospects through commercial negotiations, signing and initial rollout. You'll combine strong commercial execution with a strategic view on which partners can have the greatest impact on Wolt's selection, coverage and long-term growth.

Day-to-day in this role you'll:

  • Own the end-to-end sales cycle for regional Enterprise retail opportunities, from prospecting and qualification through negotiation, contracting and signing.
  • Build and manage a high-quality pipeline of larger regional retailers and multi-location partners across priority verticals such as grocery, convenience, pet, pharmacy and beauty.
  • Develop a deep understanding of prospective partners' businesses and create compelling commercial propositions that demonstrate the value of partnering with Wolt.
  • Lead complex commercial negotiations, balancing partner needs with sustainable economics and Wolt's long-term business objectives.
  • Build strong relationships with senior decision-makers and act as a trusted commercial partner throughout the sales process.
  • Work closely with internal teams including Operations, Account Management, Finance, Legal, Marketing and Product to structure partnerships and enable successful launches.
  • Take ownership beyond the signature, ensuring a strong handover and initial rollout so that newly acquired partners can successfully go live and scale.
  • Use market insights, pipeline data and commercial learnings to identify opportunities, prioritize the highest-impact accounts and continuously improve our regional Enterprise sales approach.
  • Contribute to sharing best practices and raising the bar for Enterprise sales execution across the wider team.

Our humble expectations

  • You have significant experience in B2B sales, business development or strategic partnerships, ideally working with Enterprise or other complex, multi-stakeholder customers.
  • You have a strong track record of independently managing and closing complex commercial opportunities from initial outreach through contract signature.
  • You're an excellent negotiator and understand how to build partnerships that create sustainable value for both sides.
  • You're comfortable engaging and influencing senior stakeholders, both externally and across cross-functional internal teams.
  • You combine a hands-on, results-oriented sales mindset with strong commercial judgment and the ability to prioritize opportunities based on their strategic impact.
  • You're highly structured and comfortable managing multiple opportunities and stakeholders simultaneously while maintaining strong attention to detail.
  • You're comfortable working with data and commercial metrics to evaluate opportunities, build business cases and inform decisions.
  • You communicate clearly and persuasively and are fluent in German and English.

What we offer

This is an opportunity to play a meaningful role in the next phase of Wolt's Retail growth. You'll have direct ownership of high-impact regional partnerships and the autonomy to take opportunities from first conversation all the way through to launch.

You'll work at the intersection of sales, strategy and operations, collaborating with experienced colleagues across Wolt while building relationships with some of the most important retailers in the market. The role offers substantial commercial ownership and exposure while giving you the opportunity to develop further in Enterprise sales and contribute to how we scale our Retail business.

You'll also join a fast-moving international environment where good ideas can quickly turn into action, with the tools, support and trust to take ownership of your work and make a visible impact.

Next steps

If this sounds like an opportunity you'd be excited about, we'd love to hear from you.

After you apply, our Talent Acquisition team will review your application and get in touch with selected candidates for an initial conversation. The process will typically include interviews with the hiring team and relevant stakeholders, giving you the opportunity to learn more about the role, team and business while we get to know your experience and approach.

Depending on the role and location, the process may also include a practical case or commercial exercise. We'll share the exact interview steps and expectations with you as you progress through the process.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash .

title: Senior Scientist, Biologics
descriptionHtml:
About Boltz

Boltz is a public benefit company building the next generation of AI-powered molecular modeling tools to make biology programmable and accelerate drug discovery, while keeping frontier capabilities broadly accessible.

Boltz began as an MIT spin-out. Our founders built Boltz-1 at MIT, and it became the first fully open-source model to match AlphaFold 3's accuracy in predicting the 3D structure of biomolecular complexes.

We focus on two things:

  • Open foundation models. Boltz-1, Boltz-2, and BoltzGen are open models trusted by 100,000+ scientists across biotech and academia, and used in programs at every Top 20 pharma as well as leading agrichemical and industrial research organizations.

  • Boltz Lab. Our commercial platform runs our latest models and design agents as reliable, production-grade tools built around real chemistry and biology workflows. Teams start from a target and a hypothesis, then generate, evaluate, and rank candidate molecules, while we provide the compute, infrastructure, and collaboration layer so their scientists can move faster.

The two feed each other: open-source adoption earns scientific credibility and community insight, and Boltz Lab turns that into real impact on our partners' discovery programs.

You can read more about our mission, research and product vision in our manifesto.

About the role

As Scientist, Biologics, you will own the scientific direction of our biologics work, as Boltz's senior experimental voice on antibodies, peptides and other biologic modalities. Our models are only as useful as their fit with how biologics are really discovered and optimized, and this role keeps them grounded in the lab.

You will work closely with ML Research, our Computational Scientists in Protein Design, Product, and external partners.

This role is ideal for a product-minded scientist who wants to extend their impact beyond individual programs, setting direction while staying hands-on.

What you'll do

  • Set the scientific direction for biologics across Boltz's models and Boltz Lab.

  • Define biologically meaningful modeling objectives, datasets and the experimental readouts that matter.

  • Interpret model outputs and failure modes against real lab outcomes, alongside ML Research and our protein design team.

  • Shape product and roadmap decisions so Boltz Lab fits real biologics engineering workflows.

  • Bring what you learn from partners and experiments back into how we build and evaluate models.

About you

Minimum Requirements

  • PhD or equivalent, plus significant industrial or academic research experience in biologics engineering, protein science, structural biology or a closely related field.

  • Strong hands-on experimental experience discovering, engineering or characterizing biologics (e.g. display campaigns, affinity maturation, developability assessment).

  • Deep understanding of end-to-end biologics discovery and optimization workflows, and experience connecting computational outputs to experimental results.

  • A track record of leading biologics programs or scientific direction, with influence on product or platform decisions.

  • Ability to translate biological problems into clear modeling objectives with ML researchers and engineers, and to explain complex biology to interdisciplinary teams.

Preferred Requirements

  • Familiarity with structure prediction, docking, scoring or protein design tools.

  • Interest in scaling scientific impact through platforms, tools or open scientific infrastructure.

  • Applied experience using Boltz models on biologics projects.

We know great people don't always tick every box. If this role excites you and you meet most of the minimum requirements, we'd like to hear from you.

What we offer

  • Set the scientific direction for biologics on a platform used by leading discovery teams.

  • Work alongside one of the most talent-dense teams in the field.

  • Significant ownership and independence, with responsibility for driving projects from concept to deployment.

  • Highly competitive salary with meaningful equity in a public benefit company.

  • Benefits:

    • 25 days plus bank holidays a year

    • Annual team offsite trip

    • Private healthcare (BUPA), covering pre-existing conditions

    • Pension program

    • Paid parental leave

    • Wellhub gym membership

    • Free lunch every day

    • Travel expenses

How we hire

  1. Initial screen with a member of the Talent team

  2. Scientific presentation

  3. Onsite in London or virtual onsite with the team

  4. Offer + Onboarding

Our commitment

Boltz is committed to building a diverse team and an inclusive workplace. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds. If you need any adjustments during the hiring process, tell us and we'll make it work.

title: Senior Simulation Engineering – Autonomous Driving, Land Domain (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
About the role:

As Senior Simulation Engineer – Autonomous Driving, Land Domain, you will play a key role in shaping the simulation capabilities that enable us to develop, test, and validate the next generation of autonomous ground systems at scale. You will design and evolve realistic, reliable, and reproducible virtual environments in which our autonomy software can be developed and challenged long before a physical vehicle enters the field.

You will take strong technical ownership of simulation systems, architecture, and engineering decisions, helping to define how simulation is integrated into our autonomy development and verification workflows. You will tackle complex technical challenges hands-on, challenge existing approaches, identify limitations, and continuously improve the quality, scalability, and effectiveness of our simulation environment.

As a senior engineer, you will also act as a technical sparring partner for other engineers. You will share your expertise, review technical approaches, mentor less experienced colleagues, and contribute to engineering standards and best practices, while enabling teams to retain ownership of their respective systems and decisions.

Working closely with engineers across autonomy, perception, localization, planning and control, platform software, verification, and vehicle integration, you will translate complex simulation needs into robust technical solutions. You will help align interfaces and requirements across teams and ensure that our simulation capabilities address real engineering challenges and become an integral part of autonomy development, continuous testing, and system-level verification.

What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Take technical ownership of simulation capabilities, contributing to the architecture, technical roadmap, and quality of the simulation systems used for autonomy development, testing, and verification.

  • Design and develop scalable simulation solutions, building realistic, reliable, and reproducible environments that enable autonomy software to be tested across complex scenarios before deployment on physical vehicles.

  • Drive strong engineering decisions, leading technical discussions, challenging assumptions, evaluating trade-offs, and helping teams make pragmatic and sustainable architectural choices.

  • Translate autonomy and verification needs into technical solutions, working closely with stakeholders to turn complex requirements into clear simulation concepts, priorities, and implementation plans.

  • Contribute hands-on to complex engineering challenges, investigating technical limitations, improving simulation fidelity and performance, and solving problems that require deep technical expertise.

  • Drive collaboration across the Land Domain, working closely with autonomy, perception, localization, planning and control, verification, platform software, and vehicle integration teams to identify where simulation provides the greatest engineering value.

  • Keep simulation closely connected to the real system, using field data, vehicle testing, real-world failures, and operational feedback to continuously improve simulation fidelity, coverage, and relevance.

  • Raise the technical standard across the team, sharing knowledge, reviewing technical approaches, mentoring other engineers, and contributing to engineering standards, development practices, and continuous improvement.

  • Identify technical risks and dependencies early, helping teams address scalability, maintainability, integration, and verification challenges before they become blockers.

  • Act as a senior technical interface for simulation, communicating technical challenges, architectural decisions, dependencies, and opportunities clearly across engineering teams and stakeholders.


What you bring to the team:

  • 8+ years of professional experience in simulation, robotics, autonomous driving, physical systems, vehicle dynamics, software engineering, or closely related engineering domains.

  • Strong technical expertise in simulation and autonomous systems, with experience designing, building, and evolving complex simulation environments used for development, testing, and verification.

  • A strong software engineering background, ideally including modern C++ and Python, with hands-on experience building or extending simulation infrastructure using technologies such as CARLA, NVIDIA Isaac Sim, Unreal Engine, Gazebo, or comparable simulation environments.

  • Solid understanding of physical simulation and autonomous systems, including areas such as vehicle dynamics, sensor simulation, Software-in-the-Loop (SiL), scenario-based testing, and the trade-offs between simulation fidelity, performance, determinism, and scalability.

  • Experience taking technical ownership of complex systems, contributing to architecture and technical roadmaps while driving decisions around scalability, maintainability, reliability, and system quality.

  • Proven ability to solve complex engineering problems hands-on, including debugging system-level issues, evaluating technical trade-offs, challenging existing approaches, and developing pragmatic solutions.

  • Experience working across engineering disciplines, collaborating effectively with autonomy, perception, localization, planning and control, verification, platform software, and vehicle integration teams.

  • Experience connecting simulation with real-world systems, using vehicle testing, field data, operational feedback, and real-world failures to improve simulation fidelity, coverage, and relevance.

  • Ability to provide technical guidance and mentorship, supporting other engineers through design discussions, code and architecture reviews, knowledge sharing, and engineering best practices without requiring formal people-management responsibility.

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to explain complex technical topics, influence engineering decisions, align stakeholders, and drive technical topics across organizational boundaries.

Note: We operate in an industry where women, as well as other minority groups, are systematically under-represented. We encourage you to apply even if you dont meet all the listed qualifications; ability and impact cannot be summarised in a few bullet points.

Why Quantum-Systems:

  • We believe in the power of combined efforts: straightforward tech expertise paired with a customer-centric focus.

  • We are industry pioneers who are ambitious, bold, and visionary.

  • We push limits, think outside-the-box and strive for technological excellence to shape the future of aerial data.

About us:

Quantum Systems is a leading European deep-tech company for unmanned systems across air, land and maritime domains.
