title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer (Data Platform)
descriptionHtml:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The Role

We’re looking for a Senior Site Reliability Engineer to join the team building and operating Nebius Data Platform — a distributed storage and a processing platform that acts as the company’s “source of truth” and the backbone of many internal (and some external) products.
Nebius Data Platform is a single multi-tenant ecosystem based on YTsaurus — instead of running separate HDFS/Kafka/HBase-style systems, we provide storage, compute, and analytics capabilities inside one platform.

We operate across data centers worldwide, running YTsaurus in dedicated Kubernetes clusters with Kubernetes operators and supporting services written primarily in Go. We maintain our own Nebius distribution, develop functionality across the core and platform services, and contribute upstream where it makes sense. This gives us the ability to take improvements from design through implementation to production.

At scale today, this includes ~500 servers, ~20k CPU cores and ~10 PB of compressed data in our largest production cluster, supporting workloads ranging from business-critical pipelines and financial transactions to large-scale ML/LLM training datasets and compute.
As an SRE, you’ll combine software engineering with production ownership: understand how the platform behaves, identify what limits its reliability and growth, and build lasting improvements alongside the developers and teams who use it.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Own and improve the reliability, performance, and capacity of our YTsaurus clusters, with particular attention to data durability and predictable behavior under load.

  • Develop services, Kubernetes automation, and operational tooling in Go to simplify cluster provisioning, upgrades, and maintenance.

  • Improve monitoring, alerting, and diagnostic tools so we can detect problems early and understand their impact on users.

  • Investigate failures across Linux, networking, Kubernetes, and distributed storage and compute. Participate in on-call, lead incident investigations, and turn findings into lasting fixes.

  • Improve resource utilization and workload isolation as the platform grows and serves more teams.

  • Work with platform developers and users to make architectural decisions, deliver changes safely, and reduce repetitive operational work.

We expect you to have:

  • Experience operating distributed, stateful systems in production and taking responsibility for their reliability.

  • Strong Linux and networking fundamentals, including the ability to investigate resource bottlenecks and failures beyond the application layer.

  • Practical Kubernetes experience: deploying, operating, and troubleshooting production workloads.

  • Strong programming skills and experience building maintainable software. We primarily use Go; experience in another language and a willingness to learn Go are welcome.

  • A systematic approach to troubleshooting, using evidence from logs, metrics, traces, and system behavior.

  • The ability to drive improvements from problem identification through delivery, communicate trade-offs clearly, and collaborate with developers and platform users.

It will be an added bonus if you have:

  • Experience with Big Data systems (YTsaurus/Hadoop/Spark/ClickHouse/Kafka-like ecosystems).

  • Experience developing Kubernetes operators or controllers.

  • Experience with performance analysis, capacity planning, or resource management in multi-tenant systems.

We conduct coding interviews as part of the process.

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

title: Senior Software Engineer, Java
descriptionHtml:
Teamwork makes the stream work.

Roku is changing how the world watches TV

Roku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.

From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.

About The Team

The Roku Enterprise Engineering team is at the forefront of building a robust, integrated, and scalable platform that powers critical business processes across the organization. As a cornerstone of Roku's corporate strategy, this team is instrumental in automating workflows across all Business Systems, including Supply Chain, Finance, Sales Operations, and Human Resources. By challenging traditional approaches to workflow automation, the team leverages cutting-edge Engineering practices and API-driven design to streamline internal processes, boost efficiency, and deliver innovative solutions.

The team's expertise spans a wide range of technologies, including Java and Python-based MicroServices, AWS/GCP cloud backend systems, Big Data technologies like Hive and Spark, and modern Web applications. With a globally distributed presence across the US, India and Europe, the team thrives on collaboration, bringing together diverse perspectives to solve complex challenges. At the heart of their success is a shared commitment to technical excellence, creativity, a strong sense of ownership, and a collaborative spirit that drives impactful results for Roku's business operations.

About The Role

As a senior technical lead, you consider yourself a platform services developer and developing innovative solutions using modern software frameworks and paradigms. You are self-driven and problem solver, with a strong background in building large-scale software platform and applications. You are execution focused and would develop a reputation for repeatedly delivering projects on-time.

#LI-GL1

Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance.

What are some of the benefits?

Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Accommodations

Roku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to

title: Senior Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
The opportunity

How taxation, accounting and payroll work today is a pain for everyone. Still every business must do it continuously. It is the backbone our economy runs on.

Enabled through AI, we are turning this often-painful process into a radically simple experience for our customers, so they can focus on what matters to them: growing their business.

The role

As a Senior Software Engineer, you own a product area – e.g. bookkeeping, payroll or client onboarding – and take it from problem to production. You work directly with the founders, product and our tax experts, and you decide how things get built in your area.

We are past the founding phase but still very early: most of what you touch is greenfield.

What you’ll own

  • Your product area, end-to-end: Turn customer and tax-expert problems into shipped features (spec → ship → measure).
  • APIs, data models and services: Design and build the backend your area runs on – and ship the UI on top.
  • AI that is correct, not just plausible: Build AI-powered workflows with evaluation, fallbacks and human review where it matters.
  • Quality and operations: Tests, monitoring and incident response for what you ship.
  • Raising the bar: Code reviews, mentoring, and active part in hiring engineers.

Our tech context (greenfield)

  • Prefer boring tech where it matters; innovate where it differentiates.
  • Current stack (continually evolving): TypeScript end-to-end, Next.js (React) with server-side APIs, PostgreSQL, Vercel, …
  • Most hard problems sit behind the API: data modelling for tax logic, third-party integrations, and AI pipelines.
  • Tooling budget for whatever makes you fast. No legacy, no yak-shaving.

What you’ll bring

  • 7+ years building and operating web applications in production, end-to-end
  • Strong TypeScript/Node fundamentals; React on the frontend (Next.js or comparable)
  • Backend depth: API design, relational data modelling (PostgreSQL), third-party integrations
  • A track record of owning features from idea to production with real users
  • Product mindset: you talk to users, challenge requirements and cut scope to ship
  • AI deeply integrated into your daily engineering work – beyond autocompletion
  • Experience with containerised deployments (e.g. Docker) and CI/CD
  • A degree in computer science or a related field – or an equivalent track record
  • Very good English (min. C1); German is a plus
  • A valid work permit for Germany and readiness to work on-site in Munich

Nice to have

  • LLM-based features in production (RAG, agents, evaluations)
  • Experience in a start-up or scale-up
  • Exposure to fintech, accounting, tax or payroll

The process (fast, meaningful, no homework)

  • Intro call with a recruiter
  • Get to know a fellow engineer, virtually or in person (up to you)
  • Meet our founding team in a final interview (in person, ~3h, incl. live coding)

Missions

  • L'automatisation par l'IA pour simplifier la gestion de la paie et le suivi réglementaire : c'est dans la transformation des usages métiers que l'IA a le plus de potentiel, et le marché de la paie et du social, largement ignoré depuis plus d'une décennie, est un terrain d'innovation immense.

  • Une plateforme collaborative et ouverte, connectée à l'ensemble des outils métiers des cabinets, qui fluidifie les échanges entre les gestionnaires de paie et leurs clients.

  • Une gestion avancée des données pour offrir à plus long terme un conseil social à 360° sur l'ensemble des problématiques paie et social : budgétisation de la masse salariale, construction intelligente des grilles salariales, gestion contractuelle avancée, avantages salariés, mutuelle, etc.

L'objectif : développer le « Pennylane de la paie », une plateforme centrale de gestion paie et social pour les cabinets comptables et leurs clients TPE/PME.

Ce que nous offrons

Chez Alassio, notre ambition est de remplir une mission que beaucoup présentent comme impossible techniquement, et de la remplir rapidement.

Chez nous, il n'y a pas de place (et surtout pas le temps) pour des process inutiles ou des lourdeurs managériales : toute l'équipe est pleinement concentrée sur une mission claire, construire rapidement un outil tech exceptionnel.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Runtime
descriptionHtml:
About IonQ: 

IonQ, Inc. [NYSE: IONQ] is the world’s leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. IonQ’s newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including Amazon Web Services, and AstraZeneca achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, setting a world record in quantum computing performance.

Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before.  

Location: Oxford, UK
Job ID:  1831

The Role: 

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Runtime Software team at Oxford Ionics / IonQ. In this role, you will be responsible for working directly with the experimental scientists to implement the real-time control system behaviours and provide abstractions they require for their experiments, contributing to the team’s mission of enabling our science teams to experiment and improve the primitive operations which allow compute, and building towards fault tolerant computation.

You’ll play an important part in shaping the core, Rust, libraries and the execution environment which take our system from a collection of hardware to a quantum computer, and support our work in building the world’s most advanced quantum systems.

Responsibilities:

In this position, you will work on developing abstractions over real-time control hardware, supporting the effective delivery of a control system capable of repeatedly and reproducibly driving our ions with nano-second level precision, with abstractions which are conducive to both fast iteration and system scaling.

You’ll have the opportunity to accelerate the science core to the development of our systems, and contribute to the core execution model of our quantum computers, contributing directly to the success of building utility-scale quantum computers.

Key responsibilities include: 

  • Collaborating with scientists to understand their requirements.
  • Interfacing with system orchestration, non-realtime control and compiler teams to ensure our work integrates seamlessly with the wider software architecture.
  • Implementing drivers for various real-time devices.
  • Producing tooling to enable users of our code to iterate rapidly and fearlessly.
  • Developing the execution environment for the user programs which run on our systems.
  • Continually improving the APIs used by our internal users.

Requirements:

To be successful, you will need expert programming skills in a systems programming language and a desire to produce high quality code appropriate to a real-time environment. We’re looking for someone who can quickly iterate on low-level code in a collaborative, cross-disciplinary, environment and contribute effectively within a fast moving, highly technical team.

You’d be a great fit if you:

  • Have strong programming skills in one or more mainstream programming languages
  • Have experience with a systems programming programming
  • Have an interest in or experience with Rust
  • Have developed excellent communication skills both within the context of software and across disciplines
  • Are comfortable working with rapidly evolving requirements
  • Are used to maintaining and producing high quality code reviews and appropriate testing
  • Have a desire to maximize impact through quick iteration and short cycles of learning and improvement
  • Are eager to learn and develop your skills

Compensation will vary based on individual factors such as education, qualifications, and experience of the final candidate(s), specific office location, and calibration against relevant market data and internal team equity. Posted base salary figures are subject to change as new market data becomes available. Our benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans, matching 401(k), unlimited PTO and paid holidays, parental/adoption leave, legal insurance, and a home technology stipend. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided when a candidate receives an offer of employment. 

At IonQ, we believe in fair treatment, access, opportunity, and advancement for all while striving to identify and eliminate barriers. We empower employees to thrive by fostering a culture of autonomy, productivity, and respect. We are dedicated to creating an environment where individuals can feel welcomed, respected, supported, and valued.
 
We are committed to equity and justice. We welcome different voices and viewpoints and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, ancestry, physical and/or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, age, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other basis protected by law. We are proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer.

US Technical Jobs. The position you are applying for will require access to technology that is subject to U.S. export control and government contract restrictions.  Employment with IonQ is contingent on either verifying “U.S. Person” (e.g., U.S. citizen, U.S. national, U.S. permanent resident, or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum) status for export controls and government contracts work, obtaining any necessary license, and/or confirming the availability of a license exception under U.S. export controls.  Please note that in the absence of confirming you are a U.S. Person for export control and government contracts work purposes, IonQ may choose not to apply for a license or decline to use a license exception (if available) for you to access export-controlled technology that may require authorization, and similarly, you may not qualify for government contracts work that requires U.S. Persons, and IonQ may decline to proceed with your application on those bases alone.  Accordingly, we will have some additional questions regarding your immigration status that will be used for export control and compliance purposes, and the answers will be reviewed by compliance personnel to ensure compliance with federal law.

About the role:

CoreWeave's customers train and serve some of the most valuable models in the world, and they need to trust the platform underneath them. As a Senior Specialist Field Engineer for Security, you'll help those customers design for isolation, identity, and compliance on large GPU clusters, from the hardware up through Kubernetes. You'll work closely with the product, engineering, and security teams, and what you learn in the field will help shape what they build.

In this role, you will:

  • Design security architectures for complex customers, including the threat model, the trust boundaries, and the risks that remain.
  • Trace isolation and identity problems across hardware, firmware, the Linux kernel, the network, and Kubernetes.
  • Find where the product falls short for real customers and help the engineering teams fill those gaps.

  • B.S. in Computer Science or a related technical discipline, or equivalent experience.

  • Solid working knowledge of identity: OIDC, SCIM, and workload identity federation, and how to trace an identity from the IdP to a running workload.
  • Hands-on experience with network isolation: VPCs, private interconnects, egress controls, and zero-trust designs.

  • Linux kernel security primitives and runtime detection with tools like Falco or Tetragon.
  • Hardware and firmware security: DPUs, GPUs, secure boot, and supply chain integrity.
  • Contributions to security open source or published work on threat modeling, isolation, or cloud security.

descriptionHtml:

Together they run on 13% of the world’s smartphones, connecting advertisers, publishers, and hundreds of millions of users, with one goal: making mobile advertising work better for everyone in the ecosystem.

Next-Gen Machine Intelligence for Auctions & Real-Time Bidding

The Data Science Research team builds the foundational algorithms that govern real-time bidding, budget pacing, and allocation mechanics across our products. Operating as a horizontal deep-tech layer, the team leverages advanced AI—specifically reinforcement learning, objective-based optimization, and control theory—to deliver critical systems that perfectly harmonize advertiser ROI, platform health, and user relevance. These frameworks scale adjoe’s products beyond standard industry limitations, utilizing behavioral and transactional data from over 770 million users.

The team operates at the intersection of high-load, low-latency engineering, auction mechanism design, and state-of-the-art machine learning. Acting as the company’s internal science bar raiser, they translate complex business constraints into mathematical objectives. The stack is optimized for high throughput: PyTorch for training deep learning and RL models, distributed architectures for large-scale Bayesian inference, Trino and Athena for querying massive user-behavior data lakes, and dedicated GPU infrastructure. The full lifecycle of these AI capabilities is owned by the team—from academic paper translation and offline prototyping to deploying core algorithmic frameworks built to sustain ultra-low latency, real-time production environments evaluating tens of thousands of requests per second.

Your Mission & Who We Are Looking For:

  • PhD or equivalent research depth, with a production track record. You have a PhD in CS, Statistics, Math, or Physics (or an MSc with extensive industry research) and a track record of peer-reviewed publications in fields like Computational Advertising, Auction Theory, Mechanism Design, or Game Theory. You’ve spent 4+ years optimizing complex systems through automated algorithms in AdTech, marketplaces, or high-frequency trading.

  • You translate research into production, not just prototypes. You distill SOTA research into robust, production-ready code optimized for sub-millisecond latency. At adjoe, that means architecting sophisticated auction mechanics, real-time bidding engines, and allocation algorithms serving millions of requests across a stack built on 770 million users.

  • Deep expertise in Reinforcement Learning and Optimization. You have hands-on, deep theoretical and technical expertise in objective-based optimization, control theory, or RL applied specifically to bidding, pricing strategy, and budget pacing under extreme production constraints.

  • Mastering high-dimensional data at scale. Large-scale Bayesian inference and handling sparse, high-dimensional advertising data are core to your work. You are strongly proficient in Python and related stacks, and know exactly how to architect scalable data pipelines to feed real-time optimization models.

  • Raises the technical bar around them. You lead architectural debates, collaborate tightly with Product Managers and Engineers to map business goals to mathematical objective functions, mentor junior scientists, and drive the team’s research direction without needing a roadmap handed to you.

title: Senior Staff Product Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About hyperexponential (hx)

At hyperexponential, we're building the AI-powered platform that enables the world's most critical decisions in a $7 trillion industry - which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms.

Until now, insurance has been making billion-dollar decisions using outdated tools. We're changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision - helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence.

Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we're scaling globally - already trusted by nearly 50 of the world's largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx.

What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do - from building the world's first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates.

What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn't tied to title or tenure; it's defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you'll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure.

If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next.

About the Engineering team

At hyperexponential, engineering is at the heart of our mission to transform the insurance industry. Our engineers build and scale, enabling insurers to model complex risks and make smarter pricing decisions at speed. By combining deep technical expertise with creativity, the team pushes the boundaries of what’s possible in insurance technology.

Within engineering, our product teams are cross-functional, pairing frontend and backend engineers with designers and product managers. This enables end-to-end ownership of features, with engineers contributing across design, architecture, implementation, and testing. Collaboration is a core part of how we work, ensuring that every release is both technically sound and valuable to our users.

How we work

We're in the middle of a deliberate shift in how hx builds. Everyone in product development is a Builder, and the Product Engineer is the default unit of how we work.

We organise around problems, not permanent teams. Small pods, usually of two to four Product Engineers, form around the highest-value problem, own it end-to-end from discovery through to running it in production, and re-form as priorities change. Pods sit inside value streams, each owning a customer outcome and led by a Stream Lead who decides which problems the stream takes on and holds the bar for what ships. Your growth sits elsewhere: a Career Mentor owns your development and progression, so you can move to where the most important problem is without your career following the org chart.

We hire Product Engineers into hx, not into a fixed team, domain, or layer of the stack. You'll start in the stream where your strengths and our highest-value problems meet, and move as the problems move.

Product Engineers are T-shaped: deep expertise in software engineering, plus enough product and design judgement to make routine calls yourself. An embedded PM or designer raises a pod's ceiling on the hardest problems, but is never a gate between you and the customer. This is also a deliberately AI-native role, and one of the areas where we're moving fastest.

A pod of three owns its problem whole, which means going wherever it leads: front end, back end, data, or infrastructure. You don't need to be full-stack by trade, but you do need to be comfortable working outside your strongest layer.

The Product Engineer role is the same at every level. What scales is the size of the problem you own, how expensive your decisions are to reverse, and how far your judgement travels beyond your pod. At Level 5, that looks like this.

 

What you'll be doing

  • Taking a customer problem from discovery to production inside a pod, getting close to customers yourself, framing the problem, and shipping in small increments guided by real customer signal rather than internal opinion.

  • Directing AI agents to draft implementation, tests, and migrations, then reviewing, integrating, and hardening that work. You'll write intent precisely enough to brief both a teammate and an agent, and own correctness and maintainability regardless of how the first draft was produced.

  • Designing and delivering robust production systems where correctness, performance, and resource efficiency matter, with the tests and observability that make complex behaviour safe to evolve.

  • Working across the codebase wherever the problem leads, including areas your pod doesn't steward, with stewards looped in proportionate to the risk rather than handing work off and waiting.

  • Moving between pods, problems, and streams as priorities change, ramping fast on unfamiliar domains and leaving what you built running well behind you.

  • Taking full accountability for outcomes rather than just your code changes: raising risks early, and deciding rather than escalating.

What you'll need to have done

  • Built and shipped production systems end-to-end, from design through rollout, monitoring, and iteration, in settings where correctness, performance, and resource efficiency mattered.

  • Designed testing and observability that made complex behaviour understandable, debuggable, and safe to evolve.

  • Worked effectively in a polyglot environment, choosing the right tool for the problem and picking up unfamiliar languages, domains, and codebases fast. Strong systems experience, for example in Rust, C/C++, or Python, is valued, and we'll upskill you where there are gaps.

  • Shipped work outside your strongest layer of the stack when the problem needed it, picking up the front end, the data layer, or the infrastructure rather than waiting for someone else to.

  • Used AI tools as a serious part of how you build, with the judgement to direct, review, and stand behind what they produce.

  • Carried product and design judgement into your engineering work, shaping the solution rather than only implementing a spec and making sensible calls under ambiguity.

  • Owned outcomes beyond your immediate task, taking decisions rather than escalating them.

At Level 5 we'll also look for

  • Set technical direction on a hard problem other engineers built on, and been judged on whether you made them faster and safer rather than on the size of your team.

  • Held a quality bar across other people's work without becoming the gate they wait on.

  • Led cross-cutting or decoupling work that teams adopted because it was the best path, not because it was mandated.

 

You’re unlikely to thrive here if

  • You prefer following detailed instructions rather than experimenting and finding your own approach.

  • You are uncomfortable working directly with non-technical stakeholders to understand their challenges.

  • You avoid tackling ambiguous or open-ended problems where the solution isn’t obvious.

If reading our Culture Document leaves you feeling neutral rather than energised, hx may not be the place where you’ll do your best work. We’re building something that asks for commitment and conviction, and we want you to feel excited by the opportunity to grow with us.

 

Compensation

At hx, we’re committed to salary transparency. You’ll always have clarity on pay early in the process - our Talent Partner will share details with you during initial conversations - and we’re working towards publishing salary information for all roles globally.

Because we’re building at the intersection of technology/SaaS and insurance, our roles don’t always map neatly onto traditional benchmarks. Our approach is to design compensation that’s competitive in the market, fair across teams, and aligned with the impact our people make.

Benefits

£5,000 training and conference budget for individual and group development.

25 days of holiday plus 8 bank holidays (33 days total).

Company pension scheme via Penfold.

Mental health support and therapy via Spectrum.life.

Individual wellbeing allowance via Juno.

Private healthcare insurance through AXA.

Income protection and Life Insurance.

Cycle to Work Scheme.

title: Senior UX Design Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Orbital is the AI platform for real estate legal work.

Real estate shapes the world around us: our homes, our workplaces and our cultural landmarks. It’s the infrastructure that powers everyday life and is the world's largest asset class. Yet behind every single deal, real estate and legal teams work hard to navigate decades-old complexity; manually connecting documents, hidden obligations, geo-spatial context, and multiple parties into a path forward. We connect the legal and physical record, so that path is clearer than ever before. Our mission is to make real estate transactions faster, clearer, and less manual.

Here, you'll be part of changing how the deals behind the largest asset class get transacted, and will help shape the future of real estate.

A bit about us:

🚀 We’re building at the forefront of AI technology, without losing the deeply human expertise our clients depend on.

🏢 Orbital is built with former practising real estate lawyers and 250+ years of combined legal expertise. We're purpose-built for the complexity of real estate: accelerating due diligence, drafting and negotiation, and deal coordination with legal-grade precision.

💰 We've just raised a $60m Series B, led by Brighton Park Capital, to accelerate our global expansion – $75m raised to date.

🤝 We're trusted by 5,000+ real estate professionals, spanning UK Magic Circle and US Am Law 100 firms, to household names like M&S. Leading firms like BCLP, Orrick, Goodwin, Womble Bond Dickinson and Clifford Chance rely on Orbital to remove the busywork, freeing legal and real estate teams to focus on sharp judgment, standout client service, and closing deals faster.

💡 Working at Orbital means joining a bold, ambitious team, with the trust to take ownership and make a real impact from day one.

Role Overview 🔎

As a Senior UX Design Engineer, you'll own some of the hardest problems in our product and see them through until they're solved. You'll join our design team, three designers today and growing, and work inside our teams alongside product managers and our product, legal and AI engineers (our legal engineers are former real estate lawyers).

We've built a product that real estate lawyers rely on, and now we're also building for the businesses that own, occupy and develop property. You'll work across both, and much of it is new ground. Nobody here has the full answer yet, and that's the job: you'll get to know the people we build for, work out what they need from us, and build it.

This role is not about polishing screens. Our product is live and trusted by some of the most demanding real estate lawyers and property teams in the world. The hardest design problems here are not about how it looks. They are about whether people can trust it and get their work done.

Your starting point is the users, their work and the product: you notice what isn't working, decide what matters most, and see it through, from the first customer conversation to the version they use.

Here, designers build what they design. With AI coding tools, you'll build your designs into the product yourself, often live for customers the next day. When anyone can build, judgement matters most, and that is the heart of this role.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Find out who you're building for: talk to customers and map who does what inside law firms and property businesses. You'll do it together with the wider team.

  • Design how people work with our AI agents, which do real work on their behalf: what people hand over, how they check it and see where each answer came from, when they step in, what the agent asks about first and what it simply does, and how that shifts as AI improves.

  • Solve first, then refine: get to the right answer with rough, working versions in front of real people, and add polish once the problem is solved.

  • Build and ship interface changes yourself, using AI coding tools in our codebase. Engineering depth is welcome, not required.

  • Keep the product coherent while everyone builds: engineers, legal engineers, product people and coding agents all build interfaces here. Explain why one option beats another so people can make the call themselves, write it down as clear, reusable rules in the codebase for agents to follow, and evolve our design system so it all still feels like one product.


New to design engineering? 🌱

Design engineering is still a new kind of role, and most great candidates won't have had the title. If you're a strong designer with a good sense of product, and you're excited about building what you design, we'd love to hear from you. We'll help you make the shift.

You should apply if: ✍️

  • You go after the hard problem, not the surface one, and own it until it's solved. You judge your work by whether people use it, rely on it and come back.

  • You're comfortable not knowing yet. You form a view, test it with real people, and change it when they tell you something different.

  • You bring design excellence and strong product sense: hierarchy, layout, type, copy, states, navigation and flow, and a clear view of what is worth building.

  • You've designed for experts, people who know their field better than any designer will. You reach for patterns they already know, and never talk down to them.

  • You can say why. You make a call and ship it without waiting for sign-off, explain it in words others can reuse, and change your mind for a good reason. You'd rather guide people than overrule them.

  • You're genuinely excited about AI: what it can do, where it's heading and how to get the most out of it. You already design or build with AI tools, at work or in your own projects, and you want to help shape how AI changes the working day of property professionals.

  • You want to learn how property and legal work gets done. No legal or property knowledge needed.

  • You have owned and shipped product design work, and can walk us through the problem, not just the result.

Desirable

  • Experience designing AI products: showing the reasoning behind an answer, signalling confidence, and letting people steer an agent.

  • Experience in legal tech, fintech, compliance or another field where precision and professional accountability shape every decision.

  • Side projects, hackathons or things you've built outside work.

  • Design systems and accessibility experience.

  • Experience at an early-stage or fast-scaling startup, where there was no established process and you helped create one.

Reasons we might not be for you

  • The pace is fast and our ways of working keep evolving. If you prefer clear boundaries between design and engineering, this may not be the role for you.

  • You'll spend most of your time on hard, unsolved problems and on building, not on perfecting polished mock-ups.

Why you'll love it here

  • You'll join a collaborative, highly ambitious team where the standard is high and the ownership is real.

  • You'll help shape how design works in a company where AI builds alongside people.

  • Your work is used by lawyers and property teams on real deals and real buildings.

How we hire

  1. A short call with our recruiter.

  2. A 30-minute video call with the hiring manager.

  3. A design task.

  4. A 90-minute panel: you'll walk us through your task, then meet people from across the company.

  5. A final conversation with our CTO.

Read more

  • How we think about design engineering: Design After the Leap

  • Everyone Ships Code Now

  • Our Product Engineering Guide

Benefits 🌟

  • 💰 Competitive salary

  • 🏢 Equity options in a fast-growing startup

  • 🌴 25 days holiday plus bank holidays

  • 📚 £1,000 personal development budget and learning opportunities

  • 🏥 Company pension, healthcare, eye care and enhanced parental leave

  • 🍔 Free lunch on Wednesdays, and a Deliveroo budget for late nights

  • 🚲 Cycle-to-work scheme

  • 🎉 Regular team off-sites, shared lunches and social events

  • 🧑‍💻 We believe in flexibility, but we're big on working together in person. This role is based in our London office, several days a week.

🔒 Security is everyone’s responsibility at Orbital. We ask all team members to follow our security policies, complete regular awareness training, and handle sensitive data with care in line with ISO 27001 standards. Spot something unusual? Reporting risks or incidents quickly helps us maintain the strong culture of security and compliance we all depend on.

💡 At Orbital, we’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We especially welcome applications from people who are traditionally underrepresented in tech. Even if you don’t meet every single requirement, or if the right role isn’t listed yet, we’d still love to hear from you.

💰 This hiring range is a reasonable estimate of the base pay range for this position at the time of posting. Pay is based on several factors, which may include job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and business requirements.

Everyone who works with Orbital goes through background screening before they start. It's part of how we keep Orbital secure, for the people who work here and for the client information we're trusted with.

title: Social Media Manager (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
DEINE MISSION

Lust, Ernährung neu zu denken? Bei yfood machen wir seit 2017 gutes Essen alltagstauglich – ausgewogen, praktisch und richtig lecker. Mit unseren Produkten haben wir eine eigene Kategorie geformt: Smart Food. In ganz Europa unterwegs, rasant wachsend und immer auf der Suche nach neuen Ideen. Wenn du Teil eines dynamischen Teams sein möchtest, das die Lebensmittelbranche revolutioniert, dann bist du bei yfood genau richtig.

Du postest eh schon jeden Tag. Mach daraus deinen Job.
Du scrollst nicht nur – du weißt, warum ein Video durch die Decke geht und warum das nächste floppt. Genau dieses Gespür suchen wir. Der Großteil unserer Reichweite entsteht über Creator, nicht über uns selbst – und weil du selbst postest, sprichst du ihre Sprache und zeigst auf unseren eigenen Kanälen das Beste davon.
Die Rolle ist global gedacht: Du denkst unsere Social-Strategie nicht nur für DACH, sondern sparrst dich dabei auch mit unseren internationalen Marketing Leads, zum Beispiel dem Head of Marketing in UK.

Die Position ist zunächst als Elternzeitvertretung auf zwei Jahre befristet.

Deine Aufgaben als Social Media Manager

  • Strategie, global gedacht: Du entwickelst unsere Social Media Strategie nicht im stillen Kämmerlein in München, sondern im Austausch mit unseren internationalen Marketing Leads. Du hinterfragst HQ-Vorgaben, wenn UK oder ein anderer Markt etwas anderes braucht, und sorgst dafür, dass Strategie und lokale Realität zusammenpassen.
  • TikTok ist dein zweites Zuhause: Du erkennst Trends, bevor sie durch sind, und weißt sofort, welche Formate zu yfood passen und welche nicht. Instagram und YouTube bespielst du mit, aber TikTok ist dein Hauptrevier.
  • Deine eigenen Kanäle, dein Anspruch: Du verantwortest unsere DACH-Kanäle und zeigst dort die stärksten Creator Videos, Produktlaunches und informativen Content. Qualität vor Quantität.
  • Du sprichst Creator-Sprache: Weil du selbst Content machst, schreibst du Briefings, die Raum für eigene Ideen lassen, und gibst Feedback, das Creator tatsächlich weiterbringt, statt sie nur zufriedenzustellen.
  • Du machst Markenmomente viral: Große Produktlaunches, außergewöhnliche Events und Creator Kampagnen bringst du auf Social und bist dabei auch in den Kommentaren mittendrin statt nur Beobachter.
  • Daten sind dein Vibe-Check: Du planst im Redaktionskalender, schaust auf Watch Time, Saves, Shares und Hook Rate und machst konsequent mehr von dem, was funktioniert.
  • Kein Soloprojekt: Du arbeitest eng mit Content & Comms, Influencer & Creator, Creative, Brand Activation, Performance und E-Commerce zusammen. Social ist bei uns nicht einfach nur ein Kanal, sondern das Betriebssystem.

DAS MACHT DICH AUS

Deine Qualifikationen als Social Media Manager

  • Du bist selbst Social: Aktiv auf TikTok, idealerweise mit eigenem Content – zeig uns gern deinen Kanal. Instagram und YouTube kennst du ebenfalls aus dem Effeff.
  • 2+ Jahre Erfahrung im Social Media Marketing – ob Brand, Agentur, Start-up oder als Creator. Food, FMCG oder Lifestyle sind ein Plus, kein Muss.
  • Plattform-Fluency: Sounds, Duett/Stitch, Green Screen, Reels, Carousels, Shorts – du weißt aus eigener Erfahrung, was wo funktioniert und warum.
  • Creator-Verständnis: Du weißt, wie Creator ticken, und formulierst Briefings und Feedback so, dass sie auch ankommen.
  • Analyse mit Attitüde: Watch Time, Saves, Shares, Hook-Rate sind für dich Steuerrad, kein Selbstzweck.
  • Deutsch & Englisch fließend.

WAS UNS ANTREIBT

Wir sind ein bisschen anders – und genau das macht uns aus

  • Leidenschaft – Wir brennen für das, was wir tun. Voller Energie, voller Optimismus, immer hungrig nach Neuem.
  • Verantwortung – Heißt für uns: Füreinander einstehen, Verantwortung übernehmen und alles geben, wenn’s drauf ankommt.
  • Professionalität – Wir nehmen unsere Arbeit ernst – uns selbst aber nicht zu sehr. Wir sind offen, direkt und immer auf Augenhöhe. Kein Bullshit, kein Ego. Nur Team.
  • Innovation – Wir denken lieber „Warum eigentlich nicht?“ statt „Das war schon immer so.“ Wir lieben neue Ideen, unkonventionelle Wege – und bleiben nie stehen.

(WH)yfood?

Was wir dir bieten: Unsere Benefits

  • Wir fördern Chancengleichheit und schätzen Vielfalt. Wir verpflichten uns, ein integratives Umfeld für alle Mitarbeitende zu schaffen.
  • yfood wächst international: Obwohl Deutschland unsers „Home Base“ ist, haben wir mit unseren internationalen Märkten ein dynamisches und buntes Umfeld geschaffen, in dem viele spannende Themen auf Dich warten.
  • Agilität ist uns wichtig. Daher arbeiten wir in einem hybriden Arbeitsmodell und bieten dir die Möglichkeit mit Workation aus dem EU-Ausland zu arbeiten.
  • Urlaub ist wichtig. Daher erhältst du bei uns 30 Tage bezahlten Urlaub im Jahr.
  • yfood hält dich fit. Mit einer subventionierten Mitgliedschaft bei EGYM-Wellpass kannst du dir für nur 29€ im Monat Gutes tun. Dazu bieten wir im Rahmen unseres Gesundheitsmanagements & Healthy@yfood Workshops und Aktionen (z.B. Yoga, Breathwork, Soccer, Pickleball) an.
  • Gemeinsam Gutes tun. Mit unserem yforgood Day erhältst du einen bezahlten Tag pro Jahr, um gemeinsam mit deinem Team eine soziale, gemeinnützige oder ökologische Initiative zu unterstützen.
  • Weg vom Fleck. Wir steuern 30€ zu deinem ÖPNV-Ticket bei und bieten dir über JobRad die Möglichkeit, vergünstigt ein Fahrrad zu leasen.
  • Trainiere deine Geschmacksnerven. Bei uns ist jeder der Lust hat Teil unseres Sensory-Teams. Probiere also neue Produkte, Sorten oder Geschmäcker vor allen anderen. Ansonsten gibt es so viel yfood wie du tragen kannst, natürlich auch für dich gratis.
  • Als Start-Up hat man oft mit Klischees zu kämpfen. Manche sind aber auch wahr. Daher gibt es bei uns natürlich auch einen Obstkorb, deinen gratis Koffein-Kick oder das stille Wässerchen.
  • Come as you are. Ob im Anzug oder Einhorn-Onesie. Einen Dresscode kennen wir nicht.

KONTAKT

Katharina Bauer
Senior Talent Acquisition Manager

Chancengleichheit für alle
yfood steht für die Chancengleichheit aller ein. Wir begrüßen und feiern Vielfalt und setzen uns dafür ein, ein inklusives Arbeitsumfeld für alle Mitarbeiter:innen zu schaffen. Wir stehen allen Personengruppen offen, unabhängig von Alter, Hautfarbe, Herkunft, Ethnizität, Religion, Geschlecht, sexueller Orientierung, Geschlechtsidentität und/oder -ausdruck, Familienstand oder anderen gesetzlich geschützten Merkmalen.

title: Social Media Manager (Working Student) // AI Music Video Platform
descriptionHtml:
Neural Frames is a leading AI music video generator, turning any song into a fully produced music video in minutes. We’re bootstrapped, profitable, and generating more than $7M in annualized revenue. Our ambition is to build a category-defining company that helps tens of millions of audio creators visualize and promote their work.

Our product makes video and our users make thousands of them, so we’re never short of material. Our own social channels don’t show it yet. They’re shared between a few people on top of their other work, and we think they could be much better with one person who owns them.

As our working student for social media, you’ll own our social channels day to day: posting on TikTok, Instagram and YouTube Shorts, writing captions in our voice, bringing ideas for what we post next, and replying to our users in the comments and on Discord and Reddit. You’ll work closely with the founder and with our marketing team across content, creators, design and paid.

Within weeks you’ll see whether your ideas show up in the numbers, and you’ll learn how content turns into signups and revenue at a fast-growing startup.

Tasks

  • Currently enrolled at a university in Germany, and able to work around 20 hours per week during the semester

  • You spend a lot of time on TikTok and Instagram and know what's going on there: you notice trends early and can tell why one video gets 400 views and another gets 4 million

  • You write well in English: short, clear and funny when it fits, and you pick up a brand voice quickly

  • You're full of ideas: show you our product and a few user videos, and you'll have ten things we could post

  • You've run a social account before, your own or one for a club, band or small brand, and can show it to us

  • You can do basic video edits in CapCut or similar. You don't need to be a video editor

  • Reliable: your hours are flexible and you plan them around university, but you check in on our channels once a day and keep a steady posting schedule

  • You like talking to people online, and you're friendly and patient when someone needs help

  • AI tools are a normal part of how you work

  • You're into music, AI and internet culture

  • You're based in Berlin and can join us in the office at least one day per week

Requirements

  • Currently enrolled at a university in Germany, and able to work around 15-20 hours per week during the semester

  • You already make content: you've run your own account or one for a club, band or small brand, and can show what you made

  • Strong instincts for short-form content: you can tell why one video gets 400 views and another gets 4 million

  • You can make the content yourself: script, edit, caption and post (CapCut, Premiere or similar)

  • Reliable and organized: you can plan your hours around university and keep a steady posting schedule

  • Curious about numbers: you want to know which posts lead to signups, not just likes

  • AI is part of how you work: you use AI tools to ideate, edit and repurpose faster

  • Genuinely into music, AI and internet culture

  • You're based in Berlin and can join us in the office at least two days per week

Bonus points:

  • You've grown your own or a club's account to a real audience

  • You study marketing, media, communications, film or music

  • You make music, or you're close to the music scene

  • You're comfortable on camera

  • You edit video well, beyond the basics

How we measure success

Our channels post on a steady schedule, sound like us, and pick up on what's happening while it still matters. Users who comment or ask for help get a friendly, useful answer within a day.

Over time, we want channels musicians follow, share and talk about, and that make them want to try Neural Frames themselves.

Benefits

Flexible hours around your studies, bi-weekly team lunches, regular team events, an annual summer offsite, learning & development support, productivity tools, and a real path into a full-time growth role after graduating.

Neural Frames is dedicated to creating an equitable, inclusive, and supportive work environment that brings people together from diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. Our strength is in our differences. We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome all applicants as we're committed to promoting a culture of opportunity for all.

title: Software Developer - Senior Consultant

descriptionHtml:
Ready to work somewhere that cares more about how you build software than how fast you can ship it?

At Opencast, we don’t measure developers by the number of tickets you complete. We care about engineering craft, clean design and thoughtful problem-solving. Opencast consultants deliver in complex environments, pairing often and working with others who take pride in doing things properly: TDD, emerging design, refactoring and leaving code better than they found it. We build software we are proud of, and our clients trust us not just to code but to think, challenge and guide. If you value simple and robust solutions and want a role where your judgment matters as much as your keyboard, this could be a great fit for you.

The role

Software developers at Opencast care about building products right and combine their own experience and approach with our company values. They are tech agnostic, have expertise in agile methodologies, eXtreme programming practices and use industry-leading programming languages to deliver agile transformation. Our approach to software development is collaborative, focused on keeping things simple, and we use test driven development and pair programming as best practice. Working with clients and key stakeholders is a crucial part of a consultancy role. Our developers are inclusive team players that listen, collaborate, can positively challenge and manage expectations when needed but most of all are always willing to teach and help others. Leaving a client with improved ways of working, working technology and a good experience from discovery through to live is the priority. The role is varied, technical, never confined to any one provider or solution and there are always opportunities for learning and development.

Requirements

This role involves weekly on-site work, and you’ll be required to travel regularly to client locations across the UK. We’re looking for people who value in-person collaboration, enjoy building strong relationships, and are passionate about delivering solutions that make a real difference for our clients. Due to the nature of this role, you must either hold active Security Check (SC) clearance or be eligible and willing to undergo the clearance process. SC clearance is granted in line with UK Government security vetting requirements. Typically, applicants must have UK citizenship and have lived continuously in the UK for at least the past five years, with no single absence exceeding 28 consecutive days. Nationality and immigration status may also be considered as part of the vetting process. We are unable to progress applications from candidates who do not meet these requirements. If you are unsure whether you meet the eligibility criteria, we encourage you to review the guidance or discuss this with us before applying. We are recruiting for multiple positions, with opportunities available immediately and in the coming months. If you are interested in joining Opencast, we encourage you to apply.

Essential experience

To succeed in this role, you’ll have experience as a Senior Software Developer and be able to demonstrate, with tangible examples, that you can:
  • Lead the design and delivery of high-quality, user-centred services using Java or Scala.
  • Use a range of technologies, including languages such as Kotlin, Ruby or JavaScript, to solve real problems in the right way.
  • Design and build scalable, maintainable systems, considering performance, security and accessibility.
  • Build quality into your work by embedding strong testing practices throughout delivery.
  • Deliver complex digital services, supporting others to do the same.
  • Explore and adopt new technologies, helping teams learn and continuously improve.
  • Work within agile teams to deliver value early and often, adapting to changing needs.

Essential consulting skills

In addition to software engineering skills, there are essential core skills you’ll need to be an Opencast consultant. You’ll need to demonstrate how you:

  • Shape and guide delivery by driving clear, prioritised backlogs aligned to user and client needs.
  • Lead on technical delivery, supporting others and ensuring a high-quality approach from idea through to implementation.
  • Set and evolve testing approaches that build confidence and improve outcomes across the team.
  • Encourage collaborative ways of working, including pairing and mobbing, to share knowledge and strengthen delivery.
  • Build trusted relationships with clients and stakeholders, communicating openly and helping shape the right solutions.
  • Lead technical conversations in discovery and delivery, bringing clarity to complex problems.
  • Support and develop others through coaching, mentoring and sharing good practice.
  • Respond positively to change, showing resilience, adaptability and a commitment to continuous improvement.
  • Bring multidisciplinary teams together, aligning stakeholders and disciplines to shape solutions and deliver value for users.
During the interview process, we’ll ask questions to explore your experience across these areas.

Salary

£61,001 - £78,000 per annum.

What we offer


A competitive package including a 7% employer pension contribution, share options, and a discretionary bonus. You’ll also benefit from 25 days’ holiday and access to 3 annual “life happens” days to support unexpected situations. We provide wellbeing support, ongoing professional development, volunteering opportunities, and the chance to be part of a genuinely supportive team.

Where you’ll work


This role requires regular on-site attendance at our HQ, hub offices, and client sites, as well as the ability to work from home. Applicants must be able to travel to offices and client sites across the UK as part of their normal working arrangements, as travel is essential for fulfilling the responsibilities of the role.

We include you

We welcome candidates from all identities, attributes, ways of thinking and backgrounds to thrive in a career at Opencast. Our aim is for the diversity of our people to be reflected in the solutions we deliver, to help create a fairer society for all.

Interview


Interviews will be conducted via Microsoft Teams. We’re happy to make adjustments to support your needs.

title: Software Engineer, Agent
descriptionHtml:
About us

Sierra is the leading platform for customer-facing AI agents, working with many of the world's biggest brands — including The GAP, Rocket Mortgage, SoFi, Sutter Health, and SoftBank — to transform how they serve customers and grow their businesses. We are primarily an in-person company based in San Francisco, with growing offices across North America, Europe, and Asia.

We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and a commitment to balancing Family along the way. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do.

Sierra was co-founded by Bret Taylor and Clay Bavor who first met while working together at Google over 20 years ago. Bret currently serves as Chairman of the Board of Open AI. Previously, he was co-CEO of Salesforce and CTO of Facebook. Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs.

What you’ll do

  • Design and deliver production-grade AI agents: You'll build and ship highly performant, reliable, and intuitive AI agents that are central, mission-critical and drive revenue directly to Sierra's growth. These aren't prototypes—they are powerful, scalable systems running in production environments across industries like finance, healthcare, and commerce.

  • Drive the Agent Development Life Cycle (ADLC): You'll have complete ownership and autonomy from initial pilot through deployment and continuous iteration. You'll be responsible for building, tuning, and evolving AI agents in production environments, defining the standard for ADLC best practices along the way.

  • Partner with large enterprises and cutting-edge startups: You’ll work directly with leaders at some of the world’s largest enterprises to understand their most pressing business challenges, and build AI agents that transform how they operate at scale. You'll also partner with the most cutting-edge startups, embedding AI agents across their entire business stack to drive innovation and efficiency.

  • Build the future of the platform: Your direct work with customers will guide the evolution of Sierra's core platform. You'll surface unmet needs, prototype new tools and features, and collaborate with research, product, and platform to shape the future of AI agent development and Sierra's product.

Example projects

These are some examples of projects that engineers on our team have worked on recently:

  • Design and build AI agents for large telecommunications and media companies that consistently outperform human agents in managing subscription churn

  • Develop and refine AI agents capable of navigating complex customer interactions, like troubleshooting a broken device and personalising product recommendations

  • Create generalisable AI agent frameworks tailored for industry-specific use cases. See some examples in our financial services blog!

  • Facilitate design partnerships for new product initiatives, such as new agent architectures, self-service capabilities, and generative agent development

  • Experiment with the latest voice models and figure out how to integrate them at scale to enterprise-grade customers

What you'll bring

  • Experience building and scaling end-to-end production systems

  • Strong technical problem-solving skills, especially in fast-changing, ambiguous environments

  • A builder and tinkerer’s mindset with high agency - you find creative ways to overcome obstacles and ship

  • Comfort working directly with customers to understand their needs and solve real-world problems

  • Excellent communication skills - clear, direct, and persuasive across technical and non-technical audiences

Even better...

  • Experience building or deploying AI/LLM systems in production

  • Have been a founder or founding engineer - you know what it means to balance craft, ownership, and speed

  • Familiarity with tools that power today's AI agents: eval frameworks, agent tooling, RAG pipelines, and prompt engineering

  • Prior experience with React, TypeScript, and/or Go

  • Previous roles where you interfaced with customers or led technical projects with external stakeholders

Our values

  • Trust: We do the right thing, even when no one is looking, and even when it’s hard. When we screw up, we take accountability, fully and completely. We act in such a way that if all of our actions were completely visible to our customers, we would be proud.

  • Customer Obsession: Our entire business is designed to ensure every agent built on Sierra succeeds, and that we are accountable to our customers and their success. We do whatever it takes to make our customers successful, and we go the extra mile in how we show up as a partner with unreasonable hospitality.

  • Craftsmanship: A great company is the aggregation of thousands of things done well. As they say, “how you do anything is how you do everything”. Most important is craftsmanship in building agents that are so great that people thank them at the end of a call. That’s the standard.

  • Intensity: We operate with urgency, and we want to win. We are never complacent. We fight to win every deal, big or small, using the full force of the company. And when we fail, we talk about it openly and without blame so we succeed the next time.

  • Family: We know that balance and intensity are compatible, and we model it in our actions and processes. We work hard, and turn on the afterburners when needed. But we pick up our parents at the airport when they’re visiting from out of town. We go to our kids’ events. And we show up for one another, in moments of celebration and hardship.

What we offer

We want our benefits to reflect our values and offer the following to full-time employees:

  • Flexible (unlimited) paid time off

  • Medical, dental, and vision benefits for you and your family

  • Life insurance and disability benefits

  • Retirement plan dependent on country of employment

  • Parental leave

  • Fertility and family building benefits

  • Lunch, as well as delicious snacks and coffee to keep you energized when working onsite

  • Discretionary benefit stipend giving people the ability to spend where it matters most

  • Free alphorn lessons

These benefits are further detailed in Sierra's policies, may vary by region and employment type, and are subject to change at any time, consistent with the terms of any applicable compensation or benefits plans. Eligible full-time employees can participate in Sierra's equity plans subject to the terms of the applicable plans and policies.

Be you, with us

We're working to bring the transformative power of AI to every organization in the world. To do so, it is important to us that the diversity of our employees represents the diversity of our customers. title: Software Engineer (C++/C#)
descriptionHtml:
The financial industry is growing at a record pace, but our data providers are still stuck in the past — with cumbersome onboarding processes, complicated APIs, slow infrastructure, and expensive licensing costs.

Databento is the market data platform for modern finance. The company provides real-time and historical data across futures, options, and equities through a unified API. By owning the entire market data stack end-to-end, Databento is the first platform of its kind to combine the performance and reliability demanded by the world's leading trading firms with a dramatically simpler developer experience. Our team includes alumni of Two Sigma, Citadel Securities, Flow Traders, IMC, Tower Research, Jump Trading, HRT, Jane Street, and SIG.

We're looking for a midlevel or senior IC to join our core engineering team. You'll be responsible for implementing and maintaining our C# client library, and also working alongside our core engineering team on the most performance-sensitive parts of our codebase.

Responsibilities

  • Own and maintain our C# client library, ensuring it is robust, well-tested, and easy for external users to integrate with.
  • Design, develop, and maintain high-performance server applications in C++.
  • Write message parsers and feed handlers for direct market data feeds from trading venues.
  • Optimize existing codebase for high throughput (millions of messages per second, up to 40+ gigabits) and low latency (measured in nanoseconds).
  • Implement tools and libraries for petabyte-scale data processing and analysis.
  • Collaborate with the systems team to implement best practices for build, deployment, CI/CD.
  • Implement monitoring and improve application uptime.
  • Ensure smooth feature rollouts and updates.

Preferred background

  • 5+ years of full-time software engineering experience, preferably at a trading firm, tech company, or high-growth startup.
  • Strong proficiency in both C++ and C#.
  • Experience with Java is a plus.
  • Experience designing APIs with a strong focus on intuitive, developer-friendly interfaces.
  • Familiarity with open source best practices, including release management, versioning, changelogs, issue triage, and backwards compatibility.
  • Knowledge of systems programming, algorithms, data structures, multithreading, networked I/O, serialization, CPU architecture, kernel, and compilers.
  • Experience working with multiprocess environments.
  • Comfortable with lldb/gdb.
  • Good communication skills and work ethic for a remote workplace.
  • An interest in low-level optimization and performance engineering.
  • An interest in financial data or algorithmic trading.

We offer health, dental, disability, and life insurance benefits, as well as 401(k) matching for full-time employees. We accommodate 100% remote work, with teammates living around the globe and paid in their local currency.

The base salary range for this role is $150,000–$250,000, benchmarked to Tier 1 locations in each country. Total compensation may also include bonuses, commissions, and equity, depending on the role.

Notice about phishing scams

Be cautious of phishing scams impersonating Databento that offer fake job interviews and request purchases. Official emails come only from us.greenhouse-mail.io (our ATS). Any other domains (e.g., databento-careers.com, databento.online) are fraudulent.

title: Software Engineer, Full Stack - UK
descriptionHtml:
About Ema

Ema builds AI Employees for HR, IT and Finance. Our AI Employees take on the busy work across the employee experience, from recruiting, onboarding and benefits to IT support, invoice processing and payroll, so people can spend their time on work that needs them. Founded by former executives from Google, Coinbase, Flipkart, and Okta, our team includes engineers from premier tech companies and graduates of Stanford, MIT, UC Berkeley, CMU, and IITs.

We are backed by industry leading investors including Accel, Naspers/Prosus, Creaegis, Section32, and angels like Sheryl Sandberg and Dustin Moskovitz. Headquartered in Silicon Valley and with offices in London, Bangalore and Vancouver, Ema is at the frontier of what Agentic AI can do in production. We ship real systems that run real business processes at scale.

The Role

You'll be an engineer who builds AI agents in production, sitting close to the customers who depend on them.

This is a full-stack engineering job with an unusually short distance between your code and someone's actual workday. You'll write Go and Python, design schemas, build evals, and present your solution to a senior executive at an enterprise - often in the same week.

What You'll Do

  • Design and ship production agents. You'll build agents that are mission-critical from day one: embedded in Teams, Slack, intranets, voice lines, and email, taking real actions against SAP, ServiceNow, Workday, and a long tail of systems nobody has heard of. These run at enterprise volume under enterprise scrutiny.

  • Own the full lifecycle. Discovery, build, eval, launch, and the unglamorous months afterward where an agent goes from good to genuinely reliable.

  • Work directly with the people whose problem it is. You'll sit with leaders at global enterprises, extract the process from their heads, and decide what should be an agent, what should be a workflow, and what should stay human.

  • Push your work back into the platform. The best patterns you find in the field become part of Ema's core product - new connectors, new agent primitives, new tooling. You'll surface unmet needs and prototype the fix, working with product and platform engineering to make it general.

Example Projects

Recent work by our engineers:

  • Built the orchestration layer for a 200,000+ employee IT services firm spanning 65 countries, unifying HR, IT, and payroll into a single interface across SAP, ServiceNow, and Teams.

  • Rebuilt a recruiting firm's core stack - sourcing, screening, ranked shortlists - cutting time-to-hire by 67% and retiring their legacy ATS along the way.

  • Cut first-response time from two hours to under 90 seconds for an e-commerce logistics platform, including live carrier-site lookups, and held SLAs through peak holiday volume with no temporary hiring.

What You'll Bring

  • Experience building and scaling end-to-end production systems, with 5+ years of relevant engineering work

  • Strong backend fundamentals - algorithms, data modeling, and comfort in more than one language, Python and Go especially

  • Proven problem-solving in fast-changing, ambiguous environments where the requirements arrive in a meeting rather than a ticket

  • A builder's mindset and high agency - you find a way to ship rather than waiting for the blocker to clear

  • Comfort working directly with customers

  • Clear, direct communication with technical and non-technical audiences alike

Even Better

  • You've built or deployed LLM systems in production, and have opinions about evals

  • Familiarity with agent tooling, RAG pipelines, MCP, and prompt engineering as an engineering discipline rather than a trick

  • You've been a founder or founding engineer, and know how to balance craft against speed

  • Experience integrating enterprise applications - HRIS, ITSM, ERP, ticketing - and the authentication that guards them

  • You've worked with distributed, global teams and multi-tenant SaaS environments

You will own the backend that our optimization runs on. Your tasks include:

Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.

Join Roku as an Engineering Intern, where your passion for technology and creativity will drive our success. We offer a paid 12-week internship, running from June to early September 2027. 

As an Engineering Intern, you’ll be assigned a scoped project with one of our engineering teams, working on real Roku products and platforms. We’ll match you to the team that best fits your skills and interests, so you may work on anything from user interfaces and embedded or platform software to automation, developer tooling and AI-powered workflows.  

Our teams work across a variety of languages and technologies and embrace GenAI-assisted development to boost productivity and quality.

We’re excited if you have

  • Proficiency in one or more of C, C++, Python, JavaScript, TypeScript or similar languages, ideally with projects, open source or hackathon work beyond your coursework. 
  • A solid grounding in computer science fundamentals such as data structures, algorithms, and operating systems or networking concepts. 
  • Hands-on experience using GenAI tools in your coursework, projects or personal work. 
  • Strong problem-solving and technical communication abilities. 
  • Proactive mindset with passion for continuous learning and fast iteration.

How will I use AI at Roku? 

At Roku, we don’t just use AI, we work with it. AI agents and smart tools help power drafts, analysis, and repetitive workflows, while our people bring direction, judgment, and accountability. We’re looking for curious, adaptable builders who can show how they’ve used AI or automation to move faster, raise the bar, and scale their impact. 

We value your AI skills if you have built fluency across the agentic engineering toolchain — coding harnesses like Claude Code or Cursor, MCP servers, custom skills, or agent frameworks. You know how to drive an agent, verify its output, and ramp on an unfamiliar codebase with an agent helping you. 

What's Roku's approach to hybrid working?

Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance.

What are some of the benefits?
